text.body: kauśīdyavīryotsāhanāvadāna oṃ namaḥ śrīsarvabuddhabodhisatvebhyaḥ yaḥ śrīmāñchrīghano loke saddharmaṃ samupādiśat | śāsanāni trilokeṣu jayantu tasya sarvadā || 1.1{1} || athāśoko mahārājaḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ pramoditaḥ | upaguptaṃ yatiṃ natvā punarevamabhāṣata || 1.2{2} || bhadanta śrotumichāmi punaranyatsubhāṣitam | tadyathā guruṇādiṣṭaṃ tathā deṣṭuṃ ca me'rhati || 1.3{3} || iti saṃprārthitaṃ rājñā śrutvā so'rhan yatiḥ sudhīḥ | upagupto narendraṃ taṃ samālokyaivamādiśat || 1.4{3 } || sādhu śṛṇu mahārāja yathā me guruṇoditam | tathāhaṃ te pravakṣyāmi śrutvā cāpyanumodaya || 1.5{4} || purāsau bhagavān buddhaḥ śākyasiṃho dayānidhiḥ | dharmarājo jagacchāstā sarvajñaḥ sugato jinaḥ || 1.6{5} || sarvavidyākalābhijñaḥ ṣaḍabhijño munīśvaraḥ | mārajillokavinnātho vināyakastathāgataḥ || 1.7{6} || śravastyāṃ jetakāraṇye mahodyāne manorame | anāthapiṇḍadākhyasya gṛhasthasya mahātmanaḥ || 1.8{7} || nānāvṛkṣaiḥ samāpanne nānāpuṣpapraśobhitaiḥ | nānāphalabharānamraiḥ kalpapādapasannibhaiḥ || 1.9{8} || aṣṭāṅgaguṇasaṃpannajalaiḥ padmotpalādibhiḥ | puṣpaiśca paripūrṇābhiḥ puṣkariṇībhirāśrite || 1.10{9} || nānājantugaṇaiścāpi mithasnehanivandhitaiḥ | nānāpakṣigaṇaiścāpi saṃrāvairupasevite || 1.11{10} || tasmin divyamanoramya ārāme pariśobhite | puṇyakṣetre jināvāse vihāre maṇimaṇḍite || 1.12{11} || śrāvakairbhikṣubhiḥ sārddhaṃ bodhisatvagaṇairapi | sarvasatvahitārthena tasthau dharmaṃ prakāśitum || 1.13{12} || evaṃ tatra samāsīnaṃ saṃbuddhaṃ dharmadeśinam | dṛṣṭvā dharmottamaṃ śrotuṃ sarve lokāḥ samāyayuḥ || 1.14{13} || devā daityāśca siddhāśca yakṣagaṃdharvakinnarāḥ | grahā vidyādharāścāpi nāgāśca garuḍā api || 1.15{14} || sarve'pi lokapālāśca munayaśca maharṣayaḥ | brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyāścāpi vaiśyāśca maṃtriṇo janāḥ || 1.16{15} || amātyāḥ sādhavaḥ śūdrāḥ sārthavāhā mahājanāḥ | dhanino vaṇijaścāpi gṛhasthāḥ paurikā api || 1.17{16} || tathā jānapadāścāpi grāmyāḥ kārpaṭikā api | evamanye'pi satvāśca saddharmaśravaṇārthinaḥ || 1.18{17} || pūjāpaṃcopahārāṇi gṛhītvā bhaktisaṃyutāḥ | saddharmaṃ saugataṃ śrotumanumodya samāyayuḥ || 1.19{18} || sarve tatra praviṣṭāste dṛṣṭvā taṃ sugataṃ jinam | vismitānaṃditāḥ pūjāṃ kṛtvā natvā yathākramam || 1.20{19} || sarve tatra samāsīnāḥ parivṛtāḥ puraskṛtāḥ | taṃ dṛṣṭvā sadguruṃ dharmaṃ śrotuṃ tasthuḥ samāhitāḥ || 1.21{20} || athāsau bhagavān dṛṣṭvā lokān sarvān samāhitān | ādimadhyāntakalyāṇaṃ dideśa dharmamuttamam || 1.22{21} || evaṃ nityamasau nāthaḥ sarvasatvahitārthikaḥ | dharmaṃ prakāśayan loke tasthau bhānurivoditaḥ || 1.23{22} || tasmiṃśca samaye tatra śrāvastyāṃ sanmahājanaḥ | āḍhyaḥ śreṣṭhī mahābhogo vistīrṇasuparigrahaḥ || 1.24{23} || śrāddho bhadrāśayo dhīmān sarvabandhusuhṛtpriyaḥ | tīrthikaśrāvako mānī babhūva dhanagarvitaḥ || 1.25{24} || tadāsau sundarīṃ bhāryyāṃ kuladharmasamānikām | nītvā kāmaguṇāsakto reme nityaṃ tayā saha || 1.26{25} || tasyaivaṃ ramatastasyāṃ bhāryāyāṃ sucirādapi | putro na duhitā vāpi nodbabhūva kathaṃ cana || 1.27{26} || tadaputro gṛhastho'sau putrābhidarśanotsukaḥ | kapolaṃ svakare dhṛtvā vyacintayadraho gataḥ || 1.28{27} || aho daivānna me putraḥ putrī vādyāpi nāsti yat | tanme syuḥ saṃpado vyarthāyāsāṃ bhoktā na vidyate || 1.29{29!} || kiṃ mamaitairdhanai ratnaiḥ kevalaṃ duhkhasādhanaiḥ | yeṣāṃ bhoktā na vidyeta vyarthaṃ mayā hyupārjitam || 1.30{30} || hyaputrasya jagacchūnyaṃ saṃsāre niḥsukhaṃ mama | yato na varddhate dharmastajjanmāpi ca nisphalam || 1.31{31} || kimupāyaṃ kariṣyāmi yato bhāgyaṃ na vidyate | daivo hi valavāṃlloke kimupāyairguṇairvalaiḥ || 1.32{32} || kutrātra śaraṇaṃ yāsye hyaputro'haṃ kulāntakaḥ | tanme syātko'tra sanmitraṃ saṃkaṭe yaḥ samuddharet || 1.33{33} || nūnaṃ me pitaraḥ sarve piṇḍavichedadarśinaḥ | matparaṃ durlabhaṃ matvā bhaviṣyanti nirāśitāḥ || 1.34{34} || sarvathāhaṃ vinaṣṭo'smi kuladharmavināśakaḥ | kiṃ paratra prabhokṣyāmi ko me piṇḍaṃ pradāsyati || 1.35{35} || iti cintāviṣaṇṇaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve ca bāndhavāḥ | samupetya samāmaṃtrya duhkhahetumapṛchan || 1.36{36} || kiṃ duḥsthito'si sādho'tra kiṃ cāpi duḥkhacintayā | vaktavyaṃ cettadasmākaṃ sarvathā vaktumarhasi || 1.37{37} || iti pṛṣṭe gṛhastho'sau dīrghaniśvāsamutsṛjan | sarvāṃstān bāndhavān dṛṣṭvā duḥkhahetumudaharat || 1.38{38} || bhavantaḥ śrūyatāṃ sarvairmama duḥkhasya kāraṇam | yadadyāpi na me putraḥ putrī vāpi na vidyate || 1.39{39} || saṃpado me gṛhe santi sarvaratnasamanvitāḥ | sarvadravyasamṛddhāśca tāsāṃ bhoktā na vidyate || 1.40{40} || tatsarvaṃ nakṣyate vyarthaṃ mayā yātnairupārjitam | aputrasya hi sarvasvaṃ nūnaṃ rājā grahīṣyti || 1.41{[41]} || aputro'haṃ hyapuṇyātmā gantavyaṃ maraṇaṃ dhruvam | pretībhūtasya me ko'nyaḥ piṇḍadānaṃ pradāsyati || 1.42{[42]} || mayā na prakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ saṃpadarthaprasaṃginā | tanme sarvaṃ nirarthaṃ syātko māṃ pāpātsamuddharet || 1.43{43} || iha bhogyaṃ prabhuktvāpi kiṃ me sāramavasthitam | kevalaṃ dhanasaktasya paratra sadgatiḥ katham || 1.44{44} || iti cintā hṛdi sthitvā cittaṃ me tudate'niśam | evaṃ cittavyathākrāntaḥ śalyaviddha ivāsmyaham || 1.45{45} || tadvyathāharaṇopāyaṃ dātavyaṃ mama taddhitam | anyathā cedihāmutra vinaṣṭaḥ syāṃ nirāśitaḥ || 1.46{46} || iti tenoditaṃ śrutvā sarve te bāndhavā janāḥ | karuṇāviṣṭacittāstaṃ bodhayantaḥ samabruvan || 1.47{47} || mā mā bhaiṣṭhā mahābhāga tyaja cintāṃ vacaḥ śṛṇu | tadupāyaṃ vayaṃ brūmastatkuruṣva samāhitaḥ || 1.48{48} || devatārādhanāṃ kṛtvā kuruṣva vaṃśayācanām | nūnaṃ vaṃśaṃ pradāsyanti devatāste prasāditāḥ || 1.49{49} || eṣa loke pravādo'sti yadāyācanahetutaḥ | putrā duhitaro vāpi jātā devaprasādataḥ || 1.50{50} || tathā naiva pramāṇaṃ syācchāstre karmapramāṇataḥ | tattu devaprasādena karmaśśīghraṃ prasiddhyate || 1.51{51} || tadeva devavairuddhe karma vighnairnihanyate | tasmāddaivaprasiddhyarthaṃ śraddhābhaktisamāhitaḥ || 1.52{52} || devatārādhanāṃ kṛtvā sarvakāryyaṃ prasādhayet | iti matvā bhavāṃścāpi satputrapratipattaye || 1.53{53} || bhāryyayā saha bhaktyā ca devatāyācanāṃ kuru | tato raktaiḥ priyāṃ bhāryāmṛtusnātāṃ prakāmataḥ || 1.54{54} || gāḍhamāliṃgya saṃrakto dharmavījaṃ praropaya | tato devaprabhāvena suniṣpannaḥ prasiddhitaḥ || 1.55{55} || tvatputraḥ saṃprajāyeta satyamevaṃ pramāṇaya | iti teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā gṛhastho'sau vinoditaḥ || 1.56{56} || tatheti ca pratiśrutya bhāryyayā saha moditaḥ | śivabrahmādideveśāniṃdrādidigadhīśvarān || 1.57{57} || jalāśrayavanārāmacatvaramaṇḍapālayān | sūryyādīṃśca grahān sarvā bhairavādyāśca mātṛkāḥ || 1.58{58} || svakulādhipatīṃ devānanyāṃśca tribhavasthitān | sarvānevaṃ samārādhya pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ || 1.59{59} || saṃtānaṃ prārthayitvāsau patnyā saha tathāramat | tadā kaścinmahāsatvaḥ svargāccyutvā bhuvaṃ gataḥ || 1.60{60} || tasya gṛhapateḥ patnyā garbhe sa samupāviśat | tataḥ sā śreṣṭhino bhāryyāpannasatvāśu gurviṇī || 1.61{61} || garbhe satvaṃ samutpannaṃ matvā bharttāramabravīt | svāmin prasīda mā bhūstvaṃ viṣaṇno'tra sukhī bhava || 1.62{62} || tava bhāgyāddhi me garbhe nūnaṃ satvaḥ pravarttate | yadgarbhe dakṣiṇe bhāge sthitaḥ saṃparivarttate || 1.63{63} || tannūnaṃ dārako'yaṃ syātsatyameva na saṃśayaḥ | iti bhāryāvacaḥ śrutvā gṛhastho'sau pramoditaḥ || 1.64{64} || bhāryāyā garbhamālokya satyamityanvamanyata || 1.65{56!} || tato'sau sahasā vandhusuhṛnmitrasahāyakān | prāhūya puratasteṣāṃ mudaivaṃ samudānayat || 1.66{66} || aho bhāgyānmamotpannaṃ yadabhivāṃchitaṃ mayā | dhanyo'smi nāvagītaḥ syāddevatānuprasādataḥ || 1.67{67} || cirābhilaṣitaṃ putramukhaṃ paśyeya sāṃpratam | kṛtyā me pratikurvīta bhṛtaśca prativibhṛyāt || 1.68{68} || dāyādyaṃ pratipadyeta vaṃśo me sthitiko bhavet | suhṛdo me prasannāḥ syurdviṣantaśca viṣāditāḥ || 1.69{69} || mayā yāvanti dānāni puṇyāni prakṛtāni ca | etatpuṇyaphalairnityaṃ maṃgalaṃ bhavatu dvayoḥ || 1.70{70} || etatpuṇyānubhāvena bhūyānmātā nirāturā | sukhaṃ sunotu satputraṃ mā pāpaṃ samudāgamat || 1.71{71} || iti tenoditaṃ śrutvā sarve bandhusuhṛtsakhāḥ | tathāstvityanumodantaḥ svasvālayaṃ samāyayuḥ || 1.72{72} || tato'sau garbhiṇī kāntā kramādgarbhapravarddhitā | vaidyopadiṣṭamāhāraṃ bhuktvācaradyathā sukham || 1.73{73} || tataśca samaye'sūta putraṃ kāntaṃ manoharam | sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannaṃ bhadrāṃśaṃ maṃgalānvitam || 1.74{74} || tacchrutvaiva gṛhastho'sau suprasannaḥ pramoditaḥ | dṛṣṭvā taṃ dārakaṃ saumyaṃ naiva tṛptiṃ samāyayau || 1.75{75} || tato jñātīn samāhūya kṛtvā jātimahaṃ mudā | putranāmābhisaṃskartuṃ bhūya etān samabravīt || 1.76{76} || bhavanto dṛśyatāṃ siddhaṃ mamabhilaṣitaṃ cirāt | tannāmāsya yathāyogyaṃ prasiddhaṃ kriyatāṃ śubham || 1.77{76!} || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā sarve te jñātayo mudā | dārakaṃ taṃ samālokya naṃditāḥ samabhāṣata || 1.78{78} || yasmin dine hyayaṃ jātastadā sarve'pi paurikāḥ | nanditāstadbhavatvayaṃ nāmnā nanda iti śrutaḥ || 1.79{79} || athāsau dārako nandaḥ samyagdehopacāraṇe | pitrāṣṭāsu ca dhātrīṣu paritoṣya samarpitaḥ || 1.80{80} || tato'sau kramaśastāsāṃ dhātriṇāmupacārataḥ | dine dine pravṛddho'bhūddhradasthaṃ paṃkajaṃ yathā || 1.81{81} || evaṃ pravarddhamāno'sau ṣaḍvarṣiko yadābhavat | tadā kuśīdasaṃvṛtto babhūva viratotsavaḥ || 1.82{82} || sadā śayyāsanasthastatsamutthātuṃ na caichata | śayyāsanasthitaścaiva bhuktvā naivācaratkvacit || 1.83{83} || sadā svāntargṛhastho'pi sutīkṣṇabuddhimān sudhīḥ | adhītya sarvaśāstrāṇi satyadharmarato'bhavat || 1.84{84} || atha śreṣṭhī pitā dṛṣṭvā putramevaṃ kuśīditam | sarvavidyāguṇādhāraṃ dṛṣṭvā caivaṃ vyacintayat || 1.85{85} || kathaṃ cidyo mayā prāpto devatāsaṃprasādataḥ | so'pi putro mamābhāgyādbhavatyevaṃ kuśīditaḥ || 1.86{86} || sarvavidyāguṇādhāraṃ sarvaśāstravicakṣaṇaḥ | kiṃ mamānena putreṇa dusthiteneva roginā | yataḥ svasthaśarīro'pi bhuktvaivaṃ paśuvatsthitaḥ || 1.87{87} || kimatrāhaṃ kariṣyāmi yatputro'yaṃ ni rudyamaḥ | kimīdrigjantunā kāryyaṃ kuladharmopahāriṇā || 1.88{68!} || dhigme daivaṃ prayatnaṃ ca sarvaṃ tatsyānnirarthakam | kimupāyaṃ kariṣyāmi sarvathāhaṃ vibhagnitaḥ || 1.89{78} || evaṃ cintāparīto'sau gṛhasthaśca vyacintayat | pūraṇo me'sti śāstā yaḥ pṛcheyaṃ tadupāyakam || 1.90{79} || iti matvā gṛhastho'sau tadāśramaṃ samāgataḥ | pūraṇaṃ taṃ guruṃ natvā papraccha tadupāyatām || 1.91{80} || bhagavan bho mahābhijña śāstāsi me prasīda tat | yanmayā pṛchyate kāryyaṃ tatsamādeṣṭumarhasi || 1.92{81} || iti tenārthitaṃ śrutvā tīrthiko mānagarvitaḥ | āśu siddhaṃ kariṣyāmo yatkāryyaṃ te'tra tadvada || 1.93{82} || iti proktvaivamāśvāsya pūraṇo'tyabhimānikaḥ | pravadaṃstaṃ gṛhasthaṃ vai sarvathaivamabodhayat || 1.94{83} || iti tena samādiṣṭaṃ śrutvā gṛhapatirmudā | kṛtāñjalipuṭo natvā taṃ guruṃ samabhāṣata || 1.95{84} || bhagavan bho vijānīyā yo me putraḥ prajāyate | sa pravṛddho nirutsāhī kuśīdo varttate'dhunā || 1.96{85} || sadā śayyāsthito bhuṅkte bhuktvā śete nirudyamaḥ | notsahati kvacidgaṃtuṃ paśuvattiṣṭhate gṛhe || 1.97{86} || na śayanātsamutthāya śrotuṃ draṣṭuṃ samicchati | gṛhe śayyāsanārūḍho rogīva vasate sadā || 1.98{87} || tadupāyaṃ kathaṃ kuryyāṃ yenāyaṃ śayanotthitaḥ | śrotuṃ draṣṭuṃ ca gaṃtuṃ ca karttuṃ kāryyaṃ yathotsahet || 1.99{88} || tathā me bhagavan putraṃ kuladharme niyojaya | bhavāneva hi me śāstā taddhitaṃ kartumarhasi || 1.100{89} || ityevaṃ prārthitaṃ tena śrutvāsau pūraṇo yatiḥ | tasya gṛhapateścittaṃ praharṣayan samabravīt || 1.101{90} || are mā gā viṣādaṃ tvaṃ cintayā kiṃ pratapyase | asmāsu vidyamāneṣu ṣaṭsu vijñeṣu śāstṛṣu || 1.102{91} || tadahaṃ te mahābhāga sārddhaṃ sarvaiśca tīrthikaiḥ | ṛddhyā gatvā kariṣyāmi dārakaṃ vistayotthitam || 1.103{92} || yadāsau dārako hyasmān sarvān dṛṣṭvā samutthitaḥ | kṛtvā praṇāmamasmākaṃ dharmmaṃ śrotuṃ samutsahet || 1.104{93} || śrutvā dharmasamutsāhātkuśalāni samācaret | tatkuśalaiḥ samāpanno vīryavān sa bhavetsudhīḥ || 1.105{94} || tataste sarvakāryāṇi sādhayetsa samudyataḥ | svakuladharmakarmāṇi kuśalī saṃcariṣyate || 1.106{95} || evaṃ me vacanaṃ satyaṃ dṛṣṭvā samyakpramāṇaya | tadviṣādaṃ parityajya karttavyaṃ hi tathā kuru || 1.107{96} || iti tena samādiṣṭaṃ śrutvā sa gṛhabhṛnmudā | sahasā svagṛhaṃ gatvā tadbhojyaṃ samasādhayat || 1.108{97} || athāsau pūraṇo'nyaiśca tīrthikaiḥ sārddhamāgataḥ | gṛhe gatvā purastasya paryyaṅke samupāśrayat || 1.109{98} || tathāsau tān samāgatvā kramaśa āsane sthitān | dṛṣṭvā saṃharṣitaḥ śreṣṭhī sahasā putramabravīt || 1.110{99} || putra paśya gṛhe'smākaṃ śāstāraḥ samupasthitāḥ | tatsamutthāya natvaitāñchāstṝn bhojyaiḥ pravāraya || 1.111{100} || ityuktvā janakenāsau dārako na samutthitaḥ | draṣṭumapi na cotsehe kiṃ namecca pravārayet || 1.112{1} || bahuśaḥ preryyamāṇo'pi pitrā sa bandhubhiḥ saha | dārakastān samāsīnān draṣṭumapi na caichata || 1.113{2} || kiṃ punarutthito natvā bhojaṇaiḥ saṃpravārayet | tathā śayyāsanārūḍha evaṃ tasthau nirutsavaḥ || 1.114{3} || tataste tīrthikāḥ sarve dṛṣṭvaivaṃ nirutsavam | nānāvidhiprayatnaistamutthāpayitumārabhan || 1.115{4} || tathāpi naiva śayyāyā udatiṣṭhatsa dārakaḥ | svadharmadeśakāṃścāpi tān draṣṭumapi naihata || 1.116{5} || evaṃ cānutthitaṃ dṛṣṭvā taṃ te sarve ca tīrthikāḥ | haṭhāccainaṃ samutthāpya vaśīkarttuṃ parākraman || 1.117{6} || tathaitāṃstīrthikān sarvāneva garvābhivāditān | dṛṣṭvābhisaṃmukhāyātān bhīto'rautsītsa dārakaḥ || 1.118{7} || tathā taṃ ruditaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve te lajjayā bhiyā | pratijagmurvibhinnāsyāḥ svasvālayāni bheditāḥ || 1.119{8} || tathā gṛhapatirdṛṣṭvā sarvānetān parāyitān | pratibhinnaviṣaṇnātmā tasthau cintāvimohitaḥ || 1.120{9} || atha śrībhagavān buddhaḥ sarvadarśī vināyakaḥ | paśyan satvān samuddhartuṃ dadarśa taṃ kuśīditam || 1.121{10} || dṛṣṭvā tasya kuśīdasya karmavṛttiparaṃparām | tatkuśīdaṃ samuddhartumaryānaṃdaṃ samabravīt || 1.122{11} || paśyānaṃda gṛhasthasya śrāvastīpuravāsinaḥ | putro naṃda iti khyātaḥ sāmprataṃ saṃkuśīdikaḥ || 1.123{12} || asau me darśanādeva nūnaṃ vīryyaṃ samārabhan | sahasotthāya sa natvā dharmaṃ praśṛṇuyānmudā || 1.124{13} || tato me śāsane dharmaṃ pracaretsa sudhīḥ sadā | kramādbodhicarīṃ pūryya saṃbodhiṃ cāpi lapsyati || 1.125{14} || tasmāttasya gṛhe gatvā tīrthikadarppachittaye | saddharme saṃpratiṣṭhāpya sarvān bodhau niyojaye || 1.126{15} || ityādiṣṭaṃ munīndreṇa śrutvānandaḥ sa harṣitaḥ | karttavyaṃ bhagavannevamityanumodito'bhavat || 1.127{16} || tato bhagavatā tena suvarṇābhā marīcayaḥ | utsṛṣṭāstaiśca tadgehamavabhāsya vyaśodhayat || 1.128{17} || yadā tairdārakaḥ spṛṣṭo buddhamaitrīmarīcibhiḥ | tadā prahlāditaścāsāvityevaṃ samacintayat || 1.129{18} || aho kasya prabhāvo'yaṃ yenaivamavabhāsitam | prahlāditaśca me kāyastanna jāne kutaḥ katham || 1.130{19} || iti cintāṃ samālambya kautukākrāntamānasaḥ | samantato nirīkṣyaivaṃ tasthau gehe suvismitaḥ || 1.131{20} || tathā taṃ vismitaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhagavān bhikṣubhiḥ saha | sahasā tadgṛhaṃ gatvā prādurāsītprabhāsayan || 1.132{21} || tatra sa dārako'paśyadbhagavantaṃ tamāsthitam | kāntaṃ divyātiriktābhaṃ samantabhadrarūpiṇam || 1.133{22} || dṛṣṭvaiva sahasotthāya natvā pādau pramoditaḥ | svayamevāsanaṃ tasmai prajñapyaivamabhāṣata || 1.134{23} || svāgataṃ bhagavannātha vijayasva munīśvara | prasīdānugrahārthena niṣīdātra śubhāsane || 1.135{24} || iti tenodite tatra bhagavān bhikṣubhiḥ saha | tatprajñaptāsane sthitvā dharmaṃ deṣṭuṃ samārabhat || 1.136{25} || taddṛṣṭvā dārakasyaivaṃ dharmotsāhaṃ samutthitam | pitarau jñātivargāśca sarve'pyāsan suvismitāḥ || 1.137{26} || tatrāsau dārako harṣādutphullanayano mudā | natvā pādau muneścāgre dharmaṃ śrotumupāśrayat || 1.138{27} || athāsau bhagavāṃstasya jñātvāśayaviśuddhatām | ādimadhyāntakalyāṇaṃ dharmaṃ deṣṭuṃ tamabravīt || 1.139{27} || śṛṇu vatsa mahābhāga pāpapuṇyārthasādhane | hetuṃ vakṣye śubhārthe te tadatra tvaṃ samācara || 1.140{29} || mānuṣyaṃ durlabhaṃ prāpya vidyuttaraṃgacaṃcalam | pāpakṣaye matiḥ kāryā puṇyārthasādhaneṣu ca || 1.141{30} || pāpena durgatiṃ yāyātpuṇyena sadgatiṃ vrajet | pāpamitrānurāgeṇa matiḥ pāpe pravarttate || 1.142{31} || tataḥ pāparataḥ kuryātpāpāni dāruṇānyapi | tato duṣṭaḥ supāpiṣṭhaḥ saddharmāṇi vinindayet || 1.143{32} || tato dharmaviruddhatvātkuśaktiḥ kutsito bhavet | tataḥ sa kutsitātmā hi sarvasatvairvinindyate || 1.144{33} || paribhūto viṣādena bhavetmūḍho nirutsahaḥ | utsāhavarjite citte ālasyaṃ samupāśrayet || 1.145{34} || ālasvī sādhayennaiva kiṃciddharmaṃ guṇāni vā | dharmakarmaviraktātmā nirguṇī kiṃ kariṣyati | bhogya eva sadāsaktaḥ paśorapyadhamo naraḥ | kiṃ tena puruṣeṇāpi nirguṇena sukhāśinā | yasya puṇye guṇe vāpi kadāpi notsahenmanaḥ | puṇyotsāhavipannātmā duṣṭakleśairvihanyate | kleśito mārasaṃghaiśca vaśīkṛtya nivaddhyate || 1.146{36} || mārasya vaśagaḥ strīṇāṃ dāsatvaṃ samupāśrayet | sa dāsanirato bhuktvā paśuvattiṣṭhate gṛhe || 1.147{36} || naiva dharmaṃ kvacicchrotuṃ draṣṭuṃ vāpi na cotsahet | dharmaṃ vinā vrajennaiva sadgatiṃ hi kadā cana || 1.148{37} || tasmāddharme samācartuṃ puṇyotsāhaṃ pravarddhayan | trimaṇḍalaviśuddhena dānaṃ dadyācchubhāptaye || 1.149{39} || dānena siddhyate dharmaṃ dharmāccittaṃ viśuddhyate | śuddhacittaścarecchīle śīlavān hi bhavetsudhīḥ || 1.150{40} || sudhīro bhāvayetkṣāṃtiṃ kṣāntimān duṣṭajitkṛtī | kuśalī prārabhedvīryyaṃ vīryyavān puruṣottamaḥ || 1.151{41} || mahāsatvo labheddhyānaṃ dhyātā brahmavihārikaḥ | saṃsmṛtaḥ sādhayetprajñāṃ prajñāvān hi guṇālayaḥ || 1.152{42} || guṇajñaḥ samupāyaiśca satvān dharme niyojayet | etatpuṇyānubhāvena bodhau praṇidhimācaret || 1.153{43} || bodhipraṇidhicittena balāni sādhayeddaśa | tadbalaiśca mahāghorāṃ mārasaṃghān parājayet || 1.154{44} || jitvā māragaṇān sarvān saṃbodhijñānamāpnuyāt | tataḥ sarvatra lokeṣu dharmacakraṃ pravarttayet || 1.155{45} || evaṃ pravarttayan dharmaṃ śāstā lokādhipo bhavet | sarvalokahitaṃ kurvanmahatpuṇyaiḥ samṛddhitaḥ || 1.156{46} || sadaivaṃ sadgatau sthitvā saṃbuddhapadamāpnuyāt | evaṃ matvā tvayā vatsa caritavyaṃ tathā śubhe || 1.157{47} || ityādiṣṭaṃ jinendreṇa śrutvā sa dārako mudā | kṛtāṃjaliḥ punarnatvā bhagavantamabhāṣata || 1.158{48} || adyārabhya sadā śāstarbhavataḥ śaraṇaṃ vraje | tadyathā bhavatājñaptaṃ tathā satyaṃ carāmyaham || 1.159{49} || kṛpādṛṣṭimupasthāpya samanvāhara māṃ sadā | bhavāneva hi sarvajñastraidhātukavināyakaḥ || 1.160{50} || yadaivaṃ te dayā nāsti mayyudyamavivarjite | ka evaṃ samupāgatya proddharenmāṃ kuśīdikam || 1.161{51} || pavitrībhūtamātmānaṃ manye'haṃ te prasādataḥ | dhanyo'smi tanmahābhadro yacchāstraivaṃ pradarśitaḥ || 1.162{52} || iti tenodite bhūyaḥ sarvajñaḥ sa munīśvaraḥ | sucaṃdanamayīṃ yaṣṭiṃ datvainaṃ samabhāṣata || 1.163{53} || vatsemāṃ yaṣṭimādhāya prakoṭaya samāhitaḥ | tatastvaṃ sarvadāvaśyaṃ labheḥ puṇyamahotsavam || 1.164{54} || iti śāstrā pradattāṃ tāṃ natvāsau dārako'grahīt | yathādiṣṭaṃ munīndreṇa tathā kartumudācarat || 1.165{55} || ityevaṃ taṃ samādiśya sa saṃbuddhaḥ sasāṃghikaḥ | svaṃ vihāramupāśritya dharmaṃ diśan samāvasat || 1.166{56} || athāsau dārako harṣāttāṃ yaṣṭiṃ svayamādadhat | yathādiṣṭaṃ munīndreṇa prākoṭayatsamāhitaḥ || 1.167{57} || tasyāmākoṭyamānāyāṃ puṇyaśabda udācarat | gṛhe ratnanidhānāni prādurāsan bahūni ca || 1.168{57} || tacchabdaśravaṇaṃ kṛtvā dārako'sau pramoditaḥ | gṛhe ratnanidhānāni dṛṣṭvāścaryyaṃ samāyayau || 1.169{59} || tataśca vismito harṣātpunarevaṃ vyacintayat | batedaṃ sumahāśauryyaṃ vīryyaṃ prārambhaye tataḥ || 1.170{60} || tathā ratnākaraṃ gatvā ratnāni samupārjayan | sasaṃghaṃ sugataṃ nityamupatiṣṭheya saṃbhajan || 1.171{61} || iti dhyātvā samutsāhaṃ saṃnibadhya sa dārakaḥ | ratnākaraṃ samāgantuṃ prārebhe saha vāṇijaiḥ || 1.172{62} || tato'sau dārako vīrastasyāṃ pūryyāṃ samantataḥ | sārthavāhaṃ svamātmānaṃ kṛtvā ghoṣamakārayat || 1.173{63} || tathā tadghoṣaṇāṃ śrutvā ye vīrāste vaṇigjanāḥ | tena sārddhaṃ mahotsāhairmahābdhiṃ gantumaichan || 1.174{64} || tato'sau puruṣo vīraḥ sarvaistaiśca vaṇigjanaiḥ | saha ratnākaraṃ gatvā bahuratnānyasādhayat || 1.175{65} || tataḥ sārthapatiḥ sarvaiḥ sārthaiḥ sārddhaṃ mahodadheḥ | kṣemena sahasottīryya svadeśaṃ samupāyayau || 1.176{66} || atha sārthapatistatra yātrāsiddhipramoditaḥ | sarvān sārthān samāmaṃtrya dṛṣṭvaivaṃ samabhāṣata || 1.177{67} || bhavantaḥ śrūyatāṃ sarvairyatsvasti prāgatā vayam | tatprabhāvaṃ vijānīdhvaṃ jinendrasya prasādatāḥ || 1.178{68} || tasmādasya munīndrasya kṛtvā darśanamādarāt | pūjayitvā praṇatvā ca paścādgehaṃ vrajema hi | iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā sarvve'pi te vaṇigjanāḥ | dṛṣṭasatyānumodantaḥ tatheti pratimenire | iti saṃbhāṣaṇāṃ kṛtvā sarvvasārthasamanvitaḥ | tataḥ sārthapatiḥ śīghraṃ vihāraṃ samupāyayau | tatra dṛṣṭvā jinendraṃ taṃ sarvve te saṃpraharṣitāḥ | pādau natvā munestasya parivṛtyopatasthire || 1.179{69} || athāsau bhagavān dṛṣṭvā sarvān sārthagaṇānapi | dharmotsāhaprāvṛddhyarthaiḥ samāmaṃtrya samabravīt || 1.180{70} || āgatāḥ stha samāyāta mā stha śrāntāśca kheditāḥ | yātrāsāphalyasiddhiśca kaccidvaḥ kuśalāni ca || 1.181{71} || evaṃ pṛṣṭe jinendreṇa sarve te saṃpramoditāḥ | kṛtāñjalipuṭo natvā saṃbuddhaṃ procurādarāt || 1.182{72} || bhagavan bhavatāmevaṃ kṛpādṛṣṭiprasādataḥ | yātrāsiddhiḥ kathaṃ na syātsarvatra kuśalaṃ hi naḥ || 1.183{73} || yadvayaṃ śāstarāyātāḥ śubharatnasamanvitāḥ | tatsarvaṃ tvatprabhāvena satyametatpramāṇyate || 1.184{74} || tadbhavantaṃ suśāstāraṃ draṣṭuṃ sarve samāgatāḥ | pūjayituṃ samichāmastatprasīda jagadguro || 1.185{75} || iti vijñāpanāṃ kṛtvā saha sārthaiḥ sa sārthabhṛt | sasaṃghaṃ pūjayitvā ca ratnāni samaḍhaukata || 1.186{76} || namaste bhagavannātha vrajāmaḥ śaraṇaṃ tava | pāhi naḥ sarvadāpyevaṃ tvameva jagadīśvaraḥ || 1.187{77} || evaṃ stutvā munīndraṃ taṃ sarve te saṃprasāditāḥ | kṛtāñjalipuṭā natvā svagṛhaṃ gantumīhire || 1.188{78} || tataśca bhagavān dṛṣṭvā tān sarvān svagṛhotsukān | datvāśīrvacanaṃ spṛṣṭvā vrajateti vyasarjayat || 1.189{79} || tataḥ sarve'pi te sārthāḥ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇatrayam | śāstāraṃ sugataṃ natvā svaṃ svaṃ gehaṃ samāyayuḥ || 1.190{80} || tato bhūyastathānyaiśca prārthyamānaḥ sa vīryyavān | ṣaḍḍhā ratnākaraṃ gatvā bahuratnānyasādhayat || 1.191{81} || tataśca gṛhapatiḥ śreṣṭhī sārthavāhaḥ suvīryyavān | sasaṅghaṃ sugataṃ gehe praṇītvārcitumārabhat || 1.192{[82]} || tato bhojanasāmagrīṃ sādhayitvā niveśane | sasaṃghaiḥ buddhamāmaṃtrya nyaveśayacchubhāsane || 1.193{[83]} || tataḥ pūjopahāraiśca pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ | pratyekaṃ cīvaraṃ datvā bhojanaiḥ samatoṣayat || 1.194{84!} || tataśca bhojanānte'sau sārthavāhaḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ | sasaṃghaṃ sugataṃ natvā praṇidhānaṃ tathākarot || 1.195{85} || yatkiñcitprakṛtaṃ dānaṃ saṃbuddhaśāsane mayā | etatpuṇyaphalena syāṃ saṃbuddho'yaṃ jino yathā || 1.196{86} || iti tasya gṛhasthasya cittaṃ saṃbodhivāṃchitam | jñātvāsau bhagavān buddhaḥ smitaṃ kṛtvābhyanaṃdata || 1.197{87} || tadā bhagavato vaktrānniśceruḥ paṃcavarṇikāḥ | raśmayastāḥ samantācca trailokyaṃ śāmabhāsayan || 1.198{88} || yāḥ kāścidraśmayo yātā adhastānnarakeṣvapi | tāśca niścaritāstāvatsaṃjīvaṃ kālasūtrakam || 1.199{[89]} || saṃghātaṃ rauravaṃ cāpi mahārauravaviśrutam | tapanākhyaṃ tathā caivaṃ pratāpanāhvayaṃ tataḥ || 1.200{90} || avīcimarbudaṃ caivaṃ nirarbudaṃ tathāṭaṭam | hahavaṃ huhuvaṃ caivamutpalaṃ padmakaṃ tataḥ || 1.201{91} || mahāpadmākhyametāni ṣoḍaśa nilayāni hi | tatroṣṇanarakā ye tu teṣu sarveṣu niḥsṛtāḥ || 1.202{92} || śītībhūtā viniḥpatya prabhāsayan samaṃtataḥ | ye śītanarakāsteṣu tūṣṇībhūtāpyabhāsayan || 1.203{93} || teṣu ye nārakāḥ satvā nānāduḥkhābhivedinaḥ | te tābhī raśmibhiḥ spṛṣṭā mahatsaukhyaṃ prarebhire || 1.204{94} || atha sarve'pi te satvā mahatsaukhyasamanvitāḥ | vismitāstatra saṃmīlya mithaścaivaṃ vabhāṣire || 1.205{95} || aho bhavanta āścaryyaṃ kiṃ cāsmākaṃ bhavetkhalu | yadvayaṃ sarvadāpītthaṃ nānāduḥkhaiḥ prapīḍitāḥ | tanmuktāḥ sāṃprataṃ sarve vayaṃ saukhyasamanvitāḥ || 1.206{96} || kiṃ tato hi vayaṃ muktā anyatra caritā nanu | iti vismitacittānāṃ sarveṣāṃ cittabodhane || 1.207{97} || bhagavānnirmitaṃ teṣāṃ purastātsamadarśayat || 1.208{98} || tatra taṃ nirmitaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve'pi te'tivismitāḥ | parasparaṃ mukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā tathaivaṃ saṃvabhāṣire || 1.209{99} || bho bhavanta itaścyutvā nānyatra gamitā vayam | kiṃ tvayaṃ sugatākāra āyāto'pūrvadarśanaḥ || 1.210{100} || nūnamasyānubhāvena vayamitthaṃ sukhānvitāḥ || 1.211{1} || iti saṃbhāṣya te sarve tasmiṃ saugatanirmite | cittaṃ prasādya buddhāya nama iti praṇemire || 1.212{2} || tataste nirmitaṃ dṛṣṭvā natva cittaprasāditaḥ | sarvapāpavinirmuktāḥ sarve'pi sugatiṃ yayuḥ || 1.213{3} || yāśca kāścidgatā ūrddhvaṃ tā mahārājikān gatāḥ | trayastriṃśāṃśca yāmāṃśca tuṣitāṃśca gatāstataḥ || 1.214{4} || nirmāṇaratimābhāsya nirmitavaśavarttikān | brahmakāyikalokāṃśca gatā brahmapurohitān || 1.215{5} || mahābrahmālayaṃ cāpi parītābhāṃstathā gatāḥ | apramāṇābhalokāṃśca tata ābhāsvarān gatāḥ || 1.216{6} || parīttaśubhalokāṃstadāpramāṇaśubhān gatāḥ | śubhakṛtsnānanabhrāṃśca puṇyaprasavakāṃstataḥ || 1.217{7} || bṛhatphalāṃstataścaivamavṛhānatapān gatāḥ | ḥsudṛśāṃśca tato yātā tathā caivaṃ sudarśanān || 1.218{8} || akaniṣṭhaṃ tathā gatvā sarvānetān vyabhāsayan | teṣu ye saṃsthitā lokāḥ sarve tābhiśca raśmibhiḥ || 1.219{9} || parispṛṣṭāḥ sukhaprāptā dṛṣṭvā tāṃ caivamūcire | aho citraṃ śubhā kāmyā kasya puṇyaprabhā imāḥ || 1.220{10} || yābhirvayaṃ parispṛṣṭā mahatsaukhyaṃ labhāmahe | iti vismitacittānāṃ teṣāṃ cittavinodane || 1.221{11} || tathā tā raśmayaścaināṃ gāthābhiḥ samacodayan | anityaṃ khalu saṃsāraṃ duḥkhaṃ śūnyaṃ hyanātmakam || 1.222{12} || ataḥ kleśagaṇāṃstyaktvā bhajadhvaṃ sugataṃ sadā | niṣkrāmatārabhadhvaṃ kaṃ yujyadhvaṃ buddhaśāsane || 1.223{13} || dhunīta mārasainyāṃśca naḍāgāramiva dvipaḥ | yo hyasmiṃ dharmavaineye'tyapramattaścaretsudhīḥ || 1.224{14} || prahāya sa bhave kleśān duḥkhasyāntaṃ kariṣyati | iti tā raśmayaḥ sarvā avabhāsya samantataḥ || 1.225{15} || prerayitvā śubhe satvān punarmuneḥ purogatāḥ | tato bhagavatastasya kṛtvā trayapradakṣiṇām || 1.226{16} || tathā tā raśmayaḥ sarvā uṣṇīṣe'ntarhitaṃ yayuḥ | athānandaḥ samutthāya kṛtāñjalipuṭo mudā || 1.227{17} || bhagavantaṃ praṇamyaivaṃ papraccha smitakāraṇam | bhagavaṃstava śubhā raśmiḥ smitodbhavā vinirgatā || 1.228{18} || yayāvabhāsitā lokāḥ sūryyeṇodayatā yathā | nākasmāddarśayantyevaṃ smitaṃ buddhā jināḥ kvacit || 1.229{19} || tatkasmādbhagavān smitaṃ saṃdarśayati sāṃpratam | yasyārthe bhavatāpyevaṃ smitaṃ saṃdarśitaṃ tathā || 1.230{20} || taṃ dṛṣṭvā vismitāḥ sarve śrotumichanti sajjanāḥ | tadatra bhagavāñchāstā hyesāṃ dharmābhikāṃkṣiṇām || 1.231{21} || sarveṣāṃ tatsamādiśya saṃdehaṃ chettumarhati | ityānaṃdoditaṃ śrutvā bhagavāṃśca tamabravīt || 1.232{22} || evametattathānaṃda yathā tvaṃ bhāṣase kila | nākāraṇe jinaṃ sarvaṃ smitaṃ saṃdarśitaṃ kvacit || 1.233{23} || tadarthaṃ śṛṇu vakṣye'haṃ yadarthaṃ saṃsmitaṃ mama | paśyānanda gṛhastho'yaṃ dārako yaḥ kuśīditaḥ || 1.234{24} || mama saṃdarśanādevaṃ viryyotsāhaṃ samāpnuvan | itthaṃ ratnāni saṃsādhya buddhimāṃśca samṛddhitaḥ || 1.235{25} || evaṃ śrāddhaḥ prasannātmā śāsane me'numoditaḥ | satkṛtya śaraṇaṃ kṛtvā bhajati māṃ sasāṃghikam || 1.236{26} || yadayaṃ sārthabhṛnnando mama dharmābhisaṃrataḥ | asya puṇyavipākena bodhicittaṃ samāpnuyāt || 1.237{27} || tataḥ cikṣāḥ samāsādya pūryya pāramitā daśa | kramānmāragaṇāñjitvā saṃbodhiṃ samavāpnuyāt || 1.238{28} || tato'rhannabhivandyo'tibalavīryyaparākramaḥ | iti nāmnā prasiddho'yaṃ saṃbuddhaḥ sugato jinaḥ || 1.239{29} || sarvadharmādhipaḥ śāstā sarvavidyāguṇākaraḥ | sarvajñastrijagadbharttā tathāgato bhaviṣyati || 1.240{30} || tasmādevaṃ sadānaṃda karttavyaṃ buddhadarśanam | buddhadarśanapuṇyena dharmotsāhaṃ samāpuṇyāt || 1.241{31} || tato vīryyasamārūḍhaḥ saddharmaṃ sādhayenmudā | tato dharmabalairmārāñjitvā saṃbodhimāpnuyāt || 1.242{32} || ityādiṣṭaṃ munīndreṇa śrutvānaṃdaḥ sasāṃghikaḥ | anumodya guruṃ natvā tatheti prābhyanaṃdata || 1.243{33} || evaṃ me guruṇādiṣṭaṃ dharmotsāhapravṛddhaye | tathā tava mayā khyātaṃ satyametatpradhāryyatām || 1.244{34} || evaṃ rājaṃstvayāpyevaṃ kṛtvānumodanāṃ tathā | dharmaprotsāhanāṃ kṛtvā karttavyaṃ buddhadarśanam || 1.245{35} || saddharmacaraṇotsāhe cāraṇīyāḥ prajāḥ sadā | ityetadguruṇādiṣṭaṃ śrutvāśokaḥ sa bhūmipaḥ || 1.246{36} || satyamevaṃ pratiśrutya prābhyanandatsapārṣadaḥ || 1.247{37!} || tatkauśīdyāvadānaṃ munivarakathitaṃ śraddhayā yaḥ śṛṇoti | śrutvā yaḥ śrāvayedyaḥ pratidinamaniśaṃ buddhasevānuraktaḥ | hitvā kleśān praduṣṭān sakalakalivalānmārapakṣāṃśca jitvā | pāraṃ gatvā guṇābdhervrajati sa subhagaṃ śrīghanasya caritram | iti ratnamālāyāṃ kauśīdyavīryyotsāhanāvadānaṃ snātāvadāna athāśoko nṛpendro'sau saddharmacaraṇotsavaḥ | upaguptaṃ guruṃ natvā kṛtāñjalipuṭo'vadat || 2.1{1} || bhadanta śrotumichāmi punaranyatsubhāṣitam | yathā te guruṇā khyātaṃ tathā me khyātumarhasi || 2.2{2} || iti tena nṛpeśena prārthyamāno jināṃśajaḥ | upaguptaḥ samāmaṃtrya taṃ kṣitīśaṃ samabravīt || 2.3{3} || sādhu suṣṭhu mahāraja śṛṇu dharmaṃ samāhitaḥ | yathā me guruṇādiṣṭaṃ tathātra te pracakṣyate || 2.4{5!} || puraikasamaye yo'bhūcchākyasiṃho dayākaraḥ | dharmarājo jagacchāstā sarvajñaḥ sugato jinaḥ || 2.5{6} || sarvavidyākalāvijñaḥ ṣaḍabhijño munīśvaraḥ | samantabhadrakṛnnātho vināyakastathāgataḥ || 2.6{7} || sa śrāvastyāṃ mahodyāne jetārāme manohare | anāthapiṇḍadasyaiva vihāre maṇimaṇḍite || 2.7{8} || śrāvakairbhikṣubhiḥ sārddhaṃ bodhisatvairupāsakaiḥ | devāsuramahārājairmanujendraṃ sapārṣadaiḥ || 2.8{9} || sarvalokādhipaiścāpi traidhātukanivāsitaiḥ | caturvarṇaiśca pauraiśca tathānyaiśca śubhārthibhiḥ || 2.9{10} || satkṛto mānitaścābhivanditaḥ saṃstuto'rcitaḥ | gurukṛtaḥ puraskṛtya parivṛto'valokitaḥ || 2.10{11} || ādimadhyāntakalyāṇaṃ dharmaṃ loke prakāśayan | sarvasatvahitārthena vijahāra samāhitaḥ || 2.11{12} || tasmiṃśca samaye tatra śrāvastyāṃ ye vaṇigjanāḥ | te paṃcaśatamātrāṇi ratnākaraṃ samāgatāḥ || 2.12{13} || tataḥ pratyāgatāḥ sarve kāntāraṃ samupāviśan | tatra te bhramitā mārgātparibhraṣṭā vicerire || 2.13{14} || vimārgeṇa carantaste vālukāsthalamupāviśan | tatra praptāśca te sarve madhyāhne dyotitātape || 2.14{15} || bhānostīkṣṇakaraistaptā gharmatāpābhikheditāḥ | kṣīṇapathyādanāścāpi kṣuttṛṣṇā paripīḍitāḥ || 2.15{16} || tīvraduḥkhābhisaṃtaptāḥ paryāvarttanta tatra ca | sthalaprāptā yathā mīnā mṛtyubhayavikaṃpitāḥ || 2.16{17} || tadā sarve'pi te sārthāḥ śraddhayā śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ | svasvakuleśasvasveṣṭadevatāḥ saṃyayācire || 2.17{18} || kecitsvayaṃbhuvaṃ smṛtvā kecinnārāyaṇaṃ tathā | kecicchivaṃ mahāraudraṃ kecitsūryyagrahādhipam || 2.18{19} || keciccaṃdraṃ ca tāreśaṃ kecidiṃdraṃ surādhipam | kecidagniṃ yamaṃ caiva naiṛtyaṃ ca tathāpare || 2.19{20} || vāruṇaṃ ca tathā vāyukuveraṃ ca maheśvaraiḥ | bhairavaṃ mātṛkāścaivaṃ kecitskandhaṃ vināyakam || 2.20{21} || mahākālaṃ tathā caivaṃ kecidṛṣīn yatīśvarān | keciddaityādhipān vīrān kecinnāgādhipāṃstathā || 2.21{22} || keciccāturmahārājān kecidyakṣādhipān tathā | evamanyāṃstridhātusthāṃssarvān smṛtvā yayācire || 2.22{23} || tairevaṃ yācyamānānāṃ devatānaṃ na kaścana | eko'pyāsīttadā trātā vāṇijāṃ duḥkhabhāginām || 2.23{24} || tataste vaṇijaḥ sarve mṛtyubhayavikaṃpitāḥ | nirāśayā viṣīdantastasthurniśceṣṭamānasāḥ || 2.24{25} || tatra yaḥ sugatopāsī dṛṣṭasatyaḥ sa dhīravān | tān sārthān vipannāśāṃ dṛṣṭvāmaṃtryaivamabravīt || 2.25{26} || bhavanto mā viṣīdadhvaṃ kiṃ viṣādena setsyate | tasmāttyaktvā viṣādatvaṃ dhīryyamālambya tiṣṭhata || 2.26{27} || dhairyyeṇa tārayedduḥkhaṃ mahākṛcchraṃ vipatsvapi | tasmāddhairyyaṃ samādhāya smaradhvaṃ ca jinaṃ drutam || 2.27{28} || jina eva jagannāthastrātā sarvānukaṃpakaḥ | tadasmadvacanaṃ śrutvā saṃbuddhaṃ smaratādarāt || 2.28{29} || tatrāpyevaṃ bhaye'smākaṃ trātā ko'nyo bhaviṣyati | buddha eva jagadbaṃdhustadvrajadhvaṃ jinaṃ drutam || 2.29{30} || sarvathā no jinendro'sau sarvasatvānukanipakaḥ | ḍṛṣṭvāsmān karuṇādṛṣṭyā saṃrakṣetsahasā khalu || 2.30{31} || iti tenoditaṃ śrutva sarve te vaṇijastathā | saṃbuddhaṃ śaraṇaṃ kṛtvā smṛtvābhayaṃ yayācire || 2.31{32} || namaste bhagavannātha sarvajño'si jagatprabhuḥ | bhavataiva jagatsarvaṃ pālitaṃ putravatsadā || 2.32{33} || adyāgreṇa vayaṃ sarve yāvajjīvaṃ sadāpi hi | bhavatāṃ śaraṇaṃ yāmastadrakṣāsmāñjagadguro || 2.33{34} || bhavāneva jagaddharmaṃ saṃsāre pālitaṃ sadā | bhagavan sarvavinnātha trātumarhasi sarvathā || 2.34{35} || paṃcaśatasarvāṇi vāṇijāśca samāgatāḥ | vimārgeṇa carantaste madhyāhne dyotitātape || 2.35{36} || tatra prāptāśca te sarve vālukāsthale saṃsthitāḥ | bhāno tīkṣṇakare taptā kṣuttṛṣārttā paripīḍitāḥ || 2.36{37} || tīvrātivedanākrāntā mṛtyubhayaṃ samāgatāḥ | namo buddhāya dharmāya saṃghāyeti namo namaḥ || 2.37{38} || dṛṣṭvāsmān karuṇā sarvān paṃcaśatāni vāṇijān | bhavāneva jagatsvāmiṃ tathā buddhānubhāvatām || 2.38{39} || tadā sa bhagavān tebhya māhendravṛṣṭimācaran | śītalā vāyavo yāti tena śītatvamāgatāḥ || 2.39{40} || taddṛṣṭvā sārthapatinā sarvān sārthān samabravīt | bhavantaḥ śrūyatāṃ sarve yanmayā procyate hitam || 2.40{41} || tadbhavadbhiḥ samādhṛtvā karttavyaṃ kṛtavedibhiḥ | yadvayaṃ mṛtyusaṃprāptā paralokādivāgatāḥ || 2.41{42} || tadjñeyaṃ jinendrasya kṛpādṛṣṭiprasādataḥ | tasmātsarve vayaṃ tasya buddhasya śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ || 2.42{43} || saddharmmaṃ samupāśritya caremahi sadāpi hi | anityaṃ khalu saṃsāramanityaṃ jīvitaṃ sukham || 2.43{44} || kṣaṇadhvaṃsi śarīraṃ ca bhave nityaṃ na kiṃ cana | dharma eva mahāsāraṃ yenaivaṃ rakṣyate jagat || 2.44{45} || tasmāddharmaṃ samādhartuṃ gantavyaṃ śaraṇaṃ muneḥ | iti tenoditaṃ śrutvā sarve te vaṇijo mudā || 2.45{46} || tathetyabhyanumodantastato gaṃtumupākramat | atha sārthapatiścaivaṃ kṛtvā taṃ saha saṃmatam || 2.46{47} || vihāre sugataṃ draṣṭuṃ dharmaṃ cāptumagānmudā | tatropetya praviṣṭo'sau sarvasārthagaṇānvitaḥ || 2.47{48} || dṛṣṭvā taṃ sugataṃ natvā viṣasāda puro muneḥ | athāsau bhagavāṃsteṣāṃ dṛṣṭvāśayaviśuddhatām | āryyasatyāryyamārgāṅgaṃ dideśa dharmamuttamam || 2.48{49} || tadā sarve'pi te satvāḥ śrutvā taṃ dharmamādarāt | satkāyadṛṣṭinirmuktā bodhicittaṃ pralebhire || 2.49{50} || tatra kecinmahāśrāddhā dharmānusāriṇo'bhavan | śrotāpannāstathā kecitsakṛdāgāmino pare || 2.50{51} || tathānāgāminaḥ kecitkecidbhavaparāṅmukhāḥ | saṃsārakleśasaṃghāṃśca hitvā suvimalāśayāḥ || 2.51{52} || sākṣātsaddharmmamāsādya babhūvurdharmacāriṇaḥ | kecicchrāvakabodhau ca pratyekāyāṃ tathāpare || 2.52{53} || kecidanuttarāyāṃ ca saṃbodhau praṇidhiṃ dadhuḥ | evaṃ tāḥ parṣadaḥ sarvāḥ saṃbuddhaśaraṇe sthitāḥ || 2.53{54} || saddharmmācaraṇe raktāḥ saṃghabhaktā babhūvire | atha te bhikṣavo dṛṣṭvā tān sarvān bodhicāriṇaḥ || 2.54{55} || saṃbuddhaṃ prayatā natvā paprachurvismayānvitāḥ | āścaryyaṃ bhagavan yāvadyadime vaṇijastathā || 2.55{56} || kāṃtārapatitāḥ sarve bhavatā paripālitāḥ | bhavaccintitamātre'pi māhendravṛṣṭimācaran || 2.56{57} || śītalā vāyavo vātāstatkathaṃ vaktumarhasi | iti tairbhikṣubhiḥ pṛṣṭo bhagavāṃstānabhāṣata || 2.57{58} || śṛṇudhvaṃ bhikṣavaḥ karmma yanmayā kṛta kṛtaṃ kathyate | yanmayā prakṛtaṃ karma ko'nyo bhuṃjyāddhi tatphalam || 2.58{59} || yena yatprakṛtaṃ karma sa evādyāddhi tatphalam | abhuktaṃ kṣīyate karma naiva kvāpi kathaṃ cana || 2.59{60} || agnibhirdahyate naiva vāyubhirnāpi śuṣyate | udakaiḥ klidyate nāpi bhūmiṣu || 2.60{61} || api tu pacyate skandhaṣaḍdhātvāyataneṣu hi | anyathā cāpi karmāṇi na dadanti phalāni ca || 2.61{62} || yathaiva yatkṛtaṃ karma tathaiva tatphalaṃ matam | śubhakarma śubhaṃ dadyātpāpakarmāśubhaṃ khalu || 2.62{63} || miśritamubhayaṃ dadyāditi matvā śubhe caret | na praṇaśyaṃti karmāṇi kalpakoṭiśatairapi || 2.63{64} || sāmagrīṃ prāpya kālaṃ ca phalanti khalu dehinām | yanmayā prakṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ tatphalaṃ prāpyate'dhunā || 2.64{65} || kathyate tatpurāvṛttaṃ sādhu śṛṇuta sādaram | puraikasamaye buddhaścaṃdano nāma dharmarāṭ || 2.65{66} || sarvajño'rhañjagannāthaḥ śāstā lokādhipeśvaraḥ | vidyācaraṇasaṃpannaḥ sugato lokavijjinaḥ || 2.66{67} || tathāgato mahābhijñaḥ saṃbuddho'bhūdvināyakaḥ | tadaikasamaye tatra caṃdanaḥ sa munīśvaraḥ || 2.67{38!} || bhikṣubhiḥ saha saddharmmaṃ prakāśayan samaṃtataḥ | hitāya sarvasatvānāṃ jānapadeṣu saṃcaran || 2.68{69} || anyatamāṃ purīṃ ramyāṃ rājadhānīmupāśrayat | tatra satvahitārthena bodhicaryāṃ prakāśayan || 2.69{70} || śrāvakairbhikṣubhiḥ sārddhaṃ vijahāra jināśrame | atha tadādhipo rājā śrutvā taṃ buddhamāgatam || 2.70{71} || sa maṃtrijanapauraiśca saha pratyudyayau mudā | tatrāsau sahasopetya dṛṣṭvā taṃ sugataṃ munim || 2.71{72} || kṛtāṃjalipuṭo natvā tasthāvekāṃtike mudā | athāsau bhagavān dṛṣṭvā taṃ nṛpaṃ samupasthitam || 2.72{73} || ādimadhyāntakalyāṇaṃ dideśa dharmamuttamam | śṛṇu rājan bhave sāraṃ dharmaṃ nityamataṃdritam || 2.73{74} || dharmeṇa jāyate loko dharmeṇa svargamāruhet | tasmāddharmaṃ puraskṛtya saṃpālayan prajā sadā || 2.74{75} || prajārakṣāvrataṃ dharmaṃ mūlaṃ rājñāṃ vidurbudhāḥ | prajārakṣāvrataṃ tyaktvā kimanyairbahubhirvrataiḥ || 2.75{76} || tena rājan tvayā dharme pālanīyāḥ prajāḥ śubhe | taddaśākuśalebhyaśca vinivārya tvayā sadā || 2.76{77} || yojanīyāḥ prajā dharme tatpuṇyaistvaṃ pramokṣyase | ādau dāne prajān yojyāḥ saṃbodhipadakāraṇe || 2.77{78} || tatpuṇyaiḥ pracariṣyanti prajāḥ saṃvarddhitāḥ śubhe | śubhakarmarate loke tatpuṇyaiḥ varddhyate nṛpaḥ || 2.78{79} || tasmāddānaṃ svayaṃ datvā prajā śīle niyojaya | śīlena śuddhyate kāyaḥ śuddhakāyo bhavetsudhīḥ || 2.79{80} || subuddhiḥ kṣamayā sarvācchatrūṃ jitvā virājate | tato vīryyabalaiḥ sarvān satvān saukhye niyojayet || 2.80{81} || tataḥ kleśān vinirjitya dhyātvā bodhiṃ prasādhayet | bodhipraṇidhicittena kṛtī prajñāṃ prasādhayet || 2.81{82} || tataḥ prājña upāyaiśca jagadbodhau niyojayet | tato mārān vinirjitya saṃbodhijñānamāpnuyāt || 2.82{83} || tatra prāpya rasābhijñā daśabhūmīśvaro bhavet | tataḥ kṛtvā vaśe sarvāṃstraidhātukanivāśinaḥ || 2.83{84} || saṃsthāpya saugate dharme svayaṃ nirvṛtimācaret || 2.84{85} || evaṃ jñātvā mahārāja nirvāṇagatisādhanam | yadi te nirvṛtau vāṃchā tadaitāsu samācara || 2.85{86} || tataste maṃgalaṃ nityaṃ saṃvṛttisukhamāpnuyāḥ | kramātpāramitāḥ pūryya nirvṛtiṃ samavāpnuyāḥ || 2.86{87} || nirvāṇaṃ paramaṃ jñānaṃ nirvāṇaṃ paramaṃ sukham | nirvāṇaṃ paramaṃ puṇyaṃ nirvāṇaṃ paramāṃ gatim || 2.87{88} || evaṃ hi sukṛtaṃ sarvaṃ jñātvā nirvāṇakāraṇam | tathā dharme svayaṃ sthitvā preraṇīyāḥ prajā api || 2.88{89} || evaṃ sa caṃdano buddho bodhayitvā ca taṃ nṛpam | bodhimārge pratisthāpya virarāma kṣaṇaṃ tataḥ || 2.89{90} || atha sa nṛpatī rājā śrutvā taddharmamādarāt | pramoditaḥ samutthāya uttarāsaṃgamudvahan || 2.90{91} || jānubhyāṃ bhuvi saṃsthitvā kṛtāṃjalipuṭo nataḥ | suprasannamukhaḥ pādau natvā taṃ prārthayanmunim || 2.91{92} || namaste bhagavannātha bhavatāṃ śaraṇaṃ vraje | saddharmamādiśannatra vijayasva gaṇaiḥ saha || 2.92{93} || iti tena nṛpendreṇa prārthite sa munīśvaraḥ | tatheti pratisaṃśrutya traimāsyamadhyavāsayat || 2.93{94} || tataḥ sāntaḥpurā rājā taṃ munīndraṃ sasāṃghikam | sadā satkārapūjāṅgairbhojyaiḥ prārāgayanmudā || 2.94{95} || tasmiṃśca samaye tatra lokānācarakopitāḥ | varṣādhidevatā meghāvṛṣṭiṃ na mumucurbhuvi || 2.95{96} || tatastasyāmanāvṛṣṭyāṃ taḍāgādi jalāśrayāḥ | dine dine prahīnāṃbhaḥ paṃkaśeṣaviśoṣitāḥ || 2.96{97} || niḥpuṣpā niṣphalā vṛkṣāḥ śākhāpattraviśīrṇṇitāḥ || 2.97{97!} || sthāṇukalpā nirābhogyāḥ pakṣisaṃpātavarjitāḥ | mahīśasyavipannāśca bījāṃkulaviśoṣitāḥ || 2.98{98} || nistṛṇā prakhalībhūtā marukalpābhavattadā | annapānaviyogena mṛtā anekajantavaḥ || 2.99{99} || kṣutpipāsahatāḥ kecinnyaṣīdanta mṛtā iva | kecidgehe viṣaṇṇāsyā mṛtyuśaṃkāviṣāditāḥ || 2.100{100} || parasparaṃ mukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā niḥśvasanto niṣedire | kecinmeghaṃ ca khe dṛṣṭvā prāyācanta divāniśam || 2.101{1} || hā hatāsma iti proktvā kecittasthurnirāśitāḥ | evaṃ nānāprakāreṇa vilapanto vikheditāḥ || 2.102{2} || sarve'pi paurikāstatra cikhedurmṛtyuśaṃkitāḥ | taddṛṣṭvā nṛpatiścāpi mṛtyutrastānukaṃpitaḥ || 2.103{3} || maṃtriṇaḥ sacivān sarvān samāmaṃtryābravīditi | hā kaṣṭaṃ kathamatraivaṃ durbhikṣaṃ varttate'dhunā | kiṃ karomi na manye'haṃ vadadhvaṃ tatpratikriyām || 2.104{4} || yena tadā mahāpāpadurbhikṣaṃ śāmyate drutam | tadupāyaṃ prakuryāma tatkurudhvaṃ yathāvidhim || 2.105{5} || iti śrutvā nṛpājñāṃ te samaṃtrijanapaurikāḥ | devatā vidhinārādhya tacchāntiṃ saṃyayācire || 2.106{6} || bho devatāḥ prasīdadhvaṃ namo vaḥ praṇatā vayam | aparādhaṃ yadasmāsu kṣantavyaṃ sarvathāpi tat || 2.107{7} || imaṃ durbhikṣanirvṛṣṭiṃ prāptaṃ śamayata drutam | suvṛṣṭiṃ kārayitvātra subhikṣaṃ kuruta dhruvam || 2.108{8} || evaṃ kecidvidhātāraṃ kecidviṣṇuṃ janārdanam | kecicchivaṃ maheśānamiṃdraṃ kecitsurādhipam || 2.109{9} || kecidgrahādhipaṃ kecillokapālānmaharddhikān | kecicca mātṛkādevīṃ skaṃdavighneśabhairavān || 2.110{10} || mahākālagaṇāṃścāpi kecinnāgāñjalādhipān | kecinmeghān samālokya natvā vṛṣṭiṃ yayācire || 2.111{11} || evaṃ sarve'pi lokāśca svasveṣṭakuladevatāḥ | vidhinārādhya saṃprārthya suvṛṣṭiṃ prayayācire || 2.112{12} || evaṃ taiḥ prārthyamānāstāḥ sarvāśca devatā api | tatra vṛṣṭiṃ samutsraṣṭuṃ naiva śekurvighātitāḥ || 2.113{13} || tataḥ sarve ca te lokā dṛṣṭvā tadvṛṣṭighātitām | hāhākāravirāvanto vicikhedurnirāśitāḥ || 2.114{14} || atha rājā sa tān dṛṣṭvā durbhikṣākṣobhitāśāyān | tathā ca grahāmālokya visaṇṇāsyo vyacintayat || 2.115{15} || aho kaṣṭaṃ mahotpātaṃ mama rājye bhaviṣyati | kathamatra pratīkāraṃ tatpraśāntyai kariṣyate || 2.116{16} || kiṃ mayā nṛpabhūtena yaśodharmavighātinā | na śakyaṃte prajā yena rakṣitumītipīḍite | dhigmāṃ nṛpādhamībhūtaṃ kiṃ pāpaṃ prakṛtaṃ mayā | yena yasya prajā eva kṣutpipāsahatā mṛtāḥ | kimeva mama rājye na bhogyaiścāpi dhanairapi | kiṃ tena jīvitenāpi yaśodharmavināśinā || 2.117{18} || yena rājñā na rakṣyante prajāḥ svaviṣayāśritāḥ | sa kiṃ rājā baliṣṭho'pi kṛtānta iva manyate || 2.118{19} || yaśca rājā svabhogyārthaṃ kevalaṃ daṇḍamāharan | na vipatsu prajāḥ pāti sa kiṃ rājāpi cauravat || 2.119{20} || yeṣāmeva hitārthāya yaśca rājābhiṣicyate | sa teṣāṃ na hitaṃ kuryyātsa kiṃ rājā kṛtārthahā || 2.120{21} || dhikpravādahataḥ so'tra yaśodharmasukhārthahā | svayaṃ naṣṭaḥ parān hatvā narakeṣu vrajeddhruvam || 2.121{21!} || kiṃ cāhamapi mānuṣyaḥ samāna iṃdriyairapi | yato me kriyate sarvaiḥ sevo nityaṃ samāhitaiḥ || 2.122{22} || yadi na kriyate rakṣā mayāpyeṣāṃ vipatsvapi | kathametadṛśairmuktaḥ kadā yāsyāmi sadgatim || 2.123{23} || sarvadaitadṛṇairbaddhaḥ sarvathā pratibaṃdhitaḥ | karmabhiḥ preryyamāṇo'haṃ yāsyāmi narakān dhruvam || 2.124{24} || tadāhaṃ kiṃ kariṣyāmi yamadūtairadhiṣṭhite | dṛṣṭvā tāṃ bhīṣaṇāṃ krūrān patiṣyāmi vimohitaḥ || 2.125{25} || tadā tatra na vidyeta kaścittrātā dayānvitaḥ | dharma eva tadā rakṣettaddharmaṃ sādhayecchubham || 2.126{26} || dharmāśca bahudhā proktāsteṣāṃ prāhurmunīśvarāḥ | ādimadhyāntakalyāṇaṃ saugataṃ dharmamuttamam || 2.127{27} || yenaiva śubhatāṃ kṛtvā sarvatra bhuvaneṣvapi | sarvasatvāśca pālyante sarvadeha paratra ca || 2.128{28} || tathātrāpi śubhaṃ kartuṃ saṃbuddhaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajan | saddharmaṃ samavāptuṃ ca sevitavyaṃ sasāṃghike || 2.129{29} || tenātra sahasā kṛtvā puṣkaraṇīmanoramām | saṃbuddhasugataṃ tatra snāpayitvā sasāṃghikam || 2.130{30} || mahatsatkārapūjābhirbhojanaiśca pratoṣayan | tatastaṃ sugataṃ natvā taddurbhikṣaṃ praśāṃtaye || 2.131{31} || suvṛṣṭicāraṇe loke prārthayiṣyāmi sādaram | tadā sa bhagavānatra suvṛṣṭiṃ cārayeddhruvam || 2.132{32} || sarvatra śubhatāṃ kṛtvā subhikṣaṃ kārayetsadā | tato'tra sarvadāpyevaṃ durbhikṣaṃ na kadā cana || 2.133{33} || subhikṣaṃ sarvato bhadraṃ bhavennūnaṃ samaṃtataḥ | iti dhyātvā viniścitya manasā sa narādhipaḥ || 2.134{34} || sahasā sacivān sarvān samāmaṃtryābravīttathā | śṛṇudhvaṃ maṃtriṇo yanme manasā saṃviciṃtitam || 2.135{35} || tadanumodya yuṣmābhiḥ prakarttavyaṃ samāhitaiḥ | yadadya jāyate'vṛṣṭiṃ durbhikṣaṃ copavarttate || 2.136{36} || tadasmatpāpato nūnaṃ tatpāpaparihāṇaye | saṃbuddhaśaraṇaṃ kṛtvā saddharmasamavāptaye || 2.137{37} || sasaṃghaṃ sevituṃ nityamiche tadanumodyatām | sa eva bhagavānnāthaḥ kṛtvātra śubhatāṃ sadā || 2.138{38} || suvṛṣṭiṃ cārayitvā ca subhikṣaṃ kārayeddhruvam | tato'smākaṃ tadāpyatra maṃgalaṃ syātsamaṃtataḥ || 2.139{39} || sadā saddharmamādhāya saukhyaṃ bhuktvā bhajemahi | dharmeṇa śubhatā nityaṃ dharmeṇa jīyate vipat || 2.140{40} || dharmeṇa pālyate sarvaṃ dharmeṇa sadgatiṃ vrajet | dharmaṃ tu saugataṃ bhadraṃ sarve prāhurmunīśvarāḥ || 2.141{41} || saddharmaṃ samavāptuṃ taṃ saṃbuddhaṃ bhajatādarāt | buddha eva jagadbaṃdhuḥ sarvasatvahitaṃkaraḥ || 2.142{42} || buddha eva jaganmitraṃ sarvasatvasukhapradaḥ | buddha eva jagattrātā sarvasatvānukaṃpakaḥ || 2.143{43} || buddha eva jagadbhartā dharmārthasukhasaṃpradaḥ | buddha eva jagacchāstā sarvasattvānubodhakaḥ | buddha eva jagannātho bodhisaṃbhārapūrakaḥ | buddha eva jagatsvāmī saṃbodhimārgadeśakaḥ | buddha eva mahāvīraḥ sarvamāraprabhaṃjakaḥ || 2.144{44} || buddha eva mahāsatvaḥ ṣaḍabhijño jagatprabhuḥ | buddha eva trilokeṣu dharmarūjā munīśvaraḥ | yenaiva trijagallokaṃ pālitaṃ putravatsadā || 2.145{47!} || sa eva bhagavān buddhaḥ sevanīyaḥ śubhārthibhiḥ | yenaivaṃ triṣu lokeṣu sarvalokādhipeśvaraḥ || 2.146{48} || rājate jayate tena siddho'yaṃ dharmmarājjinaḥ | yathā ca triṣu lokeṣu bodhicaryāḥ prakāśayan | karoti bhadratāṃ nityaṃ tathātrāpi kariṣyati || 2.147{19} || saṃsthāpayati saddharme yathā traidhātuvāsinaḥ | satvān prabodhayannasmānniveśayettathā khalu || 2.148{20} || tataḥ sarve vayaṃ dhṛtvā saddharmaṃ śubhadaṃ śivam | yaśopuṇyasukhaṃ bhuktvā yāsyāmo'nte sukhāvatīm || 2.149{21} || iti matvā tathāsmābhiścandano'yaṃ jineśvaraḥ | mahatsatkārapūjābhiḥ sevitavyo mudā sadā || 2.150{22} || iti saṃbhāṣya taiḥ sarvaistathetyabhyanumoditaiḥ | maṃtribhiḥ saha rājā sa prayayau tajjināśramam || 2.151{23} || tatra prāptaḥ praviṣṭaśca dṛṣṭvā taṃ caṃdanaṃ munim | kṛtāṃjalipuṭo natvā cakāra prārthanāmiti || 2.152{24} || namaste bhagavacchāstaḥ vayaṃ te śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ | tatprasanno bhavāsmākaṃ kṣantavyā cāparādhatā || 2.153{24} || yadavṛṣṭiḥ pravṛttātra tadasmatpāpataḥ khalu | tatpāpaparihāṇāya saddharmaṃ deṣṭumarhasi || 2.154{26} || tadbhavantaṃ vayaṃ sarve snāpayitvā sasāṃghikān | yathāśaktyupacāraiśca samichāmo'rcituṃ pure || 2.155{27} || tatprasīda munīndro'si yathāsmākaṃ hitaṃ bhavet | tathāsmatpuramāgatvā śubhaṃ kartuṃ samarhasi || 2.156{28} || iti tenārthitaṃ rājñā śrutvā sa caṃdano muniḥ | tūṣṇībhūtvā tathetyevamadhyuvāsa sa sāṃghikaḥ || 2.157{29} || tataḥ sa nṛpatirjñātvā tadadhivāsitaṃ muneḥ | pādau natvā punardṛṣṭvā sahasā svaṃ puraṃ yayau || 2.158{60!} || tataḥ pure ca mārgeṣu śodhayitvā samaṃtataḥ | sugaṃdhijalasaṃsiktamakārayanmahītalam || 2.159{61} || tataḥ puṣpāvakīrṇṇaṃ ca kārayitvā samaṃtataḥ | dhvajacchatravitānaiśca tatpuraṃ paryyabhūṣayat || 2.160{62} || tatastannagare madhye kārayitvā saro varam | tadgaṃdhodakasaṃpūrṇamakārayatpraśobhitam || 2.161{63} || tatra puṣpābhiḥ saṃyuktaṃ kṛtvā tīre samaṃtataḥ | chatradhvajapatākāni vitatya paryyamaṇḍayat || 2.162{64} || āsanāni ca prajñapya sasaṃghasya kramānmuneḥ | svarṇakuṃbhāṃśca saṃsthāpya śucigaṃdhāmbupūritān || 2.163{65} || tato pūjopacārāṃ bhojyopakaraṇāni ca | sādhayitvopasaṃsthāpya saṃgītisahitāni ca || 2.164{66} || tato rājā sa sāmātyaiḥ paurikaiśca samanvitaḥ | taṃ buddhaṃ puramānetuṃ jināśramamagānmudā || 2.165{67} || tatra sa sahasā prāpto dṛṣṭvā taṃ candanaṃ munim | kṛtāṃjalipuṭo natvā gamanaṃ prārthayaditi || 2.166{68} || sarvajña bhagavaṃ gantuṃ samayo varttate'dhunā | sarvaṃ ca sādhitaṃ siddhaṃ tadāśvāgantumarhasi || 2.167{69} || evaṃ tenārthite rājñā sa saṃbuddhaḥ sasāṃghikaḥ | pātracīvaramādāya prāgāttatpurasaṃmukhaḥ || 2.168{70} || yadāsau bhagavān buddhāḥ prātihāryyaṃ pradarśayan | lokān bhāsāvasaṃbhāsya prācaran prāptagopuram || 2.169{71} || tadākampadrasā sābdhirvavau vāyuḥ sumaṃgalam | kṣutpipāsā hatā ye ca te sarve paritṛptitāḥ || 2.170{72} || ye ca hīnendriyāḥ satvāste ca pūrṇendriyā babhuḥ | nirdhanā dhanināścāsan rogino nirujo'bhavan || 2.171{73} || baṃdhanasthā vimuktāśca duḥkhitāḥ sukhino'bhavan | unmattāḥ susmṛtiṃ prāptā nagnā āsan suvastrikāḥ || 2.172{74} || gurviṇyā yāśca tāḥ sarvāḥ pramadāḥ sukhasūtikāḥ | ciravairānusaṃbaddhā maitrībhūtāḥ samācaran || 2.173{75} || ye ca pāparatāḥ satvā daśākuśalacārikāḥ | te sarve parisaṃtṛptāḥ puṇyakāmāḥ pracerire || 2.174{76} || evamanye ca ye tatra pāpakā upasargikāḥ | te sarve vilayaṃ yātāḥ te sarve saṃśubhāṅkitāḥ || 2.175{77} || evaṃ sarvaprakāreṇa hatvā sarvamamaṅgalam | kṛtvā bhadraṃ ca sarvatra sasaṃghaḥ sa pure'viśat || 2.176{78} || kramātpradakṣiṇenaivaṃ pracaritvā mahotsavaiḥ || 2.177{79} || vaṃdyamānastu taiḥ sarvaiḥ sadevāsuramānavaiḥ || 2.178{80} || taṃ nṛpaṃ purataḥ kṛtvā rājamārgamupāsaran | tatsarovarasaṃprāpto dṛṣṭvā tīre samāśrayat || 2.179{81} || tataḥ sa bhagavān buddho yathā prajñapta āsane | ekacīvarakastasthau snātuṃ tatra sarovare || 2.180{82} || tato nṛpādayaḥ sarve lokāstaṃ caṃdanaṃ munim | sasaṃghaṃ snāpayāmāsuḥ svarṇakumbhāmbubhiḥ kramāt || 2.181{83} || kṛtvā snānaṃ tato'nyatra yathāprajñapta āsane | sasaṃgho bhagavān tasthau svaprabhāvaṃ pradarśayan || 2.182{84} || atha rājā sa taṃ buddhaṃ samāsīnaṃ sasāṃghikam | cīvaraprāvṛtaṃ kṛtvā pūjāṅgaiḥ samapūjayat || 2.183{85} || tataśca bhojanaiḥ śuddhaiḥ praṇītairvyañjanairapi | paṃcāmṛtaiśca pānaiśca sutṛptiṃ samatoṣayat || 2.184{86} || tataśca bhojanāṃte saṃśodhayitvā mukhādikam | nīcāsane samāsīnaḥ kṛtāṃjalipuṭo nṛpaḥ || 2.185{87} || suprasannamukhāmbhojaḥ sa maṃtrījanapaurikaiḥ | natvā kṣamāpayitvā taṃ sasaṃghaṃ prārthayattathā || 2.186{88} || sarvajña bhagavannātha kṣamasva no'parādhatām | prasīda sarvathā rakṣa dṛṣṭvāsmān pāpacāriṇaḥ || 2.187{89} || taddurbhikṣavināśāya suvṛṣṭiṃ cāraya drutam | sarvasatvahitārthāya saddharmaṃ ca samādiśa || 2.188{90} || ityevaṃ prārthite tena rājñā lokahitārthinā | saṃbuddho bhagavāṃścaivaṃ svāśīrvacanamabravīt || 2.189{91} || ārogyamastu te rājan sarvatrāpi ca maṃgalam | subhikṣaṃ sarvadāpyatra nirvighnaṃ bodhimāpnuhi || 2.190{92} || iti svāśīrvaco datvā saṃbuddhaḥ sa sasāṃghikaḥ | tataśca svāśramaṃ prāgātsa nṛpajanamanvitaḥ || 2.191{93} || evamasya munīndrasya traimāsyaṃ ca niraṃtaram | tenākāri nṛpendreṇa sevā satkārapūjanaiḥ || 2.192{94} || tataḥ śakro mahendro'sau dṛṣṭvā tatsugatārcitām | taddurbhikṣapraśāṃtyarthaṃ suvṛṣṭiṃ samacārayat || 2.193{95} || tato jalāśrayānyambupūritāni samaṃtataḥ | padmotpalādipuṣpaiśca channāni rurucustadā || 2.194{96} || tṛṇairnavāṅkurodbhūtaṃ sādvalaiśca prarūḍhitaiḥ | pratichannā haridvastraiḥ prāvṛtaiva rarāja bhūḥ || 2.195{97} || vṛkṣāścāpi haritpatraiḥ samāchannāḥ praśobhitāḥ | puṣpaiḥ prasphullitairamyaiḥ phalaiśca saṃcakāsire || 2.196{98} || kramāccaivaṃ prarūḍhāni śasyāni varddhitāni ca | pariniṣpannasiddhāni pravipecuḥ samaṃtataḥ | tataḥ sarve janāścaivaṃ saṃprayātāṃ subhikṣatām | dṛṣṭvānaṃdaṃ samuccāryya pracerire praharṣitāḥ || 2.197{99} || atha rājā sa tān sarvānmahāharṣapramoditān | dṛṣṭvā bhūyaḥ samāmaṃtrya vabhāṣa saṃprabodhayan || 2.198{100} || bhavanto dṛśyatāmasya saṃbuddhasyānubhāvatā | yasya puṇyānubhāvena prajātaiva subhikṣatā || 2.199{1} || tasmānnityaṃ tathaivāsya saṃbuddhasya jagatprabhoḥ | mahatsatkārapūjābhiḥ karttavyaṃ bhajanaṃ sadā || 2.200{2} || evaṃ yadi sadā cāsya saṃbuddhasya jagatprabhoḥ | pūjābhiḥ satkariṣyanti sadātra maṃgalaṃ bhavet || 2.201{3} || tasmādasya munīndrasya nakhakeśavidarbhitaḥ | gandhastūpaḥ pratisthāpya sevitavyaḥ sadārcanaiḥ || 2.202{4} || iti saṃbhāṣya rājāsau taistathetyanumoditaiḥ | saha bauddhāśramaṃ gatvā natvā taṃ prārthayanmunim || 2.203{5} || namaste bhagavaṃ chāstarvayaṃ te śaraṇasthitāḥ | sadā caivaṃ kariṣyāmo bhavatsevāmupāsthitāḥ || 2.204{6} || tatprasīda sadā pātra vihṛtya dharmamādiśan | vijayasva na cānyatra mā vraja no'nukaṃpayā || 2.205{7} || tenaivaṃ prārthite rājñā bhagavāṃśca sa caṃdanaḥ | taṃ nṛpaṃ sajanaṃ dṛṣṭvā prasannāsyo'bravīttathā || 2.206{8} || naiva rājanmayā bodhirekasyārthe prasādhitā | api ca sarvasatvānāṃ hitārthe hyanukaṃpinā || 2.207{9} || tasmādatra sadā naiva sthāsyāmyahaṃ sasāṃghikaḥ | sarvatrāpi careyāhaṃ saddharmaṃ saṃprakāśitum || 2.208{10} || yadi me śraddhayā nityaṃ sevāṃ kartuṃ samichatha | keśastūpaṃ pratisthāpya sevyata sarvadārcanaiḥ || 2.209{11} || tataste'tra sadā rājye subhikṣaṃ maṃgalaṃ bhavet | durbhikṣatā ca kutrāpi nākramiṣyati kadā cana || 2.210{12} || iti matvā tvayā gatvā triratnaśaraṇaṃ svayam | sarvasatvāśca saddharme preraṇīyāḥ prayatnataḥ || 2.211{13} || ityādiśya munīṃdro'sau chitvā svānnakharāṃstathā | keśāṃścāpyavatāryyaivaṃ tasmai rājñe svayaṃ dadau || 2.212{14} || tato rājā sa taṃ buddhaṃ natvā keśāṃ nakhāṃśca tān | samādāya praharṣeṇa pratyāyayau svamālayam || 2.213{15} || tatra prāptaḥ pure madhye puṣkariṇyāstaṭāntike | tatkeśanakharān ropya gaṃdhastūpamakārayat || 2.214{16} || tasmiṃ siddhe pratisthāpya vidhinā ca mahotsavaiḥ | nityaṃ satkārapūjābhiḥ sevāṃ cakre prasannadhīḥ || 2.215{17} || etatpuṇyānubhāvena loke'ṃdhe'pariṇāyake | jagalloke hitaṃ kartuṃ bhaveyaṃ sugatastathā || 2.216{18} || iti dhṛtvā pracitte'sau praṇidhānaṃ narādhipaḥ | gaṃdhajalaiśca taṃ stūpaṃ snāpayitvā sadārcayat || 2.217{19} || pratisthāpya mahaṃ cāpi gatvā ca śaraṇe mudā | aṣṭāṃgaiśca praṇatvaivaṃ mahotsāhairasevayat || 2.218{20} || tathā sarve janāścāpi śraddhayā taṃ prabhejire | ye gatāḥ śaraṇaṃ tatra te sarve nirvṛtiṃ yayuḥ || 2.219{21} || ahamevāvasiṣṭaḥ sa teṣāṃ yo'bhūnnarādhipaḥ | saṃbodhipraṇidhiṃ dhṛtvā naivaṃ nirvāṇamāyayau || 2.220{22} || etatpuṇyānubhāvaiśca suvṛṣṭiḥ saṃpracāritā | sarvadāpyabhavattatra subhikṣaṃ nirupadravam || 2.221{23} || etaddharmānubhāvaiśca sarvatra sāṃprataṃ labhe | pūjāsatkāramānyāni yaśodharmasukhāni ca || 2.222{24} || yatra yatra pragachāmi tatra tatra samaṃtataḥ | itthaṃ satkārapūjābhirmānito'haṃ sasāṃghikaḥ || 2.223{25} || tacchāstāraṃ samārādhya yaśodharmasukhepsubhiḥ | śubheṣu sarvadā nityaṃ caritavyaṃ prayatnataḥ || 2.224{26} || śubhena sukhatā nityaṃ bhavelloke samaṃtataḥ | pāpena duḥkhatā caivaṃ miśritenāpi miśritā || 2.225{27} || tasmātpāpaṃ viramyaivaṃ miśritāni vihāya ca | śubheṣveva prayatnena caritavyaṃ sukhārthibhiḥ || 2.226{28} || ityādiṣṭaṃ munīndreṇa sarve te sāṃghikāstathā | śrutvā pramenire satyaṃ karmabhāvaṃ bhavālaye || 2.227{29} || pāpebhyo viratā nityaṃ miśritebhyo'pi te sadā | sadā śubheṣu niratāḥ sarve saṃcerire samāhitāḥ || 2.228{30} || evaṃ rājaṃstvayā nityaṃ pāpācca miśritādapi | viramya sarvathā dharme caritavyaṃ sukhāptaye || 2.229{31} || prajāścāpi vinirvāryya sarvathā pāpacāraṇāt | śrāvayitvā ca saddharmaṃ yojanīyāḥ śubhe sadā || 2.230{32} || tathā te sarvadā nityaṃ sarvatra viṣayeṣvapi | suvṛṣṭiḥ pracareccaivaṃ maṃgalaṃ nirupadravam || 2.231{23!} || iti tena samādiṣṭamupaguptena śāsinā | śrutvāśoko nṛpo'stvevamityanandatsapārṣadaḥ || 2.232{24} || snātāvadānaṃ tadidaṃ niśamya ye śrāvayanti pratibodhya lokān | te pāpanirmuktaviśuddhadehāḥ prayānti nūnaṃ sugatālayeṣu || 2.233{25} || iti ratnāvadānamālāyāṃ snātāvadānaṃ samāptam cakrāvadāna athāśoko narendro'sau bhūyo natvā kṛtāṃjaliḥ | upaguptaṃ guruṃ prāha śrotumanyatsubhāṣitam || 3.1{1} || bhadanta śrotumichāmi bhūyo'pyanyatsubhāṣitam | yathā te guruṇā khyātaṃ tathā me vaktumarhasi || 3.2{2} || iti tenārthite rājñā bhūyo'pyasau jināṃśajaḥ | upagupto yatirbhikṣustaṃ nṛpamevamabravīt || 3.3{3} || yathā me guruṇādiṣṭaṃ vakṣye'haṃ te subhāṣitam | sādhu cittaṃ samādhāya śṛṇu rājan samāhitaḥ || 3.4{4} || yaḥ purāsīnmahābuddhaḥ sarvajñaḥ śrīghano jinaḥ | sarvavidyākalābhijño dharmarājastathāgataḥ || 3.5{5} || śāstārhan sugato nāthastraidhātukavināyakaḥ | sa śākyādhipatirloke hitāya ca samaṃtataḥ || 3.6{6} || saddharmadeśanāṃ kṛtvā bodhimārgaṃ prakāśayan | bhikṣuśrāvakasaṃghaiśca bodhisatvaiśca sāṃghikaiḥ || 3.7{7} || upāsikāgaṇaiścaivamupāsakagaṇaṃ saha | rājagṛhamupāśritya veṇuvane jināśrame || 3.8{8} || kalaṃdake nivāpākhye mahodyāne samāśritaḥ | ādimadhyāṃtakatyāṇaṃ dideśa dharmamuttamam || 3.9{9} || taddharmadeśanāṃ śrotuṃ devāsuramanuṣyakāḥ | yakṣakinnaragaṃdharvāḥ siddhavidyādharādayaḥ || 3.10{10} || garuḍā nāgarājāśca mahāharṣasamanvitāḥ | brāhmaṇā kṣatriyāścaiva rājāno rājaputrakāḥ || 3.11{11} || vaiśyāśca śreṣṭhinaḥ śūdrā maṃtriṇo mātṛkājanāḥ | sārthavāhāśca paurāśca dhaninaśca vaṇigjanāḥ || 3.12{12} || evamanye'pi lokāśca sarve te saṃpraharṣitāḥ | mahatsatkārapūjābhiḥ sarvopakaraṇaistathā || 3.13{13} || pūjayitvā pravaṃditvā saṃbuddhaṃ sugataṃ munim | parivṛtya puraskṛtya tasthau sarvānya tasthire || 3.14{14} || saddharmavāṃchitāḥ sarve śrotuṃ tatra samāgatāḥ || 3.15{15} || tasmiṃśca samaye pūryyāṃ śrāvastyāṃ subhago vaṇik | anyattamaḥ sārthavāha āsīnmahādhanaḥ sudhīḥ || 3.16{16} || tena bhāryyā subhadrāṃgī jātidharmasamānikā | pariṇītā kulasthityai kuladharmānusārataḥ || 3.17{17} || tatastau daṃpatī raktau snehānubandhitau mudā | yathākāmaṃ prabhuṃjānau sanramāte yathechayā || 3.18{18} || tatastasya gṛhasthasya bhogyeṣvevābhirāgiṇaḥ | svakulavṛttidharmeṣu pramādādanapekṣiṇaḥ || 3.19{19} || vyavahāre viraktasya prodyamarahitasya ca | arjanopāyamaṃdasya kevalaṃ vyayakurvataḥ || 3.20{20} || dine dine kraṃānnityamativyayānnirāgamat | saṃpadaḥ kṣīṇatāṃ yātā griṣmakāla iva hradāḥ || 3.21{21} || tatastasya gṛhasthasya bhāryā yā kuladharmikā | saṃpadaḥ kṣīnatāṃ dṛṣṭvā gṛhe caivaṃ vyacintayat || 3.22{22} || ayaṃ me puruṣo bharttā sārthavāho vaṇikdhanī | bhāgyameva gṛhe bhuktvā nivasati nirudyamaḥ || 3.23{23} || atyarthavyayatā yatra vidyate na tathāgamaḥ | sā ca saṃpatkiyatkālaṃ tiṣṭhetkṣīṇaṃ vrajetkramāt || 3.24{24} || tadayaṃ puruṣaścāpi kathaṃ sustho bhaviṣyati | kena saṃdhāryyate lokairvihīne bhogyasaṃcaye || 3.25{25} || vṛddho'pyayaṃ bhavennūnaṃ daridro'pi bhavettathā | tadā kiṃ paribhuktvaivaṃ gṛhe tisthetkathaṃ sukhī || 3.26{26} || yasya saṃpadgṛhe nāsti kathaṃ sa puruṣaḥ sukhī | svayaṃ bhoktuṃ na śaktaḥ syātkiṃ punardānamācaret || 3.27{27} || dānaṃ vinā na saṃsāre kiṃ sārasukhamāpsyate | dānenaiva hi labhyante yaśodharmasukhāni ca || 3.28{28} || dānena śuddhyate cittaṃ śuddhacitto bhavetsudhiḥ | sudhiyā sādhyate śīlaṃ śīlavān syācchubhaṃkarī || 3.29{29} || śubhakarmā ca saddharmaṃ kṛtvā yāsyati sadgatim | tasmādahamimaṃ nāthaṃ bharttāraṃ puruṣaṃ prabhum || 3.30{30} || saddharmasukhasaṃprāptyai prerayeyaṃ dhanārjane | dhanavān puruṣo loke sarvārthasādhane kṛtī || 3.31{31} || dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ mūlaṃ prāhurdhanaṃ budhāḥ | bharturhi puruṣasyāpi trivargakāryyasādhane || 3.32{32} || sahāyaḥ kathyate prājñaiḥ satī bhāryyānucāriṇī | asya bharturhyahaṃ bharyyā satī dharmārthasādhane || 3.33{33} || manaḥ protsāhitaṃ kṛtvā prerayeyaṃ dhanārjane || 3.34{34!} || iti niścitya sā sādhvī dṛṣṭvā bharttāramādarāt | dharmārthasādhane caivaṃ protsāhayitumabravīt || 3.35{34!} || svāmi bharttāsi me nātho devatāpi tvameva hi | tanmayā vakṣyate tathyaṃ paratreha sukhāya te || 3.36{35} || tathyaṃ ca tacchṛṇuṣvaivamanyathā cettu mā kuru || 3.37{36} || yadbhavān purusaḥ prāḍhyaḥ sārthavāho vaṇikprabhuḥ | sadā bhogyāni bhuktvaiva sthitvā naivaṃ praśobhati || 3.38{37} || tatpramādaṃ parityaktvā yaśodharmasukhāptaye | satyadharmānusāreṇa kuruṣva dhanasādhanam || 3.39{38} || dhanena sādhayedbhogyaṃ bhogyena pālayettanum | dehena sādhayeddharmaṃ dharmeṇa satsukhaṃ labhet || 3.40{39} || kiṃ ca yatra gṛhe svāmī vyavahāranirudyamaḥ | tatra sarve janāścāpi niṣatsyaṃtyavasādinaḥ || 3.41{40} || api yatra gṛhe svāmī vyavahārasamudyataḥ | tatra sarve janāścaiva pracareyuḥ samudyamāḥ || 3.42{41} || yacca dānamahotsāhaṃ yatra gehe na vidyate | sa kiṃ geho na ramyaḥ syācchūnyāraṇye śmaśānavat || 3.43{41!} || yasmin gṛhe sadā nityaṃ dānapuṇyamahotsavam | sa eva mandiro ramyasvargavatpratibhāsyate || 3.44{42} || yasmiṃścāpi gṛhastho hi dānapuṇyanirutsahaḥ | svayameva prabhuktvaivaṃ vasate paśuvatsa kim || 3.45{43} || dhanyāste puruṣā vīrā yaśodharmasukhānvitāḥ | kṛtvā dānavṛṣotsāhaṃ sukhaṃ bhuktvā vasaṃti ye || 3.46{44} || teṣāmeva hi saṃsāre susāraṃ jīvitaṃ khalu | ye kṛtvā dānapuṇyāni svayaṃ saukhyaṃ ca bhuṃjate || 3.47{45} || dānenaiva hi lobhyaṃte yaśodharmasukhāni ca | anyathā naiva lapsyante tataḥ saṃpannirarthitā || 3.48{46} || kiyatkālaṃ ca jīveyurye bhuktvaiva sukhaṃ sthitāḥ | avaśyaṃ sarvaśo hitvā mṛtā yāyuryamālayam || 3.49{47} || tatra karmasahāyāṃstān dṛṣṭvā dharmādhipo yamaḥ | nirṇayitvā ca tatkarma prerayetkarmabhuktaye || 3.50{48} || ye ca pāpakarā duṣṭā prerayettān tu durgatau | ye tu puṇyakarā bhadrāḥ prerayettāṃśca sadgatau || 3.51{49} || tatra karmaphalānyevaṃ duḥkhāni ca | sukhāni ca sarvatheha paratrāpi bhuṃjate sarvajāṃtavaḥ || 3.52{50} || śubhena sadgatiṃ yayādyaśodharmasukhānvitāḥ | pāpena durgatiṃ yāyāddhikpravādāsukhānvitāḥ || 3.53{51} || evaṃ matvā prabho svāmin yaśodharmasukhāptaye | svakulavṛttimādhāya prodyamasva dhanārjane || 3.54{52} || sadā dānamahotsāhaṃ kṛtvā sadgatilabdhaye | yathechayā sukhaṃ bhuktvā pālayasva sadā janān || 3.55{53} || tataste maṃgalaṃ nityaṃ bhavediha paratra ca | saphalaṃ mānuṣaṃ janma nūnaṃ sadgatimāpnuyāt || 3.56{54} || iti bhāryāvacaḥ śrutvā sa gṛhastho vaṇiksudhīḥ | bhāryāṃ tāṃ vallabhāṃ kāntāṃ dṛṣṭvā caivaṃ samabravīt || 3.57{55} || ayi priye subhadrāsi mama bhāryānucāriṇī | yattvayā bhāṣitaṃ satyaṃ tatkariṣyāmi sarvathā || 3.58{56} || kiṃ tu tvaṃ me priyā bhāryā vallabhātimanoharā | tatkathaṃ tvāṃ priyāṃ tyaktvā kutra yāsye dhanārthataḥ || 3.59{57} || sārthavāho hyahaṃ cāpi tatkathaṃ nīcavṛttibhiḥ | ratnārjanaṃ kariṣyāmi tato ratnākaraṃ vraje || 3.60{58} || tasmātpriye subhadrāṃgī sati dharmānucāriṇī | gṛhakāryyaṃ samādhāryya vasa bhuktvā yathāsukham || 3.61{59} || yāvannāhaṃ gṛhe prāptastāvaddhairyyaṃ samāśraya | śīghramevāgamiṣyāmi maṃ smṛtvā mānvatapyathāḥ || 3.62{60} || iti bharttoditaṃ śrutvā sā ca bhāryānutāpitā | galadaśrumukhī natvā svāminaṃ tamabhāṣata || 3.63{61} || he nātha supriya svāminmāṃ vihāya kathaṃ vrajeḥ | tvayā vinā kathaṃ gehe tiṣṭheyāhaṃ yathā vane || 3.64{62} || darśane śravaṇe vāpi gaṃdhatailānulepane | sparśane bhojane pāne suvastraparibhūṣaṇe || 3.65{63} || saurabhyā'ṅgane cāpi bhāṣane gamane kvacit | nidrābhoge tathā naiva vidyeta me'bhilāṣatā || 3.66{64} || tavaiva smaraṇaṃ kṛtvā niḥśvasantī muhurmuhuḥ | virahānalasaṃtaptā vrajeyaṃ maraṇaṃ dhruvam || 3.67{65} || mṛtāyāṃ mayi te gehe ko'nurakṣennu saṃpadaḥ | śrutvā me maraṇaṃ nūnaṃ dhakṣyase virahānalaiḥ || 3.68{66} || tadaitābhiśca saṃpattiratnaiśca kiṃ kariṣyasi | aputrasya hi sarvasvaṃ nūnaṃ rājā grahīṣyati || 3.69{67} || tadātmanā vikhidyaivaṃ dūraṃ mā gā vihāyatām | gṛhe sthitvā mayā sārddhāṃ sukhaṃ bhuktvodyamaṃ kuru || 3.70{68} || atrāpi bahavaḥ santi vaṇiksaṃghā mahājanāḥ | paṇyaṃ prasāryya taṃ sārddhaṃ sādhayasva dhanaṃ sukham || 3.71{69} || kiyatkālaṃ ca jīveva santatiśca na vidyate | tatkiṃ nau bahubhī ratnairmā gā ratnākaraṃ hyataḥ || 3.72{70} || yāvajjīvaṃ sukhaṃ bhuktvā dānaṃ kṛtvā sadārthine | saṃvṛtyā prārjaya dravyaṃ svagehe saṃsthito rama || 3.73{71} || mā dhāva priya kutrāpi kiṃ vā ratnākare labhet | svagṛhe'pi labhejjantuḥ svakarmanirmitaṃ dhanam || 3.74{72} || svakṛtaṃ karma tadbhāvi nirmāṇasadṛśaṃ phalam | sarvatrāpi labhantyeva mahāntaḥ kṣudrikā api || 3.75{73} || tathā ye sujanā loke sadhanā sadguṇāśrayāḥ | te'pi kṣaṇādbhavantyeva nirdhanā bhikṣutāśritāḥ || 3.76{74} || ye cāpi durjanā loke nirdhanā nirguṇāśca ye | te'pi labhanti mānyārhaṃ sevyante cāpi sajjanaiḥ || 3.77{75} || tathā ye vaṇijo dhīrāḥ sārthavāhā maṇīchayā | ratnākaraṃ gatāsteṣāṃ ke citsvastisamāgatāḥ || 3.78{76} || ke cittatra samudre vā bhagnanaukā dhanaiḥ saha | patitāḥ sannimajjantā mṛtāśca vilayaṃ gatāḥ || 3.79{77} || ke cidvīryabalenaivaiḥ samuttīrya prayatnataḥ | akiṃcanyāḥ paribhraṣṭā riktahastā gṛhāgatāḥ | evaṃ sarve'pi satvāśca svakṛtakarmanirmitam | phalaṃ bhuktvā bhramantyevaṃ saṃsāre ṣaḍgatiṣvapi || 3.80{78} || iti karmapramāṇatvaṃ jñātvā saṃpadvipattitā | mā khedaya svamātmānaṃ dharmaṃ kṛtvā sukhaṃ vasa || 3.81{79} || tathā nau maṃgalaṃ nityaṃ sarvatrāpi bhavetkhalu | yāvajjīvaṃ sukhaṃ bhuktvā sadgatiṃ ca vrajemahi || 3.82{80} || iti bhāryoditaṃ śrutvā sārthavāhātmajaḥ sa ca | taṃ priyāṃ ramaṇīṃ bhāryyāṃ dṛṣṭvaivaṃ samabhāṣata || 3.83{81} || bhadre satyaṃ tvaṃ yā proktaṃ yatsvakarmapramānatā | iti matvāhamichāmi gantuṃ ratnākare'pi hi || 3.84{82} || yadabhāvi na tadbhāvi bhāvi cenna tadanyathā | sarvatrāpi bhavennūnaṃ tenābdhiṃ gantumīhyate || 3.85{83} || yadi bhāgyaṃ mamāstyevaṃ svasti syādgamane khalu | ratnāni bahuśo labdhā pratyāgacheya siddhitāḥ || 3.86{84} || atha me bhāgyatā naiva nūnaṃ tatra vipattitā | mahattīrthe nimagno'haṃ mṛto yāsye surālayam || 3.87{85} || yathā bhaṭṭā mahāvīrā yaśodharmasukhāptaye | śatruṃ jetuṃ mahotsāhairviśanti raṇamaṇḍale || 3.88{86} || tatra ke ciddhatā vīrā yaśodharmānvitā mṛtāḥ | sahasā te prayāntyevaṃ svargasaukhyānubhoginaḥ || 3.89{87} || ahamapi vaṇikputraḥ sārthavāhātmajo hyaham | tattathāhaṃ gaṃiṣyāmi ratnākaraṃ na cānyataḥ || 3.90{88} || yadi svasti gṛhaṃ prāpsye yaśoratnasukhānvitaḥ | mṛto'tha nirmalībhūtvā svarge saukhyamavāpnuyām || 3.91{89} || iti matvā priye bhadre mā viṣīda sukhāṃ vasa | yāvannāhaṃ gṛhaṃ prāptastāvadbhajeṣṭadevatām || 3.92{90} || sarvathāhaṃ gamiṣyāmi svakulakīrtilabdhaye | anivarttī hyahaṃ kāryye tanmāṃ tvaṃ mā nivāraya || 3.93{91} || iti bhartturvacaḥ śrutvā nirbandhaṃ gamanaṃ prati | sā satī taṃ svabharttāraṃ natvā prāha kṛtāṃjaliḥ || 3.94{92} || svāmiṃstvaṃ sarvathā gantuṃ yadīchasi mahāmbudhim | dhairyyamālamvya saṃpaśyanmārge vraja samāhitaḥ || 3.95{93} || svasti te vrajato mārge sarvatrāpi divāniśam | svasti pratyāgate caivaṃ bhūyānnityaṃ śubhaṃ sadā || 3.96{94} || yātrāsiddhimahāsaṃpadyaśodharmasukhānvitaḥ | svasti śīghraṃ samāgacha vrajā te'stu sadā śivam || 3.97{95} || iti bhāryoditaṃ śrutvā sārthavāhastatheti saḥ | pratijñāya vaṃksaṃghān sarvānāhūya cābravīt || 3.98{96} || bhavanto'haṃ samichāmi yośodharmasukhāptaye | svakulavṛttimādhāya gantuṃ ratnākarāṃbudhau || 3.99{97} || tatra gantuṃ mayā sārddhaṃ yadi yūyaṃ samichatha | tatpaṇyaṃ sahasādāya samāyāta caremahi || 3.100{98} || iti tenoditaṃ śrutvā sarve te vaṇijo mudā | sahasā paṇyamādāya tatra gantumupākraman || 3.101{99} || atha sārthapatiḥ śīghraṃ taiśca paṃcaśataiḥ saha | svastyayanavidhiṃ kṛtvā pratasthe saṃpramoditaḥ || 3.102{100} || tataḥ kramādatikramya grāmajanapadāni te | vilaṃghyāraṇyadeśāṃśca tīraṃ prāpurmahodadheḥ || 3.103{1} || tato nāvaṃ samāruhya tāni paṃcaśatāni ca | pravitatya dhvajaṃ śubhraṃ jagāhire'mbudhau kramāt || 3.104{2} || tathā te vahanārūḍhā vātānukūlato dhruvam | kramāddvīpāṃśca laṃghitvā ratnākaraṃ samāyayuḥ || 3.105{3} || tatra ratnākaraṃ prāptā devatā supramodataḥ | te mithaḥ kalahaṃ kṛtvā pratyāgaṃtuṃ na śekire || 3.106{4} || ciramevaṃ virodhitvādratnāni ca na lebhire | bāṃdhavāṃśca muhuḥ smṛtvā tasthuḥ sarve vilaṃvitāḥ || 3.107{5} || atrāṃtare ca sā nārī sārthavāhapriyā satī | bharttrā vinā gṛhaṃ śūnyamamanyata nirutsavāt || 3.108{6} || yaddine prasthito bhartā sārthavāhaḥ purādvahiḥ | taddinārabhya sā nārī gaṇayantī dinaṃ prati || 3.109{7} || bharttureva muhuḥ smṛtvā virahavedanāturā | niḥśvasantī muhuścaivamadhairyyā paritāpinī || 3.110{8} || kṛśāṅgā pāṇḍuvarṇā ca virukṣākīrṇakeśinī | prasādhanānabhīchantī malinavasanāvṛtā || 3.111{9} || darśanaśravaṇe cāpi gaṃdhānvāharaṇe'pi ca | bhojaneṣvapi pāne ca sparśane gamaneṣvapi || 3.112{10} || kutūhare tathānyatra manorame'pi cādbhute | sarvatra viṣayeṣvevaṃ na protsahe yathāturā || 3.113{11} || bhartturviyogaduḥkhārttā roginīva viṣādinī | asahyamadanākrāntā dhairyyopāyavicetanā || 3.114{12} || bharturāgatimālambya kṣaṇaṃ dhairyyasamāśritā | bhartārameva saṃsmṛtvā gṛha eva nyaṣīdata || 3.115{13} || na nidrāṃ śayane bheje nānyasmṛtau mano'nudat | prabhumevaṃ samādhyātvā tasthau dhyāyīva yogavit || 3.116{14} || athaivaṃ vikalībhūtāṃ yauvanīṃ tāṃ pativratām | kācidekā sakhī bhadrā saṃnirīkṣyābravīdrahaḥ || 3.117{15} || bhadre kin te viṣāda tvaṃ vibhāsi tvaiḥ yathāturā | mā viṣīda yadarthan te tadvadasva mayi priye || 3.118{16} || kathaṃ notsahase bhadre svakuladharmacāriṇi | kautuke cādbhute cāpi sarvatra viṣayeṣvapi || 3.119{17} || bhojane bhūṣaṇe cāpi draṣṭuṃ śrotuṃ na vāṃchasi | kiṃ viṣādena siddhaṃ te tatprabhukṣva yathāsukham || 3.120{18} || iti tayodite sakhyā sārthavāhapriyāpi sa | tāṃ sakhīṃ pramadāṃ kāntāṃ dṛṣṭvā caivamabhāṣata || 3.121{19} || nāhaṃ bhogārthinī bhadre nāpi kāmātirāgiṇī | kiṃ tu dharmānuraktāsmi tatkathaṃ svāminaṃ vinā || 3.122{20} || tenāhaṃ viṣayāṃ tyaktvā smṛtvā bharttārameva tam | svāgāra eva tiṣṭhāmi bhogyeṣvapi ca nispṛhā || 3.123{21} || kadā sa me priyo bharttā gṛhe pratyāsariṣyati | iti ciṃtāṃ samādhāya tiṣṭhāmi yoginī yathā || 3.124{22} || yāvacca sa priyaḥ svāmī nāyāti svagṛhaṃ prati | tāvadevaṃ na bhokṣye'haṃ bhogyāni surasānyapi || 3.125{23} || viṣayeṣvapi sarveṣu na me vāṃchā priyaṃ vinā | nānyacciṃtā ca me citte tasmādevaṃ sthitā sadā || 3.126{24} || yāvatsvāmī na me dṛṣṭastāvatsthāsyāmyahaṃ tathā | api me jivitaṃ yātu na ca yāyāṃ gṛhādbahiḥ || 3.127{25} || strīṇāṃ hi devatā svāmī dharmo'pi bhartṛsevayā | tasmātsmṛtvaiva bharttāraṃ bhājāmyahaṃ pativratā || 3.128{26} || kutra dharmaṃ cariṣyāmi yasyā nāsti gṛhe pumān | tatmanasaiva bharttāraṃ dhyātvā bhaje divāniśam || 3.129{27} || dhigme janma nirarthaṃ syādyasyā na yauvane patiḥ | vṛddhatve kiṃ kariṣyāmi svāminā ca dhanairapi || 3.130{28} || varamevādya me mṛtyurna mithyā cirajīvitam | yasmācciramapi sthitvā mṛtyuduḥkhaṃ tadeva hi || 3.131{29} || yamevālaṃvya jīvāmi sa yadi nāgamiṣyati | kimeva jīvitenāpi kevaladuḥkhabhāvinā || 3.132{30} || dhanyāstā hi striyo bhadrāḥ svasvāmisahacārikāḥ | kṛtvā dharmaṃ sadā gehe saukhyaṃ bhuktvā vasanti yāḥ || 3.133{31} || mā bhūttu mādṛśi kācidabhadrā duḥkhabhāginī | samyagbhogyaiśca kiṃ tasyā yasyā bharttā na yauvane || 3.134{32} || tathāpi kiṃ kariṣyāmi nāryyahaṃ hi pativratā | tasmāttameva bharttāraṃ smṛtvā sthāsyāmi sarvadā || 3.135{33} || iti tayoditaṃ śrutvā sā sakhī hitakāriṇī | tadupāyahitaṃ kartuṃ tāṃ sakhīṃ ca samabravīt || 3.136{34} || bhadre satyaṃ tvayā proktaṃ strīṇāṃ hi devatā patiḥ | tathāpi vakṣyate bhadre tava prītyā ca tacchṛṇu || 3.137{35} || yāvannivasate gehe bhartā kāmarasārataḥ | tāvatstrī sevayennityaṃ dharmaṃ bharturanujñayā || 3.138{36} || yadā bharttā gṛhe na syāddūradeśaṃ gatastathā | yāvadgṛhaṃ na cāyātastāvaddevaṃ bhajetpatiḥ || 3.139{37} || pateste devatāsmākaṃ viṣṇurnārāyaṇo hariḥ | tasmādenaṃ prabhornāmnā smṛtvā nityaṃ bhajārcaya || 3.140{38} || sa eva kāmado devaḥ kāmadhātvīśvarādhipaḥ | saṃsārasthitidharmastho ratibhogyasukhapradaḥ || 3.141{39} || tasyaiva hyanubhāvena preryyamāno mano bhuvāḥ | bharttā te sahasā prāyātsvasti ratnaiśca saṃyutaḥ || 3.142{40} || tataste saphalaṃ janma saṃsāre prabhunā saha | dānaṃ kṛtvā sukhaṃ bhuktvā yāvajjīvaṃ sukhaṃ vasa || 3.143{41} || evaṃ sakhyoditaṃ śrutvā ramaṇī sā pativratā | tatheti pratisaṃśrutya punastāmavadatsakhīm || 3.144{42} || satyaṃ bhadre yathā proktaṃ tvayā me hitakāraṇam | tathāhaṃ saṃbhajiṣyāmi smṛtvā nāmnā prabhorharim || 3.145{43} || yathā svasti samāyātaḥ svāmī ratnasamṛddhibhṛt | tadā hyekaṃ suvarṇasya cakraṃ dāsyāmi viṣṇave || 3.146{44} || ityevaṃ sā pratijñāya viṣṇumevaṃ samasmarat || 3.147{45} || namaste bhagavan viṣṇo hare nārāyaṇa prabho | prasīda paśya māṃ nārīṃ prabhuṃ ca prāpayāśu me || 3.148{46} || yadā me puruṣo bharttā svasti gehasamāgataḥ | tadopaḍhaukayiṣyāmi svarṇacakraṃ hare tava || 3.149{47} || iti sakhyāḥ puraḥ proktvā smṛtvā nityaṃ hariṃ mudā | svarṇacakraṃ ca saṃkalpya tasthau bhartuḥ smaranti sa || 3.150{48} || tadaiva sārthavāho'sau sarvasārthagaṇaiḥ saha | bahuratnāni saṃgṛhya pratasthe sahasā tataḥ || 3.151{49} || tataḥ svasti samuttīryya mahodadhestadāgataḥ | sarvasārthagaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ sahasā gṛhamāyayau || 3.152{50} || tatastaṃ gṛhasaṃprāptaṃ dṛṣṭvā sā naṃditā satī | pādau natvā puraḥ sthitvā svaṃ pravṛttamabhāṣata || 3.153{51} || svāmin yadā bhavān gehātprasthito māṃ vihāya ca | tadārabhya sadā smṛtvā tvāmevāsmi sthitā gṛhe || 3.154{52} || tadāhamanayā sakhyā dṛṣṭvā tvadvirahāturā | tadduḥkhaṃ me vinodārthaṃ preritā smaraṇe hareḥ || 3.155{53} || tadārabhya sadā nityaṃ smṛtvā taveṣṭadevatām | bhajāmi satataṃ bhaktyā tavāśu gamanārthinī || 3.156{54} || cakramekaṃ suvarṇasya saṃkalpya śraddhayā mayā | prārthanāpi kṛtā nityaṃ tava yātrāprasiddhaye || 3.157{55} || yathā me prārthitaṃ sarvaṃ tathā siddhaṃ hi sāṃpratam | tanme saṃkalpitaṃ deva pūrayeyaṃ tathā prabho || 3.158{56} || tatpūjāṃgaṃ samādāya śakraṃ samupaḍhokitum | devakulaṃ gamiṣyāmi tadanujñāṃ pradehi me || 3.159{57} || iti bhāryoditaṃ śrutvā sārthavāho'numoditaḥ | pūraya tvaṃ priye satyaṃ gacchetyevamabhāṣata || 3.160{58} || tataḥ sānujñayā bhartuḥ satī sārddhaṃ sakhījanaiḥ | pūjāṃgāni ca taṃ cakraṃ dhṛtvā devakulaṃ yayau || 3.161{59} || tasmiṃ kṣaṇe sa saṃbuddho bhagavān karuṇāmayaḥ | loke satvān samuddhartumapaśyadbuddhacakṣuṣā || 3.162{60} || tāmevaṃ prasthitāṃ dṛṣṭvā bhadrāṃ saddharmacāriṇīm | praikṣacca bhagavānenāṃ pratyekabodhilābhinīm || 3.163{61} || tato'sau bhagavān buddhaḥ saṃnirīkṣya ca tāṃ satīm | sarvān bhikṣugaṇāṃ chiṣyān samāmaṃtryābravīttathā || 3.164{62} || paśyadhvaṃ bhikṣavo yūyaṃ dārikaṃ tāṃ subhadrikām | nūnaṃ maddarśanādeṣā bodhicittamavāpnuyāt || 3.165{63} || samyakkuśalamūlāni samavaropayiṣyati | dhruvaṃ pratyekabodhau ca praṇidhānaṃ kariṣyati || 3.166{64} || tasmātsaṃdarśanaṃ datvā dārikāṃ tāṃ subhāvinīm | pratyekabodhicaryāyāṃ supratisthāpayāmyaham || 3.167{65} || tatra ca gantumichanti ye mayā saha bhikṣavaḥ | pātracīvaramādāya te prāyātaṃ caremahi || 3.168{66} || ityādiṣṭaṃ jinendreṇa śrutvā sarve'pi sāṃghikāḥ | pātracīvarasaṃyuktāstatra gaṃtumupācaran || 3.169{67} || tato'sau bhagavān buddhaḥ svaprabhāvaṃ pradarśayan | sarvaiśca sāṃghikaiḥ sārddhaṃ rājagṛhamupāsarat || 3.170{68} || tatra mārge samāyātā dārikā sasakhīvṛtā | taṃ buddhaṃ śrīghanaṃ dūrāddadarśa saṃprabhāsvaram || 3.171{69} || dvātriṃśallakṣaṇopetamaśītivyaṃjanānvitam | divyātikrāntasaundaryyaṃ samantabhadrarūpakam || 3.172{70} || sahasreṇātiriktābhaṃ saumyaṃ kāntaṃ manoharam | puṇḍarīkamivodbhāsaṃ ratnāṅgamiva jaṃgamam || 3.173{71} || sākṣātpuṇyāvatāraṃ ca dṛṣṭvā cātyanumoditā | sahasopetya taccakramupaḍhaukitumaichata || 3.174{72} || evaṃ tāṃ cakramādāya saṃbuddhamupaḍhaukitum | prayātaṃ tāṃ sakhī dṛṣṭvā nivārayitumabravīt || 3.175{73} || nāyaṃ nārāyaṇo bhadre sugato'yaṃ jitendriyaḥ | tadasmai mā pradehīdaṃ cakraṃ saṃkalpitaṃ hareḥ || 3.176{74} || evaṃ nivāryyamānāpi sakhībhiḥ sā ca bhadrikā | saddharmaguṇavāṃchantī tāḥ sakhīḥ punarabravīt || 3.177{175} || sakhyo bhāgyānmayāpyevaṃ saṃbuddho dṛśyate'dhunā | tadadya saphalaṃ janma saṃsāre jīvitaṃ ca me || 3.178{76} || yadābhāsparśitā cāpi satvāḥ kleśavimocitāḥ | saṃvṛttisukhasaṃprāptā nirvṛttimapi cāpnuyuḥ || 3.179{77} || yannāmoccāraṇādvāpi saṃbhāvyasmaraṇādapi | mārapāśavinirmuktāḥ saṃbodhipadamāpnuyuḥ || 3.180{78} || yaddharmaśravaṇādevaṃ nityānumodanādapi | sarvapāpavinirmuktāḥ sadgatiṃ samavāpnuyuḥ || 3.181{79} || yatsaṃgheṣu supātreṣu kiṃcinmātrārppanādapi | saṃsāre'nantasaukhyāni bhuktvā yāyuḥ sukhāvatīm || 3.182{80} || yenaivaṃ pālitāḥ satvāḥ ṣaḍgaticaritā api | bodhayitvā ca saddharme sthāpitā nirvṛtāvapi || 3.183{81} || yasya dharmānubhāvācca maṃgalaṃ bhuvanatraye | sarve satvā sukhāḍhyāśca saṃbodhipadacāriṇaḥ || 3.184{82} || so'pyayaṃ bhagavānnāthaḥ śāstā trailokyādhipaḥ | nūnaṃ me puṇyabhāgyena dṛśyate'yatnato'dhunā || 3.185{83} || tadahaṃ kuśalinī syāṃ hi saṃbuddhena darśitā | mahābhāgyavatī cāsmi yadayaṃ sadguruḥ sudhīḥ || 3.186{84} || amṛgyamāna evetthaṃ labhyate purato mayā | tadahaṃ pūjayitvemaṃ cakraṃ ca samupaḍhaukitum || 3.187{85} || ichāmyasmai munīṃdrāya nirvṛtipadalabdhaye | api cātra sadā naiva saṃbuddho lapsyate tathā || 3.188{86} || kadā ciddhi jinotpattiḥ puṣpamaudunvaraṃ yathā | mānuṣye'pi sadā naiva janma bhavānucāriṇām | puṇyaireva hi mānuṣyaṃ lapṣyate janma dullabham || 3.189{87} || mānuṣye'labhyamāne tu kathaṃ buddhānusevanā | buddhasevāṃ vinā kena bodhicittamavāpnuyāt || 3.190{88} || bodhicittaṃ vinā kasya saddharmeṣu matiścaret | vinā dharmamatiṃ ko hi bodhicaryyāṃ samācaret || 3.191{89} || bodhicaryāṃ vinā loke hitaṃ kartuṃ kathaṃ caret | loke hitamakṛtvaiva kutaḥ puṇyamavāpnuyāt || 3.192{90} || apuṇyena kathaṃ kleśān hitvā nirvṛtimāpnuyāt | tasmātkleśavimuktyarthaṃ nirvṛttipadalabdhaye || 3.193{91} || imaṃ buddhaṃ jagannāthamichāmyabhyarcituṃ mudā | buddha eva jagannāthaḥ sarvasatvahitārthadaḥ || 3.194{92} || saddharmadeśakaḥ śāstā saṃbodhijñānanāyakaḥ | tasmādenaṃ samutsṛjya nānyamichāmi cārcitum || 3.195{93} || asyaiva śaraṇaṃ gatvā bhajiṣyāmi sadāpyaham || 3.196{94} || iti sā dārikā proktvā cakramādāya moditā | saṃbuddhaṃ cārppituṃ tasmai pūjāṃ kartumupāyayau || 3.197{95} || atha sā taṃ muniṃ natvā pūjābhiśca samarcayat | taṃ cakraṃ samupasthāpya natvaivaṃ praṇidhiṃ vyadhāt || 3.198{96} || yathāyaṃ sugato buddho niḥkleśo vijitendriyaḥ | tathāhamapi śuddhātmā nirvṛtipadamāpnuyām || 3.199{97} || tathāsau bhagavān buddho dṛṣṭvā tatpraṇidhiṃ tataḥ | suprasannamukhāmbhojādvyasṛjatsaṃsmitāmṛtam || 3.200{98} || tatsmitasahoccāryamāṇā paṃcavidhāṃśavaḥ | ke cidūrddhvaṃ gatāḥ ke cidadho yātāśca te'ṃśavaḥ || 3.201{99} || ye ca yātā adholoke te saṃjīvanarake gatāḥ | kālasūtre ca saṃghāte tathā ca raurave tataḥ || 3.202{100} || mahārauravake cāpi tapane ca pratāpane | avīcau cārbude cāpi nirarbude tathāṭaṭe || 3.203{1} || hahave huhuve caivamutpale padmake tathā | mahāpadme'pi caiteṣu ṣoḍaśeṣu samaṃtataḥ || 3.204{2} || tathopanārakeṣvevaṃ sarveṣvapi ca te'ṃśavaḥ | prasṛtā bhāsayitvaivaṃ prākāśayan samaṃtataḥ || 3.205{3} || ye śītanarakāsteṣu tūṣṇībhūtā nipātitāḥ | ye uṣṇanarakāsteṣu śītībhūtā vyabhāsayan || 3.206{4} || teṣu ye pāpinaḥ satvā duḥkhātivedanāturāḥ | te sarve taddyutispṛṣṭāstadduḥkhavedanojjhitāḥ || 3.207{5} || śāṃtasaukhyānubhūtāśca vismayoddhatamānasāḥ | dṛṣṭvaiva saha saṃmīlya mithaścaivamabhāṣata || 3.208{6} || aho citraṃ bhavanto'dya kiṃ nu vayamitaścyutāḥ | anyatra caritāḥ smaḥ kiṃ vatāhosvinna manyate || 3.209{7} || iti saṃdigdhacittānāṃ teṣāṃ cittaprabodhane | bhagavānnirmitaṃ tatra praiṣayacca samaṃtataḥ || 3.210{8} || atha taṃ nirmitaṃ saumyaṃ dṛṣṭvā te saṃprasāditāḥ | bhūyo dṛṣṭvābhimodanto mithaścaivaṃ vabhāṣire || 3.211{9} || bhavanto nu vayaṃ sarve nānyatra caritā itaḥ | api tvayamihāyātaḥ satvo hyapūrvadarśanaḥ || 3.212{10} || nūnamasyānubhāvena nirduḥkhā susukhā vayam | iti te nirmite tasmin bauddhe cittaṃ prasādya ca || 3.213{11} || namo buddhāya te tāyinnityuktvā śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ | tataḥ sarve ca te satvāstadbuddhasmṛtidhāriṇaḥ || 3.214{12} || niḥpāpāḥ kuśalādhyāśca sadgatiṃ sahasā yayuḥ | ye tathorddhaṃ gatāste ca buddhasmitotsṛtāḥ karāḥ || 3.215{13} || gatvā cāturmahārājabhuvaneṣu tato gatāḥ | trayastriṃśāśca yāmāśca tathā ca tuṣitāṃ gatāḥ || 3.216{14} || nirmāṇaratikāṃ cānyanirmitavaśavarttinaḥ | brahmakāyikalokaṃ ca tathā brahmaprohitam || 3.217{15} || mahābrāhmaṇalokāṃśca parīttābhaṃ tathā gatāḥ | apramāṇaṃ tato yātā ābhāsvarāṃ tathā gatāḥ || 3.218{16} || parīttaśubhamevaṃ ca hyapramāṇaśubhaṃ tathā | śubhakṛtsnamanabhraṃ ca puṇyaprasavasaṃjñikam || 3.219{17} || bṛhatphalaṃ tathā caivamabṛhamatapaṃ tathā | sudṛśaṃ bhuvanaṃ caiva sudarśanaṃ tathā gatāḥ || 3.220{18} || akaniṣṭhaṃ tathā gatvā proccairevamaghoṣayan || 3.221{19} || anityaṃ khalu saṃsāraṃ duḥkhaṃ śūnyaṃ hyanātmakam | iti matvā triratnāni saṃbhajadhvaṃ samāhitāḥ || 3.222{20} || niṣkrāmatārabhadhvaṃ ca yujyadhvaṃ buddhaśāsane | dhunīta mṛtyusainyāśca naḍāgāraṃ yathā karī || 3.223{21} || yo'pyasmin dharmavaineye hyapramattaścariṣyati | sa hitvā jātisaṃsāraṃ duḥkhasyāntaṃ kariṣyati || 3.224{22} || evaṃ tā arciṣaḥ sarvāṃllokadhātūn samaṃtataḥ | avabhāsya śubhe satvān vinīya punarāgatāḥ || 3.225{23} || bhagavato'grataḥ sthitvā kṛtvā pradakṣiṇatrayam | ūrṇāyāṃ ca munīndrasya sarvā antardadhustviṣaḥ || 3.226{24} || tadānandaḥ samutthāya kṛtāṃjalipuṭo nataḥ | jānubhyāṃ bhuvi saṃsthitvā bhagavantaṃ samabravīt || 3.227{25} || nānāraṅgakalāpaste vaktrānniṣkasito muneḥ | yenāvabhāsitāḥ sarvā sūryeṇodayatā yathā || 3.228{26} || vigatoddhavā dainyamadaprahīṇā buddhā jagatyuttamahetubhūtāḥ | nākāraṇaṃ śaṃkhamṛṇālagauraṃ smitamupadarśayanti jinā jitārayaḥ || 3.229{27} || tatkālaṃ svayamadhigamya dhīrabuddhyā śrotṝṇāṃ śramaṇajinendra kāṃkṣitānām | dhīrābhirmunivṛṣa vāgbhiruttamābhirutpannaṃ vyapanaya saṃśayaṃ śubhābhiḥ || 3.230{28} || nākasmāllavaṇajalādrirājadhairyyāḥ saṃbuddhāḥ smitamupadarśayanti nāthāḥ | yasyārthe smitamupadarśayanti dhīrāstaṃ śrotuṃ samabhilaṣanti janaughāḥ || 3.231{29} || ityānaṃdavacaḥ śrutvā saṃbuddho bhagavānasau | tatsmitahetumādeṣṭuṃ tamānandaṃ samabravīt || 3.232{30} || evametattathānanda nāhetvapratyayaṃ smitam | prāviṣkurvanti saṃbuddhā arhantaḥ sugatā jināḥ || 3.233{31} || paśyānandānayā nāryyā cakraṃ me samupārppitam | pūjayitvā praṇatvā ca bodhau ca praṇidhiḥ kṛtā || 3.234{32} || anena dānadharmeṇa kuśalaiśca samanvitāḥ | dārikeyaṃ subhadrāṃśā divyabhogyaṃ samāpnuyāt || 3.235{33} || na paṃcadaśakalpāni vinipātaṃ gamiṣyati | tataścakrāntaro nāma pratyekasugato sudhīḥ || 3.236{34} || arhaṃ kleśavimuktātmā paṃcābhijño jitendriyaḥ | sarvasatvānukaṃpī ca brahmacārī bhaviṣyati || 3.237{35} || yanmayi sugate buddhe cittamasyāḥ prasīdati | tena puṇyabaleneyaṃ pratyekabodhimāpsyati || 3.238{36} || sugateṣu kṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ na kṣiṇoti kadā cana | kramāttena viśuddhātmā saṃbodhimapi cāpnuyāt || 3.239{37} || iti matvā triratneṣu cittamevaṃ prasādya ca | śraddhayā saṃprakarttavyaṃ satkāraṃ bodhivāṃchibhiḥ || 3.240{38} || ityādiṣṭaṃ munīndreṇa śrutvā sarve janāśca te | tathetyabhyanumodantastriratnasevino'bhavan || 3.241{39} || tato buddhānubhāvena taccakraṃ khe samudgatam | kṣaṇaṃ buddhopari sthitvā chatramivojjvalan babhau || 3.242{40} || tataśca viyato gatvā hariharmyopari sthitam | sudarśanamivoddīptaṃ babhau rasmisamutkiran || 3.243{41} || tato'sau bhagavān buddho dṛṣṭvā tāṃ dārikāṃ svayam | śirasi pāṇinā spṛṣṭvā
