svāśīrvacanamādiśat || 3.244{42} || bhadre te maṃgalaṃ bhūyā vinipātaṃ na cāpnuhi | kramātpāramitāḥ pūryya pratyekaṃ bodhimāpnuhi || 3.245{43} || ityāśīrvacanaṃ datvā saṃbuddho'sau munīśvaraḥ | tato rājagṛhaṃ gaṃtumupācaratsasāṃghikaḥ || 3.246{44} || tato'sau dārikā cāpi natvā taṃ sugataṃ punaḥ | dṛṣṭvaivaṃ muhuḥ smṛtvā svagehaṃ samupāyayau || 3.247{45} || tatra gehe praviṣṭvāsau dārikā saṃpramoditā | bhartturagre ca tadvṛttamācakhye sarvamādarāt || 3.248{46} || bharttāpyasau tathā śrutvā buddhadharmānumoditaḥ | tayaivaṃ bhāryayā sārddhaṃ bheje ratnatrayaṃ sadā || 3.249{47} || evaṃ me guruṇā khyātaṃ tathā te kathyate mayā | tvamapyevaṃ mahārāja triratnāni sadā bhaja || 3.250{48} || prajāścāpi triratnānāṃ bhajane preraya prabho | tathā te maṃgalaṃ nityaṃ bodhiṃ cāpi samāpnuyāḥ || 3.251{49} || iti tenopaguptena bhāṣitaṃ tatsubhāṣitam | śrutvāśoko narendro'sau mumoda saha pārṣadaiḥ || 3.252{50} || etaccakrāvadānaṃ munivaraguṇadaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti prasādya | śrutvā yaścānumodya pramuditamanasā śrāvayatyevamanyān | sa jitvā kleśasaṃghān vigatakalimalo buddhadharmānucārī | pūtātmā sadguṇāḍhyaḥ munivaranilayaiḥ saṃprayāti pramodāt || 3.253{51} || iti ratnāvadānamālāyaṃ cakrāvadāno nāma samāptam pretikāvadāna athāśoko mahīpālaḥ saddharmacaraṇotsavaḥ | upaguptaṃ guruṃ natvā kṛtāñjalipuṭo'vadat || 4.1{1} || bhadanta śrotumichāmi punaranyatsubhāṣitam | yathā me guruṇā proktaṃ tathā vaktuṃ samarhasi || 4.2{2} || iti tena narendreṇa prārthite'sau jināṃśajaḥ | upagupto mahābhijñastaṃ nareśamabhāṣata || 4.3{3} || yathā me guruṇādiṣṭaṃ tathā vakṣyāmi te'dhunā | tathāpi śrūyatāṃ rājan tava dharmapravṛddhaye || 4.4{4} || puraikasamaye cāsau saṃbuddho bhagavāñjinaḥ | cailakaiśca tathānyaistatsaddharmaguṇavāṃchibhiḥ || 4.5{5} || rājagṛhamupāśritya veṇuvane jināśrame | karaṇḍakanivāpākhye tasthau dharmaṃ samādiśat || 4.6{6} || taddharmmadeśanāṃ śrotuṃ sadevāsuramānuṣāḥ | siddhavidyādharāścāpi yakṣagaṃdharvakinnarāḥ || 4.7{7} || garuḍā nāgarājāśca rākṣasāśca mahoragāḥ | sarve lokādhipāścāpi sasainyaparivārakāḥ || 4.8{8} || rājāno rājamātrāśca brāhmaṇāśca mahājanāḥ | maṃtriṇo śreṣṭhinaścāpi sārthavāhāśca paurikāḥ || 4.9{9} || ṛṣayo yoginaścāpi yatayo brahmacāriṇaḥ | evamanye'pi lokāśca parivṛtya samaṃtataḥ || 4.10{10} || satkṛtya svaryya pūjāṅgaiḥ sarvopakaraṇairapi | mānayitvā ca taṃ nāthaṃ dṛṣṭvā tasthuḥ samāhitāḥ || 4.11{11} || tasmiṃśca samaye tatra maudgalyāyana ātmavit | sa pretabhuvane gatvā caran pretīmapaśyata || 4.12{12} || svakeśaromasaṃchannāṃ dagdhasthūnāmahākṛtim | sūcīmukhīṃ mahatkāyīṃ parvatasaṃnibhodarām || 4.13{13} || piṅgalakeśinīṃ raudrīṃ pradīptāgniśikhāmiva | tīvrātivedanākrāntāṃ tṛṣārttaṃ parimūrchitām || 4.14{14} || tatrāyuṣmān sa maudgalyo dṛṣṭvā tāṃ pretikāṃ ciram | kaiṣeti sahasopetya papracha samupāgatām || 4.15{15} || kiṃ tvayā prakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ yenaivaṃ duḥkhabhāginī | tṛṣārttā jalamārgantī bhramitvā carase'dhunā || 4.16{16} || iti tena yatīśena pṛṣṭvā sā pretikā tataḥ | taṃ yatiṃ saugataṃ natvā praruditvāvadattathā || 4.17{17} || bhadanta tadvijānīyāḥ pāpakāriṇyahaṃ yataḥ | evaṃ tṛṣṇāprataptāṅgā bhramāmi jalalālasā || 4.18{18} || yatrāhamudakaṃ pātuṃ gachāmi tṛṣṇayānvitā | atra paśyāmi nadyādijalādhārān viśoṣitān || 4.19{19} || yadā varṣati deve ca dṛṣṭvā tadambupātitam | pātumichantltṛṣṇārttā sahasāhaṃ pradhāvitā || 4.20{20} || tadā paśyāmi tadvinduvisphuliṅganibhojvalān | dṛṣṭvaivaṃ nirāśāndhā bhramāmi dikṣu sarvataḥ || 4.21{21} || kiṃ mayā prakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ yenāsmyevaṃ supāpinī | tanme pāpaṃ jagacchāstā pṛchyatāṃ bhavatādarāt || 4.22{22} || nūnaṃ so bhagavāñchāstā yanme karmapurākṛtam | vyākariṣyati tatsarvaṃ tathā lokaprabodhane || 4.23{23} || yacchrutvānye'pi satvāśca saṃvignamanaso drutam | viramya pāpamārgebhyaścariṣyanti śubhe sadā || 4.24{24} || tasmādbhadanta sarvajñastava śāstā sa pṛchyatām | vyākuryānmama sarvatra yatkarma prakṛtaṃ purā || 4.25{25} || asmannāmnā sa saṃbuddho vaṃdyatāṃ bhavatā yathā | ityuktvā sā tamātmajaṃ natvā pretā gṛhaṃ yayau || 4.26{26} || sa maudgalyastathetyuktvā tatsaṃdeśamanusmaran | sahasaitatparipraṣṭuṃ veṇuvanamupāyayau || 4.27{27} || tadādau bhagavān dṛṣṭvā tanmaudgalyamupāgatam | prahasan suprasannāsyaḥ samāmaṃtryaitadabravīt | kaṃcitte kuśalaṃ vatsa kuto'trāsi samāgataḥ | lokeṣu kiṃ pravṛttāṃtaṃ tatpracakṣva mahāmate | iti pṛṣṭe jinendreṇa sa maudgalyaḥ purogataḥ || 4.28{28} || ādau tasya munernatvā tatpravṛttamudāharat | āgato'smi bhadanto'haṃ caritvā pretabhūmiṣu || 4.29{29} || tatra sthito'hamīkṣan tāṃ pretīmekāṃ bhayānakīm | dagdhasthūṇānibhāṃ nagnāṃ parvatasannibhodarām || 4.30{30} || sūcīchidramukhacchidrāṃ kaṃkārayantrikāmiva | svakeśaromasaṃchannāṃ jvalitāgniśikhāmiva || 4.31{31} || tivrātivedanākrāntāmārttasvarānurodinām | durgandhāmaśucivyāptāṃ svakeśaparitāpitām || 4.32{32} || viṇmūtrānubhoktuṃ ca sākṣātpāpāvatārikām | bhagavan sā mayā dṛṣṭvā tṛṣṇārttā jalalālasā || 4.33{33} || bhramantī jalamārgantī jalāśrayeṣu sarvataḥ | nadīkūpataḍāgādinudapānajalāśrayān || 4.34{34} || svechāmbupūritān dṛṣṭvā prādhāvatsahasā yadā | tasyā darśaṇamātreṇa te sarve'pi jalāśrayāḥ || 4.35{35} || nirjalāḥ paṃkaśeṣeṇa śuśuṣuśca samaṃtataḥ | tathā viśoṣitāṃ dṛṣṭvā nadyādīṃstāñjalāśrayān || 4.36{36} || nirāśā paritaptāṅgā sā pretī paryamūrchata | tataśca punarutthāya kṣuttṛṣṇonmādacāriṇī || 4.37{37} || jalaṃ cānnaṃ samanveṣṭuṃ babhrāma dikṣu sarvataḥ | tathāpi sā jalaṃ nāsādayatkuhāpi vā || 4.38{38} || tato'titṛṣṇayā taptā viṇmūtrabhoktumaichata | tadapi kṛcchrato'nviṣya bhuktvā tṛptiṃ na sā yayau || 4.39{38} || tathāmedhyāni bhuktvāpi kadācinnaiva tṛptitā | kṣuttṛṣṇāhatāklāntā patitā kheditāvasat || 4.40{40} || māṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasotthāya śanairmandasvarāvadat | svāgataṃ bho bhavānaitu rakṣa māṃ pāpinīṃ laghu || 4.41{41} || pānīyaṃ dehi me bhadra pānīyaṃ dātumarhasi | iti proktābhidhāvanti pānīyaṃ māmayācata || 4.42{42} || tato'hamavadaṃ caināṃ pānīyaṃ nātra vidyate | kātvamevaṃ nu duḥkhāni bhuktvātra vasase katham || 4.43{43} || kiṃ tvayā hi kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ yenaivaṃ duḥkhatādhunā | vaktavyaṃ cecca tatpāpaṃ sarvaṃ me vaktumarhasi || 4.44{44} || iti me gaditaṃ śrutvā sa pretī punarabravīt | kiṃ mayā vakṣyate pāpaṃ yatpurā kudhiyā kṛtam || 4.45{45} || sarvajño hi bhavacchāstā sa evaṃ paripṛchyatām | tatsarvāṇi ca me pāpaṃ sa vyākuryātsa sarvavit || 4.46{46} || asmannāmnā ca saṃbuddho vaṃdyatāṃ bhavatādarāt | iti tayoditaṃ śrutvā pratijñāya tatheti ca || 4.47{47} || bhavantaṃ praṣṭumāyāmi tatsamādeṣṭumarhasi | ārttasvarā rudantī sā pretī vindati vedanām || 4.48{48} || yena viṇmūtradhānāni tena dhāvati duḥkhitā | tadapi kṛcchrato labdhvā bhuṃkte kiṃ citkadā cana || 4.49{49} || evaṃ sā pāpinī pretī dṛṣṭātiduḥkhitā mayā | kiṃ tayā prakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ martyaloke sudāruṇam || 4.50{50} || yenaivaṃvidhaduḥkhaṃ sā hyanubhavati sāṃpratam | kadā sā pāpato muktā kathaṃ ca sugatiṃ vrajet || 4.51{51} || tatsarvaṃ vadatāṃ śāsta sarvasatvaprabodhane | iti tenārthite cāsau bhagavān punarabravīt || 4.52{52} || maudgalyāyana sā pretī pāpinī matsarī kudhīḥ | tayā yatprakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ yena sā duḥkhabhāginī || 4.53{53} || tatsarvaṃ te pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu śrotuṃ yadīchasi || 4.54{54} || purāsīdbhagavān buddhaḥ kāśyapo nāma sarvavit | sarvavidyādhipo nātho dharmarājastathāgataḥ || 4.55{55} || samantabhadrakṛcchāstā traidhātukavināyakaḥ | jino'rhan sugatastrāyī saṃbodhimārgadeśakaḥ || 4.56{56} || sa satvānāṃ hitārthena bodhicaryāḥ prakāśayan | vārāṇasīmupāśritya mṛgadāve jināśrame || 4.57{57} || śrāvakairbhikṣubhiḥ sārddhaṃ bodhisatvagaṇairapi | tasminneva parṣatmadhye tasthau dharmaṃ samādiśat || 4.58{58} || tasmiṃśca samaye tasya bhikṣuranyatamo yatiḥ | anyatranagare gatvā pratyāgachatsvamāśramam || 4.59{59} || tatra mārge tṛṣārtto'sau dūrātkūpaṃ vilokayan | sahasā samupāgatya kūpāntikamupāyayau || 4.60{60} || tadaikā dārikā tatra pūrayitvā ghaṭaṃ jalaiḥ | sahasā śirasohitvā gṛhaṃ gantumupācarat || 4.61{61} || sa tṛṣārtto yatirdṛṣṭvā tāmambughaṭavāhikām | samupetya jalaṃ pātuṃ prārthayan samupācarat || 4.62{62} || bhaginyo'haṃ tṛṣārtto'smi dūradeśādupāgataḥ | tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasopetya jalaṃ pātumihāgataḥ || 4.63{63} || tadbhaginī jalaṃ dehi jīvaya māṃ tṛṣāturam | datvā me jīvanaṃ tvaṃ tacciraṃ jīvyā niroginī || 4.64{64} || iti tenārthitaṃ dṛṣṭvā dārikāsau durāśayā | mātsaryyaprahatatvātā taṃ bhikṣuṃ paryyabhāṣata || 4.65{65} || are bhikṣo'tra māyāhi mriyase yadi vā khalu | na te dadāmi pānīyaṃ ghaṭo pūrṇo bhavenmama || 4.66{66} || kūpe yatnātsamuddhṛtya pūrayitvāmbunā ghaṭe | prohitvāyaṃ mayānītastvadarthe kiṃ na manyate || 4.67{67} || nirlajja kva nu te lajjā parakīyāmbumichasi | rājā kiṃ tvaṃ dhanī vāsi gururvā kiṃ na manyate || 4.68{68} || ityākṣepaṃ pratikṣipya taṃ bhikṣuṃ saugataṃ yatim | adatvaivāmṛtaṃ kiṃ citsatvarā sā gṛhaṃ yayau || 4.69{69} || tato bhikṣustṛṣārtto'pi lajjayāsau nyavarttate | anyatraivaṃ samāyācya pītvā yayau svamāśramam || 4.70{70} || tatrāśrame tarormūle paryaṇkamupabhujya saḥ | anuśocaya tāṃ nārīṃ manasaivaṃ vyaciṃtayat || 4.71{71} || aho sā durmatī nārī mātsaryyaprahatāśayā | kathaṃ na manyate hyevaṃ mānuṣyajanma durllabham || 4.72{72} || mānuṣyaṃ puṇyato labdhvā nisphalaṃ kriyate tayā | dhiktāṃ durāśayāṃ mūḍhāṃ yasyā janma nirarthakam || 4.73{73} || kadaiṣā pāpato muktvā sadgatiṃ samavāpsyati | mā gātsā narake duḥkhaṃ bhūyāddharmānumodinī || 4.74{74} || śīghraṃ lokeśvarasmārttaṃ labdhvā vrajatu sanmatim | ityevaṃmanasā bhāṣya sa bhikṣurvijitendriyaḥ || 4.75{75} || triratnasmaraṇaṃ kṛtvā tasthau dhyānasamāhitaḥ | tato'sau dārikā gehe prāptā bhartuḥ purogatā || 4.76{76} || etatsarvaṃ pravṛttāṃtaṃ vistareṇābravīnmudā | svāminnadyāmbusaṃpūrṇaṃ ghaṭaṃ dhṛtvāgatā pathi || 4.77{77} || tato bhikṣurupāgatya pānīyaṃ māṃ prayācati | adatvaivaṃ jalaṃ tasmai bhikṣave satvarāgatā || 4.78{71} || vahuśo yācyamānāpi kiṃ cinnaiva dadāmyaham | iti tayoktamātre'sau bharttā sādhurapi krudhā | tāṃ bhāryāṃ rukṣaṇetreṇa dṛṣṭvā caivamabhāṣata || 4.79{72} || are pāpini durbuddhe kathaṃ na dīyate tvayā | kiyadvyeti jalaṃ datvā bhikṣave tṛṣitāya te || 4.80{71!} || jalamātrapradāne'pi yasyāḥ śraddhā na vidyate | sā kimannaṃ dhanaṃ ratnaṃ kathāṃ dātuṃ samutsahet || 4.81{72} || dhiktvāṃ pāpinīṃ duṣṭāṃ yasyā nāsti dayārthine | kiṃ tvayā mama satyāpi yaśodharmapraghātayā || 4.82{73} || yadyevaṃ na pradadyāstvaṃ kasmai cidarthine jalam | preyasīmapi bhārye tvāṃ parityakṣyāmyahaṃ khalu || 4.83{74} || yadi me priyatāṃ kartumichasi snehacetasā | arthino mānayitvā taddānaṃ kartuṃ samutsaheḥ || 4.84{75} || no cedevaṃ mayā tyaktā vraja mā tiṣṭha me gṛhe | avaśyaṃ nau viyogaḥ syādekānte maraṇaṃ dhruvam || 4.85{76} || kiṃ tvādṛśyā striyā puṃsaḥ kevalaṃ dharmahānaye | dharmaṃ vinā na me kāryyaṃ dākṣiṇyāpi ca bhāryayā || 4.86{77} || kiṃ tvayā kāṃtayāpyevaṃ mātsaryyakuladurdhiyā | dharma eva vinaśyeta tadvraja mā gṛhe vasa || 4.87{78} || dharmeṇa rakṣyate lokaḥ kāntayā kiṃ hi rakṣyate | tatkāntāpi parityājyā yadi pāpanuraginī || 4.88{79} || bhāryā hi pālanīyā sā yadi dharmārthinī satī | kiṃ tvaṃ pāpārthinī duṣṭā yaśodharmavināśinī || 4.89{80} || naivāhaṃ ca tvayā sārddhaṃ bhoktuṃ rantuṃ samutsahe | kriyate cettvayā dharmastathā vasa mayā saha || 4.90{81} || no cedevaṃ mayā tyaktā tvaṃ mā tiṣṭha gṛhe vraja | evaṃ bharttrocyamānāpi pramadā sā na bodhitā || 4.91{82} || mātsaryyālīḍhacittatvādroṣitā caivamabravīt | naiva sthāsyāmyahaṃ yāsye kiṃ sthitvaivaṃ vininditā || 4.92{83} || kiyattvayyaparādhaṃ me yattathāhaṃ vimocitā | kiṃ sa bhikṣurgururrājā mitraṃ vā te pitā suhṛt || 4.93{84} || jñātirvā sa sakhā vandhuḥ kiṃ ca bhrātā prabhurdhanī | pradattaṃ kimadattaṃ ca kiyannaṣṭaṃ bhavetyataḥ || 4.94{85} || naiva kiṃcicca dāsyāmi kasmai cidbhikṣave'rthitam | adatvā me bhavetkiṃ hi dāsyāmyahaṃ yathechayā || 4.95{86} || dāsyāmi vā na dāsyāmi kā carcātra tathā tava | pāpaścenmayi pacyeta dharmo vāpi tathā mama || 4.96{87} || tvamatra mā kṛthāścintāṃ kiṃ tvayātra vicāryyate | śubhaṃ vāpyaśubhaṃ vā me tava kiṃ tadvicāratā || 4.97{88} || tathāpi mama doṣaṃ cedyāsyāmi na vasāmyaham | varaṃ prāṇaparityājyaṃ na tu dānaṃ dadāmyaham || 4.98{89} || ityasau pramadākruṣya bharturākṣipya garvitā | kvacitkiṃcicca kasmaiciddadau naiva kadācana || 4.99{90} || gṛhe tithīnupāyātān dṛṣṭvaivātipraroṣitā | vahudhā kruṣya tān gehānnyakāsayadbalādapi || 4.100{91} || tadāśīrvacanānyevaṃ śrutvāpi parikopitā | hasati nindayitvaināṃ paribhāṣya nyakāsayat || 4.101{92} || sadā badhvā gṛhadvāraṃ yācakāgatiśaṃkayā | koṣṭha eva samāsīnā kadācinna viniryayau || 4.102{93} || sarvadā svāminā sārddhaṃ kṛtvaivaṃ kalahaṃ muhuḥ | svayameva prabhuktvāsau kālamevamayāpayat || 4.103{94} || tataḥ kāla upāyāte pramadā sā rujānvitā | tadāpyevaṃ na cotsehe kiṃciddātuṃ samarthine || 4.104{95} || tataḥ pravṛddharogārttā tṛṣṇārttā pariśoṣitā | mṛtā sā narake yātā pretī bhavati sāṃpratam || 4.105{96} || yā cābhūddārikā duṣṭā mātsaryyaprahatāśayā | saivaiṣā hi tvayā dṛṣṭā pretī narakavāsinī || 4.106{97} || iti maudgalya dṛṣṭvaivaṃ pratyakṣaṃ pāpaduḥkhinīm | sarvādā śraddhayārthibhyo dātavyaṃ jalamādarāt || 4.107{98} || sarvavastupradānānāṃ jaladānaṃ mahattaram | sarveṣāṃ jīvanaṃ yasmādamṛtaṃ saṃvaraṃ jalam || 4.108{99} || jalapānaṃ vinā sarve na jīvanti hi jantavaḥ | tadamṛtaṃ jalaṃ śuddhaṃ dātavyamarthine sadā || 4.109{100} || jalameva hi pītvā te nirāhārāstapasvinaḥ | yogino'nekavarṣāni jīvanti prāṇino yathā || 4.110{1} || sarvāhārābhisaṃtyaktā jivaṃti prāṇino jalaiḥ | sarvānna paribhuktvāpi na jīvanti jalairvinā || 4.111{2} || tadamṛtapradānaṃ tajjīvadānaṃ pracakṣyate | sarvavastupradānebhyo jaladānaṃ praśasyate || 4.112{3} || viśeṣādgrīṣmakāle tu tṛṣārttāya ca rogine | bālavṛddhāturebhyaśca dātavyaṃ jalamāditaḥ || 4.113{4} || jaladānaṃ mahādānaṃ jaladānasamaṃ na hi | yenābhidhāryyate prāṇaṃ tatphalaṃ saṃpraśasyate || 4.114{5} || sarvadhātupradānebhyaḥ sarvaratnapradānataḥ | sarvānnabhogyadānebhyo jaladānaṃ mahīyate || 4.115{6} || kanyākoṭipradānācca gajakoṭipradānataḥ | gavāṃ koṭipradānācca jaladānaṃ mahīyate || 4.116{7} || saptaratnamayībhūmipradānācca mahīyate | evaṃ sarvapradānebhyo jaladānaṃ mahattaram || 4.117{8} || tṛpyante devatāḥ sarve pitṛlokāstathāpare | sarve bhūtāśca satvāśca jalenaiva sadāpi hi || 4.118{9} || tathā dravyāni sarvāṇi bhūtāni hyaśucinyapi | jalābhiṣiktamātreṇa śuddhyante sarvadā khalu || 4.119{10} || jalaṃ vinā na tṛpyante bhuktvāpi divyabhojanam | tasmātsarvapradānānāṃ jaladānaṃ mahīyate || 4.120{11} || tathā ye ca sudhāṃ pītvā divyakāntā samarpitā | ramanti tridaśāḥ svarge te hi sarve jalapradāḥ || 4.121{12} || cakravarttī nṛpendro yo ramaṇībhiḥ sahāmṛtam | bhuktvā ramati saṃmodī so'pi cāmbupradānataḥ || 4.122{13} || evaṃ cānye'pi ye lokā yathechā sukhabhoginaḥ | niḥkleśā nirujā bhadrāste hi sarve jalapradāḥ || 4.123{14} || ye tu nīcāśayādīnāḥ kṣutpipāsāturāḥ kṛśāḥ | yācakāḥ preṣyakāścāpi sarve te'mbho'pradānikāḥ || 4.124{15} || jaladānodbhavaṃ puṇyaṃ saṃkhyātuṃ naiva śakyate | sarvairapi munīṃdraiśca kimanyairvibuddhairjanaiḥ || 4.125{16} || matveti śraddhayā nityaṃ divyāmṛtābhivāṃchibhiḥ | arthibhyaḥ sarvasatvebhyo dātavyaṃ jalamādarāt || 4.126{17} || ityādiṣṭaṃ munīndreṇa śrutvā sarve ca bhikṣavaḥ | sarvebhyaḥ sarvadā kartuṃ jaladānaṃ samaichan || 4.127{18} || athānandaḥ samutthāya natvā taṃ śrīghanaṃ gurum | kṛtāṃjalipuṭo pṛchan tatpāpaparimocanam || 4.128{19} || kadā sā bhagavan pretī tatpāpātparimokṣyate | sarvasatvābhibodhārthaṃ tatsamādeṣṭumarhasi || 4.129{20} || ityānandena pṛṣṭe'sau sarvajño bhagavāṃstadā | tamānaṃdaṃ samārabhya prāha pāpavimocanam || 4.130{21} || śṛṇvānaṃda samādhāya yena sā parimokṣyate | sarvasatvaprabodhāya tadupāyaiḥ pracakṣyate || 4.131{22} || sā pretī narakeṣvevaṃ sarveṣu bhramitā sadā | duḥkhābhivedanākhinnā paritaptānutāpitā || 4.132{23} || tataḥ kālāntare saivaṃ smṛtvā ratnatrayaṃ yadi | namo buddhāya dharmāya saṃghāyeti vadedyadā || 4.133{24} || tadā lokeśvaro sarvalokanātho jinātmajaḥ | dṛṣṭvā tāṃ sahasopetya svaprabhābhiḥ parispṛśet || 4.134{25} || yadā lokeśvarābhābhiḥ sparśitā sā sudhī satī | tadātisaukhyatāṃ labdhvā vismitaivaṃ vyacintayet || 4.135{26} || aho saukhyaṃ mayā labdhaṃ kasyānubhāvato'dhunā | kimāhosviditaścyutvāgato'nyatra vasāmyaham || 4.136{27} || iti cintāri tiṣṭhantī vismayoddhatamānasīm | dṛṣṭvā lokeśvaraścaināṃ bodhayitumupācaret || 4.137{28} || upetya tarpayitvā ca svatanuniḥsṛtairjalaiḥ | vividhairbhojanaiścāpi pratarppayetsa bodhirāṭ || 4.138{29} || tato'sau pāpinī pretī pītvā tattanujāmṛtam | paritṛptā viśuddhāṅgā natvā taṃ prārthayettathā || 4.139{30} || namaste bhagavannātha kṛpayā māṃ samuddhara | darśaya dharmamārgaṃ me sadā te śaraṇaṃ vraje || 4.140{31} || tayaivaṃ prārthite cāsau lokanātho dayānidhiḥ | darśayitvāryamārgaṃ ca śrāvayeddharmadeśanām || 4.141{32} || yāṃ śrutvaiva ca sā pretī sarvapāpavimocitā | tataścyutvā viśuddhātmā janma bodhikule labhet || 4.142{33} || tatra bodhicarīḥ prāptuṃ caredvratamupoṣadham | tadvratapuṇyabhāvaiśca bodhicaryyāḥ samācaret || 4.143{34} || kramādbodhicarīḥ pūryya bodhipraṇidhimānasaḥ | bodhisatvo mahāsatvo bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 4.144{35} || tato lokahitaṃ kṛtvā saṃbodhipadamāśrayan | sarvadā ca sukhaṃ bhuktvā sukhāvatīṃ gamiṣyati | tatrāmitābhasaṃbuddhaṃ sevitvā samupāśrayan | saṃbodhijñānamāsādya nirvṛtiṃ cāpyavāpsyati || 4.145{36} || yadyasau smarate pretī triratnānāṃ samāhitā | tadā caivaṃ tataścyutvā saukhāvatīṃ gamiṣyati || 4.146{37} || no cedevaṃ hi sā pretī sadāpi narake vaset | yāvanna smarate buddhaṃ tāvanna mokṣyate tataḥ || 4.147{38} || evaṃ sarve'pi ye satvā yāvanto narakāsthitāḥ | tāvantaste'pi sarve ca duṣṭāḥ pāpānucārikāḥ || 4.148{39} || yadaiṣāṃ ye triratnānāṃ smarantyanutāpitāḥ | namo buddhāya dharmāya saṃghāyeti vadaṃti ca || 4.149{40} || tadā tatpāpanirmuktā viśuddhāṅgāḥ śubhāśayāḥ | saddharmācaraṇaṃ kartumutsaheyuḥ samāhitāḥ || 4.150{41} || tato lokeśvaro dṛṣṭvā tān satvān dharmabhājanān | bodhayitvā prayatnena bodhimārge niyojayet || 4.151{41!} || tataḥ sarve ca te satvā bodhipraṇidhimānasāḥ | sarvasatvahitārthena samicheyuḥ śivāṃ carīm || 4.152{42} || tataste narakāccyutvā saṃprayāyuḥ sukhāvatīm | tatrāmitābhanāthasya dharmaṃ śrutvānumoditāḥ || 4.153{33!} || bodhicaryyāḥ samāśritya kuryurlokahitāni te | kramādbodhicarīḥ pūryya sarvakleśavimuktigāḥ || 4.154{34} || saṃbodhijñānamāsādya nirvṛtiṃ samavāpnuyuḥ | evamanye'pi ye satvā lokeśasaraṇaṃ gatāḥ || 4.155{35} || te āśu pāpanirmuktāḥ sukhāvatīṃ vrajanti hi | ye ye lokeśvaraṃ smṛtvā bhajanti satataṃ mudā | te te sarve ca niḥpāpā bhavanti bodhibhāginaḥ || 4.156{36} || tasmāllokeśvaraṃ smṛtvā gatvā ca śaraṇaṃ sadā | trimaṇḍalaviśuddhena caritavyaṃ vratottamam || 4.157{37} || vratottamaṃ samākhyātamāryāṣṭāṃgikapoṣādham | sarveṣāmapi puṇyānāṃ tadvratapuṇyamuttamam || 4.158{38} || yenaivāśu viśuddhyaṃte ghorapātakināpi ca | tasmādetatmahatpuṇyaṃ vratarājaṃ vidurjināḥ || 4.159{39} || yasya puṇyānubhāvena pūryya pāramitāgaṇāḥ | sarvakleśān vinirjitya śīghraṃ bodhimavāpnuyuḥ || 4.160{40} || ye'pyatītāśca saṃbuddhāḥ sarvajñāḥ sugatā jināḥ | te'pi tadvratapuṇyaistu śīghraṃ bodhimavāpnuvan || 4.161{41} || ye'pyetarhi ca saṃbuddhāḥ saṃbodhidharmadeśakāḥ | te'pyetadvratapuṇyaiśca bhavanti bodhipāragāḥ || 4.162{42} || ye cāpyanāgatā buddhā bhaviṣyanti tathāgatāḥ | te'pyetadvratapuṇyaistu lapsyante bodhisaṃpadam || 4.163{43} || evamanye'pi ye prājñāḥ saṃbodhipadavāṃchitāḥ | te'pyetadvratamādhāya labhanti bodhisaṃpadam || 4.164{44} || tasmādetadvrataṃ dhṛtvā dātavyaṃ dānamadarāt | etatphalaṃ sadākṣīṇaṃ sūte kalpataruryathā || 4.165{45} || etadvratadharāḥ satvāḥ saddharmācaraṇodyatāḥ | sarvathā na vrajaṃtyeva durgatiṣu kadācana || 4.166{46} || sadaiva sugatiṃ prāptāḥ sarvasatvānukaṃpinaḥ | saddharmācaraṇaṃ dhṛtvā bodhisatvā bhavanti te || 4.167{47} || ye ca lokeśvaraṃ smṛtvā carantyetadvrataṃ sadā | te paśyanti sadāpyenaṃ lokanāthaṃ jagatprabhum || 4.168{48} || tena lokeśvareṇāpi dṛśyaṃte te'pi sarvadā | ye ca lokeśasaṃdṛṣṭāste sarve bodhibhāginaḥ || 4.169{49} || bodhisatvā mahāsatvāḥ saṃbodhiṃ samavāpnuyuḥ | ye smaranti sadā nityaṃ lokeśaṃ karuṇāmayam | sahasā durgatiṃ tyaktvā muktvā yāyuḥ sukhāvatīm || 4.170{50} || ye ca taccharaṇaṃ gatvā bhajaṃti taṃ jinātmajam | sarvapāpavinirmuktāste'pi yāyuḥ sukhāvatim || 4.171{51} || ye sugandhairjalaiḥ śuddhaiḥ snāpayanti jagadgurum | mandākinyāṃ ca te snātvā śuddhā yāṃti sukhāvatim || 4.172{52} || paṃcagaṃdhādisaurabhyairlokeśaṃ lepayaṃti ye | cakravarttipadaṃ bhuktvā te'pi yāṃti sukhāvatīm || 4.173{53} || cīvaraṃ ye dadaṃtyasmai te divyavastrasaṃyutāḥ | sarvadharmādhināthāśca yāṃti cāṃte sukhāvatīm || 4.174{53*} || satkṛtya śraddhayā ye'pi puṣpaistamarcayanti ye | te surendrapadaṃ prāpya yānti cānte sukhāvatīm || 4.175{54} || saurabhyayojitairdhūpairye bhajanti tamīśvaram | te narendrapadaṃ bhuktvā yāṃti cānte sukhāvatim || 4.176{55} || ye dadanti ca bhaiṣajyaṃ tasmai lokādhipāya ca | cakravarttipadaṃ prāpya yāṃti te ca sukhāvatīm || 4.177{56} || ye dadanti pradīpāni tasmai lokeśvarāya ca | te mahendrapadaṃ bhuktvā yānti cānte sukhāvatīm || 4.178{57} || naivedyaṃ ye dadantyasmai te bhavanti nareśvarāḥ | divyabhogyāni bhuktvā ca yānti cānte sukhāvatīm || 4.179{58} || ye ca pānaṃ dadantyasmai te pītvā satataṃ sudhām | svarge ramanti devendrā yānti cānte sukhāvatīm || 4.180{59} || phalamūlādikaṃ dattaṃ yaiśca tasmai sutāyine | yathepsitasukhaṃ bhuktvāṃte'pi yāṃti sukhāvatīm || 4.181{60} || tāmbūlaṃ pūgasaṃyuktaṃ lokeśāya dadanti ye | surūpāḥ satsukhaṃ bhuktvāṃte'pi yānti sukhāvatīm || 4.182{61} || śayyāsanaṃ pradattaṃ yaistasmai satvānukaṃpine | te kṣitīśaśriyaṃ bhuktvā yāntyaṃte ca sukhāvatīm || 4.183{62} || siṃhāsanaṃ pradattaṃ yaistasmai dharmānuśāsine | te vaṃdyāḥ sarvalokaiśca yāntyante ca sukhāvatīm || 4.184{63} || chatraṃ tasmai pradattaṃ yaiste nṛpāścakravarttinaḥ | yaśodharmasukhaṃ bhuktvā saṃprayānti sukhāvatīm || 4.185{64} || patākāṃ ye prayachanti tasmai lokādhipāya cā | te'pi sarvāṃ mahīṃ bhuktvā yānti cānte sukhāvatīm || 4.186{65} || tasmai ye ca prayachanti dhāturatnagaṇāni ca | te narendrāścaturdvīpāṃ bhuktvā yānti sukhāvatīm || 4.187{66} || ye vitānaṃ vitanvaṃti gehe tasya kṛpānidheḥ | te narendrāḥ surendrāśca bhūtvā yāṃti sukhāvatīm || 4.188{67} || trailokyādhipatestasya ye kurvanti pradakṣiṇām | te narendraśriyaṃ bhuktvā yānti cānte sukhāvatīm || 4.189{68} || saṃgītairye prakurvanti pūjāṃ tasya jagatprabhoḥ | sadā subhāṣitānyeva śṛṇvanti te guṇākarāḥ || 4.190{69} || cāmarairvyajanairvāpi taṃ nāthaṃ vījayanti ye | te nṛpāḥ suralakṣmīṃ ca bhuktvā yāṃti jinālaye || 4.191{70} || śodhayanti ca ye nityaṃ vihāre kāruṇānidheḥ | divyanetrāśca te saukhyaṃ bhuktvā yāṃti surālayam || 4.192{71} || kṛtvā ramyaṃ vihāraṃ ca lokeśāya dadanti ye | te mahendraśriyaṃ bhuktvā saṃprayānti sukhāvatīm || 4.193{72} || vihāre tatra saṃsiddhe yaṣṭimāropya ye narāḥ | suvarṇakalaśāṃśchatradhvajaghaṇṭāvalīyutān || 4.194{73} || paṃcavarṇapatākābhiḥ puṣpasragbhiśca saṃyutān | saṃpratisthāṃ prakurvati mahotsāhairvidhānataḥ || 4.195{74} || te narendrāḥ surendrāśca yaśodharmasukhānvitāḥ | māheśvaryyaśriyaṃ bhuktva yānti cānte sukhāvatīm || 4.196{75} || padyagadyamayaiḥ stotrairye stuvaṃti tamīśvaram | niḥpāpāḥ sukhinaḥ prājñāste prayānti sukhāvatīm || 4.197{76} || ye cāṣṭāṃgapraṇāmāni asmai śāstre prakurvaṃte | cakravartīpadaṃ bhuktvā te prayānti jinālayam || 4.198{77} || ye smaranti sadā nityaṃ tamīśaṃ sugatātmajam | te sadyaḥ pāpanirmuktā ante yānti sukhāvatīm || 4.199{78} || ye ye satvāśca taṃ nāthaṃ smṛtvā bhajanti sarvadā | te te sarve na yāntyeva durgatiṣu kadācana || 4.200{80} || sadāpi sadgatiṣveva yātāḥ saukhyasamanvitāḥ | saddharmācaraṇaṃ kṛtvā saṃprayānti sukhāvatīm || 4.201{81} || evaṃ ye pāpinaścāpi lokeśaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ | te'pi pāpavinirmuktāḥ śuddhā yāṃti jinālayam || 4.202{82} || evaṃ lokeśvaro nāthaḥ puṇyakṣetraṃ śubhapradaḥ | ciṃtāmaṇiḥ kalpavṛkṣo yathepsitaphalapradaḥ || 4.203{83} || na hi tena samaḥ kaścinmahatpuṇyaphalapradaḥ | kuto'dhikastu vidyeta traidhātubhuvaneṣvapi || 4.204{84} || tenaiva sakalāḥ satvā bodhayitvā prayatnataḥ | āryyamārge pratiṣṭhāpya preritā nirvṛtāvapi || 4.205{85} || pāpiṣṭho api satvāśca tenopetya svayaṃ tathā | narakebhyaḥ samuddhṛtya saṃpreritāḥ sukhāvatīm || 4.206{86} || evaṃ sarve'pi satvāśca nānopāyavidhānataḥ | darśayitvāryyamārgāṇi tena bodhau niveśitāḥ || 4.207{87} || tasmātsarvādhikeśaḥ sa lokeśvaro maheśvaraḥ | sarvadharmānubhartā sa lokanāthaḥ pratīyate | kenāpi gaṃtuṃ tasya puṇyaskaṃdhaṃ na śakyate | mayāpi śakyate naivaṃ sarvaiścāpi munīśvaraiḥ | evaṃ matvā tvamānaṃdaḥ lokanathaṃ dayodadhim || 4.208{88} || sarvadevādhideveśaṃ smṛtvaiva satataṃ bhaja | tataste maṃgalaṃ nityaṃ sarvadāpi samaṃtataḥ || 4.209{89} || kutaścinnaiva vidyeran bhayāni vividhānyapi | yatra lokeśvarasmṛtistatrotpātabhayaṃ na hi || 4.210{90} || agnerapi bhayaṃ naiva nāpyutpātamarudbhayam | na codakabhayaṃ tatra na ca bhūmibhayaṃ khalu || 4.211{91} || vidyutpātabhayaṃ nāpi na cāśanibhayaṃ sadā | na ca śatrubhayaṃ kvāpi nāpi rājabhayaṃ tathā || 4.212{92} || na ca caurabhayānyevaṃ na ca rogabhayāni ca | sarvabhayaḥ praśāmyante lokeśasmṛtibhāvataḥ || 4.213{93} || sarve'pyupadravāścaivaṃ prayāṃti vilayaṃ tataḥ | evaṃ lokeśvaro nātho mahatpuṇyānubhāvavān || 4.214{94} || yenaivaṃ trijagallokaṃ pālitaṃ putravatsadā | tasmāllokeśvaro nityaṃ sevitavyaḥ śubhārthibhiḥ || 4.215{95} || yasya dharmānubhāvena sarvatrāpi śivaṃ sadā | iti matvā tvayānaṃda taddharmāñchrāvayan sadā || 4.216{97} || prerayitvā ca tadbhaktau saṃbodhau saṃpraveśaya | etatpuṇyānubhāvaistvamapyevaṃ kuśalī bhavan || 4.217{98} || bodhisatvo mahāsatvo bhavennūnaṃ jinātmajaḥ || 4.218{99} || ityādiṣṭaṃ munīndreṇa śrutvānaṃdaḥ sasāṃghikaḥ | tatheti pratimoditvā sadā lokeśamasmarat || 4.219{100} || evaṃ rājaṃstvayā cāpi smṛtvā lokeśvaraḥ sadā | sevitavyaḥ prayatnena bodhipraṇidhicetasā || 4.220{1} || tatastvaṃ sahasā sarvapāpebhyaḥ parimocitaḥ | bodhisatvo viśuddhātmā prayāsyasi sukhāvatīm || 4.221{2} || ityevaṃ guruṇādiṣṭamupaguptena dhīmatā | śrutvā rājānumoditvā so'bhyanandatsapārṣadaḥ || 4.222{3} || idaṃ śrutvāvadānaṃ ye śrāvayitvā parānapi | bhajaṃti lokanāthaṃ te saṃprayāyuḥ sukhāvatīm || 4.223{4} || iti ratnāvadānamālāyaṃ pretikāvadānaṃ samāptam śālapuṣpāvadāna athāśoko mahīpālo bhūyaḥ śrotuṃ subhāsitaiḥ | upaguptaṃ guruṃ natvā kṛtāṃjaliravocat || 5.1{1} || bhadanta śrotumichāmi punaranyatsubhāṣitam | tadarhasi samādeṣṭuṃ lokānāṃ puṇyavṛddhaye || 5.2{2} || iti vijñāpite tena nṛpendreṇa prasādinā | upagupto yatiścāpi taṃ nṛpaṃ pratyabhāṣata || 5.3{3} || śṛṇu rājanmahābhāga sarvalokahitārthabhṛt | yathā me guruṇādiṣṭaṃ vakṣye'haṃ te tathā khalu || 5.4{4} || puraikasamaye buddho bhagavāñchrīghano jinaḥ | śrāvastyāṃ jetakāraṇye vihāre maṇimaṇḍite || 5.5{5} || śrāvakairbhikṣubhiḥ saṃghairbodhisatvagaṇaiḥ saha | saddharmadeśanāṃ kartuṃ vyaharallokaśāsitum || 5.6{6} || taddharmadeśanāṃ śrotuṃ sarve satvāḥ samāgatāḥ | brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyāścāpi rājāno rājamātrikāḥ || 5.7{7} || vaiśyāḥ śūdrā amātyāśca maṃtriṇaḥ sādhavo janāḥ | śreṣṭhinaḥ sārthavāhāśca dhaninaśca vaṇiggaṇāḥ || 5.8{8} || paurājānapadāścāpi nānādeśasamāgatāḥ | devā daityāśca gandharvā yakṣakinnararākṣasāḥ || 5.9{9} || siddhāvidyādharāḥ sādhyā vasavaśca grahādhipāḥ | nāgeṃdrā garuḍāścaivamṛṣayo brahmacāriṇāḥ || 5.10{10} || yogino yatayaścāpi lokapālāḥ sasainyakāḥ | sarve taṃ sugataṃ natvā dharmaṃ śrotumupāgatāḥ || 5.11{11} || satkṛtya pūjayitvā ca kṛtāṃjalipuṭo mudā | parivṛtya puraskṛtya dṛṣṭvā tasthuḥ samāhitāḥ || 5.12{12} || athāsau bhagavān dṛṣṭvā tān sarvān dharmavāṃchinaḥ | ādimadhyāntakalyāṇaṃ dideśa dharmamuttamam || 5.13{13} || tatra devādayaḥ sarve tatsaddharmāmṛtaṃ mudā | pītvā cābhyanumodantaḥ prāpurjñānaviśeṣatām || 5.14{14} || śrāvasteyāttadāneke dārikā dārakāśca te | kusumān yācitaṃ śālabhaṃjikākhyaṃ giriṃ yayuḥ || 5.15{15} || tatra te sahasā gatvā dṛṣṭvā puṣpāṇyanekaśaḥ | prādāya samupāgatvā śrāvastyāmacaranmudā || 5.16{16} || tatraikā dārikā vālā śreṣṭhiputrī pramoditā | śanaiḥ sā śālapuṣpāṇi prādāya pṛṣṭhato'carat || 5.17{17} || tadā ca bhagāvān buddho bhikṣusaṃghasamanvitaḥ | śrāvastyāṃ bhojanaṃ bhuktvā tato bahirviniryayau || 5.18{18} || tatra sā dārikādrākṣīdbhagavantaṃ tamāgatam | dvātriṃśallakṣaṇāśītivyaṃjanaṃ samalaṃkṛtam || 5.19{19} || vyāmaprabhāvirājantaṃ sahasreṇādhikaprabham | jaṃgamamiva ratnāṅgaṃ samantabhadrarūpikam || 5.20{20} || dṛṣṭvaivaṃ śrīghanaṃ nāthaṃ dārikā sā pramoditā | śraddhayārcayituṃ puṣpairmanasaivaṃ vyaciṃtayat || 5.21{21} || aho puṇyaṃ mayā labdhaṃ yatsaṃbuddho dṛśyate'dhunā | evaṃ kadā kathaṃ kutra drakṣyate'yaṃ munīśvaraḥ || 5.22{22} || bhāgyenaivaṃ mayā labdhaṃ saṃbuddhadarśanaṃ tathā | nūnaṃ bhāgyavatī cāsmi yatpuṇyanidhirāpyate || 5.23{23} || tasmātpuṇyaṃ mahāratnaṃ prāptumupetya sādaram | etaiśca kusumaiḥ sarvairarhāmyetaṃ samarcitum || 5.24{24} || kadāyaṃ lapsyate bhūyaḥ paravaśyā striyā mayā | tadahaṃ sahasopetya puṣpāṇyasmāyupākire || 5.25{25} || sadā notpadyate nātra saṃbuddho hi kadā cana | atisudurllabhaṃ hyasya darśanaṃ ca sadā na hi || 5.26{26} || mānuṣyaṃ durllabhaṃ janma vinā puṇyairna labhyate | mānuṣye'labhyamāne'pi saṃbuddhe sevyate katham || 5.27{27} || mānuṣye labhyamāne'pi kṣaṇaṃ saṃpatsudurllabhā | narairapyakṣaṇaprāptaiḥ kathaṃ buddhe'nusevyate || 5.28{28} || tadadya mānuṣī bhūtvā prāpyaivaṃ sukṛtau kṣaṇam | yadyatra kusumairebhiḥ saṃbuddhaṃ nārcayāmyaham || 5.29{29} || tato me niṣphalaṃ janma mānuṣye vyarthameva hi | kiṃ mamānena dehena sarvathaikāntanāśinā || 5.30{30} || kimanenāpi jīvena mṛtyau nityaṃ puraḥsthite | kiyatkālaṃ ca jīveyaṃ gacheyaṃ maraṇaṃ dhruvam || 5.31{31} || ciraṃ sthitvāpi kiṃ sāraṃ saṃbuddhabhajanaṃ vinā | varaṃ prāṇaparityāgaṃ kṛtvā saṃbuddhadarśanam || 5.32{32} || anityaṃ khalu saṃsāraṃ sarvadehādikaṃ dhanam | etadeva tu satsāraṃ yadbuddhe bhajanaṃ sadā || 5.33{33} || tadaitaiḥ kusumaiḥ sarvaiḥ pūjayāmi munīśvaram | kathaṃ na pūjayisyāmi saṃbuddhaṃ trijagadgurum || 5.34{34} || iti niścitya sā vālā dṛṣṭvā taṃ sugataṃ mudā | sahasopetya taiḥ sarvaiḥ sālapuṣpairavākiran || 5.35{35} || tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya praṇamya taṃ praharṣitā | kiṃ ciddūre parāvṛtya tasthau dṛṣṭvā muniṃ mudā || 5.36{36} || tato'sau bhagavān buddhastasyā āyurvihīnatām | matvā tāṃ saṃnrīksyaivaṃ svaṃ vihāraṃ samāyayau || 5.37{37} || atha sā dārikā bhūyastathānyatkusumāni ca | gṛhasyārthe samādātuṃ tataḥ śālavanaṃ yayau || 5.38{38} || tatra śālataruṃ dṛṣṭvā praphullakusumānvitam | tatpuṣpāṇi samācetuṃ sahasā sā ruroha tam || 5.39{39} || tatrāvaruhya puṣpāṇi cinvantī sā pramodataḥ | agraśākhāsamārūḍhā papāta sahasā tataḥ || 5.40{40} || patitā sā virugnāṅgā tīvrātivedanāturā | hā hatāsmīti niścitya saṃbuddhasmaraṇaṃ vyadhāt || 5.41{41} || namo buddhāya dharmāya saṃghāya sugatāya ca | iti proktvaiva saṃbuddhaṃ smaranti maraṇaṃ yayau || 5.42{42} || tataḥ svargopapannā sā vismitaivaṃ vyacintayat | kutaścyutvā kuhotpannā kena vā kuśalena ca || 5.43{43} || iti cintāparītā sā sahasaivaṃ vyabuddhyata | martyāccyutvāgatā svarge buddhe puṣpapradānataḥ || 5.44{44} || iti buddhvā ca sā bhadrā suprasāditamānasī | tameva sugataṃ nāthaṃ smṛtvā natvābhyanandata || 5.45{45} || tato devairupanītaṃ divyapuṣpasvalaṃkṛtam | vimānaṃ sā samāruhya devasabhāmupāyayau || 5.46{46} || tasmiṃśca samaye śakraḥ sudharmāyāṃ suraiḥ saha | saṃbuddhavarṇanāṃ kṛtvā tasthau devān pramodayan || 5.47{47} || tathā tāṃ samupāyātāṃ śālapuṣpābhyalaṃkṛtām | dṛṣṭvā divyātivarṇābhāṃ papracha vismito hariḥ || 5.48{48} || gātraṃ kena vimṛṣṭakāṃcananibhaṃ padmotpalābhaṃ tava | divyaśrīratulākṛteyamiha te kena prabhā niḥsṛtā | vaktraṃ kena vibuddhapadmasadṛśaṃ cāmīkarābhaṃ tava | kasya tvaṃ varadevate phalamidaṃ yatkarmajaṃ bhujyate || 5.49{49} || iti prokte surendreṇa sā bhadrā devakanyakā | taṃ devādhipatiṃ natvā kṛtāṃjalipuṭo'bravīt || 5.50{50} || saśrāvakā narāditya ākīrṇaśālapuṣpakaiḥ | tatkarmakuśalaṃ kṛtvā rājate me'dhikaṃ tanuḥ || 5.51{51} || jalajenduviśuddhābhaṃ vadanaṃ me'bhirocate | etatkarmānubhāvena vijānīyāḥ sureśvara || 5.52{52} || tayeti proditaṃ śrutvā devendro'sau suvismitaḥ | dṛṣṭvā caināṃ subhadrāṅgīṃ praharṣayannabhāṣata || 5.53{53} || aho guṇamayaṃ kṣetraṃ sarvadoṣavivarjitam | yatra nyastaṃ tvayā vījamitthaṃ svargopapattaye || 5.54{54} || ko nārcayetpravarakāṃcanarāśigauraṃ buddhaṃ vibuddhakamalāyatapatranetram | yatrādhikārajanitāni viśobhitāni kāṃtāmukhāni kamalāyatalocanāni || 5.55{55} || dhanyo'si tvaṃ subhadrāṃgi saṃbuddhaguṇabhāvini | sarvathā hi sa saṃbuddhaḥ sevitavyaḥ sadāpi ca || 5.56{56} || yasya puṇyaprasādāttvaṃ sadyaḥ svarge samāgatā | sa eva bhagavānnāthaḥ saṃsmṛtvā sevyatāṃ sadā || 5.57{57} || tataste sarvadā nityaṃ maṃgalaṃ syātsamaṃtataḥ | ciraṃ divyasukhaṃ bhuktvā yāyāścānte sukhāvatīm || 5.58{158} || ityādiṣṭaṃ surendreṇa sā devakanyakā sudhīḥ | anumodya ca taṃ śakraṃ natvā svamālayaṃ yayau || 5.59{59} || tataḥ sā saṃsthitā devīprāsāde divyamaṇḍite | divyabhogyasukhaprāptā moditvaivaṃ vyacintayet || 5.60{60} || yaccyutvāhaṃ manuṣyebhyo'dhunā svargasamāgatā | tatsaṃbuddhaprasādena jānāmi nānyathā khalu || 5.61{61} || yanmayā pūjito buddhaḥ śālapuṣpairvanodbhāvaiḥ | tatpuṇyaphalabhogyārthe āgatāhaṃ surālayam || 5.62{62} || yaddivyasukhasaṃprāptaṃ tatsaṃbuddhaprasādataḥ | tena tamevaṃ saṃbuddhaṃ punargacheya vaṃditum || 5.63{63} || na yuktaṃ saugate gantuṃ paryyuṣitena vāsasā | yuktaṃ tu saugate gaṃtumaparyuṣitavāsasā || 5.64{64} || iti sā manasā matvā devakanyā subhadrikā | snātvā saurabhyaliptāṃgā divyaśuddhāmvarāvṛtā || 5.65{65} || divyālaṃkāramālādimaulīkuṇḍalamaṃḍitā | anekadevakanyābhirapsarobhiḥ samanvitā || 5.66{66} || divyapūjopacārāṇi gṛhītvā sahasā yayau | tasyāmeva niśi svarddhyā bhāsayantī samaṃtataḥ || 5.67{67} || jetavanamupetyāsau praviveśa jinālayam | tataḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā praṇamya caraṇau muneḥ || 5.68{68} || paṃcopahārapūjābhiḥ pūjayitvā kṛtāṃjaliḥ | natvā ca purataḥ tasthau saddharmaśravaṇotsukā || 5.69{69} || athāsau bhagavāṃstasyā jñātvāśayaviśuddhatām | ādimadhyāntakalyāṇaṃ dideśa dharmamuttamam || 5.70{70} || catvāri cāryyasatyāni niḥkleśapuṇyalabdhaye | daśakuśalamūlāni samyaksatvaviśuddhaye || 5.71{71} || āryyāṣṭāṅgikamārgāṃśca saṃbodhimārgalabdhaye | bodhipākṣikadharmāṃśca saṃbuddhaguṇalabdhaye || 5.72{72} || athāsau devakanyā tāṃ saddharmadeśaṇaṃ muneḥ | śrutvānumoditā cāpi prāpya dharmaviśeṣatām || 5.73{73} || jñānavajreṇa satkāyadṛṣṭiśailaṃ vibheda sā | śrotāpattiphalaṃ prāptā dṛṣṭasatyābhavattadā || 5.74{74} || tato bhūyaḥ praṇamyaivaṃ bhagavantaṃ kṛtāṃjaliḥ | suprasannamukhāmbhojo trirudānamudāharat || 5.75{75} || bhagavannidamasmākaṃ mahāpuṇyasukhodayam | jananyāpi kṛtaṃ nāpi na pitrā na ca vaṃdhubhiḥ || 5.76{76} || na jñātibhirna mitraiśca na sahāyasuhṛjjanaiḥ | nāpi sālohitaiścāpi pitṛlokairna cāparaiḥ || 5.77{77} || na rājñā na cāmātyairna maṃtribhirna ca paurikaiḥ | na gurubhirna vipraiśca na yatibhirna tāpasaiḥ || 5.78{78} || na devairnāpi daityaiśca nāpi lokādhipairapi | tathānyaiśca kṛtaṃ naiva yadidaṃ bhavatā kṛtam || 5.79{79} || uchoṣito yadasmākaṃ rudhirāśrusaritpatiḥ | asthimayo mahāchailo yadasmābhiśca laṃghitaḥ || 5.80{80} || tavānubhāvātpihitaḥ sughoro hyapāyamārgo bahudoṣayuktaḥ | apāvṛtā svargagatiḥ supuṇyā nirvāṇamārgaśca mayopalabdhaḥ || 5.81{81} || bhavatprasādānnirupetadoṣaṃ mayādya labdhaṃ suviśuddhacakṣuḥ | prāptaṃ ca śāntaṃ padamāryyakāntaṃ tīrṇaśca duḥkhārṇavapāramasmi || 5.82{82} || naravarendrasurāsurapūjite vigatajanmajarāmaraṇādayaḥ | bhavasahasrasudullabhadarśane saphalamadya mune tava darśanam || 5.83{83} || tataḥ praṇatvā caraṇāraviṃdau muneḥ prakṛtvā tṛpradakṣiṇāṃ ca | prajātaharṣā sugataṃ jineṃdraṃ smṛtvā ca bhūyo divamāyayau sā || 5.84{84} || tathā svargasamāyātā devakanyā mumoda sā | yathā vaṇiglabdhalābho rogamukto yathāturaḥ || 5.85{85} || samyagniṣpannaśasyāpto yathā ca kṛṣikārmikaḥ | siddhayātrāpralabdhārthaḥ sārthavāho vaṇigyathā || 5.86{86} || atha te bhikṣavaḥ sarve dṛṣṭvaivamavabhāsitam | saṃdigdhavismitāścaivaṃ paprachustaṃ munīśvarām || 5.87{87} || bhagavannadya rātrau ko bhavato'ntikamāgataḥ | brahmā vā surarājo vā lokapālagaṇā api || 5.88{88} || asmābhirjñāyate nāyaṃ yo'dya rātrāvihāgataḥ | tadasmān vismitān sarvān bodhayituṃ samarhasi || 5.89{89} || iti tairbhikṣubhiḥ pṛṣṭo bhagavān sa munīśvaraḥ | tāṃśca bhikṣugaṇān sarvān samāmaṃtryābravīttathā || 5.90{90} || na hi sa bhikṣavo brahmā nāpi vāsau surādhipaḥ | naiva lokādhipālāśca yādya rātrāvihāgatā || 5.91{91} || api tu dārikā dṛṣṭā yuṣmābhiḥ sagatā pathi | yayāhaṃ sālapuṣpaiśca prāvakīryyābhitoṣitaḥ || 5.92{92} || sā māṃ puṣpairavākīryya gṛhasyārthe punarvanam | gatā puṣpāṇyupāhartuṃ vṛkṣārūḍhāpatattaroḥ || 5.93{93} || tato'sau patanodvignā vedanākrāṃtacetasā | triratnāni smarantyeva dehaṃ tyaktvā divaṃ yayau || 5.94{94} || tatra svarge samāsādya smṛtva māṃ sugataṃ punaḥ | draṣṭuṃ dharmaṃ ca me śrotumihāsau samupāgatā || 5.95{95} || tanmayā deśitaṃ tasyai saṃbodhidharmamuttamam | śrutvā sā cānumodyaivaṃ saṃharṣitā divaṃ yayau || 5.96{96} || ityevaṃ bhikṣavo matvā triratnāni śubhārthibhiḥ | sevitavyāni saṃsmṛtvā gatvā ca śaraṇaṃ sadā || 5.97{97} || ye bhajanti triratnāni saṃsmṛtvā śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ | durgatiṃ te na gachaṃti vrajanti sadgatiṃ sadā || 5.98{98} || ye nindanti triratnāni pratikṣipya pramādataḥ | sadgatiṃ te na gachanti vasanti narake sadā || 5.99{99} || tasmānnityāṃ triratnāni saṃsmṛtvā śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ | satkṛtya bhāvayitvā ca bhajadhvaṃ bodhivāṃchayā || 5.100{100} || tathā vo maṅgalaṃ nityaṃ sarvatra sarvadā bhavet | kramādbodhicarīṃ pūrya saṃbodhimapi lapsyatha || 5.101{1} || ityādiṣṭaṃ munīndreṇa śrutvā te bhikṣavo mudā | tathetyabhyanumodantastriratnāni sadābhajan || 5.102{2} || ityevaṃ guruṇādiṣṭaṃ mayaivaṃ te pracakṣyate | śrutvaitacchrāvayitvā ca triratnāni sadā bhaja || 5.103{3} || tatastvaṃ kramaśaścaiva bodhicaryāṃ samācaran | sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sukhāvatīṃ samāvrajeḥ || 5.104{3*} || ityetadguruṇādiṣṭamupaguptena bhikṣuṇā | śrutvā rājā tathetyevamabhyanandatsapārṣadaḥ || 5.105{4} || tatsaṃbuddhānubhāvaṃ munivarakathitaṃ śālapuṣpāvadānam | ye śrutvā śrāvayanti pramuditamanasaḥ śraddhayā bodhikāmāḥ | te sarvakleśamuktāḥ sakalaguṇadharā bodhicaryyānuraktāḥ | kṛtvā loke hitārthaṃ jinavaravasatiṃ saṃprayaṃti praharṣaiḥ || 5.106{5} || iti śālapuṣpāvadānaṃ samāptaṃ sūkaryavadāna punarevaṃ yatīśo'sāvupagupto jināṃśajaḥ | triratnasmṛtijaṃ puṇyaṃ khyātuṃ nṛpamabravīt || 6.1{1} || mahatpuṇyānubhāvatvaṃ triratnasmṛtisaṃbhavam | tadahaṃ te pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu rājan samāhitaḥ || 6.2{2} || dharmatā khalu devānāṃ svargacyavanadharmmiṇām | paṃcapūrvanimittāni prādurbhaveyurātmani || 6.3{3} || akliṣṭāni hi vāsāṃsi kliśyeyuścyavanāntike | amlānāni ca mālyāni mlāyeran sahasā khalu || 6.4{4} || daurgandhaṃ niḥsareddehātkakṣābhyāṃ sveda udbhavet | pracyutisamaye prāpte svāsane na dhṛtiṃ labhet || 6.5{5} || etatpaṃcanimittāni svargāccyavanadharmiṇām | sarveṣāṃ prodbhaveyuśca pracyutisamayāgame || 6.6{6} || puraikadevaputrasya tathā cyavanadharmiṇaḥ | etatpaṃcanimittāni prādurāsaṃścyuteḥ puraḥ || 6.7{7} || atha cyavanadharmāsau devaputro viṣāditaḥ | avaśyaṃ cyavanaṃ svargānmatvā rautsīdadhīritaḥ || 6.8{8} || āvartya svavimānasthaḥ parivarttya vimūrchitaḥ | punaścaitanyamāsādya vilapaṃ paryyadevataḥ || 6.9{9} || hā mandākini hemāvjavyāpte puṇyāmbuvāhini | tvayi snātvapyahaṃ cyutvā yāsyāmi durgatiṃ katham || 6.10{10} || hā caitrarathamutsṛjya kva krīḍeyaṃ yathechayā | hā nandanavanaṃ ramyaṃ tyaktvāhaṃ kva rameya ca || 6.11{11} || hā miśrikāvanaṃ divyaṃ tyaktvā ramye kuhādhunā | hā pāruṣyavanaṃ tyaktvā kva ramyāmyapsarogaṇaiḥ || 6.12{12} || kva sukhaṃ lapsyate pāṇḍukaṃvalakaśilāṃ vinā | hā devasamitiṃ tyaktvā kva śroṣyāmi subhāṣitām || 6.13{13} || hā hā sudarśanaṃ ramyaṃ puraṃ tyaktvā vraje cyutaḥ | prāsādaṃ vaijayaṃtañca kadā drakṣyāmyahaṃ punaḥ || 6.14{14} || hā śakrapramukhairdevaiḥ sārddhaṃ kṛdāpramoditaḥ | adhunā me kva tatsaukhyaṃ śrotuṃ cāpi na lapsyate || 6.15{15} || hā devyamamṛtaṃ tyaktvā kiṃ prabhokṣyāmi sāṃpratam | divyakāmasukhaṃ bhuktvā punardurgatimāśrayan || 6.16{16} || kiyadduḥkhaṃ ca saṃbhoktuṃ yāsyāmi narakeṣvaham | etaddivyamahotsāhādbhraṣṭo'haṃ narake gataḥ || 6.17{17} || mahadduḥkhābhisaṃtaptaḥ sahiṣyāmi kathaṃ tadā | hā hato'smi svapāpena kiṃ pāpaṃ prakṛtaṃ mayā || 6.18{18} || yenetaḥ svargataścyutvā punaryāsyāmi nārakān kim | upāyaṃ kariṣyāmi na yāyāṃ yena durgatim || 6.19{19} || ko me śāstātra vidyeta yo māṃ dharme niyojayet | dharmeṇa rakṣyate prāṇī narake saṃsthito'pi ca || 6.20{20} || dharmaṃ vinātra devo'pi svargātprabhransyate punaḥ | kiṃ karomi kva yāsyāmi nātropāyaṃ tu manyate || 6.21{21} || sarvathāhamitaścyutvā gacheyaṃ durgatiṃ khalu | itaścyutasya me janma labdhavyaṃ bhuvane kuha || 6.22{22} || iti dhairyaṃ samādhāya manasaivaṃ vyalokayat | cyutvetaḥ saukaraṃ janma prāptavyaṃ saptame dine || 6.23{23} || evaṃ svāptagatiṃ dṛṣṭvā papāta savimūrchitaḥ | athādrākṣīnmahendrastaṃ patitaṃ bhuvi mūrchitam || 6.24{24} || dṛṣṭvā ca sahasopetya sudhāsekairasiṃcayat | tato'sau cetanāṃ labdhvā śanairutthāya taṃ prabhum || 6.25{25} || dṛṣṭvā pādau pariṣvajya natvaivaṃ prārthayadrudan | hā hā nātha mahendro'si sarvalokādhipaḥ prabhuḥ || 6.26{26} || māmadhaḥ patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā nopekṣāṃ kartumarhasi | bhavān hi jagatāṃ rājā svāmī bharttā patiḥ prabhuḥ || 6.27{27} || nātho dharmānuśāstā ca tanmāṃ rakṣatumarhasi | tvadṛte'nyo na me kaścidrakṣako vidyate'tra hi || 6.28{28} || tadanukaṃpayā dṛṣṭyā dhṛtvā māmuddhara prabho | yadi māṃ rakṣituṃ nātha na śaknoti bhavānapi || 6.29{29} || ko māṃ samuddharedanyo hā hato narake vraje | maṃḍākinyāṃ tvayā sārddhaṃ snātvā pūtātmako'pyaham || 6.30{30} || kathaṃ ca narake gatvā vaseyamaśuciṃ caran | sahāpsarogaṇairnityaṃ caritvā naṃdane vane || 6.31{31} || divyasaṃgītivādyaiśca ramāmi saṃpramoditaḥ | adyetaḥ patito pṛthvyāṃ rājagṛhopajāṃgale || 6.32{32} || saukaraṃ janma lapsyāmi saptame divase khalu | tatra mūtrapuriṣādīnamedhyānapi kṛcchrataḥ || 6.33{33} || labdhvā bhuktvā cariṣyāmi vyādhasaṃghairupadrutaḥ | bahuvarṣasahasrāṇi bhūtvaivaṃ sūkarātmajaḥ || 6.34{34} || amedhyakardame nityaṃ vatsyāmyāvartya saṃcaran | evaṃ divyāmṛtaṃ bhuktvā ramitvā bhavatā saha || 6.35{35} || kathaṃ hi nārake gatvā bhokṣye'medhyāni saṃcaraḥ | imaṃ kalpataruṃ tyaktvā yathepsitaphalapradam || 6.36{36} || jāṃgalaṃ vṛkṣamāśritya sthito bhokṣyāmi kiṃ tadā | sarvathāhaṃ cyuto'smītaḥ prerito hi svakarmaṇā || 6.37{37} || vividhāni ca duḥkhāni bhoktuṃ yāsyāmi nārake | tadupāyaṃ pradātavyaṃ bhavatā me'nukaṃpinā || 6.38{38} || yenāśu durgatermuktaḥ prāgacheyaṃ ca svargatim | sarvathā rakṣa māṃ nātha yadyasti te kṛpā mayi || 6.39{39} || bhavānmāṃ patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā nopekṣāṃ kartumarhati | bhavāneva jagacchāstā sarvalokādhipaḥ prabhuḥ || 6.40{40} || tadāśu māṃ prayatnena samuddhartuṃ samarhati | idaṃ te darśanaṃ nātha paścimaṃ me bhavetkhalu || 6.41{41} || janmaśatasahasraiśca durlabhaṃ syāddhi saṃgamam | ityevaṃ vilapaṃ devaputrassa taṃ surādhipam || 6.42{42} || natvā pādau nirīkṣyaiva tasthāvaśrugalanmukhaḥ | atha śakraḥ surendro'sau dṛṣṭvaivaṃ pravilāpitam || 6.43{43} || kāruṇyā krāntacittastamāśvāsayannabhāṣata | mā kṛthā rodanaṃ bhadra samāśvasi hi dhīraya || 6.44{44} || kriyante kiṃ prayatnāni sarvathā maraṇaṃ dhruvam | mṛtyurmahāvaliṣṭho hi sarvasatvāntakārakaḥ || 6.45{45} || hrīyante mṛtyunā sarve mṛtyuḥ kena nihanyate | anirvāyo hi sarvatra sarvatraidhātukeṣvapi || 6.46{46} || sarveṣāmapi jantūnāmekānte maraṇaṃ dhruvam | tasmānmā bhestathā mṛtyoḥ kiṃ viṣādena sidhyate || 6.47{47} || taddhairyyataiḥ samālaṃvya triratnaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja | gatvā ca śaraṇaṃ teṣāṃ smara nityaṃ samāhitaḥ || 6.48{48} || tatastvaṃ durgatiṃ muktvā sadgatiṃ samavāpnuyāḥ | etadeva hi saṃsāre mahopāyaṃ śubhāptaye || 6.49{49} || nānyaddhi vidyate kiṃcinmṛtyau sādhāraṇe dhruve | tadanyaccetanāṃ hitvā triratnānyabhisaṃsmaran || 6.50{50} || namo buddhāya dharmāya saṃghāyeti vadan bhaja | ye triratnasmṛtiṃ dhṛtvā mṛtāste puṇyabhāginaḥ || 6.51{51} || kramādbodhicarīṃ prāpya yāyuścānte sukhavatīm | tvaṃ cāpi triratnānaṃ smṛtvā mṛtaḥ supuṇyadhṛk || 6.52{52} || kramādbodhicarīṃ prāpya saṃprayāyāḥ sukhāvatīm | itīndreṇa samādiṣṭaṃ śrutvā devasuto'tha saḥ || 6.53{53} || tathetyanusaṃmodya punarnatvaivamabravīt | adyārabhya mahendrāhaṃ triratnānaṃ sadā smaran || 6.54{54} || gatvā ca śaraṇaṃ teṣāmupāsako bhave khalu | ityuktvā sa mahendrasya puraḥ sthitvā kṛtāñjaliḥ || 6.55{55} || anusmṛtya triratnānāṃ namaskṛtimudāharat | namo buddhāya bhadrāya namo dharmāya tāyine || 6.56{56} || namaḥ saṃghāya nāthāya sarvadāpi name bhaje | adyārabhya triratnānāṃ sadāhaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraje || 6.57{57} || upāsako bhavennityaṃ namāmi satataṃ smaret | ityuktvā devaputro'sau kāladharmayutaścyutaḥ || 6.58{58} || tuṣite devaloke'bhūdupapannaḥ supuṇyataḥ | dharmatā khalu devānāṃ ye devāḥ svargataścyutāḥ || 6.59{59} || te'dholokeṣu gacheyurna tūrddhvabhuvaneṣu hi | atha śakro narendro'sau dṛṣṭvā taṃ svargataścyutam || 6.60{60} || kutrāsau labhate janma ityadhastādvyalokayat | kimasau sūkarīgarbha utpanno vā na veti ca || 6.61{61} || apaśyatsarvataścainaṃ na dadarśa kuhāpi sa | tato'sau vismitaḥ śakro divyena cakṣuṣā punaḥ || 6.62{62} || kutrāsau labhate janma ityevaṃ samalokayat | vata tiryyakṣu jāto'sau preteṣu ca prajāyate || 6.63{63} || atha narakeṣu vā jāta ityevaṃ samalokayat | teṣu triṣvapyapāyeṣu nādrākṣīttaṃ samaṃtataḥ || 6.64{64} || tato manuṣyalokeṣu jāto veti dadarśa ca | tatrāpi ca sa sarvatra nādrākṣīttaṃ sureśvaraḥ || 6.65{65} || tataścaturmahārājabhuvaneṣu prajāyate | iti teṣu ca sarvatra vilokayan dadarśa na || 6.66{66} || tataśca vismitaḥ śakrastrayastriṃśe vyalokayan | tatrāpi taṃ na cādrākṣītkutrāpi ca samaṃtataḥ | evaṃ sarvatra lokeṣu vilokayaṃstadudbhavam | adṛṣṭvā vismitaḥ śakraḥ punarevaṃ vyaciṃtayat | aho vata mahāścaryyaṃ yanmayāpi na dṛśyate || 6.67{67} || kutrāsau jāyate nūnaṃ na manye tatpravṛttitām | ko nu jñāsyati tadvṛttiṃ buddhādanyo na kaścana || 6.68{68} || buddha eva jagaddarśī ṣaḍabhijñastrikālavit | tasmādahamito gatvā saṃbuddhe samupācaran || 6.69{69} || vijñapyaivaṃ ca tadvṛttiṃ praṣṭumarhāmi sāṃprātam | ityevaṃ manasā dhyātvā devendro'sau savismayaḥ || 6.70{70} || sahasā jetakāraṇye jināśramamavātarat | tatrāsau sugataṃ dṛṣṭvā saharṣavismayānvitaḥ || 6.71{71} || praṇamya purataḥ sthitvā kṛtāṃjalipuṭo'vadat | bhagavaṃstadvijānīyā yadihāhamupāgataḥ || 6.72{72} || tathāpi praṣṭumichāmi tatsamādeṣṭumarhasi | ekaḥ kālagato devaputraḥ svargāccyuto gataḥ || 6.73{73} || ṣaṭsu lokeṣu sarvatra dṛśyate na mayā hyasau | kutrāsau jāyate śāstarmayā na dṛśyate kvacit || 6.74{74} || tasyotpattiḥ kuha sthāne tatsamādeṣṭumarhasi | itīndravacanaiḥ śrutvā sa saṃbuddho munīśvaraḥ || 6.75{75} || tasya puṇyātmanaḥ sthānamiṃdrāya samacakṣatac | kauśika tuṣito nāma lokadhātuḥ prasiddhitaḥ || 6.76{76} || tatrāsau modate devo gatvā triśaraṇaṃ cyutaḥ | ityādiṣṭaṃ munīndreṇa śrutvā sa tridaśādhipaḥ || 6.77{77} || vismitaḥ suprasannātmā praṇatvaivaṃmudānayat | aho buddhamaho dharmamaho saṃghaṃ śubhaṃkaram || 6.78{78} || yatsaṃśaraṇamātre'pi satvā yānti śubhālayam | ye buddhaṃ śaraṇaṃ yānti na te gachaṃti durgatim || 6.79{79} || prahāya pātakān sarvān divyalokamupāsate | ye dharmaṃ śaraṇaṃ yānti na te gachaṃti durgatim | prahāya mānuṣān kāyān divyān kāyānupāsate || 6.80{80} || ye saṃghaṃ śaraṇaṃ yānti na te gachanti durgatim | prahāya sarvaduḥkhāni divyasaukhyānyupāsate || 6.81{81} || dhanyāste puruṣā bhadrāḥ saṃbodhipadagāminaḥ | ye saṃsmṛtvā triratnāni vrajanti maraṇaṃ dhruvam || 6.82{82} || athāsau bhagavāñchrutvā śakreṇaivaṃ subhāṣitam | tathānuvarṇayan prāha kauśikaṃ taṃ surādhipam || 6.83{83} || evametaddhi devendra yathaivaṃ tvaṃ prabhāṣase | dhanyāste puruṣā bhadrā triratnaṃ bhajaṃti ye || 6.84{84} || ye buddhaṃ śaraṇaṃ yānti na te gachanti durgatim | kleśavairīṃ vinirjitya saṃbodhiṃ samavāpnuyuḥ || 6.85{85} || ye dharmaṃ śaraṇaṃ yānti na te gachanti durgatim | māradharmavinirmuktā bodhidharmānavāpnuyuḥ | ye saṃghaṃ śaraṇaṃ yāṃti na te gachaṃti durgatim | pātakebhyo vinirmuktāḥ saṃprayānti sukhāvatīm || 6.86{86} || na bhajanti munīndraṃ ye te bhramaṃti bhavārṇave | saṃbodhimārgato bhraṣṭā naṣṭā gachanti durgatim || 6.87{87} || ye śṛṇvaṃti na saddharmaṃ te kleśaparidāhitāḥ | māradharmaratā duṣṭāḥ praṇaṣṭā yāṃti durgatim | na mānayaṃti ye saṃghaṃ na te jānaṃti sadgatim | sadā duḥkhābhisaṃtaptā bhraṣṭā gachaṃti durgatim | nindanti ye triratnāni te duṣṭā mārapākṣikāḥ | naiva caraṃti sanmārge vinaṣṭā yaṃti durgatim | tasmādye mānavāḥ santo vāṃchanti sadgatiṃ sadā | taiḥ saṃsmṛtvā triratnānāṃ karttavyaṃ śaraṇaṃ mudā || 6.88{88} || ye smaranti triratnānāṃ na te gachaṃti durgatim | prahāya pātakān sarvāñśīghraṃ yānti sukhāvatīm || 6.89{89} || sukhāvatyāṃ jinendrasya dharmaṃ śrutvānumoditāḥ | bodhicittaṃ samāsādya caranti bodhicārikām || 6.90{90} || tatastāḥ kramataḥ pūryya saṃvṛttipāramāgatāḥ | paramārthacarīṃ prāpya nirvṛttiṃ samavāpnuyuḥ || 6.91{91} || idaṃ hi bodhimārgānāṃ vījaṃ vijñāya kauśika | triratnasmaraṇaṃ nityaṃ karttavyaṃ bodhivāṃchibhiḥ || 6.92{92} || kadāpi naiva moktavyaṃ triratnasmaraṇaṃ sadā | gatvā ca śaraṇaṃ teṣāṃ triratnānāṃ samācara || 6.93{93} || evaṃ tena munīndreṇa samādiṣṭaṃ sa kauśikaḥ | śrutvaivamityanujñāya prābhyanandatprasāditaḥ || 6.94{94} || tato'sau bhagavantaṃ taṃ natvā sa racitāṃjaliḥ | tridhā pradakṣiṇīkṛtya punarnatvā divaṃ yayau || 6.95{95} || tato devapure gatvā sudharmamaṃdire sthitaḥ | devalokān samāmaṃtrya tatpravṛttaṃ samabravīt || 6.96{96} || bho bho devagaṇāḥ sarve śṛṇudhvaṃ tatsamāhitaḥ | yadadbhutaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ saṃbodhihetumucyate || 6.97{97} || dharmatā khalu devānāṃ ye ye devā hi nākataḥ | cyutāste te prayāntyadho na tūrddhvaṃ yānti ke cana || 6.98{98} || idānīṃ tu vrajeyuste ye devāḥ svargataścyutāḥ | triratnaśaraṇaṃ kṛtvorddhvagatiṃ na tvadhogatim || 6.99{99} || dṛśyatāmamuko devaputrastriśaraṇaṃ gataḥ | svargāccyutvā samutpannastuṣite'sau pramodate || 6.100{100} || yūyamapi ca taddṛṣṭvā triratnānāṃ samāhitāḥ | gatvā ca śaraṇaṃ nityaṃ smṛtvā bhajadhvamādarāt || 6.101{1} || tato yūyaṃ na yāyāta durgatiṣu kadā cana | sadā divyasukhaṃ bhuktvā prayāsyatha sukhāvatīm || 6.102{2} || ye buddhe śaraṇaṃ yāṃti na te gachanti durgatim | kleśavairān vinirjitya saṃbodhipadamāpnuyuḥ || 6.103{3} || ye dharme śaraṇaṃ yānti na te gachanti durgatim | māradharmavinirmuktā buddhadharmāṇyavāpnuiyuḥ || 6.104{4} || ye saṃghe śaraṇaṃ gatvā na te gachanti durgatim | sarvapātakanirmuktā prayāsyaṃti sukhāvatīm || 6.105{5} || na bhajanti triratnaṃ ye te bhramanti bhavārṇave | saddharmanindakā bhraṣṭā naṣṭā gachanti durgatim || 6.106{6} || durgatiṣu bhramaṃtaste duḥkhāni vividhāni ca | bhuktvā caranti duṣṭāṃśā naiva gachaṃti sadgatim || 6.107{7} || tadduḥkhaṃ hātumichaṃti sukhaṃ prāptuṃ ca ye sadā | te triratnaṃ sadā smṛtvā bhajaṃtāṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ || 6.108{8} || tato vo maṃgalaṃ nityaṃ naiva yāyāta durgatim | sadgatimeva yāyāta saṃbodhimapi lapsyatha || 6.109{9} || iti tena surendreṇa samādiṣṭaṃ hitārthinā | śru tadā sarve'pi devāśca triratnaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ | sarvadānusmarantaśca satkṛtyaivaṃ prabhejire || 6.111{11} || evaṃ devāstadā ye ye triratnaśaraṇaṃ gatāḥ | te te svargādapi cyutvā naivāgachannadhogatim || 6.112{12} || tata ūrddhvaṃ samudgamya prāgachaṃstuṣitālaye | triratnaśaraṇaṃ yātā maitreyaṃ samupāśrayan || 6.113{13} || tathā śakraśca tān sarvānmaitreyasamupāśritān | dṛṣṭvānumodanāṃ kurvan prābhyanandatsuraiḥ saha || 6.114{14} || iti me guruṇā khyātaṃ tathā te vakṣyate mayā | evaṃ matvā mahārāja triratnaśaraṇaṃ vraja || 6.115{15} || tataste maṃgalaṃ nityaṃ sarvatrāpi bhaveddhruvam | kramādbodhicarīḥ prāpya saṃbodhipadamāpnuyāḥ || 6.116{16} || prajāścāpi mahārāja bodhayitvā prayatnataḥ | triratnaśaraṇe sthāpya tvayā dharmapravṛddhaye || 6.117{17} || ityevamupaguptena samādiṣṭaṃ subhāṣitam | śrutvā rājā tathetyevaṃ prānvamodatsapārṣadaḥ || 6.118{18} || ye puṇyaprāptukāmāstadidamavirataṃ sūkarīkāvadānam | śṛṇvanti śravayanti pramuditamanasā durgatiṃ te na yānti | nirjitya kleśasaṃghāṃstriguṇahitakarā bodhicaryyānuraktā | maitreyaṃ bodhisatvaṃ tuṣitabhuvanāgāḥ saṃbhajanti prakāmam || 6.119{19} || iti ratnāvadānamālāyāṃ sūkaryyavadānaṃ samāptaṃ vapuṣmatkumārāvadāna athaśoko mahīpālaḥ kṛtāṃjalipuṭo mudā | upaguptaṃ guruṃ natvā punarevamabhāṣata || 7.1{1} || bhadanta śrotumichāmi punaranyatsubhāṣitam | sarvasatvahitārthāya tatsamādeṣṭumarhasi || 7.2{2} || iti saṃprārthite tena rājñāśokena bhūbhujā | upagupto yatiścāsau dṛṣṭvā taṃ nṛpamabravīt || 7.3{3} || sādhu rājan samādhāya śrūyatāṃ puṇyavṛddhaye | yathā me guruṇā khyātaṃ tathā te vakṣyate mayā || 7.4{4} || purāsīdbhagavān buddhaḥ śrīghanaḥ śakyakeśarī | sarvavidyāguṇācāryyastraidhātukavināyakaḥ || 7.5{5} || sugato'rhanmahābhijño dharmarājastathāgataḥ | jinaḥ samantabhadrāṃśaścaturbrahmavihārakaḥ || 7.6{6} || sa ekasamaye tatra kapilākhye purottame | nyagrodhāramake ramye vyaharacchrāvakaiḥ saha || 7.7{7} || tasmiṃśca samaye tatra dharmmaṃ śrotuṃ samāgatāḥ | devāsuramahārājā yakṣagaṃdharvakinnarāḥ || 7.8{8} || garuḍā nāgarājāśca siddhavidyādharā grahāḥ | yogino yatayaścāpi munayo brahmacāriṇaḥ || 7.9{9} || rājānaḥ kṣatriyāścāpi vaiśyāmātyāśca maṃtriṇaḥ | śreṣṭhinaḥ sārthavāhāśca paurā jānapadā api || 7.10{10} || evamanye'pi satvāśca ye saddharmaguṇavāṃchinaḥ | te sarve samupāgatya vaṃditvā taṃ munīśvaram || 7.11{11} || pūjayitvā puraskṛtya parivṛtya samantataḥ | kṛtāṃjalipuṭo dharmaṃ śrotuṃ samupatasthire || 7.12{12} || athāsau bhagavān dṛṣṭvā tān sarvān dharmakāṃkṣiṇaḥ | ādimadhyāṃtakalyāṇaṃ dideśa dharmamuttamam || 7.13{13} || taṃ ca dharmāmṛtaṃ pītvā sarve te saṃpramoditāḥ | satkṛtya śraddhayā nityaṃ bhajanta upatasthire || 7.14{14} || bhagavāṃśca tathā nityaṃ sarvasatvahitārthataḥ | saddharmadeśanāṃ kṛtvā vyaharatsāṃghikaiḥ saha || 7.15{15} || tasmiṃśca samaye tatra pure kapilavastuni | āsīcchākyo mahāsādhurmahābhogo mahādhanaḥ || 7.16{16} || tena kalatramānītaṃ svakulasadṛśātkulāt | tayā sa kāntayā sārddhaṃ rarāma paricārayan || 7.17{17} || tasyaivaṃ ramamāṇasya sā bhāryāsītsugarbhiṇī | tato'sau samaye'sūta dārakaṃ divyasuṃdaram || 7.18{18} || martyātikrāntavarṇābhaṃ divyakalpasuvarṇitam | sūkṣmachaviṃ subhadrāṃgaṃ gauravarṇaṃ manoharam || 7.19{19} || maheśākhyaṃ manāpaṃ ca darśanīyaṃ prasādikam | abhirūpaṃ supuṣṭāṃgaṃ sarvalakṣaṇamaṇḍitam || 7.20{20} || tatrāsau janako dṛṣṭvā dārakaṃ taṃ subhadrikam | moditaḥ sahasā jñātiṃ samāhūyābravīttathā || 7.21{21} || bhavantaḥ paśyatāṃ putro mamāyaṃ divyasuṃdaraḥ | asya jātimahaṃ kṛtvā nāmadheyaṃ pracakṣyatām || 7.22{22} || iti tenoditaṃ śrutvā jñātayaste sasaṃmatāḥ | dṛṣṭvā taṃ vālakaṃ divyaṃ kalyavarṇaṃ susuṃdaram || 7.23{23} || saṃmīlya saṃmataṃ kṛtvā dṛṣṭvā tasyāṅgalakṣaṇam | kṛtvā jātimahaṃ nāma sthāpituṃ saṃvabhāṣire | yadayaṃ dārako divyavapuḥ kalyātisuṃdaraḥ | tasmādbhavatu nāmnāyaṃ vapusmāniti viśrutaḥ | iti saṃbhāṣaṇāṃ kṛtvā sarve te jñātivargikāḥ || 7.24{24} || purastāttasya śākyasya gatvā caivaṃ vabhāṣire | yadayaṃ bhavataḥ putro divyavapurguṇānvitaḥ || 7.25{25} || tasmādbhavatu nāmnāyaṃ vapuṣmāniti viśrutaḥ | tatheti samabhikhyāya pitrā sa suta ātmajaḥ || 7.26{26} || aṣṭābhya upamātṛbhya upanyasto'bhipālane | tato'sau dārakastābhirdhātrībhirupacāraṇaiḥ || 7.27{27} || pālito varddhitaḥ puṣṭa āsītpadmaṃ yathā hrade | kramātpravarddhitaścāsau kumāro'bhūdyadā tataḥ || 7.28{28} || tadā suhṛtsahāyaiśca sārddhaṃ krīḍitumācarat | yatra yatra vapuṣmān sa cakrāma bhuvi saṃcaram || 7.29{29} || tatra tatrābhavanmedhyā bhūpradeśāḥ samaṃtataḥ | evaṃvidhamahāpuṇyamaheśākhyaḥ śivāśayaḥ || 7.30{30} || kāruṇiko mahāśrāddhaḥ svaparātmahitārthabhṛt | dharmakāmaḥ subhadrātmā pūjyo mānyo jitendriyaḥ || 7.31{31} || abhivādyaḥ kumāro'pi vapuṣmān sa vyarājata | tataḥ karmavipākena preryyamānaḥ kumārakaḥ || 7.32{32} || sa vapuṣmān suhṛtsaṃghaiḥ sārddhaṃ puro viniryayau | tato'sau jetakāraṇyaṃ dūrāddṛṣṭvā pramoditaḥ || 7.33{33} || ramituṃ tatra mahodyāne sahasā samupācarat | tataḥ samupaviṣṭo'sau dṛṣṭvodyānaṃ pramoditaḥ || 7.34{34} || śāntarūpān yatīn paśyan vihāre harṣito'viśat | tatrāsau bhagavantaṃ taṃ dadarśa samitisthitam || 7.35{35} || dvātriṃśallakṣaṇāśītivyañjanaparimaṇḍitam | vyāmābhālaṃkṛtaṃ kāmyaṃ śatasūryyādhikaprabham || 7.36{36} || samaṃtabhadrarūpaṃ ca ratnāṃgamiva jaṃgamam | dṛṣṭvāsau suprasannātmā samupetya purogataḥ || 7.37{37} || pādau tasya munernatvā dharmaṃ śrotumupāviśat | athāsau bhagavān dṛṣṭvā tasya cittaṃ viśodhitam || 7.38{38} || aryyasatyāni mārgaṃ ca dideśa bodhisādhanam | tacchrutvā sugatoditaṃ vapuṣmān sa praharṣitaḥ || 7.39{39} || bhavābhisaraṇodvignaḥ saddharmaguṇamaichata | bhitvā sa jñānavajreṇa satkāyadṛṣṭiparvatam || 7.40{40} || śrotāpattiphalaṃ labdhvā dṛṣṭasatyo'bhavatsudhīḥ | saṃsāraṃ cāsthiraṃ matvā bhavabhogyasunispṛhaḥ || 7.41{41} || pravrajyāṃ caritumaichatsvākhyāte sugatāśrame | tato'sau purato gatvā munīndrasya kṛtāṃjaliḥ || 7.42{42} || pādau natvā prasannāsyaḥ pravrajyāṃ samayācata || 7.43{43} || namaste bhagavañchāstaḥ śaraṇaṃ bhavatāṃ vraje | tatpravrajyāvrataṃ dehi cariṣye brahmacārikām || 7.44{44} || iti tenārthitaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhagavāṃstaṃ kumārakam | pravrajyācaraṇāraktaṃ matvā caivaṃ samabravīt || 7.45{45} || kumāra yadi te vāṃchā pravrajyācaraṇe'sti hi | pitrorādeśamāsādya prāgacha dāsyate tadā || 7.46{46} || iti śrutvā munīndrasya nirdeśaṃ tattatheti saḥ | naṃditaścaraṇau natvā svagṛhaṃ sahasāgataḥ || 7.47{47} || tato gṛhe samāsādya pitrośca purataḥ sthitaḥ | kṛtāṃjalipuṭo natvā vṛttāṃtaṃ samabhāṣata || 7.48{48} || adyāmba tāta saṃbuddho dṛśyate'pūrvadarśanaḥ | sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpūrṇo divyātikāntasuṃdaraḥ || 7.49{49} || saṃsthitaḥ parṣadāṃ madhye bhāṣati dharmamuttamam | apūrvaṃ śrūyate tasya subhāṣitavaco'mṛtam || 7.50{50} || tatsubhāṣitasudhāṃ pītvā cittaṃ me tṛpyate na hi | bhūyastadamṛtaṃ pātuṃ vratamichāmi sāṃpratam || 7.51{51} || anye'pi bahavo dṛṣṭvā bhikṣavo brahmacāriṇaḥ || 7.52{52} || śāntaśīlāḥ śubhātmāno dayākāruṇyamānasāḥ | tatsabhāgavrataṃ cartumichāmi khalu sāṃpratam || 7.53{53} || tadanujñāṃ pradattaṃ me kṛpāsti yadi vāṃ mayi | evaṃ tasya svaputrasya vacanaṃ vajrasannibham || 7.54{54} || tau mātāpitarau śrutvā mūrchitau petaturbhuvi | tataḥ putraprayatnena cetanāṃ prāpya tau punaḥ || 7.55{55} || pariṣvajya svakaṃ putraṃ tamevaṃ paryyadevatām | hā putra kathamajño'si hātmaja vallabho'si naḥ || 7.56{56} || hā suta vaṃcyase kena hā tāta kiṃ nu vāṃchasi | hā jīva kathamekānte tyaktvāsmān kva nu yāsyase || 7.57{57} || nandanaḥ supriyāścāsi kena duḥkhena yāsyase | kiṃcidduḥkhaṃ na te dattamasmābhirvā kadā cana || 7.58{58} || kutaḥ kiṃ jāyate duḥkhaṃ tadvadasva yadīhasi | ityevaṃ paridevitvā pitāsau cetasātmajam || 7.59{59} || nivārayan pravaṃdhena bodhayituṃ samabravīt | tvaṃ kumāra vayastho'si sukomalaḥ sukhaidhitaḥ || 7.60{60} || śītatāpāsahiṣṇuśca yathechābhogyasaṃrataḥ | kiṃcidduḥkhānabhijñastvaṃ tatkathaṃ pravrajeḥ suta || 7.61{61} || pravrajito gṛhaṃ tyaktvā bahirdeśe vasessadā | cīvaraprāvṛtaḥ piṇḍaṃ yācitvā svayamāhareḥ || 7.62{62} || anekajantusaṃcāre vane'raṇye kathaṃ vaseḥ | jaṃgale durgame naikacaurākīrṇe kathaṃ careḥ || 7.63{63} || ekākī ca kathaṃ tiṣṭhervṛkṣamūle ca nirjane | śmaśāne saṃsthitaḥ paśyanmṛtakānto traseḥ katham || 7.64{64} || śayithāśca kathaṃ śūnye gṛhe bhūtanivāsite | evaṃ suduṣkarīṃ caryyāṃ carituṃ kathamichasi || 7.65{65} || tatpravrajyāvrate cittaṃ mā kṛthāstvaṃ nivarttaya | iti madvacanaṃ śrutvā gṛhe sthitvā sukhaṃ rama || 7.66{66} || nityaṃ pravrajatāṃ duḥkhaṃ kiṃ siddhaṃ duḥkhacaryyayā | dharme vaṃchāsti cetputra gṛhe sthitvā cara vratam || 7.67{67} || śṛṇvaṃśca dharmaśāstrāṇi śrāvayaṃśca bahūñjanān | dānaṃ kṛtvā viśuddhātmā triratnaṃ satataṃ bhaja || 7.68{68} || yasya kiṃcidgṛhe nāsti jñātirvaṃdhuśca kaścana | nāpi mitragatiścāpi pravrajyā tasya yujyate | kiṃ tava setsyate putra pravrajyāṃ pākuniṣṭhayā | sarvathā tyaja tadvāṃchā gṛhe dharmaṃ sukhaṃ cara | iti pitroditaṃ śrutvā vapuṣmān sa viśaṃkitaḥ || 7.69{69} || pitroḥ pādān punarnatvā pratyuvāca prabodhayan | satyaṃ tāta gṛhe saukhyaṃ dharmāṇāṃ caramuttamam || 7.70{70} || saṃpado'pi samṛddhāste kāmabhogyaṃ mahatsukham | gṛhe parigrahāḥ poṣyāstadarthaṃ dhanamarjayet || 7.71{71} || arjane hi mahatkaṣṭaṃ rakṣaṇe'pi prayatnatā | aneke saṃpado'pāyā rājāgnyudakataskarāḥ || 7.72{72} || kṣaṇāddhareyurākṛṣya tadduḥkhaṃ sahituṃ katham | saṃpado'nte vipattiḥ syātkasya saṃpadviniścalā || 7.73{73} || vipattau hīyate dhairyyamadhairyyātkleśito bhavet | kleśito doṣamāpnoti tadā puṇye matiḥ kutaḥ || 7.74{74} || apuṇye kupitā lakṣmirnaivāśraye gamiṣyati | lakṣmīvirahite gehe kuto dharmasya gocaram || 7.75{75} || saṃpattau tu labhenmānaṃ mānāddhi jāyate madaḥ | madādpramādito dharme tadā dharmo gṛhe kutaḥ || 7.76{76} || adharmātkāmabhogyaṃ tu kevalaṃ pāpasādhanam | kāmārthe kleśitā lokāḥ kāmārthe duḥkhabhāginaḥ || 7.77{77} || kāmārthe pratihanyante tena kāme sukhaṃ katham | saṃtyevaṃ tāta sarvatra bhayāni vividhāni hi || 7.78{78} || traidhātukabhavasthānāṃ kasya nāsti bhayaṃ kuha | daivātsarvatra jāyante duḥkhāni ca sukhāni ca || 7.79{79} || kleśacittasamutthāni duḥkhāni ca bhayāni ca | yatra yatrāpi saṃyāti kleśitātmā sukhechayā || 7.80{80} || tatra tatrāpi karmotthairduḥkhairbhayaiśca hanyate | yatra yatrāpi saṃyāti dharmacitto hitechayā | tatra tatrāpi sarvatra nirbhayaścarate sukham | yallokānāṃ bhayasthānaṃ tatraiva ramate yatiḥ | vivikte nirjane'raṇye vṛkṣamūle guhāsu ca || 7.81{81} || śūnyagehe śmaśāne'pi sukhaṃ dhyātvā yatirvaset | svadharmai rakṣito yogī saṃyatātmā kuto bhayaḥ || 7.82{82} || kimeva vahuvādena nirvāṇārthimano mama | tannirvātuṃ svadehe'pi nirapekṣaḥ parivraje || 7.83{83} || tadanujñāṃ pradattaṃ me pravrajyāvratasādhane | yadi na dīyate'nujñā mariṣye'haṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 7.84{84} || iti tasyātmajasyaivaṃ nirvandhavacanaṃ pitā | śrutvā viyogaduḥkhārttaḥ punastaṃ sutamabravīt || 7.85{85} || mā putra sahasā kārṣī maraṇābhilāṣitaṃ manaḥ | sarvathāpyanivarttī tvamavaśyaṃ cedgamiṣyasi || 7.86{86} || yadichasi vrataṃ kartuṃ saddharmārthimanastava | pravraja śraddhayā putra svākhyāte buddhaśāsane || 7.87{87} || evaṃ bharttroditaṃ śrutvā tanmātā mūrchitāpatat | cirātsā cetanāṃ prāptā rudantī cāvadatsutam || 7.88{88} || hā putra kathamekānte māṃ vihāya kva yāsyasi | hā me jīvo'si kiṃ paśyaṃ pravrajituṃ samīhasi || 7.89{89} || kiṃcidduḥkhaṃ na te dattaṃ mayāmvāyā kadā cana | kena duḥkhena te cittaṃ pravrajituṃ samichati || 7.90{90} || pravrajyā śobhate putra vṛddhatve vā daridrite | tvaṃ tu dahara ityaśca tatpravrajyāṃ careḥ katham || 7.91{91} || yāvacca jivitaṃ me'sti tāvanmā gāḥ suta kvacit | yāvaccāsti gṛhe saṃpattāvadbhuktvā sukhaṃ vasa || 7.92{92} || yadāhaṃ maraṇaṃ yātā yadā cāpattitā gṛhe | jñātimitraparityaktastadā vrajasva vāṃchayā || 7.93{93} || ityukte'pi tayoḥ pitrorudatorvighnaśaṃkitaḥ | pādāṃ natvā vapuṣmān sa sahasā niryayau gṛhāt || 7.94{94} || tato veṇuvanaṃ gatvā praṇamya munimādarāt | kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā pravrajyāṃ samayācata || 7.95{95} || pitṛprāptābhyanujño'haṃ nātha sāṃpratamāgataḥ | tatpravrajyāṃ vrataṃ dehi paṃcaśikṣāpadāni ca || 7.96{96} || upasampacchubhācāramanuśikṣāpadaṃ ca me | brahmacaryyaṃ cariṣyāmi saṃbodhau kṛtaniścayaḥ || 7.97{97} || adyāgreṇa mahābuddha bhavatāṃ śaraṇaṃ vraje | sadharmasāṃghikānāṃ cṃ kāyavākcittabhaktitaḥ || 7.98{98} || ityukte bhagavān dṛṣṭvā pṛṣṭvā hastena tacchiraḥ | ehi bhikṣo kumāreti saṃvadaṃstaṃ samagrahīt || 7.99{99} || ehīti prokte sugatena muṇḍaḥ pātrī vapuṣmān sakaṣāyavāsāḥ | sadyapraśāntendriya eva tasthau svarṇṇaprabho buddhamanorathena || 7.100{100} || saccittalabdhaḥ sa muneḥ prasādātprayujyamāno vyaharatsamādhau | vyāyachamānaḥ khalu bodhimārge saṃbuddhadharme ghaṭamāna evam || 7.101{1} || sarvaṃ ca saṃsāramanityatāhataṃ matvā ca traidhātugatiṃ vighātinīm | kleśāṃśca sarvān pravihāya saṃyataḥ sākṣādvaro'rhaṃ sa babhūva sāṃghikaḥ || 7.102{2} || suvītarāgaḥ samaloṣṭahema ākāśacittaśubhagaṃdhivāsī | bhindannavidyāṃgamivāṇḍakośaṃ prāptādabhijñāḥ pratisaṃvidaśca || 7.103{3} || satkāralobheṣu parāṃmukhatvātsa śakradevāsuramānuṣāṇām | pūjyaśca mānyo'pyabhivandanīyo babhūva sa brahmavihāracārī || 7.104{4} || atha te bhikṣavaḥ sarve taṃ dṛṣṭvā vismayānvitāḥ | bhagavantaṃ praṇamyaivaṃ paprachustasya karmatām || 7.105{5} || kenāyaṃ karmaṇā nātha vapuṣmānatisuṃdaraḥ | pravrajya sahasārhatvaṃ prāpto bhavati cātmavit || 7.106{6} || iti pṛṣṭe ca tairnātho bhagavāṃstān samabravīt | bhikṣavaḥ śrūyatāṃ vakṣye tasya ca karma yatkṛtam || 7.107{7} || etena yatkṛtaṃ karma tatkenānyena bhokṣyate | yenaiva yatkṛtaṃ karma tenaiva taddhi bhujyate || 7.108{8} || puraikanavate kalpe vipaśvī nāma sarvavit | samudapādi loke'rhan dharmarājastathāgataḥ || 7.109{9} || vidyācaraṇasaṃpannaḥ sugato bhadrakṛjjinaḥ | sarvajño'nuttaro nāthaḥ puruṣadamyasārathiḥ || 7.110{10} || śāstā traidhātukasthānāṃ vināyako guṇākaraḥ | saddharmaratnadāta sa bhagavān puṇyabhāskaraḥ || 7.111{11} || purīṃ vaṃdhumato rājño rājadhānīmupāśrayan | sārddhaṃ bhikṣugaṇaiḥ śiṣyai bodhisatvagaṇairapi || 7.112{12} || hitāya sarvasatvānāṃ dideśa dharmamuttamam | ādimadhyāṃtakalyāṇaṃ bodhicaryyānusārikam || 7.113{13} || tataḥ sa buddhakāryyāṇi kṛtvā sarvāṇyaśeṣataḥ | nirvāṇamāyayau śānto vahnirivendhanakṣayāt || 7.114{14} || tato vandhumatā rājñā tattanuḥ saṃskṛto'gninā | taddhātūśca samāropya stūpa uccairmahān kṛtaḥ || 7.115{15} || tatra ratnamaye stūpe sadvidhāne pratiṣṭhite | nityasatkārapūjābhiḥ kāritaṃ ca mahotsavam || 7.116{16} || saṃgītivādyanṛtyaiśca mahānaṃdapracāribhiḥ | kārayitvā mahotsāhaṃ sthāpitaṃ sumahanmahaḥ || 7.117{17} || ekasmin divase tatra pumāneko daridritaḥ | tanmahāṃte dine'nyasmiṃ stāpāṃgaṇamupāviśat || 7.118{18} || tatra stūpāṅgaṇe cāsau praviṣṭaḥ samalokayat | mlānībhūtāni puṣpāṇi prakīrṇṇāni samaṃtataḥ || 7.119{19} || tāni nirmālyapuṣpāṇi vikīrṇṇāni samaṃtataḥ | glānībhūtānyaśuddhāni dṛṣṭvā caivaṃ vyacintayat | ayaṃ caityo munīndrasya vipaścino guṇāṃbudheḥ || 7.120{20} || dhāturatnamayastūpaḥ sarvalokābhiḥ pūjitaḥ | etannirmālyapuṣpaistu mlānitaiḥ pavaneritaiḥ || 7.121{21} || ākīrṇo malinībhūto hyaśuddheḥ syādaśobhitaḥ | tasmādetāni puṣpāṇi nirmālyāni samaṃtataḥ || 7.122{22} || apanīya viśuddhāya mārjayeyamiha drutam || 7.123{23} || iti dhyātvā daridro'sau nirmālyānyapanīya vai || 7.124{25} || saṃmārja nyāsamamārkṣī stūpāṃgaṇaṃ samaṃtataḥ | tataḥ stūpāṃgaṇaṃ sarvaṃ virajaṃ pariśodhitam | dṛṣṭvā prasannacitto'sau natvaivaṃ praṇidhiṃ dadhe | yanmayātra jinastūpe nirmālyānyapanīya vai | saṃmṛjya śobhanaṃ kṛtvā kuśalaṃ samupārjitam | anena kuśalenāhaṃ sadā durgatimocitaḥ || 7.125{26} || evaṃvidhaguṇajñānalābhi bhūyāsamātmavit | evaṃvidhaṃ ca śāstāraṃ saṃbuddhaṃ jñānabhāskaram || 7.126{27} || ārāgayaṃ samāśritya labheyaṃ saugatiṃ gatim | praṇidhānaṃ tathā dhṛtvā nityamevamupāśrayan || 7.127{28} || tatstūpe śaraṇaṃ gatvā bhaje ratnatrayaṃ sadā | bhikṣavaḥ kiṃ nu manyadhve yo puruṣaḥ daridrikaḥ || 7.128{29} || ayameva vapuṣmān sa jñeyo hi nānyathā khalu | yatstūpāṃgaṇaṃ tena saṃbuddhaguṇabhāvinā || 7.129{30} || samantataḥ susaṃmṛjya pariśuddhīkṛtaṃ tadā | tena puṇyavipākena jāta āḍhyakule'dhunā || 7.130{31} || divyābhisundaraḥ kāntaḥ sa vapuṣmān bhavatyayam | yatpraṇidhiḥ kṛtaḥ stūpe natvā tena sucetasā || 7.131{32} || tena me śāsane'pyadya pravrajyārhan bhavatyayam | ārāgitastathārhañca saṃbuddhaḥ sugato jinaḥ || 7.132{33} || anena bhikṣuṇā bodhiprāptena brahmacāriṇā | ityevaṃ karma jānīta sukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ bhave || 7.133{34} || yenaiva yatkṛtaṃ karma tenaiva tatphalaṃ gatam | na naśyanti hi karmāṇi kalpakoṭiśatairapi || 7.134{35} || sāmagrīṃ prāpya kālaṃ ca phalaṃti khalu dehinām | abhuktaṃ kṣīyate naiva karma kvāpi kathaṃ cana || 7.135{36} || nāgnibhirdahyate karma vāyubhiśca na śuṣyate | jalaiśca klidyate nāpi kṣīyate nāpi bhūmiṣu || 7.136{37} || anyathāpi bhavennaiva karmaṇāṃ gatirābhavam | śuklānāṃ śubhataiva syātkṛṣṇānāṃ durgatissadā || 7.137{38} || miśritā miśritānaṃ tu bhujyaṃte sarvajantubhiḥ | tasmādapāsya kṛṣṇāni karmāṇi miśritāni ca || 7.138{39} || caraṇīyāṃ śubheṣveva karmasu sukhavāṃchibhiḥ | tatheti bhikṣavaḥ sarve te ca lokāḥ sabhāśritāḥ || 7.139{40} || buddhavāco'mṛtaṃ pītvā nananduḥ śubhakāminaḥ | evametanmahārāja śrutaṃ me gurubhāṣitam || 7.140{41} || evaṃ śrutvā tvayāpyevaṃ karttavyaṃ puṇyameva hi | puṇyameva bhavettrātā suhṛnmitraṃ hitaṃkaraḥ || 7.141{42} || nānyaḥ kaścidihāmutra vidyate bhavacāriṇām | tasmātpuṇyaṃ svayaṃ śrutvā karttavyamādarātsadā || 7.142{43} || prajāśca śrāvayitvaivaṃ puṇye saṃsthāpaya sadā | ityevaṃ guruṇādiṣṭamupaguptena bhikṣuṇā || 7.143{44} || śrutvā rājā janaiḥ sārddhaṃ tatheti prābhyanaṃdata | śṛṇvanti ye śrāvayantīha yaśca vapuṣmato'daḥ prathitāvadānam | te kleśanirmuktaviśuddhacittāḥ prayānti nūnaṃ sugatālayeṣu || 7.144{45} || iti ratnāvadānamālāyāṃ vapuṣmatāvadānaṃ nāma samāptam praśnottarāvadāna athāśoko mahīpālaḥ saṃbuddhaguṇalālasaḥ | upaguptaṃ guruṃ natvā prāṃjaliścaivamabravīt || 8.1{1} || bhadanta śrotumichāmi punaranyatsubhāṣitam | yathā te guruṇādiṣṭaṃ tathā me khyātumarhasi || 8.2{12} || iti tena narendreṇa pṛṣṭe'sau ca jināṃśajaḥ | upagupto yatirbhūyastaṃ nṛpeśamabhāṣata || 8.3{31} || śṛṇu rājaṃstathā vakṣye yathā me guruṇoditam | śrutvā ca bhavatāpyevaṃ karttavyaṃ dharmasādhanam || 8.4{41} || puraikasamaye cāsau śākyasiṃhosdayākaraḥ | sarvajñaḥ sugato nāthaḥ śāstā traidhātukādhipaḥ || 8.5{5} || sarvavidyādhipo buddhaḥ ṣaḍabhijño munīśvaraḥ | mārajiṣṇurvinetārhaṃ dharmarājastathāgataḥ || 8.6{6} || sarvasatvahitārthāya śrāvastyāṃ vahirāśrame | jetavane vihārasthe vyaharacchrāvakaiḥ saha || 8.7{7} || bodhisatvagaṇaiścāpi sūpāsakaiśca cailakaiḥ | devāsuragaṇaiścāpi caturvarṇṇādimānavaiḥ || 8.8{8} || caturbhiśca mahārājaiḥ sasainyaparivārakaiḥ | sarvasatvaiśca pauraiśca saddharmaguṇavāṃchibhiḥ || 8.9{9} || satkṛtya pūjayitvā ca parivṛtya puraskṛtaḥ | sa bhagavān sabhāmadhye siṃhāsane sthito vabhau || 8.10{10} || tadā sa bhagavān dṛṣṭvā tāṃ sabhāṃ samupasthitām | ādimadhyāntakalyāṇaṃ dideśa dharmamuttamam || 8.11{11} || te taddharmāmṛtaṃ pītvā sarve lokāḥ pramoditāḥ | bhagavantaṃ punarnatvā svasvasthānaṃ pratīyire || 8.12{12} || tato'sau bhagavān rātrau dhyānāgāre samāviśan | paryyaṅkaṃ samupāśritya tasthau dhyānasamāhitaḥ || 8.13{13} || tadaikā devatā tasyāṃ rātrau svargātsamāgatā | svakāntyā bhāsayaṃtyevaṃ jetavanamupāviśat || 8.14{14} || tatastāṃ bhagavān dṛṣṭvā devatāṃ samupāgatām | saṃnirīkṣya samāmaṃtrya tathaināṃ samabodhayat || 8.15{15} || devate svāgataṃ kacci kuśalaṃ te samehi bho | prāyātāsi yadarthena tadvadasva prapūraye || 8.16{16} || ityādiṣṭe munīndreṇa tenāsau devatā mudā | saṃpṛchāvasaraṃ labdhvā harṣitā samupākramat || 8.17{17} || tatrāsau purato gatvā natvā pādau kṛtāṃjaliḥ | pradakṣiṇatrayaṃ kṛtvā tasthāvekāntike muneḥ || 8.18{18} || sarvajetavanaṃ tasyā devatāyāḥ prabhāvataḥ | udāreṇāvabhāsena pravisphuṭaṃ vabhau tadā || 8.19{19} || tathāvabhāṣitaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve te bhikṣusāṃghikāḥ | vismitāḥ sahasotthāya dṛṣṭvā tamupatasthire || 8.20{20} || atha sā devatotthāya kṛtāṃjalipuṭo'gragā | bhagavantaṃ munīndraṃ taṃ praṇatvaivamapṛchata || 8.21{21} || sarvajña bhagavaṃ chāstaḥ yenāhaṃ samupāgatā | tadarthaṃ tvaṃ samādiśya cittaṃ me paribodhaya || 8.22{22} || ke narāḥ sugatiṃ yānti ke narāḥ svargagāminaḥ | keṣāṃ cāpi divārātrau sadā puṇyaṃ pravarddhate || 8.23{23} || ke cāpi durgatiṃ yāṃti ke cādhaḥ patitā narāḥ | keṣāṃ cāpi divārātrau sadā pāpaṃ pravarddhate || 8.24{24} || kiṃdado valavāṃ syācca kiṃdadaśca praśobhitaḥ | kiṃdadaḥ sukhito lokaḥ cakṣuṣmānapi kiṃpradaḥ || 8.25{25} || kiṃ nu vā niśitaṃ śastraṃ kiṃ vā hālāhalaṃ viṣam | kiṃ ca prajvalito vahniḥ kiṃ mahaddāruṇaṃ tamaḥ || 8.26{26} || gṛhītaṃ kiṃ nu martyena kin teneha samujjhitam | abhedyaṃ kavacaṃ kiṃ ca kiṃ vā tīkṣṇamihāyudham || 8.27{27} || ko nvasau procyate cauro dhanaṃ kiṃ vā satāṃ matam | ke vā traidhātuke loke procyante muṣitaiti || 8.28{28} || kaśceha satsukhī loke ko vā ca parameśvaraḥ | ko vibhūṣito nityaṃ kaścāpyatra vidaṃvitaḥ || 8.29{29} || vatsalo vāṃdhavo ko nu ko vā duṣṭāśayo ripuḥ | kiṃ mahaddāruṇaṃ duḥkhaṃ kiṃ mahatparamaṃ sukham || 8.30{30} || kiṃ ca loke priyo pathyaḥ kiṃ vāpathyaṃ na cāpriyam | ko nu pīḍākaro vyādhiḥ ko nu vai ko bhiṣagvaraḥ || 8.31{31} || kenāyamāvṛto lokaḥ kena loko vaśīkṛtaḥ | kena tyajati mitrāṇi kena svargaṃ na gachati || 8.32{32} || kena mitrāṇi varddhyaṃte kena śāmyaṃti śatravaḥ | kena svargamavāpnoti kena mokṣaṃ ca gachati || 8.33{33} || kenāyaṃ badhyate lokaḥ kena loko vimucyate | kasyeha viprahāṇena nirvāṇamiti kathyate || 8.34{34} || kiṃ nu rājā ca caurāśca syaṃdamānāḥ samudyatāḥ | no śaknuvantyapāhartuṃ striyo vā puruṣasya ca || 8.35{35} || kiṃ na dahati saptārciḥ kiṃ na bhinatti mārutaḥ | kiṃ vā na kledayaṃtyāpaḥ kiṃ na kṣīṇaṃ ca bhūmiṣu || 8.36{36} || imaṃ saṃśayamadyāpi mama tacchetumarhasi | asmāllokātparaṃ lokaṃ ko gato'tyaṃtavaṃcitaḥ || 8.37{37} || kiṃ nu hatvā sukhaṃ śete kiṃ ca hatvā na śocati | kasya caikasya dharmasya vadhaṃ saṃśasi gautama || 8.38{38} || mayaitadbhagavan pṛṣṭaḥ sarvajño'si yato sudhīḥ | tanmama saṃśayaṃ chetuṃ samyagādeṣṭumarhasi || 8.39{39} || tayaivaṃ pṛchyamāno'sau bhagavān sarvavijjinaḥ | devatāṃ tāṃ samālokya tatpraśnottaramabravīt || 8.40{40} || śṛṇu tvaṃ devate samyakkṛtvā cittaṃ samāhitam | tavaitatparipṛchāyāḥ pratyuttaramudāhare || 8.41{41} || ārāmāropakā ye'tra ye ca vā setukārakāḥ | prapātodakayānaṃ ca pradadanti pratiśrayam || 8.42{42} || śraddhāśīlena satyena kṣamayā vītamatsarāḥ | te narāḥ sugatiṃ yānti te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ || 8.43{43} || teṣāmeva hi martyānāṃ divārātrau niraṃtaram | avichinnāḥ puṇyadhārāḥ pravarddhyante sadā khalu || 8.44{44} || daśākuśalakarttāro yena saddharmaniṃdakāḥ | te narā durgatiṃ yānti bhramanti pāpacāriṇaḥ || 8.45{45} || ye cātatāyino martyāḥ svakuladharmanaṣṭakāḥ | te narāḥ patitā yanti narake duḥkhabhāginaḥ || 8.46{46} || teṣāṃ pāpiṣṭhasatvānāṃ divārātrau niraṃtaram | avichinnāḥ pāpadhārāḥ pravahante sadā khalu || 8.47{47} || annado valavān bhogī vastradaḥ śobhito bhavet | pānadaḥ sukhitaḥ tṛptaścakṣuṣmān bhavati dīpadaḥ || 8.48{48} || duṣṭavāgniśitaṃ śastraṃ rāgo hālahalaṃ viṣam | dveṣaḥ prajvalito vahniravidyā dāruṇaṃ tamaḥ || 8.49{49} || gṛhītaṃ yatsvayaṃ dattaṃ yadgṛhe tadihojjhitam | abhedyaṃ kavacaṃ kṣāntiḥ prajñā tīkṣṇaṃ mahāyudham || 8.50{50} || vitarko'kuśalaścauraḥ śilaṃ dhanaṃ satāṃ matam | te eva muṣitā loke yaiḥ śīlaṃ vinipātitam || 8.51{51} || alpechaḥ satsukhī loke saṃtuṣṭaḥ parameśvaraḥ | śīlavān bhūṣito nityaṃ naṣṭaśīlo vidaṃvitaḥ || 8.52{52} || vatsalo vāndhavaḥ puṇyaṃ pāpaṃ duṣṭāśayo ripuḥ | nārakaṃ dāruṇaṃ duḥkhaṃ skaṃdhābhāvaparaṃ sukham || 8.53{53} || kāmāḥ priyā apathyā hi mokṣaḥ pathyo priyaḥ satām | dveṣaḥ pīḍākaro vyādhiḥ buddha eko bhiṣagvaraḥ || 8.54{54} || ajñānenāvṛto loko mohanaḥ pravaśīkṛtaḥ | lobhāttyajati mitrāṇi saṃgātsvargaṃ na gachati || 8.55{55} || tyāgānmitrāṇi varddhante maitryā śāmyanti śatravaḥ | śīlātsvargamavāpnoti jñānānmokṣaṃ su gachati || 8.56{56} || ichayā badhyate loko nīchayā ca vimucyate | tṛṣṇāyā viprahāṇena nirvāṇamiti kathyate || 8.57{57} || puṇyaṃ rājā ca caurāśca syaṃdamānāḥ samudyatāḥ | na śaknuvaṃtyapāhartuṃ striyo vā puruṣasya ca || 8.58{58} || puṇyaṃ na dahate vahnirbhinatti ca na mārutaḥ | puṇyaṃ na kledayaṃtyāpo naiva kṣīṇvaṃti bhūmayaḥ || 8.59{59} || vidyamāneṣu bhogyeṣu puṇyaṃ yena na saṃcitam | asmāllokātparaṃ lokaṃ sa gato'tyaṃtavaṃcitaḥ || 8.60{60} || krodhaṃ hatvā sukhaṃ śete krodhaṃ hatvā na śocati | krodhasyaikasya dharmasya vadhaṃ saṃśāmi sarvadā || 8.61{61} || etatpraśnottaraṃ śrutvā devatāsau pramoditā | bhagavaṃtaṃ punarnatvā prasaṃśyaivamavocata || 8.62{62} || dhanyo'si bhagavan buddha sarvapraśnottarapradaḥ | sarvajño jagatāṃ śāstā ṣaḍabhijño munīśvaraḥ || 8.63{63} || vīrasya ca na paśyāmi brāhmaṇyaṃ parinirvṛtim | sarvavīro bhayātītastrātuṃ loke'bhiśaktibhāg || 8.64{64} || ityuktvā devatā bhūyaḥ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇatrayam | natvā pādau munīndrasya tata eva divaṃ yayau || 8.65{6} || atha te bhikṣavaḥ sarve śrutvā śāstrānudeśitam | satyamevaṃ parijñāya samyakkarmasu cerire || 8.66{66} || evametanmahārāja guruṇā me prabhāṣitam | śrutvā caivaṃ parijñāya saddharme nirato bhava || 8.67{67} || dharmeṇa sugatiṃ yāyātpāpena durgatiṃ vrajet | tasmāddharmaṃ puraskṛtya prajāḥ samyakprapālaya || 8.68{68} || daśākuśalakarmāṇi tyaktvā saṃvṛtimācara | sarvopakaraṇaṃ dānaṃ dātavyaṃ svargavāṃchinā || 8.69{69} || duṣṭasaṃgaṃ parityajya hatvā rāgaviṣaṃ muhuḥ | dveṣāgniśamanaṃ kṛtvā hyavidyā saṃpraghātyatām || 8.70{70} || kāmavitarkatāṃ tyaktvā bodhipraṇidhicetasā | trikāyaśodhanaṃ kṛtvā śīladhanamupārjyatām || 8.71{71} || skaṃdhābhāvaṃ parijñāya matvā duṣṭāśayaṃ ripum | kṣamāsvāvaraṇaṃ dhṛtvā duṣṭasaṃghān vijīyatām || 8.72{72} || māradharmān vinirjitya saṃbodhidharmasādhane | dhairyavīryamahotsāhairudyamaṃ kriyatāṃ sadā || 8.73{(73)} || kleśamānamadāñjitvā kṛtvā cittaṃ samāhitam | sarvasatvahitārtheṣu dhyātāṃ bodhisādhanam || 8.74{(74)} || lokaṃ māyāsamudbhūtamajñānatamasāvṛtam | dṛṣṭvā prajñāpradīpena preryatāṃ sugateḥ pathi || 8.75{(75)} || evaṃ rājan bhavānmatvā duṣṭasaṃgān vivarjayet | satsaṃgaṃ nirato nityaṃ triratnasevako bhava || 8.76{(76)} || sarvā api prajāścaivaṃ paribodhya prayatnataḥ | preraṇīyā tvayā rājan saṃvṛtticaraṇe sadā || 8.77{(77)} || evaṃ matvā bhavāṃ rājā saṃsārasāramāpnuvan | kramādbodhicarī pūrya saṃbuddhapadamāpnuyāt || 8.78{(78)} || ityetadguruṇādiṣṭamupaguptena bhikṣuṇā | śrutvā tatheti rājāsāvabhyanaṃdatsaparṣikāḥ || 8.79{(79)} || devatāparipṛchākhyasūtraṃ śṛṇvaṃti ye mudā | śrāvayaṃti ca te saukhyaṃ bhuktvā yāṃti sukhāvatīm || 8.80{(80)} || iti devatāparipṛchāsūtraṃ samāptaṃ śuklāvadāna athāśoko nareṃdraśca kṛtāṃjalipuṭo mudā | upaguptaṃ guruṃ natvā punaḥ śrotuṃ samarthayat || 9.1{(1)} || bhadaṃta śrotumichāmi punaranyatsubhāṣitam | yathā te guruṇādiṣṭaṃ tanmamākhyātumarhasi || 9.2{(2)} || iti pṛṣṭe nṛpeṇāsauvupagupto jināṃśajaḥ | tamaśokaṃ mahīnāthaṃ saṃnirīkṣya samabravīt || 9.3{(3)} || śṛṇu vakṣyāmi te rājaṃ yathā me guruṇoditam | śrutvaitadbhavatāpyevaṃ karttavyaṃ dharmamādarāt || 9.4{(4)} || puraikasamaye rājaṃ śākyasiṃho dayāṃbudhiḥ | sarvajño dharmarāṇnāthaḥ śāstā traidhātukādhipaḥ || 9.5{(5)} || sarvavidyādhipo buddhaḥ ṣaḍabhijño munīśvaraḥ | jino'rhan sugato buddhastathāgato vināyakaḥ || 9.6{(6)} || bhagavān satvahitārthena pure kapilavastuni | nyagrodhamaṇḍitodyāne karaṇḍakanivāpake || 9.7{(7)} || śrāvakabhikṣusaṃghaiśca bodhisatvagaṇaiḥ saha | saddharmadeśanāṃ kartuṃ vijahāra jināśrame || 9.8{(8)} || taddharmaṃ śrotumāyātairupāsakaiśca cailakaiḥ | devāsuragaṇaiścāpi caturbhi lokapālakaiḥ || 9.9{(9)} || cāturvarṇṇyairmanuṣyaiśca paurajānapadādibhiḥ | saṃbodhicaraṇotsāhaiḥ saddharmaguṇalālasaiḥ || 9.10{(10)} || satkṛto pūjitaścaivaṃ parivṛtya puraskṛtaḥ | bhagavān sa sabhāmadhye siṃhāsanasthito vabhau || 9.11{(11)} || tatra sa bhagavān dṛṣṭvā sabhāṃ tāṃ samupasthitām | ādimadhyāṃtakalyāṇaṃ dideśa dharmamuttamam || 9.12{(12)} || tatsaddharmāmṛtaṃ pītvā sarve satvāśca moditāḥ | tathainaṃ śrīghanaṃ nityaṃ bhejire dharmalālasāḥ || 9.13{(13)} || tasmiṃśca samaye tatra pure kapilavastuni | rohiṇākhyo mahāchākyo dhanāḍhyo dhanadopamaḥ || 9.14{(14)} || mahābhogo mahāśrāddhaḥ suviśālaparigrahaḥ | dātā sādhurmahā dhīraḥ pratyuvāsa sukhānvitaḥ || 9.15{15} || samaye tena śākyena svakulasadṛśātkulāt | bhāryā nītā subhadrāṅgī svakuladharmacāriṇī || 9.16{16} || tato'sau rohiṇaḥ śākyastayaiva kāntayā saha | mahāragānurāgeṇa rarāma paricārayan || 9.17{17} || tasyaivaṃ ramamāṇasya kṛīḍato'pyanurāgataḥ | na putro na sutā vāpi sucireṇāpyajāyata || 9.18{18} || tato'sau rohiṇaḥ putrīputralābhe samutsukaḥ | putracintāparaḥ koṣṭhe sthitvaivaṃ ca vyacintayat || 9.19{19} || īyatsaṃpadgṛhe me'sti na ca putrasutāpi na | etā me saṃpado rājā mamātyayādgrahīṣyati || 9.20{20} || hā me saṃpadvinaṣṭā syātparatrāpi gatirna hi | vyarthasmajjanma saṃsāre yato me santatirna hi || 9.21{21} || ko me kuryācca saṃskāraṃ kaśca piṇḍaṃ pradāsyati | kutrāhaṃ śaraṇaṃ yāyāṃ hā daivanihato'smyaham || 9.22{22} || iti cintāviṣaṇṇo'sau śokāgāre vyavasthitaḥ || 9.23{23} || kapolaṃ svakare dhṛtvā tasthau bhogyanirutsukaḥ | evaṃ cintāsamākrāntaṃ rohiṇaṃ taṃ nirutsukam || 9.24{24} || dṛṣṭvā sarve suhṛnmitrā vāndhavāśca vyabodhayan | kimevaṃ tiṣṭhase bhadra kiṃ ca duḥkhaṃ prajāyate || 9.25{25} || vaktavyaṃ cettathāsmākaṃ vaktumarhasi sarvathā | iti pṛṣṭe ca taiḥ sarvairvandhumitrasuhṛjjanaiḥ || 9.26{26} || rohiṇo'sau purasteṣāṃ sarvamevamabhāṣata | bhavantaḥ śṛṇuta sarve kathyate duḥkhatā mayā || 9.27{27} || mahatī me gṛhe saṃpadasyā bhoktā na vidyate | kathaṃ me vidyate vaṃśastatprakāraṃ na manyate || 9.28{28} || yadi vo'sti mayi snehastadupāyaṃ pracakṣyatām | evaṃ tenārthitaṃ śrutvā sarve te snehavaṃdhitāḥ || 9.29{29} || tasya vaṃśasamutpatterupāyaṃ samupādiśan | mā kārṣīḥ śokatāṃ bhadra tadupāyaṃ nu vidyate || 9.30{30} || devatārādhanāṃ kṛtvā yācasva putramātmanā | avaśyaṃ devatānāṃ te prasannānāṃ prasādataḥ || 9.31{31} || putro vā duhitā vāpi bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ | ityetattaiḥ samādiṣṭaṃ śrutvāsau rohiṇo mudā || 9.32{32} || devatārādhanāṃ kartuṃ prayatātmā samārabhat | pūjāṅgaiḥ pūjāyitvā ca brāhmaṇaṃ harimīśvaram || 9.33{33} || iṃdrādilokapālāñca saṃtatiṃ samayācata | evaṃ putrābhinandī sa sadāraḥ vaṃśakāmyayā || 9.34{34} || devatārādhanaṃ kṛtvā tasthau nityaṃ samutsukaḥ | tathāpi tasya śākyasya svadaivaparimāṇataḥ || 9.35{35} || na putro na ca putrī vā suciramapyajāyata | tato'sau rohiṇaḥ śākyo devatāsu nirāśayā || 9.36{36} || putravāṃchāviraktātmā tasthau gehe nirutsavaḥ | asti caiṣa mahārāja pravādo laukikodbhavaḥ || 9.37{37} || yaddevatāprasādena jāyate saṃtatiḥ khalu | evaṃ cedvā tathā rājannekaikasya bhavetkhalu || 9.38{38} || yathā putrasahasraṃ vā nṛpasya
