cakravarttinaḥ | api tu saṃmukhībhāvāttristhānānāṃ nṛpeśvara || 9.39{39} || putrā vāpi sutāścāpi jāyaṃte prāṇināṃ khalu | tadyathā pitarau raktau kalyā cartumatī prasūḥ | gaṃdharvaḥ prasthitaḥ kāle tadā garbhe samudbhavet || 9.40{40} || tataśca samaye tasya rohiṇasyānurāgiṇaḥ | bhāryyā kalyāvatībhūtā snātvā ratiṃ samārabhat || 9.41{41} || tadaikā devatā svargāccyutvā karmānubhoginī | tasya śākyasya bhāryyāyā garbhe sā samupāviśat || 9.42{42} || tataḥ svāpannasatvā sā matvā garbhasamudbhavam | svāmino'gre rahaḥ sthitvā harṣitaivaṃ nyavedayat || 9.43{43} || svāminnāpannasatvāsmi vaṃśa āvāṃ samudbhavet | tadbhavān sarvakṛyāni kārayatvanumoditaḥ || 9.44{44} || iti bhāryoditaṃ śrutvā rohiṇo'sau pramoditaḥ | bhāryāṃ tāṃ garbhiṇīṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃsmitaḥ pratyabhāṣata || 9.45{45} || satyaṃ me bhāṣitaṃ bhadre matvā bhava samāhitā || 9.46{45!} || pramādamatra mā kārṣī yadi snehāsti te mayi | evaṃ te kuśalaṃ bhadre yadi putraṃ janiṣyasi || 9.47{46} || tadā niṣkāśayāmi tvāṃ yadi putrīṃ janiṣyasi | iti bharturvacaḥ śrutvā sā strī vivṛddhadohadā | bharturviyogaśaṃkārttā babhūva parikheṭitā || 9.48{47} || yāvatsā samaye sūta dārikāṃ divyasuṃdarīm | śuklavastraparītāṅgāṃ garbhamalāviliptitām || 9.49{48} || tatastāṃ dārikāṃ jātāṃ śrutvāsau rohiṇo ruṣā | pratyākhyātuṃ svayaṃ bhāryāṃ viveśa sūtikāgṛhe || 9.50{49} || prajāpatyā tayā bharturupanītā puraḥ sutā | śuklavastraparītāṅgā bhadrāṅgī divyasuṃdarī || 9.51{50} || tataḥ sa rohiṇo dṛṣṭvā tāṃ sutāṃ divyasuṃdarīm | śuklavastraparītāṅgāṃ paravismayamāyayau || 9.52{51} || aho bhāgyānmayā labdhā suteyaṃ bhadrarūpiṇī | yadeṣā sahajaiḥ śuklavastraiḥ prāvṛtya jāyate || 9.53{52} || tasmānnūnamiyaṃ sākṣāddevakanyāvatāritā | saddharmacāriṇī bhadrā bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 9.54{53} || ityuktvāsau pitā śākyaḥ paśyaṃstāṃ dārikāṃ cirāt | atṛpto niścalākṣaśca tasthau saṃmūrchito yathā || 9.55{54} || tato jñātīn samāhūya kṛtvā jātimahaṃ mudā | tannāmakaraṇaṃ tasyāstān punaḥ sa samabravīt || 9.56{55} || bhavanto'syāḥ sutāyā me bhadrāṅgyā anurūpataḥ | nāmadheyaṃ prasiddhena karttavyaṃ kriyatāṃ śubham || 9.57{56} || iti tenārthite tasyāḥ sarve te jātayastathā | sahajaśuklavastrāṅgaṃ dṛṣṭvaivaṃ saṃvabhāṣire || 9.58{57} || yadiyaṃ dārikā saumyā bhadrāṃgī divyasuṃdarī | śuklavastrāvṛtā jātā tacchukleti prasidhyatu || 9.59{58} || iti saṃbhāṣaṇāṃ kṛtvā sarve te jñātayastathā | rohiṇaṃ taṃ samāmaṃtrya tathaivaṃ samudāharat || 9.60{59} || yadiyaṃ te sutā bhadra bhadrāṅgī divyasuṃdarī | śuklavastrāvṛtā jātā tacchukleti pracakṣyatām || 9.61{60} || tathetyanumataṃ kṛtvā tena pitrā prasāditā | śuklā sā duhitāṣṭāsu dhātrīṣu samupārpitā || 9.62{61} || tatastāsāṃ ca dhātrīṇāmupacārapracārataḥ | varddhitābhūtsuramyāṅgī hradasthamiva paṃkajam || 9.63{62} || yathā yathā ca sā śuklā parivṛddhābhavatkramāt | tathā tathā ca tadvastraṃ vavṛddhe nirmalī'bhavat || 9.64{63} || na ca kāyo'pyabhūttasmātmalābhiliptadurbhagaḥ | vabhau tu nirmalaḥ śuddhaḥ sugaṃdhiparivāhakaḥ || 9.65{64} || yadā sā dārikā śuklā parivṛddhā kramādabhūt | kumārī sarvalokānāṃ manonetrābhihāriṇī || 9.66{65} || tataḥ sā śikṣituṃ vidyā guruṇāṃ samupāśritā | śikṣitvā kramaśo vidyāṃ pāramāśu yayau sudhīḥ || 9.67{66} || tadā ye ye ca tāṃ śuklāmapaśyaddivyasuṃdarīm | te te sarve'pi paśyanto vismitā mohamāyayuḥ || 9.68{67} || tataste brāhmaṇādyāśca tadguṇākṛṣṭamānasāḥ | svasvadūtena tāṃ śuklāṃ rohiṇaṃ prārthayanmuhuḥ || 9.69{68} || jātiśreṣṭho hyahaṃ viprastacchuklāṃ me dātumarhasi | iti tāṃ brāhmaṇaputrā rohiṇaṃ pratyayācayan || 9.70{[69]} || rājaputro'smyahaṃ vīrastatsutā me pradīyatām | iti rājakumārāstaṃ rohiṇaṃ tāṃ samarthayan || 9.71{[70]} || ahaṃ vaiśyaḥ prajābhartā tacchuklāṃ me dātumarhasi | iti vaiśyakumārāstāṃ rohiṇaṃ prārthayari muhuḥ || 9.72{[71]} || ahaṃ maṃtrisuto vijñastacchuklā me pradīyatām | iti maṃtrisutāḥ sarve rohiṇaṃ pratyayācayan || 9.73{71!} || mahāmātyasuto'haṃ hi tacchuklāṃ me prayachatām | ityāmātyakumārāstāṃ rohiṇaṃ pratyayācayan || 9.74{72} || evamanye'pi lokāśca rūpadravyābhimāninaḥ | svasvadūtena tāṃ śuklāṃ rohiṇaṃ pratyayācayan || 9.75{73} || evaṃ sarvaiśca tairnityaiḥ prārthyamāno mahājanaiḥ | rohiṇaḥ sa viṣaṇṇātmā sthitvaivaṃ ca vyacintayat || 9.76{74} || hā me duḥkhāni jātāni kathamatra pratikriyā | sarvathāhaṃ praṇaṣṭaḥ syāṃ sutayāḥ kāraṇe'dhunā || 9.77{75} || yadyekasmai pradāsyāmi sutāmetāṃ manoharām | anye sarve'pi me vairā bhaviṣyaṃti tadā khalu || 9.78{76} || avaśyaṃ me sutā hīyaṃ vairiṇī māṃ haniṣyati | evaṃ duḥkhānudāyinyā putryāpi kiṃ mamaitayā || 9.79{77} || iti cintāviṣaṇṇo'sau taccintākulamānasaḥ | kapolaṃ svakare sthāpya tasthau koṣṭhe nirutsavaḥ || 9.80{78} || evaṃ cintāvibhinnāsyaṃ pitaraṃ taṃ viṣādinam | sā śuklā duhitā dṛṣṭvā praṇatvaivamabhāṣata || 9.81{79} || kimevaṃ tiṣṭhase tāta kiṃ te duḥkhaṃ nu jāyate | kathyatāṃ tadyadi sneho mayi te varttate pitaḥ || 9.82{80} || iti putryā vacaḥ śrutvā pitā sa ruṣitāśayaḥ | niḥsnehastāṃ sutāṃ śuklāṃ dṛṣṭvaivaṃ paryyabhāṣata || 9.83{81} || tvannimitte mahadduḥkhaṃ jāyate me kuputrike | kiṃ tavāgre kathitvaitaṃ yato naiva pratikriyā || 9.84{82} || avaśyaṃ tvaṃ sutā śatruḥ sarvathā māṃ haniṣyasi | evaṃ duḥkhābhidāyinyā putryāpi kiṃ mama tvayā || 9.85{83} || iti pitroditaṃ śrutvā sā śuklā prahatāśayā | sahasā pitaraṃ natvā rudaṃtyaivamabhāṣata | tāta kiṃ me nimittena duḥkhaṃ te jāyate katham | sarvathaitatpravaktavyaṃ yadi te'haṃ sutātmajā | tadupāyaṃ kariṣyāmi yena duḥkhaṃ nihanyate || 9.86{84} || tadetatsarvathā tāta mamāgre vaktumarhasi | iti putryodite bhūyaḥ pitāsau rohiṇo'vadat || 9.87{85} || tatkin te kathyate putri yato nāsti pratikriyā | bahavaḥ prārthayitārastava rājasutādayaḥ || 9.88{86} || kumārā brāhmaṇā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāśca maṃtrinaṃdanāḥ | amātyanaṃdanāścāpi sārthavāhasutādayaḥ || 9.89{87} || evamanye'pi ye cānyā guṇadravyābhimānitāḥ | paurikā grāmikāścāpi kularūpābhimānikāḥ || 9.90{88} || etaiḥ sarvairahaṃ nityaṃ sumudritastvadarthibhiḥ | kathamatra kariṣyāmi cetanā me na vidyate || 9.91{89} || tvamevaikā hi me putrī bahavo yācakāśca te | ekasmai yadi dāsyāmi sarve'nye syurmamāhitāḥ || 9.92{90} || atastvāṃ khaṇḍaśaḥ kṛtvā sarvebhyo'pyarpaye ca vai | evaṃ tu kriyamāṇe me kuśalatvaṃ bhaviṣyati || 9.93{91} || anyathā cedbhavennaiva kuśalaṃ me sadāpi hi | iti pitroditaṃ śrutvā śuklā sā mṛtyuśaṃkita || 9.94{92} || moditeva pituḥ pādau praṇatvaivamabhāṣata | prasīda mā kṛthāḥ khedaṃ mamaitatkāraṇe pitaḥ || 9.95{93} || tathāhaṃ te kariṣyāmi yathā doṣo na vidyate | nāhaṃ kāmārthinī tāta tadanujñāṃ pradehi me || 9.96{94} || pravrajitvā cariṣyāmi bhagavacchāsane vratam | ityetadbhāṣitaṃ putryā śrutvāsau rohiṇaḥ pitā || 9.97{95} || putrīviyogamāśaṃkya punarevamabhāṣata | mā kṛthāḥ sarvathā putri pravrajyācaraṇe manaḥ || 9.98{96} || tvaṃ strī vālā na śaknuyāḥ pravrajyāṃ carituṃ sute | pravrajyāyāṃ vrataṃ kaṣṭaṃ puruṣairapi duṣkaram || 9.99{97} || tvaṃ tu vālā subhadrāṃgī komalā divyasuṃdarī | kathaṃ tadduṣkarasthāne vrataṃ kartuṃ saheḥ sute || 9.100{98} || tanmā kṛthāstathā vāle pravrajyāyāṃ manastyaja | yadi kāmārthinī nāsi kasmai ciddāsyate na hi || 9.101{99} || tatputri svagṛhe sthitvā vrataṃ dhṛtvā sukhaṃ vasa | yadi kāmārthinī vāsi putri teṣāṃ tvadarthinām || 9.102{100} || svayaṃvaravidhiṃ kṛtvā svayaṃ vara yamichasi | tadā me dūṣaṇaṃ nāsti tavāpi dūṣaṇaṃ na hi || 9.103{1} || sarvatrāpi hi lokeṣu vidhireṣa pravarttate | tasmātteṣāṃ kumārāṇāṃ patiṃ bhadraṃ svayaṃ vara || 9.104{2} || tenaiva patinā sārddhaṃ vrataṃ kṛtvā sukhaṃ cara | tadā santatimutpādya bhuktvā bhogyaṃ yathā sukham || 9.105{3} || saṃvṛtticaraṇaṃ kṛtvā tathānte svargamāpnuyāḥ | tenaivaṃ mā kṛthāḥ putri pravrajyācaraṇe manaḥ || 9.106{4} || kiṃ te pravrajyayā siddhyenmahadduṣkaracaryyayā | ityukte janakenāsau śuklā kāmaparāṅmukhā || 9.107{5} || saddharmacaraṇaprepsuḥ pitaramevamabravīt | nāhaṃ kāmārthinī tāta saṃbodhipadavāṃchinī || 9.108{6} || tasmādbhogyānyapi tyaktvā caritumichāmi sadvratam | sabhayāḥ saraṇāḥ kāmāḥ sakleśāśca viṣopamāḥ || 9.109{7} || tasmātkāme na me vāṃchā nirvāṇe eva me manaḥ | sadevāsuramānuṣyā ye satvāḥ kāmarāgiṇaḥ || 9.110{8} || sarve te kleśitāścāndhāścaranti pātakeṣvapi | kṛtvā te pātakānyevaṃ gachanti durgatiṣvapi || 9.111{9} || vividhāni ca duḥkhāni bhuṃjate narakāsthitāḥ | brāhmaṇā api dhīrāśca vaidikā brahmacāriṇaḥ || 9.112{10} || te'pi kāmānurāgena bhraṣṭā gacchaṃti durgatim | tapasvino mahābhijñāḥ śuddhātmānā jitendriyāḥ | te'pi kāmānurāgena bhraṣṭā gacchaṃti durgatim | yatayo yoginaścāpi nirgraṃthāśca digaṃvarāḥ || 9.113{11} || te'pi kāmānurāgena bhraṣṭā gacchanti durgatim | rājānaḥ kṣatriyāścāpi kṛtvā yuddhaṃ parasparam || 9.114{12} || āhave nidhanaṃ yānti tadapi kāmakāraṇe | amātyā maṃtriṇaścāpi mārayanti parārdhinaḥ || 9.115{13} || tatpāpairdurgatiṃ yānti tadapi kāmahetunā | yodhāraśca mahāvīrā yuddhaṃ kṛtvā parasparam || 9.116{14} || saṃgrāme nidhanaṃ yānti tadapi kāmakāraṇe | vaṇijaḥ sārthavāhāśca ratnadravyātilālasāḥ || 9.117{15} || samudre patitāḥ kecinmṛtāḥ kecicca jaṃgale | kecinmṛtā mahāraṇye cauraiḥ kecidupadrutāḥ || 9.118{16} || kṣutpipāsāhatāḥ kecinmṛtā mārge rujānvitāḥ | śītavātātapākrāntā mṛtā kecicchramāturāḥ || 9.119{17} || kecidgṛhagatā eva mṛtāḥ kecicca roginaḥ | kecidbhāraṃ vahantaśca mṛtāḥ kecidbhayānvitāḥ || 9.120{18} || jantubhiḥ khāditāḥ kecittatsarvaṃ kāmahetunā | kṛṣiṇaśca dinaṃ yāvatkṣatrakarmasamudyatāḥ || 9.121{19} || dinānte gṛhamagatya śerate te mṛtā iva | evamanye'pi lokāśca śilpipreṣyajanādayaḥ || 9.122{20} || dāsadāsījanāścāpi svasvakarmasamudyatāḥ | evaṃ nityamaviśrāntaṃ kuṭuṃvadhanasādhane || 9.123{21} || vahaṃti kheditāḥ kleśaṃ tatsarvaṃ kāmahetunā | evaṃ caurādiduṣṭāśca paradravyāpahāriṇaḥ || 9.124{22} || pātakānyapi kurvanti tadapi kāmakāraṇe | kecicca paradravyāṇi haranti hārayanti ca || 9.125{23} || keciddhatvāpi sarvaṃ haranti krūramānasāḥ | dhanārthe kiṃ na kurvanti duṣṭā lubdhāśca nirdayāḥ || 9.126{24} || praghnanti pitarau kecitte'pi ghnanti gurūnapi | kecidvighnanti mitrāṇi jñātivandhujanānapi || 9.127{[125]} || patnīputraduhitṝśca bhrātrīṃśca bhāginīrapi | kecidghnanti sahāyāṃśca dāsadāsījanānyapi || 9.128{26} || bālān vṛddhāṃśca nārīṃśca tatsarvaṃ kāmakāraṇe | kecicca prāṇinaḥ pakṣimṛgamatsyādijantukān || 9.129{27} || hatvā khādanti pāpiṣṭhāstadapi kāmakāraṇe | evaṃ tiryyaggaṇāścāpi pakṣisiṃhādijantavaḥ || 9.130{28} || parasparaṃ nihatyaivaṃ khādanti kāmahetunā | evaṃ śathāvaṃcayantastrāsayanto'pi vālakān || 9.131{29} || adattaṃ pratigṛhnanti tadapi kāmakāraṇāt | mithyākāmaratāḥ kecitparadārāṃśca kāminīḥ || 9.132{30} || haranti chadmanā cāpi tadapi kāmakāraṇe | yacca mṛṣāvadaṃto'pi parakāryyābhighāṭakāḥ || 9.133{31} || sādhayanti svakāryāṇi tadapi kāmahetunā | yacca piśunavādena suhṛnmitrānucāriṇām | virodhaṃ kārayantyevaṃ tadapi kāmahetunā || 9.134{[132]} || yacca pāruṣyavādena gurusādhujanānapi | paribhāṣya vinindanti tadapi kāmakāraṇe || 9.135{[133]} || yatsaṃbhinnapralāpena suhṛnmitrānuyāyinām | cittāni bhedayantyevaṃ tadapi kāmakāraṇe || 9.136{[134]} || yacca māyānurāgeṇa sādhūnāṃ dharmacāriṇām | prabhedayanti cittāni tadapi kāmahetunā || 9.137{[135]} || yadīrṣyāmatsarālīḍhā dṛṣṭvā paraguṇarddhitām | vyāpādaṃ cintayantyevaṃ tadapi kāmakāraṇe || 9.138{[136]} || yanmithyādṛṣṭikā loke sarvadharmaprahāsikāḥ | bhogyāni bhuṃjate hṛtvā tadapi kāmakāraṇe || 9.139{[137]} || kecijjātiparibhraṣṭā nīcajātiprasaṃgatāḥ | svakuladharmabhraṣṭāśca tadapi kāmakāraṇe || 9.140{[138]} || evaṃ sarve'pi satvāśca sadgatiparivartinaḥ | kāmarthe kleśitātmāno bhramanti durgatau sadā || 9.141{[139]} || evaṃ yāvanti duḥkhāni saṃsāre ṣaḍgatiṣvapi | tāni sarvāṇi satvānāṃ jāyante kāmahetunā || 9.142{[130]} || evaṃ matvā tu ye vijñāḥ kāmaṃ tyaktvā virāgiṇaḥ | pravrajitvā suniḥkleśā brahmacaryyaṃ caranti te || 9.143{[131]} || tato me sabhaye kāme saraṇe ca viṣopame | vidvadbhirgarhite tāta manovāṃchā na varttate || 9.144{32} || tatpravrajyāṃ samāśritya bhagavaccharaṇaṃ gatā | brahmacaryyaṃ caritvāhaṃ prāptumichāmi nirvṛtim || 9.145{33} || buddho hi jagatāṃ śāstā dharmarājo vināyakaḥ | tattasya śaraṇe gatvā caritumichāmi saccarīm || 9.146{34} || yadyasti te mayi snehaḥ saddharme cānurāgatā | tadanumodanāṃ kṛtvānujñāṃ me dātumarhasi || 9.147{35} || yadi tu saugate dharme'pyanujñāṃ me dadāsi na | tīrthayātrāṃ bhramiṣyāmi sarvadāhaṃ virāginī || 9.148{36} || iti putrīvacaḥ śrutya śākyo'sau rohiṇaḥ pitā | sutādharmaviyogatvaṃ vijñāyaivamacintayat || 9.149{37} || yadiyaṃ me sutā bhadrā nirāśravā virāginī | avaśyaṃ svagṛhaṃ tyaktvā pravrajetsarvathā khalu || 9.150{38} || avaśyaṃ me'nayā putryā viyogaṃ sarvathā bhavet | sarvathā hyanivāryyeyaṃ vrajatu saugatāśrame || 9.151{39} || yadāyaṃ saugate dharme pravrajitvā nirāśravā | brahmacaryyaṃ caratyevaṃ tato nirvṛtimāpnuyāt || 9.152{40} || yadiyaṃ me sutā kāntā subhadrā divyasuṃdarī | yadi gehaṃ parityaktvā tīrthayātrāṃ kariṣyati || 9.153{41} || tadā nūnamiyaṃ bhrāṃtā tīrthikadharmasaṃratā | kuladharmaparibhraṣṭā vinaṣṭā syānna saṃśayaḥ || 9.154{42} || tato'smākaṃ yaśodharmavinaṣṭo'pi bhavetkhalu | tasyāśca dūragāminyā darśanaṃ syātsudullabham || 9.155{43} || tasmādasyā na karttavyā vāraṇā dharmasādhane | caratu saugatīṃ caryyāmiyaṃ hi nirvṛtaye || 9.156{44} || tathā cetsaphalaṃ janma mānuṣye syānmamāpi ca | teneyaṃ jagatāṃ bhartuḥ śāsane caratu vratam || 9.157{45} || ityevaṃ manasā dhyātvā śākyo'sau rohiṇaḥ pitā | śuklāṃ tāṃ svātmajāṃ bhadrāṃ saṃnirīkṣyaivamabravīt || 9.158{46} || satyamevaṃ sute bhadre yathoddiṣṭaṃ tvayā khalu | kiṃ tu tvaṃ dārikā nārī pravrajyāṃ tatkathaṃ careḥ || 9.159{47} || pravrajyā duṣkarasthānaṃ nārīṇāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ | tatpravrajyāvrate sthitvā mā paścātparitapyathāḥ || 9.160{48} || yadi tvaṃ niścayenaiva pravrajyāvratamichasi | taccarasva munīndrasya śāsane vratamādarāt || 9.161{49} || yathā ca guruṇādiṣṭaṃ śrutvā tathā samāhitaḥ | samyakchikṣāḥ samādhāya cara nityamatandritā || 9.162{50} || saṃbuddhaśāsanaṃ dhṛtvā śraddhābhaktisamanvitā | triratnaśaraṇaṃ gatvā bodhivrataṃ samācara || 9.163{51} || iti pitrā samādiṣṭe śuklā sā pratimoditā | natvā pādau pituścaivaṃ jananyāścaraṇe'namat || 9.164{52} || tataḥ sā jananī dṛṣṭvā tāṃ śuklāṃ svātmajāṃ priyām | pariṣvajya rudantyevaṃ pravrajyāyāṃ nyavārayat || 9.165{53} || hā putri kathamekānte māṃ tyaktvā kva vrajiṣyase | hā jīva kiṃ nu paśyantī pravrajituṃ tvamīhase || 9.166{54} || kiṃ cidduḥkhaṃ na te dattaṃ mayāmvayā kadā cana | kenaivaṃ hetunā putrī pravrajituṃ tvamichasi || 9.167{55} || tvaṃ tu nārī subhādrāṅgī kumārī divyasuṃdarī | kiṃcidduḥkhānabhijñā ca tatpravrajyāṃ kathaṃ care || 9.168{56} || yāvajjīvāmyahaṃ caiva tāvatmā gāḥ kuhāpi hi | yāvaccāsti gṛhe saṃpattāvadbhuktvā sukhaṃ vasa || 9.169{57} || yadāhaṃ maraṇaṃ yātā yadā cāpi gṛhe vipat | jñātimitrajanaistyaktvā tadā vrajasva vāṃchayā || 9.170{58} || iti mātrā niṣiddhe'pi śuklā sā vighnaśaṃkitās| mātuḥ pādau praṇatvaiva sahasā niryayau gṛhāt || 9.171{59} || tataḥ sā satvarā gatvā nyagrodhārama āśrame | dadarśa bhikṣuṇībhikṣūn śantaśīlāñjiteṃdriyān || 9.172{60} || tān sarvān kramato natvā vihāre samupāviśat | tatrasthaṃ sugataṃ nāthamapaśyacchrighanaṃ jinam || 9.173{61} || dvātriṃśallakṣaṇāśītivyaṃjanaiḥ parimaṃḍitam | sahasreṇādhikābhāsaṃ vyāmābhaparirocitam || 9.174{62} || śāntātmānaṃ subhadrāṃśaṃ samantabhadrarūpiṇam | ratnarāśimivojjvālaṃ sumerumiva jaṃgamam || 9.175{63} || dṛṣṭvaiva niścalā tasthau harṣotphullatanūruhā | dṛṣṭvaivaṃ sucirāttasya śrīghanasyāntike yayau || 9.176{64} || tathaivaṃ samupāyātāṃ dṛṣṭvā tāṃ bhagavānmuniḥ | svāgataṃ dārike bhadre ehītyuktvā samagrahīt || 9.177{65} || tato'sau dārikā śuklā svāgatāsmi munīśvara | ityuktvā prāṃjaliṃ kṛtvā nanāma caraṇau muneḥ || 9.178{66} || tato bhagavatā tena preṣitā māturantike | sā śuklā sahasā gatvā gautamyāccaraṇe'namat || 9.179{67} || tathā tāṃ samupāyātāṃ śuklāṃ sadvratavāṃchinīm | dṛṣṭvā sā gautamī spṛṣṭvā hastenaiva samagrahīt || 9.180{68} || tataḥ pravrājayitvā sā gautamyā bhikṣuṇī kṛtā | khikkhirīpātrahastāṅkā saṃgatābhūjjitendriyā || 9.181{69} || yenaiva śuklavastreṇa prāvṛtā samajāyata | tataḥ paṃcasuraktaṃ jātāni cīvarāṇyapi || 9.182{70} || taireva civarai raktaiḥ prāvṛtā pariśobhitā | sā śuklā suprasannāsyā muṇḍitāpyabhyarocata || 9.183{71} || tato buddhānubhāvena supraśāntasubhāvinī | jitvā kleśārivargāṃśca śikṣāpāraṃ samāyayau || 9.184{72} || matvānityaṃ ca saṃsāraṃ bhavagatiṃ vighātinīm | nihatya sarvasaṃskāragatīsatanadharmiṇī || 9.185{73} || māracaryyāvinirmuktā sākṣādarhatvamāyayau | avidyāṅgaṃ vinirbhidya prāptavidyā śubhāśayā || 9.186{74} || abhijñā guṇasaṃpannā pratisaṃvidvatī sudhīḥ | suvītarāgiṇī dhīrā loṣṭhahemasamānikā || 9.187{75} || ākāśasamacittā ca pāṇītalasamāśayā | niraṃjanāvikalpā ca śrīkhaṇḍatulyavāsinī || 9.188{76} || svātmasatkāralābheṣu parāṇmukhī sunispṛhā | sarvasatvahitādhāni saṃbuddhadharmacāriṇī || 9.189{77} || sadevāsuralokānāṃ pūjyā mānyā samantataḥ | vaṃdanīyā cābhitoṣyā ca vabhūva brahmacāriṇī || 9.190{78} || atha te bhikṣavaḥ sarve dṛṣṭvā tāṃ brahmacāriṇīm | vismitāḥ sugataṃ natvā paprachuriti sādaram || 9.191{79} || bhagavan kimiyaṃ śuklā purā karmākarocchubham | yena vastrāvṛtā jātā bhavatyevaṃ ca bhikṣuṇī || 9.192{80} || tatsarvaṃ naḥ samādeṣṭumarhasi sarvavidguro | yadanayā kṛtaṃ karma bhikṣuṇyā śuklayā purā || 9.193{81} || iti tairbhikṣubhiḥ pṛṣṭe bhagavān sa munīśvaraḥ | tān bhikṣusāṃghikān sarvān saṃnirīkṣyaivamabravīt || 9.194{82} || śṛṇudhvaṃ bhikṣavaḥ sarve yadanayā kṛtaṃ purā | tatsarvaṃ kathayiṣyāmi sarvalokābhibodhane || 9.195{83} || purāsminneva bhadrākhye kalpe'bhūtkāśyapo jinaḥ | saṃbuddhaḥ sugato nātho dharmarājastathāgataḥ || 9.196{84} || sarvavidyādhipaḥ śāstā traidhātukavināyakaḥ | sarvajño bhagavānarhan brahmacārī hitaṃkaraḥ || 9.197{85} || sa munīndro jagannātho vārāṇasīmupāśrayan | mṛgadāve vane ramye vyaharacchrāvakaiḥ saha || 9.198{86} || bhikṣubhirbodhisatvaiśca bhikṣuṇībhirupāsakaiḥ | sārddhamupāsikābhiśca yatibhiśca maharṣibhiḥ || 9.199{87} || tatrastho bhagavān buddho sarvasatvahitāya saḥ | ādimadhyāntakalyāṇaṃ dideśa dharmamuttamam || 9.200{88} || tadaikānyatarā kācicchreṣṭhibhāryā śubhāśayā | sukalyāṇārthinī śrāddhā saddharmamānasī sudhīḥ || 9.201{89} || kena citkaraṇiyena mṛgadāvamupācarat | tatra bhikṣūn kramāddṛṣṭvā saṃbuddhāntikamupāyayau || 9.202{90} || tatra sā samupāgatya dadarśa taṃ munīśvaram | dvātriṃśallakṣaṇāśītivyaṃjanairupalakṣitam || 9.203{91} || vyāmābhālaṃkṛtaṃ saumyaṃ śatasūryyādhikaprabham | supraśāntendriyāṃ kāmyaṃ samaṃtabhadrarūpakam || 9.204{92} || ratnarāśimivojjvālaṃ sumerumiva jaṃgamam | tathā dṛṣṭvaiva prāmodātsāṃjaliṃ samupāgatā || 9.205{93} || natvā pādau munestasthāvekāntike kṛtāṃjaliḥ | tataḥ sa bhagavān dṛṣṭvā tasyāścittaṃ viśodhitam || 9.206{94} || ādimadhyāntakalyāṇaṃ dideśa dharmamuttamam | tatsaddharmāmṛtaṃ pītvā sā śūdrī pariharṣitā || 9.207{95} || sasaṃghaṃ sugataṃ nāthaṃ bhojayituṃ samaichata | tataḥ sā svagṛhe gatvā sādhayitvā subhojanam || 9.208{96} || saṃbuddhapramukhaṃ saṃghaṃ svāṃtargehe nyamaṃtrayat | tatra svasvāsanāsīnaṃ saṃbuddhaṃ taṃ sasāṃghikam || 9.209{97} || pūjayitvā tadarhaiśca bhojanaiḥ samatoṣayat | tataḥ sā śraddhayā tebhyaḥ sarvebhyo'pi prasannitā || 9.210{98} || buddhapramukhasaṃghebhyaḥ pratyekaṃ cīvaraṃ dadau | tato nityaṃ ca sā bhaktyā cakre saṃbuddhasevanām || 9.211{99} || tatpuṇyaiścāpi saddharme pravrajituṃ samaichata | tato'sau pitarau natvābhyanujñāpya prasādinī || 9.212{100} || bhagavacchāsane gatvā pravrajyāvratamācarat | tasmātkiṃ bhikṣavo yūyaṃ manyadhve yābhavattadā || 9.213{1} || śreṣṭhibhāryā na cānyā sā śuklaivaiṣeti manyata | yadanayā prasādinyā buddhapramukhasāṃghike || 9.214{2} || pratyekaṃ cīvaraṃ dattaṃ pravrajyā cāpi sādhitā | etatpuṇyavipākena prāvṛtya śuklavāsasā || 9.215{3} || jātā pravrajitā caiṣā bhavati brahmacāriṇī | ityevaṃ karmajaṃ bhogyaṃ prāṇino bhuṃjate bhave || 9.216{4} || yenaiva yatkṛtaṃ karma tenaiva bhujyate phalam | na naśyaṃti hi karmāṇi kalpakoṭiśatairapi || 9.217{5} || sāmagrīṃ prāpya kālaṃ ca phalaṃti khalu dehinām | abhuktaṃ kṣīyate naiva karma kvāpi kathaṃ cana || 9.218{6} || nāgnibhirdahyate karma vāyubhiśca na śuṣyate | jalaiśca klidyate nāpi kṣīyate nāpi bhūmiṣu || 9.219{7} || anyathā ca bhavennaiva karmagatiḥ kathaṃ cana | śuklānāṃ śubhatā nityaṃ kṛṣṇānāṃ duḥkhatā sadā || 9.220{8} || miśritā miśritānāṃ ca jaṃtubhirbhujyate gatiḥ | tasmādapāsya kṛṣṇāni karmāṇi miśritāni ca || 9.221{9} || caritavyaṃ śubheṣveva karmasu sukhavāṃchibhiḥ | tatheti bhikṣavaḥ sarve te ca lokaḥ sabhāsthitāḥ || 9.222{10} || śrutvā tatsugatādiṣṭamabhyanandan prasāditāḥ | evametanmahārāja guruṇā me prabhāṣitam || 9.223{11} || evaṃ rājaṃstvayāpyevaṃ karttavyaṃ puṇyamādarāt | puṇyameva bhave vandhubhrātā mitraṃ suhṛtsakhā || 9.224{12} || nānyaḥ puṇyātparaḥ kaścidvidyate bhavacāriṇām | tasmātpuṇyaṃ svayaṃ kṛtvā lokeṣvapi pracāraya || 9.225{13} || prajāśca bodhayitvaivaṃ puṇyamārge pracāraya | ityevaṃ guruṇādiṣṭamupaguptena bhikṣuṇā || 9.226{14} || śrutvā tatheti rājāsau prābhyanandajjanaiḥ saha || 9.227{15} || ya idaṃ śuklāvadānaṃ jinavarakathitaṃ puṇyahetornarāṇāṃ śṛṇvanti śravayanti pramuditamanasaḥ sadguṇaprāptukāmāḥ | te sarve kleśamuktāḥ suvimalamanaso bodhicaryā carantaḥ satsaukhyānyeva bhuktvā munivaranilaye saṃprayātā vasanti || 9.228{16} || iti ratnamālāyāṃ śuklāvadānaṃ nāma samāptam hiraṇyapāṇyavadāna athāśoko mahīpāla upaguptaṃ jināṃśajam | kṛtāṃjalipuṭo natvā punarevamabhāṣata || 10.1{1} || bhadanta śrotumichāmi punaranyatsubhāṣitam | yathā te guruṇā khyātaṃ tathā vaktuṃ samarhasi || 10.2{2} || evaṃ tena nṛpendreṇa prārthite sa jinātmajaḥ | upagupto mahābhijñastaṃ nṛpaṃ caivamabravīt || 10.3{3} || śṛṇu rājaṃstathā vakṣye yathā me guruṇoditam | śrutvā caivaṃ sadā bodhicaryāṃ cara samāhitaḥ || 10.4{4} || puraikasamaye'sau ca śākyamunistathāgataḥ | sarvajñaḥ sugato nāthaḥ śāstā traidhātukādhipaḥ || 10.5{5} || sarvavidyādhipastāyī ṣaḍabhijño munīśvaraḥ | jino'rhaṃ bhagavān buddho dharmarājo vināyakaḥ || 10.6{6} || śrāvastyāṃ vahirudyāne jetavane jināśrame | anāthapiṇḍadārāme vihāre maṇimaṇḍite || 10.7{7} || bhikṣubhiḥ śrāvakaiḥ sārddhaṃ bhikṣuṇībhirupāsakaiḥ | triratnopāsikābhiśca cailakaiśca śubhāśayaiḥ || 10.8{8} || bodhisatvagaṇaiścāpi sahānyaiśca maharṣibhiḥ | osaddharmadeśanāṃ datvā tasthau lokahitārthataḥ || 10.9{9} || tatsaddharmāmṛtaṃ pātuṃ prājagmuḥ sadguṇārthinaḥ | devā daityāśca nāgāśca yakṣagaṃdharvakinnarāḥ || 10.10{10} || siddhavidyādharādyāśca lokapālagaṇādayaḥ | brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyāścāpi vaiśyāḥ śūdrāśca maṃtriṇaḥ || 10.11{11} || amātyāḥ śreṣṭhinaścāpi dhaninaśca mahājanāḥ | vaṇijaḥ sārthavāhāśca tadanye'pi ca sajjanāḥ || 10.12{12} || paurā jānapadāścāpi sarve te samupāgatāḥ | taṃ buddhaṃ sugataṃ natvā pūjayitvā samaṃtataḥ || 10.13{13} || parivṛtya paraskṛtya tasthuḥ sāṃjalayo mudā | athāsau bhagavān dṛṣṭvā tān sarvān samupāsthitān | ādimadhyāntakalyāṇaṃ dideśa dharmamuttamam || 10.14{14} || tatsaddharmāmṛtaṃ pītvā sarve satvāḥ surādayaḥ | harṣitā anumodanto vabhūvurbodhicāriṇaḥ || 10.15{15} || evaṃ nityaṃ ca te satvāḥ pītvā dharmāmṛtaṃ muneḥ | triratnaśaraṇaṃ gatvā bhejire samupāśritāḥ || 10.16{16} || tadaiva samaye tasyāṃ śrāvastyāṃ puri saṃsthitaḥ | āsīdgṛhapatiḥ prāḍhyo mahābhogyasamṛddhimān || 10.17{17} || kuvelavanmahāśrīmān suvistīrṇaparigrahaḥ || 10.18{18} || śrāddho dātā mahābhogī sarvalokahitārthabhṛt | evaṃ maharddhikasyāpi tasya gṛhapateściram | na putro na ca putrī vā samudapādi daivataḥ || 10.19{19} || tato'putro gṛhastho'sau vaṃśavichinnakheṭitaḥ | kapolaṃ svakare sthāpya viṣādyaivaṃ vyacintayat || 10.20{20} || anekadhanaratnādyāḥ saṃpado me maharddhikāḥ | viśālaparivārāśca vidyante suparigrahāḥ || 10.21{21} || putro me duhitā vāpi vidyate na kathaṃ cana | saṃpado'pi nirarthāḥ syuryato bhoktā na vidyate || 10.22{22} || hā hā sarvaṃ vinaṣṭaṃ syādyato me santatirna hi | kiṃ me'nayā samṛddhyāpi yatra vaṃśo na vidyate || 10.23{23} || vyarthameva mayā dravyaṃ kaṣṭena samupārjitam | kiṃ kariṣyāmi taddravyaṃ sarvathā maraṇe sati || 10.24{24} || ke hi grastā na saṃsāre mṛtyusarppeṇa jaṃtavaḥ | mayi mṛtyuprayāte'tra saṃskāraṃ kaḥ kariṣyati || 10.25{25} || durgatiśodhanaṃ kaśca piṇḍamekaṃ pradāsyati | nūnaṃ madatyayādrājā sarvasvamāhariṣyati || 10.26{26} || tadā nāmāpi me loke na kaścana grahīṣyati | yadarthameva saṃpattīḥ sādhayāmi prayatnataḥ || 10.27{27} || tadeva yadi nāstyevaṃ tatkiṃ me syātsujīvite || 10.28{28!} || varamevādya mṛtyurna mithyācirajīvanam | yasmācciramapi sthitvā mṛtyuduḥkhaṃ tadaiva hi || 10.29{29} || tanme bhogye'pi vāṃchā na bhuktvāpi kiṃ sukhaṃ vinā | aputrasya sukhaṃ naiva paratreha niranvayāt || 10.30{30} || tanme janmāpi vyarthaṃ syāddhyaputro'smi niranvayāt | hā hato'haṃ svadaivena kiṃ mayātra kariṣyate || 10.31{31} || kasyāgre saṃvadiṣyāmi ko me buddhiṃ pradāsyati | kasyāhaṃ śaraṇaṃ yāsye ko māṃ samuddhariṣyati || 10.32{32} || iti cintāviṣaṇno'sau tasthau koṣṭhe yathāturaḥ | nirutsāhī gṛhānnaiva nirapāyātkadācana || 10.33{33} || etaccintāviṣaṇṇābhaṃ taṃ gṛhasthaṃ suhṛjjanāḥ | dṛṣṭvaiva sahasopetya bodhayituṃ samabruvan || 10.34{34} || kiṃ te duḥkhaṃ samutpannaṃ kenaivaṃ tiṣṭhase sakhe | vaktavyaṃ cettadā āśu sarvathā vaktumarhasi || 10.35{31} || iti pṛṣṭe suhṛdbhistairgṛhasthaḥ sa viniśvasan | tān sarvān suhṛdo dṛṣṭvā tadduḥkhaṃ samudāharat || 10.36{36} || suhṛdo me bhavanto hi tanmayātra pracakṣyate | saṃpattirmahatī me'sti putro naiva sutāpi naḥ || 10.37{37} || tena me saṃpadaḥ sarvā vinakṣyanti nirarthitāḥ | etaccintāviṣārttāhaṃ tiṣṭhāmi putravāṃchitaḥ || 10.38{38} || aputrasya sukhaṃ nāsti paratreha samaṃtataḥ | tanme janmāpi vyarthaṃ syādaputrasya niranvayāt || 10.39{39} || tathā hato'haṃ svadaivena kiṃ mayātra cariṣyate | iti tenodite sarve jñātivaṃdhusuhṛjjanāḥ || 10.40{40} || tasya grīhapateścaivāṃ tadupāyaṃ samādiśat | kiṃ bhadrātra viṣādena yatra devādhikāratā || 10.41{41} || tathāpi kriyatāṃ yatnaṃ klaibyaṃ tyaktvā tvayādhunā | yadaśakyaṃ valairdravyaistadupāyena śakyate || 10.42{42} || tasmātklaibyamiha tyaktvā kuru yatnaṃ samāhitaḥ | devatārādhanāṃ kṛtvā sarvakāryyaṃ hi sādhayet || 10.43{43} || tadādau devatāḥ pūjya yācasva putramātmanā | tato devaprasādena tavadharmānubhāvataḥ | putro vā duhitā vāpi samupapatsyate dhruvam || 10.44{44} || tataste saṃtatiścaivaṃ varddhiṣyati kramāttathā | tadāpi bhṛśato muktaḥ sadgatiṃ samavāpnuyāt || 10.45{45} || iti taiḥ samupādiṣṭaṃ śrutvāsāvanumoditāḥ | devatārādhanaṃ kartuṃ prayatātmā samārabhat || 10.46{46} || pūjāṃgaiḥ pūjayitvaivaṃ brahmāṇaṃ harimīśvaram | iṃdrādilokapālānāṃ saṃtatiṃ samayācata || 10.47{47} || evaṃ putrābhilāsī sa sadā ca santatīchayā | devatārādhanaṃ kṛtvā tasthau nityaṃ samutsukaḥ || 10.48{48} || nityamevaṃ kṛtasyāpi tasya daivapraṇāmataḥ | na putro duhitā vāpi nodapādi cirādapi || 10.49{49} || tathā cāpi gṛhastho'sau devatāsu nirāśayā | santatyucchinnacintārttastasthau bhūyo viṣāditaḥ || 10.50{50} || tataḥ kaścitsuhṛtsādhuḥ saṃbuddhopāsakaḥ sudhīḥ | taṃ gṛhasthamupāgatya tathaivaṃ paryyabodhayat || 10.51{51} || sādho kin te viṣādena taddhīraṃ samupāśraya | yadi te santatau vāṃchā tanme śrutvā tataścara || 10.52{52} || kimevaṃ devatāḥ pūjya yācase putramādarāt | yatra daivādhikāratvaṃ tatra kiṃ devatā valam || 10.53{53} || vaṃśārthe yadi te bhaktirastyevaṃ devatāsu tat | saṃbuddhaśaraṇaṃ gatvā saddharmaṃ samupāśraya || 10.54{54} || tato dharmānubhāvena buddhasyāpi prasādataḥ | nūnaṃ te satsutaḥ śīghramutpatsyati na saṃśayaḥ || 10.55{55} || yadi notpatsyate putrastava devavirodhataḥ | puṇyamutpatsyate nūnaṃ tena sadgatimāpnuyāt || 10.56{56} || ye buddhaśaraṇaṃ yānti te labhanti śubhāśayam | ye viśuddhāśayā loke saddharmaṃ te śṛṇvanti hi || 10.57{57} || ye saddharmānuśṛṇvan to bodhicittaṃ labhanti te | pralabdhabodhicittā ye te caranti guṇārthinaḥ || 10.58{58} || guṇakāmāśca ye loke te bhajanti jinātmajān | bodhisatvānubhāvena bodhicaryāṃ samāpnuyuḥ || 10.59{59} || bodhicaryāratā ye ca na te gachaṃti durgatim | sarvakleśagaṇāñjitvā saukhyāvatīmavāpnuyuḥ || 10.60{60} || evaṃ matvā jinaṃ smṛtvā saddharmaṃ samupāśrayeḥ | tataste saṃbhavedbhadramihāmutrāpi sarvataḥ || 10.61{61} || iti tenoditaṃ śrutvā gṛhastho'sau'numoditaḥ | tatheti pratisaṃśrutya saṃbuddhaṃ smartumaichata || 10.62{62} || tato gṛhapatirnityaṃ sadāraḥ śraddhayānvitaḥ | saṃbuddhaṃ sugataṃ smṛtvā vaṃśamevamayācata || 10.63{63} || namaste bhagavannātha bhavatāṃ śaraṇaṃ vraje | tanmāṃ karuṇāya dṛṣṭyā draṣṭumarhasi sarvathā || 10.64{64} || bhavāneva hi jagannāthaḥ sarvasatvahitārthadaḥ | tvayā mahyaṃ hitārthāya satputraṃ dātumarhasi || 10.65{65} || ityevaṃ sa gṛhī sādhuḥ putrābhilaṣitaḥ sadā | sabhāryyaḥ sugataṃ smṛtvā tathā nityaṃ samutsukaḥ || 10.66{66} || tadaiva samaye kaściddevaputro divaścyutaḥ | sa saṃbuddhānubhāvena tadbhāryāgarbhamāviśat || 10.67{67} || tataḥ svāpannasatvābhūtsā bhāryā gṛhiṇaḥ satī | dohadalakṣaṇopetā kṛśāṅgī bhāvinī kramāt || 10.68{68} || pravṛddhagarbhā sā dṛṣṭvā svayaṃ ca garbhamādarāt | dakṣapārśvagataṃ satvaṃ matvā caivaṃ vyaciṃtayat || 10.69{69} || nūnaṃ me jāyate garbhe satvo buddhānubhāvataḥ | yadayaṃ dakṣiṇe vartti tena putro bhavetkhalu || 10.70{70} || iti niścitya sā nārī putrotpatyāśayā mudā | svasvāmino pure sthitvā rahasyaivaṃ nyavedayat || 10.71{71} || dṛṣṭyāryyaputra varddhasva yadahaṃ garbhiṇī bhave | nūnamayaṃ bhavetputro yatsthito dakṣiṇodare || 10.72{72} || iti bhāryoditaṃ śrutvā sa gṛhasthaḥ pramoditaḥ | daksiṇaṃ vāhumunnamya nandannevamudānayat || 10.73{73} || cirābhilaṣitaṃ putramukhaṃ paśyeyaṃ sāṃpratam | jātaḥ syānnāmajātā me kulavaṃśasthitirbhavet || 10.74{74} || kṛtyāni ca prakurvīta bibhṛyādbharaṇaṃ prati | nūnaṃ buddhānubhāvena satputro'pi bhaviṣyati || 10.75{75} || yadasmākaṃ kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ karma dānādikaṃ śubham | etatpuṇyānubhāvena bhavetkuśalametayoḥ || 10.76{76} || tatastena sadā bharttā saha saṃmodacāriṇī | pathyāhāropacāraiśca varddhito sukhacāriṇī || 10.77{77} || tataḥ sā samaye sūta putraṃ divyātisuṃdaram | darśanīyaṃ susaumyāṅgaṃ prāsādikaṃ manoharam || 10.78{78} || sarvāṅgalakṣaṇopetaṃ sadīnārakaradvayam | sarvasatvamanāpīśamabhirūpaṃ subhadrikam || 10.79{79} || tataḥ sā jananī tasya vālakasya karadvayam | dīnārāṃkitamālokya saharṣaṃ vismitābhavat || 10.80{80} || tato'sau janakaścāpi jātaṃ putramahādbhutam | sakhībhirveditaṃ śrutvā vismito draṣṭumāyayau || 10.81{81} || tataḥ prajāpatiḥ sāpi vismito svāmino'grataḥ | darśayitvā sutaṃ putraṃ śaṃkitaivaṃ nyavedayat || 10.82{82} || svāmiṃ paśya mahāścaryyamasya hemānvitau karau | tacchubhaṃ vāpyaśubhaṃ vā darśayitvā vicāraya || 10.83{83} || iti bhāryyoditaṃ śrutvā dṛṣṭvā taṃ vālakaṃ ciram | dīnāraṃ bhujayoḥ paśyaṃ tasthau savismayānvitaḥ || 10.84{84} || tatastasya gṛhastho'sau nimittaṃ jñātumādarāt | naimittikaṃ samāhūya dārakaṃ tamadarśayat || 10.85{86} || bhavanto dṛśyatāmasya dārakasya karadvayam | tannimittaṃ parijñāya tatphalaṃ vaktumarhatha || 10.86{86} || ityukte tena te sarve dṛṣṭvā taṃ dārakaṃ śubham | dīnāre bhujayoścāpi parijñāyaivamabravīt || 10.87{87} || sādho gṛhapate hyasya dārakasya karadvayam | suvarṇalakṣaṇopetaṃ tatte bhadraṃ bhavetkhalu || 10.88{88} || tavāyaṃ dārako dātā maheśākhyo bhavetkila | svahastaṃ saṃprasāryyaiva hemavṛṣṭiṃ kariṣyati || 10.89{89} || apanīya svayaṃ hastādidaṃ dīnāramarpayet | apanīte punaranyatprādurbhavettato'dhikam || 10.90{90} || ityevaṃ taiḥ samādiṣṭaṃ śrutvā saṃharṣito gṛhī | tato jātimahaṃ kṛtvā jñātīnevamabhāṣata || 10.91{91} || bhavanto dārakasyāsya śubhākṣarasamanvitam | nāmadheyaṃ yathāyogyaṃ kriyatāṃ saṃprasiddhitam || 10.92{92} || iti tenārthitaṃ śrutvā sarve te jñātayastathā | dṛṣṭvā tasya nimittāni saṃmatenaivamabruvan || 10.93{93} || yasmāddhastadvayo'pyasya hiraṇyenopalakṣitam | tannāmnā prasiddho'stu hiraṇyapāṇirityayam || 10.94{94} || evaṃ jñātisamudiṣṭaṃ śrutvāsau sa gṛhādhipaḥ | tatheti tasya putrasya cakre nāmavyavasthitam || 10.95{95} || tato hiraṇyapāṇiḥ sa dārakaḥ pratipālane | aṣṭāsu yo'pi dhātrīṣu tena pitrā samarpitaḥ || 10.96{96} || tābhiḥ prapālyamāno'sau pathyapuṣṭopacāraṇaiḥ | varddhito'bhūtkramādāśu hradasthamiva paṃkajam || 10.97{97} || tathā kramātpravṛddho'sau hiraṇyapāṇirātmavit | śrāddho bhadrāśayo dhīmān svaparārthahitārthikaḥ || 10.98{98} || tataḥ sa śikṣituṃ vidyāḥ sadguruṃ samupāśrayat | kramātteṣāṃ prasādācca vidyāpāraṃ yayau laghuḥ || 10.99{99} || tato'sau dārako vidvān dātā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ | svahastaṃ saṃprasāryyaiva dadau dānaṃ yathepsitam || 10.100{100} || gurubhyo brāhmaṇebhyaśca yācakebhyaḥ sa dārakaḥ | svahastaṃ saṃprasāryyaiva dadau hemaṃ yathepsitam || 10.101{1} || tathā taddānamākarṇya śravaṇabrāhmaṇādayaḥ | arthino dhanalubdhāśca saṃpratīyuḥ samaṃtataḥ || 10.102{2} || tathā taṃ samupetyaivaṃ sarvadigbhyaḥ samāgatāḥ | vālāvṛddhādayo dīnā yayācire yathepsitam || 10.103{3} || tadā hiraṇyapāṇiḥ sa dṛṣṭvaitānarthino mudā | sarvopakaraṇaiścāpi sarvāṃstān samatoṣayat || 10.104{4} || tataste yācakāḥ sarve tenaiva paritarpitāḥ | yathechayā sukhaṃ bhuktvā pracerurdharmamānasā || 10.105{5} || tathā vīthigataścaivaṃ hastadvayaṃ prasārya saḥ | hemarāśiṃ samutthāpya sarvebhyaḥ pradadau mudā || 10.106{6} || tathā sarve'pi te lokā dhanāḍhyāḥ sukhino'bhavan | naiko'bhūtkṛpano duḥkhī no'pi kaściddaridritaḥ || 10.107{7} || sarve'pi dhaninaḥ prāḍhyā dātāro bhogino'bhavan | satyadharmānuraktāśca saddharmaśravaṇārthinaḥ || 10.108{8} || tadā tasyaiva tatkīrttiḥ sarvatra bhuvaneṣvapi | lokairudgīryamāno'sau prasasāra samaṃtataḥ || 10.109{9} || taddṛṣṭvā brāhmaṇo lobhī mātsaryyaprahatāśayaḥ | tadyaśaḥ pratilabdhaṃ sa manasaivaṃ vyacintayat || 10.110{10} || yadasya bhujayorhema cintāmaṇisamaṃ khalu | tenāyaṃ bhavate śrīmān prārthitārthādhikapradaḥ || 10.111{11} || yaccāyaṃ dārakaḥ śrāddhaḥ prārthanāsaṃpradāyakaḥ | tadahaṃ prārthanāṃ kṛtvā pratigṛhṇīya tatmaṇim || 10.112{12} || ityasau manasā dhyatvā lobhākṛṣṭo tvarānvitaḥ | taṃ hiraṇyabhujaṃ pretya taddīnāraṃ samayācata || 10.113{13} || jayo'stu te sadā sādho dīrghāyuśca sumaṃgalam | tathaiva tvaṃ sadā bhūyā arthināṃ kalpapādapaḥ || 10.114{14} || tvatkīrttyā samāhūtaḥ prāgato'smi yadāśayā | tadarthaṃ pūrayitvā me cittaṃ harṣaya sarvataḥ || 10.115{15} || ityevaṃ prārthite tena vipreṇābhipragalbhinā | dṛṣṭvā hiraṇyapāṇiḥ sa taṃ vipraṃ pratyabhāṣata || 10.116{16} || sādhu vipra prasīda tvaṃ yadarthaṃ samupāgataḥ | tadarthaṃ saṃpradatvādya harṣayiṣyāmi te manaḥ || 10.117{17} || tacchaṃkā mā kṛthā hyatra yadyatte hṛdi rocate | tattannūnaṃ pradāsye te tadvadasva yadīhitam || 10.118{18} || iti tenoditaṃ śrutvā vipro'sau saṃpraharṣitaḥ | svastītyāśīrvaco datvā taddīnāramayācata || 10.119{19} || sādho hiraṇyapāṇe yattava hastasamudbhavam | taddīnāraṃ pradatvā me cittaṃ saṃharṣayārthadaḥ || 10.120{20} || iti tenoditaṃ śrutvā tatpitāsau suvismitaḥ | savandhujñātimitrastaṃ putramevamabhāṣata || 10.121{21} || śṛṇu putra mayā proktaṃ tavaiva hitakāraṇam | yadi te svāminī prītistatkarttavyaṃ hi sarvathā || 10.122{22} || tvaṃ hi putra mayā labdhaḥ saṃbuddhasyānubhāvataḥ | tatsaṃbuddhaśāsane kāryyameva dātu samarhasi || 10.123{23} || yaccedan bhujayorjātaṃ dīnāraṃ maṇisaṃnibham | tadapi sugatasyaiva prabhāvānmanyatāṃ khalu || 10.124{24} || yaccedaṃ te karodbhūtaṃ jīvitaṃ sahajendriyam | tatsvakarātsamuddhṛtya kathaṃ dadyā dvijātaye || 10.125{25} || yadīdaṃ dāsyate hastātsamuddhṛtya valādapi | tadā te jīvitaṃ vāpi sahānena vrajaṃ khalu || 10.126{26} || tasmādevaṃ parijñāya yadi te jīvita priyam | tadevaṃ sahajaṃ hema mā pradāhi dvijātaye || 10.127{27} || tadanyaddīyatāṃ tasmai yadyadvastu samīchitam | idaṃ tu sarvathānyasmai dātavyaṃ naiva yatnataḥ || 10.128{28} || yenaiva tvaṃ maheśākhyo sarvārthiprārthitārthadaḥ | tena yadā paribhraṣṭastadā kiṃ tena manyase || 10.129{29} || yenāpi ca tvayā sarve yācakāḥ saṃpratarpitāḥ | taccintāmaṇisāmānyaṃ kathaṃ dātuṃ samichasi || 10.130{30} || yattvayā sukṛtaṃ karma prakṛtvā puṇyamācitam | nūnaṃ tasya vipākatvaṃ bhuṃjayoste pratiṣṭhitam || 10.131{31} || tasmādidaṃ mahāratnaṃ kasmiñcinmā pradīyatām | datvā tvidaṃ mahāratnaṃ kimanyallabdhamichasi || 10.132{32} || yadi tvidaṃ mahāratnaṃ dātumevaṃ pratiṣṭhitam | saṃpradehi jinendrāya tatpuṇyamakṣayaṃ vahum || 10.133{33} || puṇyena labhyate janma śuddhavamṣe mahatkule | puṇyena dīyate kīrttiṃ nirvṛtiṃ ca samāpnuyāt || 10.134{34} || yadi puṇye'sti te vāṃchā tadbuddhaśaraṇaṃ gataḥ | dehi buddhānuśāsinyā taddānaṃ hi mahatphalam || 10.135{35} || tato nityaṃ sukhaṃ bhuktvā kṛtvā saṃbodhisādhanam | kramādbodhicariṃ prāpte nirvṛtiṃ vā samāpnuyāḥ || 10.136{36} || iti pitrā samādiṣṭaṃ śrutvāsau hemabhṛtsudhīḥ | tatheti niścayaṃ kṛtvā punarevamabhāṣata || 10.137{37} || satyaṃ tāta tvayādiṣṭaṃ tatsarvaṃ hitameva me | tasmāttathā cariṣyāmi tvadājñāṃ śirasā vahan || 10.138{38} || kiṃ tu satyaṃ mayā proktāmidaṃ dātuṃ dvijātaye | tatkathamanyathā kṛtvā puṇyameva samāpnuyāt || 10.139{39} || tatsatyaṃ pūraṇe tāta pradadyāmi mamātmanaḥ | atha na dāsyate hyatra kiyatkālaṃ hi jīvitam || 10.140{40} || yadidaṃ bhujayorhemaṃ mamātmasahasaṃbhavam | tathaivaṃ sahajīvena vinakṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 10.141{41} || yathedaṃ tu mahāratnaṃ mama devasamudbhavam | tathaivaṃ saṃpradatvāsmai punaḥ prāpsyāmi te'dhikam || 10.142{42} || yathā buddhānubhāyena saṃjātaṃ karayoridam | tathā satyānubhāvena punaranyajjaniṣyate || 10.143{43} || dharmeṇa tuṣyate buddho mūlaṃ dharmasya satyavāk | tatsatyapāraṇārthena dāsyāmyahamidaṃ maṇim || 10.144{44} || satyaṃ vinā na phullante puṇyāni prakṛtānyapi | mlānibhūtāni naśyante śasyānīvāmṛtaṃ vinā || 10.145{45} || satyena varddhate dharmaṃ dharmeṇa pālyate naraḥ | dharmiṣṭhaḥ sadgatiṃ yāti tasmātsatyaṃ mahadvalī || 10.146{46} || tasmātsatyavalenātra yaśodharmārthalabdhaye | sarvathāsmai pradāsyāmi mā kṛthāstaṃ nivāraṇam || 10.147{47} || iti putravacaḥ śrutvā pitā sa vismayānvitaḥ | tathetyabhyanumoditvā tasthau tūṣṇī vilokayan || 10.148{48} || tato hiraṇyapāṇiḥ sa matvā pitrādhivāsitam | taddīnāraṃ sahasotkṛtya viprāya pradadau mudā || 10.149{49} || tatpradattamasau vipraḥ pratigṛhya pramoditaḥ | datvāśīrvacanaṃ tasmai svagṛhaṃ sahasā yayau || 10.150{50} || tataścānantaraṃ tasya bhuje'nyattadguṇādhikam | dīnāraṃ divyaratnābhaiḥ prādurāsīnmahādbhutam || 10.151{51} || taddattānaṃtarodbhūtaṃ dīnāraṃ tadguṇādhikam | dṛṣṭvā śrutvā ca sarve te lokā āśu suvismitāḥ || 10.152{52} || tato hiraṇyapāṇiḥ sa evaṃ lokān praharṣayan | saṃbuddhaśāsane dātuṃ jetavanamupācarat || 10.153{53} || tatra bhikṣūn yatīn dṛṣṭvā saddharmacaraṇotsukaḥ | saṃbuddhaṃ sugataṃ draṣṭuṃ vihāraṃ samupāviśat || 10.154{54} || tatrāsau bhagavantaṃ tamadrākṣītsamitisthitam | dvātriṃśallakṣaṇāśītivyaṃjanaiḥ parimaṃḍitam || 10.155{55} || vyāmaprabhāsamujvālaṃ sahasreṇādhikaprabham | śānteṃdriyaṃ subhadrāṃgaṃ saumyarūpaṃ manoharam || 10.156{56} || dṛṣṭvāsau suprasannātmā sahasā samupāgataḥ | natvā pādau munestasya purastātsamupāśrayan || 10.157{57} || tatrāsau bhagavān tasya dṛṣṭvāśayaviśuddhatām | ādimadhyāntakalyāṇaṃ dideśa dharmamuttamam || 10.158{58} || taṃ dharmaṃ sugatādiṣṭaṃ śrutvāsau saṃpramoditaḥ | ānaṃdaṃ samupāśritya praṇamyaivaṃ vyajijñapat || 10.159{59} || bhadanta dātumichāmi saṃghebhyo bhojanaṃ khalu | tadājñāṃ dehi me śāsta yadi te'sti kṛpā mayi || 10.160{60} || iti vijñāpite tena hiraṇyapāṇinā mudā | sa ānaṃdaḥ samālokya dārakaṃ taṃ samādiśat || 10.161{61} || sādhu vatsa mahābhāgyādbhadramālocitaṃ tvayā | yadyatra dāsyate bhojyaṃ kārṣāpaṇaṃ pradīyatām || 10.162{62} || evaṃkṛte tu te vatsa maṃgalaṃ sarvadā bhavet | ataśca durgatiṃ hitvā sadgatiṃ samavāpnuyāḥ || 10.163{63} || ityānaṃdasamādiṣṭe dārako'sau pramoditaḥ | svayaṃ hastau prasāryyaiva hemarāśiṃ vyadhātpunaḥ || 10.164{64} || tāṃ dṛṣṭvā bhikṣavaḥ sarve vismitāḥ saṃpraharṣitāḥ | taddravyaiḥ sādhayāmāsa bhojyāni surasāni ca || 10.165{65} || tataḥ sa dārako bhojyaistaiḥ praṇītasusādhitaiḥ | saṃbuddhapramukhaṃ sarvasāṃghikaṃ samatoṣayat || 10.166{66} || tato'sau bhojanānte ca saṃbuddhapramukhaṃ kramāt | sarvasaṃghaṃ praṇamyaivaṃ punastasthau kṛtāṃjaliḥ || 10.167{67} || tataḥ śrībhagavān dṛṣṭvā tasyāśayaviśuddhatām | āryyasatyaṃ samāyuktaṃ dideśa dharmamuttamam || 10.168{68} || tacchrutvā hemapāṇiḥ sa satkāyadṛṣṭiparvatam | prabhitvā jñānavajreṇa viṃśatiśikharodgatam || 10.169{69} || śrotāpattiphalaṃ prāpto dṛṣṭasatyo'bhavattataḥ | saṃbuddhasagaṇaṃ natvā svagehaṃ harṣito yayau || 10.170{70} || tatra sarvaṃ sa tadvṛttaṃ pitrorākhyāya harṣitaḥ | pravrajyācaraṇānujñāṃ pitarau pratyayācata || 10.171{71} || cittaṃ me rocate tāta pravrajyāvratasādhane | tadanujñāṃ pradattaṃ me hitaṃ mayi yadīcchatha || 10.172{72} || iti putroditaṃ śrutvā svātmajaṃ sa pitāvadat | mā kṛthā sahasā putra pravrajyācaraṇe manaḥ || 10.173{73} || pravrajyācaraṇe bhaikṣyaṃ duḥkhināmeva tadvratam | tvaṃ vṛddhimānmahādātā tatpravrajyāṃ kutaścareḥ || 10.174{74} || kiṃ vāpyate vivāhastvaṃ daharaśca kumārikaḥ | pravrajyā duṣkaraṃ sthānaṃ tatkathaṃ pracaretsutaḥ || 10.175{75} || tattāvattvaṃ yuvā putra vivāhitvā kulastriyam | bhuktvā saukhyaṃ yathākāmaṃ gṛhe dharmaṃ samācara || 10.176{76} || tato vaṃśaṃ samutpādya kulasthitiprasiddhaye | kuladharmaṃ pratisthāpya tataḥ pravraja vārddhikaḥ || 10.177{77} || yadā vṛddho daridraśca pravrajyāṃ hi tadā caret | yāvadyuvā samṛddhaśca tāvattvaṃ pravraja katham || 10.178{78} || saṃpattiḥ kṣaṇayauvanyametanmāravaladhruvam | tadetadā kathaṃ putra pravrajyāvratamācareḥ || 10.179{79} || ityetadduṣkaraṃ matvā pravrajyācaraṇe manaḥ | sarvathā tvaṃ vinirvārya kuladharmaṃ samācara || 10.180{80} || tataste maṃgalaṃ nityamimu putra bhaveddhruvam | yaśodharmasukhānvetya sadgatiṃ cāpyavāpnuyāḥ || 10.181{81} || iti pitroditaṃ śrutvā dārako'sau viśaṃkitaḥ | bodhayan pitaraṃ dharme punarevamabhāṣata || 10.182{82} || satyameva tathā tāta yadetadbhāṣyate tvayā | tathāpi śrūyatāṃ tāta yadabhiprāyakaṃ mama || 10.183{83} || anityaṃ khalu saṃsāraṃ jīvitaṃ cāpi bhaṃguram | kṣaṇadhvaṃsi śarīraṃ ca kṣaṇasaṃpadghanopamam || 10.184{84} || evaṃ paśyanahaṃ tāta saṃsārabhoganispṛhaḥ | pravrajyāvratamāśritya prāptumichāmi nirvṛtim || 10.185{85} || api ca dullabhaṃ janma mānuṣaṃ bhavacāriṇām | sarveṣāmapi jantūnāṃ maraṇaṃ sarvathā dhruvam || 10.186{86} || mānuṣye labhyamāne tu kuto dharmānubhāvanā | vinā dharmānubhāvena kathaṃ sadgatimāpnuyāt || 10.187{87} || saṃbuddho'pi sasaṃgho'yaṃ sthāsyati na sadeha ca | anyatrāpi vrajennūnaṃ nirvṛtiṃ vā gamiṣyati || 10.188{88} || saṃbuddhe nirvṛtiṃ yāte saddharmo'pi vinakṣyate | saddharmāntargate loke mlechadharmavalī bhavet || 10.189{89} || mlechadharmavalīkrānte sarvatra bhūmimaṃḍale | sarvalokāśca kāmāṃdhā bhaveyuḥ kleśamāninaḥ || 10.190{90} || tada dharmānusaṃvṛttau matiḥ kasyāpi no caret | pravrajyāsaṃvaraṃ dhartuṃ kaḥ samartho bhaviṣyati || 10.191{91} || naiva saṃyujyate cittaṃ pravrajyāsaṃvaraṃ vinā | aviśodhitacittātmā na yāyātparamāṃ gatim || 10.192{92} || taccittaye viśuddhyarthaṃ nirvāṇapadalabdhaye | pravrajyāsaṃvaraṃ dharttumichāmi tāta sāṃpratam || 10.193{93} || tadyadi me hitaṃ draṣṭumichasi tāta sarvadā | tadanujñāṃ samādātumarhasi mātra cāraye || 10.194{94} || iti puroditaṃ śrutvā pitā sa paribodhitaḥ | tathetyanumataṃ kṛtvābhavattūṣṇīvyavasthitaḥ || 10.195{95} || tadā tajjananī cāsau dṛṣṭvā taṃ sutamātmajam | snehādaśru vimocantī nivārayitumabravīt || 10.196{96} || hā putra kathamekānte māṃ vihāya kva yāsyase | mā putra sahasā gacha kiṃcitkālaṃ vinodaya || 10.197{97} || yāvajjīvāmyahaṃ tāta tāvanmā gāḥ kuhāpi ca | mṛtāyāṃ mayi bho putra tadā vrajasva vāṃchite || 10.198{98} || acireṇaiva māṃ mṛtyurgrahīṣyati na saṃśayaḥ | tāvadeva gṛhe sthitvā dānaṃ kurvan sukhaṃ vasa || 10.199{99} || iti mātroditaṃ śrutvā putro'sau parimoditaḥ | natvā tāṃ jananīmevaṃ bodhayitumabhāṣata || 10.200{100} || yattvayāmve rudantyevaṃ mṛtyunāma prakīrtitam | tena me coditaṃ cittaṃ pravrajyāvratasādhane || 10.201{1} || dhruvaṃ janmavatāṃ mṛtyurmṛtānāṃ janma ca dhruvam | parivarttini saṃsāre mṛtaḥ ko hi na jāyate || 10.202{2} || dharmiṣṭho vīryāvāṃścāpi maraṇaṃ yāti sarvataḥ | pāpiṣṭho nighnitaścāpi maraṇaṃ yāti sarvataḥ || 10.203{3} || dharmiṣṭhaḥ satsukhaṃ bhuktvā mṛto yātyeva sadgatim | pāpiṣṭho duḥkhatāṃ bhuktvā mṛto gachati durgatim || 10.204{4} || yadā saṃtyajate jantuḥ saṃsāraprāṇavāyunā | tadā saṃtyajyate sarvairvaṃdhumitrajanairapi || 10.205{5} || tadā na vidyate ko'pi hitakārī sahānugaḥ | dharma ekaḥ sahāyaḥ syātsarvatrāpi hitārthakṛt || 10.206{6} || tasmātmātaḥ prayatnena karttavyaṃ dharmamādarāt | dharmeṇa rakṣyate sarva ihāmutra sahāpi hi || 10.207{7} || dharmeṇaivābhipālyante vālavṛddhāturādayaḥ | dharmeṇa sudhṛtāḥ satvā nimagnā duḥkhasāgare || 10.208{8} || dharmeṇa jīyate duṣṭo dharmeṇa jīyate kaliḥ | dharmeṇa jīyate rāgo mṛtyurdharmeṇa jīyate || 10.209{9} || dharmeṇa sukule janma lakṣmī dharmeṇa sthīyate | vidyāyaśo'rthamoksāśca prāpyante dharmataḥ khalu || 10.210{10} || dharmaṃ tu saugataṃ kāryaṃ sarvalokahitaṃkaram | sugatasyāpi dharmeṣu pravrajyādharmamuttamam || 10.211{11} || yamāśritya mahāsatvā jitvā kleśagaṇān laghuḥ | sākṣādarhatpadaṃ prāpya vrajanti nirvṛtiṃ parām || 10.212{12} || iti matvā hi te sarve bhikṣavo bhavanispṛhāḥ | pravrajyāvratamāśritya bhavanti brahmacāriṇaḥ || 10.213{13} || tathātrāhaṃ samichāmi pravrajyāvratamuttamam | tadanujñāṃ pradatvā me nātra kāryo viṣāditaḥ || 10.214{14} || yadi na dīyate'nujñā tadapi no viyogataḥ | akasmānmṛtyunā ghrāya grasiṣyati puro hi naḥ || 10.215{15} || tadā kiṃ te kariṣyāmi mamāpi kiṃ kariṣyasi | kṛtvānuśocanāṃ caiva yāsyāmo maraṇaṃ dhruvam || 10.216{16} || iti mātaḥ parijñāya tadanujñāṃ pradehi me | viṣādaṃ mā kṛthā atra prasādīnī bhavetprabhu || 10.217{17} || tathā te maṃgalaṃ nityamihāmutrāpi saṃbhavet | ahaṃ ca saugataṃ dharmaṃ dhṛtvā nirvṛtimāpnuyām || 10.218{18} || iti putroditaṃ śrutvā mātāsau paribodhitā | tathānumodanāṃ kṛtvā tasthau tūṣṇīvyavasthitān || 10.219{19} || atha hiraṇyapāṇiḥ saḥ pitrormatvābhisaṃmatam | tayośca caraṇe natvā sahasā niryayau gṛhāt || 10.220{20} || tatra jñātigaṇāṃścāsau vandhumitrasuhṛjjanān | kṛpaṇātithisaṃghādiṃ vāṃchitārthairatoṣayat || 10.221{21} || tato'sau vāṃdhavān sarvān saṃtarpya paribodhayan | āśu jetavanaṃ gatvā vihāraṃ samupāviśat || 10.222{22} || tatrāsau sugataṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛtāṃjalipuṭo mudā | bhagavaṃtaṃ tamānamya pravrajyāṃ samayācata || 10.223{23} || namaste bhagavacchāsta bhavatāṃ caraṇaṃ vraje | tatpravrajyāvrataṃ datvā brahmacaryaṃ pradehi me || 10.224{24} || iti tenārthite'sau śrībhagavān tamabhāṣata | ehi bhikṣo kumāra tvaṃ brahmacaryaṃ carehi sa || 10.225{25} || iti prokto munīndro'sau pāṇinā tacchiraḥ spṛśan | samyakpravājayitvāśu svasaṃghe taṃ samagrahīt || 10.226{26} || ehīti proktamātre'pi jinendreṇa sa muṇḍitaḥ | khikkhirīpātrahastābhūclcīvaraprāvṛtaḥ sudhīḥ || 10.227{27} || tataḥ śikṣāsu śikṣitvā prāpyopasaṃpado'pi ca | vyāyacchadghaṭamānaśca samādhiṣu samāhitaḥ || 10.228{28} || tadidaṃ paṃcagaṃdaṃ ca bhavacakraṃ calācalam | viditvā sarvasaṃskāragatiścāpi vighāṭinī || 10.229{29} || bhiṃdan sarvamavidyāṅgaṃ prāpya vidyāḥ śubhaṃkarāḥ | pratisaṃvidguṇaprāpto jitakleśagaṇo yatiḥ || 10.230{30} || sākṣādarhatpadaṃ prāpya vītarāgo jitendriyaḥ | samaloṣṭasuvarṇaśca vāsīcaṃdanasaṃnibhaḥ || 10.231{31} || ākāśasamacittaśca nirvikalpo niraṃjanaḥ | saṃsārabhogyasatkāralābhalobhasunispṛhaḥ || 10.232{32} || paṃcābhijñapadaprāpto caturbrahmavihārikam | sadevāsuramartyānāṃ traidhātukanivāsinām || 10.233{33} || pūjyo mānyo'bhivaṃdyaśca babhūva sa hiraṇyabhṛt | tataste bhikṣavaḥ sarve dṛṣṭvā taṃ dārakaṃ yatim || 10.234{34} || vismitāḥ śrīghanaṃ natvā paprachustasya karmatām | bhagavan kena dharmeṇa hiraṇyapāṇirayaṃ sudhīḥ || 10.235{35} || sarvārthino hi saṃtarpya sākṣādarhan bhavatyapi | iti tairbhikṣubhiḥ pṛṣṭe bhagavān tān tathābravīt || 10.236{36} || śrūyatāṃ bhikṣavaḥ sarvairyuṣmābhirvismitāśayaiḥ | anena yatkṛtaṃ karma tanmayā kathyate'dhunā || 10.237{37} || purāsīdbhagavān buddhaḥ kāśyapo'rhanmunīśvaraḥ | sarvavidyādhipaḥ śāstā tathāgato vināyakaḥ || 10.238{38} || sasāṃghiko jinendro'sau vārāṇasīmupāśritaḥ | bodhicaryāṃ samādiśya kṛtvā dharmamayaṃ jagat || 10.239{39} || sarvāṇi buddhakāryāṇi samāpya nirvṛtiṃ yayau | tadā rājā kṛkī nāma matvā taṃ nirvṛtiṃ gatam || 10.240{40} || vidhivadagnisaṃskāraṃ kārayitvā mahārcanaiḥ | tatastaddhāturatnāni garbha āropya sādarāt || 10.241{41} || hemaratnamayaṃ stūpaṃ kārayāmāsa sa prabhuḥ | tatsusiddhaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya sadvidhānairmahotsavaiḥ || 10.242{42} || mahaścāpi tadā tatra sthāpayitvā bhajannṛpaḥ | tasminnāropyamānāyāṃ yaṣṭyāṃ pūjāparigrahī || 10.243{43} || kintavo kaṃdaro nāma nidadhe rūpakadvayam | tataḥ sa pādayornatvā praṇidhānaṃ vyadhāttathā || 10.244{44} || yanmayā śraddhayā bhaktyāropitaṃ rūpakadvayam | yatpuṇyaṃ ca vipākena jāyeyaṃ sukule sadā || 10.245{45} || karodbhavasuvarṇaiḥ saṃtarpayitvārthino janān | evaṃvidhaṃ ca śāstāramārogya samupāśritaḥ || 10.246{46} || etaddharmaṃ samāsādya prāpnuyāṃ paramāṃ gatim | tena puṇyavipākena praṇidhānena bhūyasā || 10.247{47} || hiraṇyapāṇirayaṃ dātā bhavatyarhaṃ sa sāṃpratam | evaṃ sarve'pi saṃsāre bhuṃjate karmajaṃ phalam || 10.248{48} || yenaivaṃ yatkṛtaṃ karma tenaiva bhuṃjyate phalam | abhuktaṃ kṣīyate naiva karma kvāpi kadā cana || 10.249{49} || śubhaṃ vāpyaśubhaṃ vāpi bhuktaṃ tu kṣīyate khalu | nāgnibhirdahyate karma klidyate nodakairapi || 10.250{50} || vāyubhiḥ śuṣyate nāpi bhūmiṣu kṣīyate na hi | anyathāpi bhavennaiva saṃsāre karmaṇo gatiḥ || 10.251{51} || śubhasya śubhataiva syātkṛṣṇasya kṛṣṇataiva hi | miśrasya miśritaiva syādanyathā na sadā bhavet || 10.252{52} || evaṃ matvātha saṃsāre caritavyaṃ sadā śubham | na praṇasyaṃti karmāṇi kalpakoṭiśatairapi || 10.253{53} || sāmagrīṃ prāpya kālaṃ ca phalanti prāṇināṃ khalu | ityasau bhagavān buddhaḥ satkarmadeśanāmataiḥ || 10.254{54} || tarpayan sa kalāṃllokān tato viśrāntamādadhau | iti śāstroditaṃ śrutvā sarve te bhikṣusāṃghikāḥ || 10.255{55} || śubheṣveva sadā nityaṃ saṃpraceruḥ samāhitaḥ | mahārāja tvayāpyevaṃ caritavyaṃ śubhe sadā || 10.256{56} || bodhayitvā prajāñcaivaṃ sthāpanīyāḥ śubhe sadā | tataste maṃgalaṃ nityaṃ sarvatrāpi bhavetkhalu | kramādbodhicarīṃ prāpya saṃbodhipadamāpuṇyāḥ || 10.257{57} || iti tena samādiṣṭaṃ śrutvā sa nṛpatīśvaraḥ | tathetyabhyanumoditvā prābhyanaṃdatsapārṣadaḥ || 10.258{58} || śṛṇvanti ye śrāvayantīha yaśca hiraṇyapāṇeravadānametat | te kleśamuktāḥ sugatānubhaktāḥ prayānti nūnaṃ sugatālayeṣu || 10.259{59} || iti śrīratnamālayāṃ hiraṇyapāṇyavadānaṃ nāma samāptaṃ hastakāvadāna athāśoko mahīpālaḥ kṛtāṃjalipuṭo mudā | upaguptaṃ guruṃ natvā bhūyo'pyevamabhāṣata || 11.1{1} || bhadanta śrotumichāmi punaranyatsubhāṣitam | yathā te guruṇākhyātaṃ tathā me vaktumarhasi || 11.2{2} || iti tena narendreṇa pṛṣṭo'sau sugatāṃśajaḥ | upagupto mahābhijñastaṃ nṛpaṃ pratyabhāṣata || 11.3{3} || śṛṇu rājanmahābhāga yathā me guruṇoditam | tathāhaṃ te pravakṣyāmi tadanumodanāṃ kuru || 11.4{4} || puraikasamaye caivaṃ śrīghano'sau tathāgataḥ | saṃbuddhaḥ sugataḥ śāstā sarvadharmānudeśakaḥ || 11.5{5} || śrāvastyāṃ vahirudyāne jetavane manorame | anāthapiṇḍadodyāne vihāre sugatāśrame || 11.6{6} || bhikṣubhiḥ śrāvakaiḥ sārddhamupāsakaiśca cailakaiḥ | bodhisatvairmahāsatvaistadanyaiśca maharṣibhiḥ || 11.7{7} || vyaharatsarvahitārthāya dharmāmṛtaṃ pravarṣayan | tatsaddharmāmṛtaṃ pātuṃ prayayurbodhikāminaḥ || 11.8{8} || lokapālā mahārājā svasvasainyajanaiḥ saha | brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāśca maṃtriṇo janāḥ || 11.9{9} || amātyāḥ sādhavaḥ paurā dhaninaśca mahājanāḥ | vaṇijaḥ sārthavāhāśca tathānye sarvajātikāḥ || 11.10{10} || sarvadigbhyaḥ samāgatya sarve te samupāgatāḥ | taṃ buddhaṃ sugataṃ nāthaṃ pūjayitvā samaṃtataḥ || 11.11{11} || parivṛtya purodhāya śakhyāviguṇakāmitāḥ | kṛtāṃjalipuṭo tasthuḥ saddharmacaraṇotsukāḥ || 11.12{12} || athāsau bhagavān dṛṣṭvā tān sarvān samupasthitān | ādimadhyāntakalyāṇaṃ dideśa dharmamuttamam || 11.13{13} || tatsaddharmāmṛtaṃ pītvā sarve lokādhipādayaḥ | harṣitāste'numodanto vabhūvuḥ paribodhitāḥ || 11.14{14} || tadaiva samaye tasyāṃ śrāvastyāṃ purisaṃbhavaḥ | āsīdgṛhapatiḥ prāḍhyaḥ kuveravatsamṛddhimān || 11.15{15} || śrāddho dātā mahābhogī sarvahitārthabhṛt | triratnasevako dhīmān suviśālaparigrahaḥ || 11.16{16} || saṃgṛhī vidhivadbhāryāṃ svakuladharmacāriṇī | pariṇītā yathākāmaṃ saṃrame paricārayan || 11.17{17} || tasyāsau ramaṇī bhāryā saṃvṛttā garbhiṇī satī | asūta samaye putraṃ prāsādikaṃ manoharam || 11.18{18} || sa ca jātismaro vālo jātamātraḥ svakau bhujau | saṃdṛṣṭvāliṃgya cuṃvitvā pariṣvajyaivamabravīt || 11.19{19} || aho vatādya me hastau sucireṇa samudbhavau | aho labdhāvimau hastau sucireṇa mayādhunā || 11.20{20} || tenaivaṃ jātamātreṇa dṛṣṭaṃ kṛtaṃ prabhāṣitam | dṛṣṭvā śrutvā ca sā mātā trāsitā vismitābhavat || 11.21{21} || kimetaditi saṃtrastā dṛṣṭvā taṃ dārakaṃ mudā | bharttāraṃ sahasāhūya agramenamadarśayat || 11.22{22} || tadāsau dārakaścāpi dṛṣṭvā taṃ janakaṃ mudā | hastau dṛṣṭvā tathāliṃgya cuṃvayitvā caivamabravīt || 11.23{23} || aho vatādya me hastau sucireṇa samudbhavau | aho labdhāvimau hastau sucireṇa mayādhunā || 11.24{24} || iti saṃdarśayaṃ hastāvevaṃ cāpyavadacchiśuḥ | dārako'sau punaḥ supto nidrāṃ bheje yadichayā || 11.25{25} || tato'sau janako'pyetaddṛṣṭvā śrutvā pravismitaḥ | kimetaditi sāśaṃkā jñātināhūya cābravīt | bhavanto'dya prajātaṃ me putraratnaṃ manoharam | tannimittaṃ nirīkṣyaitatsatyaṃ me vaktumarhatha | iti tenoditaṃ śrutvā sarve te jñātayo mudā | tatputraṃ dārakaṃ draṣṭuṃ tatkoṣṭhaṃ samupādiśat | tathāsau dārakaścaivaṃ tān dṛṣṭvā samupasthitān | bhujau paśyan pariṣvajya cuṃvitvaivamabhāṣata | aho vatādya me hastau sucireṇa mayādhunā | bhavanto'rhatsu mā cittaṃ dūṣayata kadā cana | kharāṃ vācaṃ ca mārhatsu niścārayata sarvadā | evaṃ saṃdarśayaṃ hastau vacanaṃ saṃvadaṃ śiśuḥ | dārako'sau punaḥ supto nidrāṃ bheje yadichayā | etatte jñātayo dṛṣṭvā śrutvā sarve'pi vismitāḥ | kimetaditi bhāṣanto vabhūvuḥ parisaṃkitāḥ || 11.26{26} || tataste jñātayaḥ sarve vijñāya tasya lakṣaṇam | saṃmīlya tamupāmaṃtrya gṛhasthaḥ pratiharṣitaḥ || 11.27{27} || tasya jātimahaṃ kṛtvā punarevamavocata | bhadanto dārakasyāsya nāmadheyaṃ pramāṇataḥ || 11.28{28} || yathāyogyaprasiddhena karttumarhatha sāṃpratam | iti tenoditaṃ śrutvā sarve te jñātayastataḥ || 11.29{29} || saṃmīlya saṃmataṃ kṛtvā taṃ gṛhasthaṃ samabruvan | yadayaṃ te suto vālo jātamātraḥ svakau bhujau || 11.30{30} || paśyanāliṃgyā cuṃvitva mudā caivaṃ prabhāṣate | tadayaṃ dārako nāmnā hastaka iti viśrutaḥ || 11.31{31} || bhavatu sarvalokeṣu suciraṃ cāpi jīvatu | tatheti pratinaṃditvā gṛhastho'sau pramoditaḥ || 11.32{32} || tena nāmnā prasiddhena prathayāmāsa taṃ sutam | tato'sau dārakastena pitrā putrābhinaṃditaḥ | upanyastopadhātrīṣu dhāraṇapratipālane || 11.33{33} || tatastāsāṃ prayatnaiḥ sa pathyopacāraṇaiḥ kramāt | dine dine pravṛddho'bhūdhradasthamiva paṃkajam || 11.34{34} || evaṃ sa hastakastābhiḥ pālyamānaḥ pravarddhitaḥ | kumāraḥ sakhibhiḥ sārddhaṃ krīḍāsthānaṃ gato'ramat || 11.35{35} || tatra teṣāṃ sakhīnāṃ ca hastako'sau puraḥsthitaḥ | hastāvāliṃgya saṃrakṣya cuṃvitvaivamabhāṣata || 11.36{36} || aho vatādya me hastau sucireṇa samudbhavau | aho labdhāvimau hastau sucireṇa mayādhunā || 11.37{37} || bhavanto'rhatsu mā cittaṃ dūṣayata kadācana | kharāṃ vācaṃ ca mārhatsu niścārayata keṣu cit || 11.38{38} || iti saṃrakṣitau hastau tenaivaṃ ca prabhāṣitam | dṛṣṭvā śrutvābhavan sarve sakhāyātīvavismitāḥ || 11.39{39} || tataśca janakenāsau lipiśālāniveśitaḥ | guruṃ samyagupāśritya vidyāpāraṃ yayau laghu || 11.40{40} || tatra teṣāṃ guruṇāṃ ca hastako'sau puraḥsthitaḥ | hastau dṛṣṭvā samāliṃgya cuṃvitvā caivamabravīt || 11.41{41} || aho vatādya me hastau sucireṇa samudbhavau | aho labdhavimau hastau sucireṇa mayādhunā || 11.42{42} || bhavanto'rhatsu mā cittaṃ dūṣayata kadā cana | kharāṃ vācaṃ ca mārhatsu niścārayata keṣu cit || 11.43{43} || iti dṛṣṭvā ca saṃśrutya sarve te guravo'pi ca | sarve śiṣya gaṇāścāpi vabhūvurvismayānvitāḥ | yasmiṃśca samaye tatra deśe bhayaupakrame | janakāyaḥ samudbhrānto'gopāyatsvasvabhāṇḍakam | tadāsau hastako'pyevaṃ samudbhrāntaḥ svakau bhujau | saṃbhujya gopayitvaivaṃ janakāyamabhāṣata | aho vatādya me hastau sucireṇa samudbhavau | aho labdhāvimau hastau sucireṇa mayādhunā | bhavanto'rhatsu mā cittaṃ dūṣayata kadā cana | kharāṃ vācaiva mārhatsu niścārayata keṣu cit | evaṃ hastau susaṃrakṣya tenaivaṃ ca prabhāṣitam | dṛṣṭvā śrutvā ca te sarve lokā āsan suvismitāḥ || 11.44{44} || tato'sau hastako'nyasmiṃ divase sakhibhiḥ saha | jetavanaṃ mahodyānaṃ jināśrame upāyayau || 11.45{45} || tatrādrākṣītmahābuddhaṃ bhagavantaṃ sabhāsthitam | dvātriṃśallakṣaṇāśītivyaṃjanaiḥ parimaṃḍitam || 11.46{46} || vyāmaprabhāsamuddīptaṃ śatasūryādhikaprabham | śāntendriyaṃ subhadrāṃgaṃ saumyakāntaṃ manoharam || 11.47{47} || dṛṣṭvāsau suprasannātmā sahasā samupāgataḥ | pādau tasya munernatvā dharmaṃ śrotuṃ puro'viśat || 11.48{48} || tato'sau bhagavān tasya dṛṣṭvāśayaṃ viśodhitam | ādimadhyāntakalyāṇaṃ dideśa dharmamuttamam || 11.49{49} || taṃ sugatoditaṃ dharmamāryyasatyasamanvitam | śrutvāsau hastako vijñaḥ satkāyadṛṣṭiparvatam || 11.50{50} || saṃbhidya jñānavajreṇa viṃśatiśikharodgatam | śrotāpattiphalaṃ prāpto dṛṣṭasatyo'bhavattataḥ || 11.51{51} || saṃbuddhasugataṃ natvā svagehaṃ sahasā yayau || 11.52{52} || tatraitatsarvavṛttāṃtaṃ pitrorājñāya harṣitaḥ | pravrajyāsādhane'nujñāṃ pitarau pratyayācata || 11.53{53} || cittaṃ me rocate tāta pravrajyāvratasādhane | tadanujñāṃ pradattaṃ me hitaṃ mayi yadīchatha || 11.54{54} || iti putroditaṃ śrutvātmajaṃ taṃ pitāvadat | mā kṛthāḥ sahasā putra pravrajyāsādhane manaḥ || 11.55{55} || pravrajyā duṣkaraṃ sthānaṃ tadanyadvratamācara | pravrajyāgrahaṇaṃ vṛddhe daridrite suśobhite || 11.56{56} || tvaṃ ca putra kumāro'si daharo'tisukomalaḥ | kiṃcidduḥkhe'nabhijñāya tatpravrajyāṃ careḥ katham || 11.57{57} || tadyāvadyauvanaṃ dehaṃ yāvatsaṃpacca te gṛhe | tāvadgehe sukhaṃ bhuktvā gṛhī dharmaṃ samācara || 11.58{58} || yadā vṛddho daridro ca pravrajyāyāṃ tadā cara | yāvadyuvā samṛddhaśca tāvattvaṃ pravrajeḥ katham || 11.59{59} || saṃpattikṣaṇayauvanyametanmārasya gocaram | tadetasmiṃ kathaṃ putra pravrajyāvratamācareḥ || 11.60{60} || ityetadduṣkaraṃ matvā pravrajyācaraṇe manaḥ | yatnenāpi vinivārya kuladharme samāśraya || 11.61{61} || tataste maṃgalaṃ nityamihāmutrāpi sarvataḥ | yaśodharmasukhānyevaṃ sadgatiṃ samavāpnuyāḥ || 11.62{62} || iti vākyaṃ pituḥ śrutvā hastako'sau viśaṃkitaḥ | pitarau bodhayan dharme punarevamabhāṣata || 11.63{63} || satyametattathā tāta tvayaivaṃ satyamucyate | atrāpi śrūyatāṃ tāta mamābhiprāyamucyatām || 11.64{64} || anityaṃ khalu saṃsāraṃ jīvitaṃ cāpi caṃcaram | kṣaṇadhvaṃsi śarīraṃ ca saṃpaccāpi ghanopamā || 11.65{65} || evaṃ dṛṣṭvā ha tātāhaṃ saṃsārasukhaniḥspṛhaḥ | pravrajyāvratamādhāya prāptumichāmi sadgatim || 11.66{66} || api ca janma mānuṣyaṃ dullabhaṃ bhavacāriṇām | tatrāpi maraṇaṃ nityaṃ purataḥ sarvasaṃmukham || 11.67{67} || mānuṣyaṃ labhyamāne hi kuto dharmānucāritam | vinā dharmānucāreṇa sadgatiṃ kathamāpnuyām || 11.68{68} || saṃbuddho'pi sadā nātra saṃsthāpyati sasāṃghikaḥ | ato'nyatrāpi yāyādvā nirvṛtiṃ cāvrajetkhalu || 11.69{69} || saṃbuddhe nirvṛtiṃ yāte saddharma lapsyate kutaḥ | saddharmāntargate loke māracaryyā samācaret || 11.70{70} || māracaryyāsamākrānte sarvatra bhuvaneṣvapi | sarve satvāśca kāmārttā bhaveyuḥ kleśabhāginaḥ || 11.71{71} || tadā dharmānucāreṣu buddhiḥ kasya kathaṃ caret | pravrajyāsaṃvaraṃ sthātuṃ kaḥ samartho bhavettadā || 11.72{72} || na ca saṃśuddhyate cittaṃ pravrajyāsaṃvaraṃ vinā | aviśodhitacitte hi naiva yāyācchivāṃ gatim || 11.73{73} || taccittapariśuddhyarthaṃ nirvṛte ca yadāptaye | pravrajyāvratamādātumichāmi tāta sāṃpratam || 11.74{74} || yadatra yadi me tāta hitaṃ kartuṃ samichasi | pravrajyāsādhane'nujñāṃ dātuṃ me prārhasi drutam || 11.75{75} || iti putravacaḥ śrutva sa gṛhastho'nubodhitaḥ | tathetyabhyanumoditvā tadanujñāṃ vyasṛjata || 11.76{76} || tacchrutvā jananī cāsau dṛṣṭvā taṃ putramātmajam | viyogaduḥkhasaṃkārtā rundantyevaṃ nyavārayat || 11.77{77} || hā putra kathamekānte māṃ vihāya kva yāsyasi | sahasā putra mā kārṣī pravrajyācaritaṃ manaḥ || 11.78{78} || yāvajjīvāmyahaṃ jīva tāvanmā pravrajātmaje | mṛtāyāṃ mayi putra tvaṃ pravrajasva yathechayā || 11.79{79} || acireṇa hi me mṛtyurbhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ | tāvadeva gṛhe dharmaṃ kurvan bhuktvā sukhaṃ vasa || 11.80{80} || iti māturvacaḥ śrutvā putro'sau paricoditaḥ | mātaraṃ tāṃ praṇatvaivaṃ bodhayitumabhāṣata || 11.81{81} || yattvayāmve rudantyevaṃ mṛtyunāmātra kīrttyate | tena me preritaṃ cittaṃ pravrajyāvratadhāraṇe || 11.82{82} || dhruvaṃ janmavatāṃ mṛtyuḥ saṃsāre parivarttinaḥ | jāto na mriyate ko hi mṛtaḥ kaśca na jāyate || 11.83{83} || gṛhastho dharmakṛccāpi yātyevaṃ maraṇaṃ dhruvam | brahmacārī vanastho'pi yātyevaṃ maraṇaṃ khalu || 11.84{84} || gṛhastho bahubhiryatnaiḥ prakṛtvā dravyasādhanam | kṛcchreṇa sādhayan dharmaṃ mṛto yāti surālayam || 11.85{85} || yāvaddharmaphalaṃ svarge tāvadbhuktvā sukhaṃ vaset | tato dharmaphale hīne svargāccyuto yatedadhaḥ || 11.86{86} || adholokeṣvavīcyādau narakeṣu bhramecciram | vividhāni ca duḥkhāni bhuktvā jīvaṃ ciraṃ vaset || 11.87{87} || yāvanna jāyate tasya puṇyānumodanā matau | tāvatkarmajaduḥkhāni prabhuktvā narake caret || 11.88{88} || yadā tu jāyate tasya triratnasmaraṇe matiḥ | tadā tatsmṛtipuṇyena dharme'numodyate matiḥ || 11.89{89} || yadā puṇyānurāgeṇa saṃbuddhaśaraṇaṃ vrajet | tadā taṃ sugataṃ dṛṣṭvā dharmākaraiḥ parispṛśet || 11.90{90} || sugate dṛkprabhāspṛṣṭe pāpaduḥkhairvimocitaḥ | narakebhyaḥ samuttīrya prayāyātsugatālayam || 11.91{91} || tatrāpi yadi dharmeṣu carannityamataṃdritaḥ | kramādbodhicarīṃ prāpya prayāyātparamāṃ gatim || 11.92{92} || evaṃ māta gṛhastho hi kṛtvāpi dharmamādarāt | sukhaduḥkhāni saṃbhuktvā saṃsāre carate bhraman || 11.93{93} || kathaṃ citsucireṇaivaṃ sugatasya prasādataḥ | bhavacārakanirmuktaṃ prayāyātparamāṃ gatim || 11.94{94} || pravrajyārhatpadaṃ prāpya prāptumichāmi nirvṛtim | tanmamātra tvayā māta naiva kāryā nivāraṇā || 11.95{95} || yadi puṇye'sti te vāṃchā tadanujñāśu dīyatām | yadi na dīyate'nujñā tadapi nau viyogatā || 11.96{96} || akasmātmṛtyurāgatya bhaviṣyati purāpi nau | tadā te kiṃ kariṣyāmi kiṃ mamāpi kariṣyasi || 11.97{97} || sadānuśocanāmeva kṛtvā jīvaṃ tyajevahi | iti mātarviditvā tvaṃ tadanujñāṃ pradehi me || 11.98{98} || vighnatāṃ mā kṛthā hyatra dharme bhavānumodinī | tathā cecchubhatā nityamihāmutrāpi te bhavet || 11.99{99} || ahaṃ ca saugatiṃ caryāṃ kṛtvā yāsyāmi nirvṛtīm | iti putroditaṃ śrutvā matāsau paribodhitā || 11.100{100} || tathānumodanāṃ kṛtvābhavattūṣṇīvyavasthitā || 11.101{1} || athāsau hastako vijñaḥ pitrormatvābhisaṃmatam | tayoḥ pādān praṇatvaivaṃ sahasā niryayau gṛhāt || 11.102{2} || tato jñātigaṇān sarvān vandhumitrasuhṛjjanān | sarvānatithivargāṃśca vāṃchitārthaiḥ pratoṣayan || 11.103{3} || santarpya bodhayitvā ca sahasā saṃpraharṣitaḥ | jetavanaṃ pragatvā sa vihāraṃ samupāviśat || 11.104{4} || tatrasthaṃ sugataṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasā samupāyataḥ | kṛtāṃjalipuṭo natvā pravrajyāṃ samayācata || 11.105{5} || namaste bhagavannātha bhavatāṃ śaraṇaṃ vraje | tatpravrajyāṃ vrataṃ dehi cariṣye brahmasaṃvaram || 11.106{6} || iti tenārthite buddho bhagavān tamabhāṣata | ehi bhikṣo kumārātra cara brahmavrataṃ varam || 11.107{7} || ityādiśya munīndro'sau pāṇinā tacchiraḥ spṛśan | samyakpravrājayitvāśu svasaṃghe taṃ samagrahīt || 11.108{8} || ehītyādiṣṭamātre'pi munīndreṇa sa hastakaḥ | muṇḍitaḥ khiṣkhirīpātrahasto'bhūccīvarāvṛtaḥ || 11.109{9} || kramācchikṣā samāsādya prāpyopasaṃpado'pi ca | vyāyaccha ghaṭamānaśca samādhiṣu samāhitaḥ || 11.110{10} || tadidaṃ paṃcagaṃḍaṃ ca bhavacakraṃ calācalam | viditvā sarvasaṃskāragatiścāpi vighātinī || 11.111{11} || bhindan sarvamavidyāṅgaṃ prāpya vidyāgaṇāḥ śivāḥ | pratisaṃvidguṇāḥ prāpya jitvā kleśagaṇāṃ yatiḥ || 11.112{12} || sākṣādarhatpadaṃ prāptaḥ vītarāgo jiteṃdriyaḥ | samaloṣṭahiraṇyaśca vāsīcaṃdanasaṃnibhaḥ || 11.113{13} || ākāśasamacittāṃgo nirvikalpo niraṃjanaḥ | saṃsārabhogyasatkāralābhalobhaparāṅmukhaḥ || 11.114{14} || paṃcābhijñāpadaprāptaścaturbrahmavihārakaḥ | sadevāsuramartyānāṃ traidhātukanivāsinām || 11.115{15} || pūjyo mānyo'bhivaṃdyo'bhūddhastako'rhaṃ yatiḥ sudhīḥ | sahasā kleśagaṇāñjitvā sākṣādarhan bhavatyapi || 11.116{16} || tataste bhikṣavaḥ sarve dṛṣṭvā taṃ dārakaṃ yatim | vismitāḥ śrīghanaṃ natvā paprachustasya karmatām || 11.117{17} || tadadya bhagavacchāstaḥ sarvasatvānubodhaye | yadanena kṛtaṃ karma tatsamādeṣṭumarhati || 11.118{18} || iti te bhikṣubhiḥ pṛṣṭe bhagavān sa munīśvaraḥ | tān svaśiṣyān yatīn bhikṣūn samāmaṃtryābravīttathā || 11.119{19} || śṛṇudhvaṃ bhikṣavaḥ sarve yūyaṃ hi vismayānvitāḥ | yadanena kṛtaṃ karma tanmayā vaḥ pracakṣyatām || 11.120{20} || purāsīdbhagavān buddhaḥ kāśyapo nāma sarvavit | ssarvatraidhātukādhīśaḥ sarvavidyādhipo jinaḥ || 11.121{21} || dharmarājo jagacchāstā tathāgato vināyakaḥ | sarvadharmānusaṃbharttā saṃbodhisaṃprakāśitaḥ || 11.122{22} || sasāṃghiko munīndro'sau vārāṇasīmupāśritaḥ | sarvasatvahitārthena tasthau dharmaṃ samādiśat || 11.123{23} || tasya saddharmarājasya kāśyapasya jagadguroḥ | śāsane dvau yatī bhikṣū saṃśītikau vabhūvatuḥ || 11.124{24} || tayoreko mahādhīro vinīto'rhaṃ vahuśrutaḥ | dvitīyo'lpaśrutaḥ bhikṣuḥ pṛthagjanasamānikaḥ || 11.125{25} || yo'sāvarhanmahāvijño vahuśruto vicakṣaṇaḥ | sa jñāto'rhanmahāpuṇyaḥ sarvalokaiḥ prapūjitaḥ || 11.126{26} || yo'bhūccālpaśruto bhikṣuḥ saṃśītikaḥ pṛthagjanaḥ | sa kena citpūjito naivaṃ yathā so'rhaṃ yatiḥ sudhīḥ || 11.127{27} || yadā so'rhanmahābhijño yatra yatra nimaṃtritaḥ | tenaiva sarvataḥ paścācchramanena sahācarat || 11.128{28} || tathānyasmin dine so'rhaṃ dātrānyena nimaṃtritaḥ | gantukāmastadā tatra paścācchramaṇamaicchata || 11.129{29} || tadāgamanamanviṣya naiva pratyalabhatkvacit | tatastaddarśanābhāvādanyamāhūya bhikṣukam || 11.130{30} || taṃ paścācchramaṇaṃ kṛtvā dāturgṛhamupācarat | tadanantaramevāsau tatrāśrame upāgataḥ || 11.131{31} || tamarhantamapaśyan sa tasthau tūṣṇī nirāśitaḥ | tathaivaṃ taṃ niṣīdantaṃ dṛṣṭvā te bhikṣavo narāḥ || 11.132{32} || tasyauddhatyamanaḥ kartumevamūcuḥ parasparam | bhadanta paśyatādyāyaṃ tenāhato na nīyate || 11.133{33} || anyo'dya nīyate paścācchramaṇaḥ kena hetunā | iti tairbhikṣubhiḥ proktaṃ śrutvāsau pratibheditaḥ | tasyārhato'ntike cittaṃ praduṣyābhyaśapattathā || 11.134{34} || yadadya māṃ parityajya samāhūyānyato harāt | gachata bhojanaṃ bhoktuṃ tadahasto bhavatvasau || 11.135{35} || tadāsau bhojanaṃ bhuktvā tenaivaṃ bhikṣuṇā saha | svāśramaṃ samupāyātastamadrākṣīdruṣākulam || 11.136{36} || ityevaṃ śapitaṃ vāpi matvā so'rhaṃ mahāmatiḥ | dṛṣṭvā taṃ kṛpayā dṛṣṭyā tūṣṇībhūtvā vyaciṃtayat || 11.137{37} || aho ayaṃ mahāmūḍha īdṛgmayi prabhāṣate | etatkarmaphalaṃ ghoraṃ kathaṃ bhokṣyati nārake || 11.138{38} || yadayaṃ mama doṣeṇa krodhenaivaṃ khalīkṛtaḥ | tadetatkarmavaipākyaṃ mayaiva paripācyatām || 11.139{39} || ityevaṃ manasā dhyātvā sa mahārhaṃ kṛpānidhiḥ | tatpāpapariśuddhyarthaṃ samādhiṃ vidadhe ciram || 11.140{40} || tataḥ so'pyayatirbhikṣurdṛṣṭvā taṃ dhyānasaṃsthitam | paścāttāpāgnisaṃtaptestatpādapraṇato'vadat || 11.141{41} || bhadanta yanmayā rauṣyātkrodhābhibhūtacetasā | procitaṃ pātakaṃ ghoraṃ tadbhavān kṣantumarhati || 11.142{42} || yanmayā duṣṭacittena bhavato'pyupabhāṣyate | tadatyayaṃ bhavāñchāstaḥ pratihartuṃ samarhati || 11.143{43} || adyāgreṇa sadā cāpi bhavatāṃ śaraṇaṃ vraje | tanme yadaparādhatvaṃ tatsarvaṃ kṣantumarhati || 11.144{43!} || punarnaitatkariṣye'hamakarttavyaṃ yadyatra hi | avaktavyaṃ ca yatkiṃ cinna tadvakṣyāmi sarvathā || 11.145{44} || abhāvyaṃ cāpi yatkiṃcidbhāvayiṣye na tatpunaḥ | yadeva taṃ prakarttavyaṃ tadeva hi karomyaham || 11.146{45} || vaktavyameva vakṣye'haṃ bhāvyameva prabhāvaye | etatsarvaṃ samāsena samādeṣṭuṃ samarhati || 11.147{46} || bhavadājñāṃ śirodhṛtvā satyamevaṃ caretsadā || 11.148{47!} || iti tenārthitaṃ śrutvā sa samādheḥ samutthitaḥ | taṃ bhikṣuṃ kṛpayā dṛṣṭvā paśyannevaṃ samabravīt || 11.149{48} || śṛṇu vatsa samādhāya tvāmatrāhaṃ prabodhaye | yathā me gaditaṃ śrutvā tathā kuru samāhitaḥ || 11.150{49} || prāṇihiṃsā na karttavyā tathādattapratigraham | strīṇāṃ saṃgānurāgaṃ ca akarttavyaṃ kadā cana || 11.151{50} || mṛṣāvādaṃ na vaktavyaṃ paiśūnyavacanaṃ tathā | saṃbhinnapralāpaṃ ca pāruṣyaṃ ca kadā cana || 11.152{51} || mithyādṛṣṭirabhidhyā ca vyāpādaṃ ca tathā sadā | bhikṣubhirmanasā naiva ciṃtanīyā kadā cana || 11.153{52} || etāni daśapāpānāṃ mūlāni duḥkhadāni hi | tasmādevaṃ parijñāya tyaktavyāni sukhārthibhiḥ || 11.154{53} || punaranyacchṛṇuṣvātra vakṣye dāruṇapātakam | saddharmāṇāṃ pratikṣepaṃ kartavyaṃ na kadā cana || 11.155{54} || tathā vāryāpavādatvaṃ vaktavyaṃ na kadā cana | paṃcānaṃtaryapāpāni naiva kāryāṇi kena cit || 11.156{55} || yāni śrutvāpi dṛṣṭvāpi bhāvayitvānumodya ca | patanto narakeṣveva kleśāndhāni ca santi hi || 11.157{56} || tasmādetāni karmāṇi mānasāpi ca mā kṛthā | varjanīyāni yatnena saddharmasukhavāṃchibhiḥ || 11.158{57} || karttavyaṃ tu sadā nityamāryasatyānubhāvitam | āryāṣṭāṃgikamārge ca caritvā vratamādarāt || 11.159{58} || vratānāmapi sarveṣāmāryāṣṭāṃgamupoṣadham | pravaraṃ vratamākhyātaṃ sarvairapi munīśvaraiḥ || 11.160{59} || yasya puṇyānubhāvena pariśuddhatrimaṃḍalāḥ | niḥśeṣapāpanirmuktāḥ prayāntyarhatpadaṃ drutam || 11.161{60} || evametatparijñāya vrataṃ kṛtvā samācaran | tataste kramataḥ pāpaṃ niḥśeṣaṃ kṣiṇuyāddrutam || 11.162{61} || tataśca kramaśaḥ śikṣāḥ śikṣitvātra samāhitaḥ | triratnaśaraṇaṃ kṛtvā brahmacaryyaṃ samācara || 11.163{62} || tatastvaṃ kramaśaścaivaṃ śodhayitvā trimaṃḍalam | sarvakleśavinirmuktaḥ sākṣādarhan bhaviṣyasi || 11.164{63} || iti tenārhatādiṣṭaṃ śrutvāsau paribodhitaḥ | tatheti ca parijñāya tadvrataṃ kartumaichata || 11.165{64} || tathā tasyārhataḥ śāstuḥ sadaivaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ | kramācchikṣāśca śikṣitvā tadupoṣadhamācarat || 11.166{65} || adhītya sakalā vidyā triratnasamupāśrayan | sarvakleśān vinirjitya brahmacaryaṃ samācarat || 11.167{66} || bhikṣavo jñāyatāmeṣa yo'sau bhikṣuḥ pṛthagjanaḥ | yadanenārhate śāstre śapitaṃ ruṣṭacetasā || 11.168{67} || tenāhasto vabhūvāyaṃ paṃcajanmaśatānyapi | yaccānenārhataḥ śasturgatvā ca śaraṇaṃ sadā || 11.169{68} || adhītya sakalā vidyā brahmacaryaṃ samāśritam | tenāyaṃ śāsanenātra pravrajyārhaṃ bhavatyapi || 11.170{69} || iti hi bhikṣavo matvā caritavyaṃ śubhe sadā | śubhena sadgatiṃ yāṃti kṛṣṇena durgatiṃ sadā || 11.171{70} || miśritenāpi miśratvaṃ bhuṃjate sarvajaṃtavaḥ | yenaiva yatkṛtaṃ karma tasyaiva karmaṇaḥ phalam || 11.172{71} || tenaiva bhujyate loke nānyena spṛśyate kvacit | abhuktaṃ kṣīyate naiva karma kvāpi kadā cana || 11.173{72} || bhuktaṃ tu kṣīyate karma śubhaṃ vāpyaśubhaṃ tathā | nāgnibhirdahyate kena vāyubhiśca na śuṣyate || 11.174{73} || klidyate nodakaiścāpi kṣīyate naiva bhūmiṣu | na praṇaśyanti karmāṇi kalpakoṭiśatairapi || 11.175{74} || sāmagrīṃ prāpya kālaṃ ca phalanti prāṇināṃ khalu | evametatprabhaṣitvā jinendro'sau mahāmuniḥ || 11.176{75} || bodhayan sakalāṃllokān samādhiṃ vidadhe tataḥ | iti śāstrā samādiṣṭaṃ śrutvā sarve ca sāṃghikāḥ || 11.177{76} || śubheṣveva sadā raktāḥ pracerire samāhitāḥ || 11.178{77} || ityevaṃ me samākhyātaṃ guruṇā śāṇavāsinā | tathaivaṃ te mayā khyātaṃ śrutvā caivaṃ śubhe cara || 11.179{78} || prajāśca śrāvayitvaivaṃ bodhayitvā prayatnataḥ | saddharmācaraṇeṣvevaṃ preraṇīyā narādhipa || 11.180{79} || tataste maṃgalaṃ nityaṃ sarvatrāpi bhaveddhruvam | kramādbodhipathaḥ prāpya saṃbodhimāpnuyāḥ khalu || 11.181{80} || iti tenopaguptena bhāṣitaṃ sa nareśvaraḥ | śrutvā tatheti vaṃditvā prābhyanandatsapārṣadaḥ || 11.182{81} || ye śṛṇvantīdamevaṃ pramuditamanaso hastakākhyāvadānaṃ ye cāpi śrāvayanti pratidinamaniśaṃ bodhicaryābhiraktāḥ | te sarve kleśamuktāḥ suvimalamanaso bodhisatvā guṇāḍhyā bhuktvā saukhyaṃ prakāmaṃ munivaranilayaṃ saṃprayāṃti pramodāḥ || 11.183{82} || iti śriratnamālāyāṃ hastakāvadānaṃ nāma samāptam sārthavāhāvadāna athāśoko mahīpālaḥ kṛtāṃjalipuṭo mudā | upaguptaṃ guruṃ natvā punarevamabhāṣata || 12.1{1} || bhadanta śrotumichāmi punaranyatsubhāṣitam | yathā te guruṇādiṣṭaṃ tathā me khyātumarhasi || 12.2{2} || iti tena narendreṇa pṛṣṭe'sau sugatātmajaḥ | upagupto yatiścaivaṃ taṃ nṛpaṃ pratyabhāṣata || 12.3{3} || śṛṇu rājan samādhāya yathā me guruṇoditam | tathāhaṃ te pravakṣyāmi tacchrutvā mudito bhava || 12.4{4} || puraikasamaye caivaṃ śākyasiṃho jagadguruḥ | sarvajñaḥ sugataḥ śāstā sarvadharmānudeśakaḥ || 12.5{5} || sarvavidyādhipo nāthastraidhātukavināyakaḥ | dharmarājo munīndro'sau sarvasatvahitaṃkaraḥ || 12.6{6} || śrāvastyāṃ vahirudyāne jetāhvaye mahāvane | anāthapiṇḍadārāme vihāre saugatāśrame || 12.7{7} || śrāvakairbhikṣubhiḥ sārddhamupāsakaiśca cailakaiḥ | bodhisatvagaṇaiścāpi tathānyaiśca maharṣibhiḥ || 12.8{8} || vyaharatsatvahitārthena dharmāmṛtaiḥ pravarṣayan | tatsaddharmāmṛtaṃ pātuṃ prāyayurbodhivāṃchinaḥ || 12.9{9} || lokapālagaṇāḥ sarve svasvasainyagaṇaiḥ saha | brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyāścāpi vaiśyāḥ śūdrāśca maṃtriṇaḥ || 12.10{10} || amātyā dhaninaḥ paurāḥ sādhavaśca mahājanāḥ | vaṇijaḥ sārthavāhāśca tathānye sarvajātikāḥ || 12.11{11} || sarvadigbhyaḥ samāgatya sarve te samupāgatāḥ | saṃbuddhaṃ śrīghanaṃ natvā pūjayitvā samaṃtataḥ || 12.12{12} || parivṛtya puraskṛtya saddharmaśravaṇārthinaḥ | kṛtāṃjalipuṭo dṛṣṭvā saṃtasthuḥ saṃmukhānatāḥ || 12.13{13} || athāsau bhagavān dṛṣṭvā tān sarvān samupāśritān | ādimadhyāṃtakalyāṇaṃ dideśa dharmamuttamam || 12.14{14} || tatsaddharmāmṛtaṃ pītvā sarve lokādhipādayaḥ | harṣitāste'numodanto nananduḥ paribodhitāḥ || 12.15{15} || tadaiva samaye tasyāṃ śrāvastyāṃ puri saṃsthitaḥ | āsītsāṃyātrikotsāhī sārthavāho mahodyamī || 12.16{16} || svakuladharmabhṛdvīraḥ svakulavṛttimānitaḥ | yaśodharmārthakāmāptyai samudraṃ gantumaichata || 12.17{17} || tato'sau svāṃ priyāṃ bhāryāṃ bodhayitvā prayatnataḥ | svasahāyāśca tāṃ sarvāṃ samāhūya samabravīt || 12.18{18} || bhavaṃto śrūyatāṃ sarve yadabhilaṣitaṃ mama | atrāsti yadi vo vāṃchā tanme svāgantumarhatha || 12.19{19} || ahaṃ ratnākaraṃ gantumiche ratnasamṛddhaye | tatprāyāta mayā sārddhaṃ yadi saṃpattimichatha || 12.20{20} || iti tenoditaṃ śrutvā sarve te ratnalobhitāḥ | sahasā gaṃtumichante ratnākare mahodadhau || 12.21{21} || tato'sau sārthabhṛcchīghraṃ sarve sārthagaṇaiḥ saha | svastyayanavidhiṃ kṛtvā pratasthe saṃpramoditaḥ || 12.22{22} || tataḥ kramādvyatikramya grāmāraṇyavanāni ca | sarve te pracaranto vai tīraṃ prāpurmahodadheḥ || 12.23{23} || tato bhāṃḍāni naukāyāmāropyāruhya ca svayam | karṇadhāraprayatnaiste jagāhire'mbudhiṃ kramāt || 12.24{24} || tataḥ kramātsamullaṃghya bahudvīpāntarāṇi te | ratnākaraṃ samāsādya ratnāni samasādhayan || 12.25{25} || tataste bahuratnāni samāsādya pramoditāḥ | tataḥ pratyāgatā abdhestīrāntikaṃ samāyayuḥ || 12.26{26} || tatra tatkarmadoṣeṇa kālavātairvighaṭṭitam | bhidyate vahanaṃ teṣāṃ hṛdayaiḥ sā sahāśu tat || 12.27{27} || tadā te vaṇijaḥ sarve niḥprayatnapratikriyā | sarvabhāṇḍaiḥ sahāgāḍhe nipeturduṣkare'mbudhau || 12.28{28} || kecitphalakamālamvya samuttīrṇāḥ svavīryataḥ | kecidvāhuvalādhānaṃ samuttīrya sthalaṃ yayuḥ || 12.29{29} || kecicca vilayaṃ prāptā nirālamvyanirāśrayāḥ | utpravanto nimajjantaḥ kheditā nidhanaṃ yayuḥ || 12.30{30} || tataste vaṇijaḥ sarve ye viśiṣṭā viṣāditāḥ | te yaśodhanavibhraṣṭāḥ śūnyahastā gṛhaṃ yayuḥ || 12.31{31} || tathāsau sārthavāho'pi gṛhaṃ prāpto viṣāditaḥ | etadvṛttaṃ svabhāryāyāḥ kathitvaivaṃ vyacintayat || 12.32{32} || hā hā me mandabhāgyatvājjāyate mīdṛśī vipat | atrāhaṃ kiṃ kariṣyāmi yato bhāgyaṃ na vidyate || 12.33{33} || bhāgyavān puruṣo dhīro bhāgyavān kuśalī sudhīḥ | bhāgyena labhyate saṃpadyaśaḥ saukhyaguṇānvitaḥ || 12.34{34} || dhīḥ śrīlakṣmīyaśoratnaṃ valaṃ saṃpatkṣaṇādayaḥ | etadādyā guṇāḥ sarve śobhanti bhāgyamāśritāḥ || 12.35{35} || nihīnabhāgyavṛttestu puruṣasyāpi saṃmate | etadādyādiguṇāḥ sarve na prasiddhyaṃti sarvataḥ || 12.36{36} || tadatra kiṃ kariṣye'haṃ kva yāsyāmi dhanāptaye | dhanahīnā na śobhante gṛhasthāḥ sādhavo'pi hi || 12.37{37} || varaṃ prāṇaparityāgaṃ na tu dravyairvinā gṛhe | paśuvannirasaṃ bhuktvā sthāsyāmyevaṃ nirutsavam || 12.38{38} || bhāgyena labhyate dravyaṃ bhāgyaṃ dharmeṇa labhyate | dharme hi jāyate sveṣṭadevatāyāḥ prasādataḥ || 12.39{39} || taddharmabhāgyalabdhārthaṃ svakuladevatāṃ prati | samyagārādhayitvaivaṃ yāyāṃ ratnākaraṃ punaḥ || 12.40{40} || manasīti viniścitya sa sārthavāhakaḥ punaḥ | svakuladevatāṃ samyagārādhya samayācata || 12.41{41} || namaste devate nityaṃ bhaje'haṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ | kṣaṃtavyaṃ me'parādhatvaṃ prasīda parameśvara || 12.42{42} || itthaṃ sā devatā samyagārādhya saṃpramoditā | sarvasārthān samāhūya punarevamabhāṣata || 12.43{43} || bho bhavanto vijānīdhvaṃ vayaṃ sarve vaṇigjanāḥ | tadatra bhavatāmagre kathyate me samīhitam || 12.44{44} || yadbhavanto vayaṃ sarve sārthavāhakulodbhavāḥ | tattathaiva gṛhe sthitvā naiva śobhāṃ vrajemahi || 12.45{45} || tasmātsvakulavṛttisthaiḥ sarvairasmābhirudyataiḥ | yaśodharmasukhāptyarthaṃ karttavyaṃ dhanasādhanam || 12.46{46} || dhanahīnā na śobhante gṛhasthā hi kuṭuṃvinaḥ | sārthavāho'stu śobhante vahuratnārjanodyatāḥ || 12.47{47} || tadviṣādaṃ parityaktvā yaśoratnasukhāptaye | dhairyyamālamvya sarvaiśca karttavyaṃ dhanasādhanam || 12.48{48} || dhanavān puruṣo lokaiḥ sarvatrāpi pramānyate | dhanena sādhayeddharmaṃ dharmeṇa sadgatiṃ vrajet || 12.49{49} || tasmānnityaṃ mahotsāhaisñltyaktvālasyakuśīdatā | arjanīyaṃ prayatnena dhanaṃ dānāya bhuktaye || 12.50{50} || dānaṃ vibhūṣaṇaṃ loke dānaṃ durgatinivāraṇam | dānaṃ svargasya sopānaṃ dānaṃ śāntikaraṃ sadā || 12.51{51} || asmāddānaṃ sadā kartuṃ bhoktuṃ saukhyaṃ yathechayā | bhūyo ratnākaraṃ gaṃtumarhāmahe dhanārjane || 12.52{52} || tatra ratnāni saṃgṛhya svastipratyāgatā vayam | yāvajjīvaṃ sukhaṃ bhuktvā dānaṃ kṛtvā vasemahi || 12.53{53} || yadi daivo vipattiḥ syātsamudre patitā vayam | tīrtharāje mṛtāḥ sarve yāsyāmaḥ svargatiṃ dhruvam || 12.54{54} || yadi bhāgyādathāsmākaṃ devānāṃ ca prasādataḥ | yātrāsiddhirbhavennūnaṃ yāvajjīvaṃ sukhaṃ tadā || 12.55{55} || asmādratnākare gantumiche ratnapralabdhaye | tatprāyāta mayā sārddhaṃ yadi saṃpattimichatha || 12.56{56} || iti tasyoditaṃ śrutvā te sarve vaṇijo mudā | tathā tena sahaichānta gantuṃ ratnākaraiḥ punaḥ || 12.57{57} || tato'sau sārthabhṛcchīghraṃ dhṛtvā svastyayanaṃ mudā | sarve sārthagaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ pratasthe svapurādvahi || 12.58{58} || tataḥ kramādvyatikramya grāmāraṇyavanāni ca | pracarantaśca te sarve tīraṃ prāpurmahodadheḥ || 12.59{59} || tatra sarve'pi te sārthā bhāṇḍāni vahane kramāt | āropya sahasārūḍhā jagāhire mahāmbudhau || 12.60{60} || tataḥ kramātsamullaṃghya vahudvīpāntarāṇi te | ratnākaraṃ samāsādya ratnāni samasādhayan || 12.61{61} || tatra te vahuratnāni samāgṛhya praharṣitāḥ | tataḥ pratyāgatāścābdhestīrāntikamupāyayuḥ || 12.62{62} || tatastaddaivayogena kālikāvātaghaṭṭitā | sā naukā bhidyate caivaṃ teṣāṃ vai hṛdayaiḥ saha || 12.63{63} || tadā te vaṇijaḥ sarve niḥprayatnapratikriyā | sarvabhāṇḍaiḥ sahāgāḍhe nyapatan duṣṭare'mbudhau || 12.64{64} || tatra te vilayaṃ prāptā nirālaṃvā nirāśrayāḥ | unmajjanto nimajjantaḥ preritāstīramūrmibhiḥ || 12.65{65} || kecitphalakamāśritya samuttīryya svavīryyataḥ | kecidvāhuvalādhānaiḥ samuttīryya sthalaṃ yayuḥ || 12.66{66} || kecinnihīnavīryyāṅgā hanyamānā mahormibhiḥ | utplavantā nimajjantaḥ kheditā nidhanaṃ yayuḥ || 12.67{67} || tatasteṣāṃ ca sārthānāṃ ye'vaśiṣṭā sujīvinaḥ | yaśoratnaviyuktāste śūnyahastā gṛhaṃ yayuḥ || 12.68{68} || tathāsau sārthavāho'pi gṛhaṃ gatvā viṣāditaḥ | etadvṛttaṃ svavaṃdhūnāṃ kathitvaivamabhāṣata || 12.69{69} || hā mayā kiṃ kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ yenedrigjāyate vipat | dvidhāpi siddhyate naiva yato bhāgyaṃ na vidyate || 12.70{70} || pāpairna siddhyate karma atra yatnasya kiṃ valaiḥ | dharmeṇa siddhyate karma tasmāddharmo valottamaḥ || 12.71{71} || tasmāddharmaṃ puraskṛtya karttavyaṃ dravyasādhanam | dravyena sādhayetkarma sadgatiṃ samavāpnuyāḥ || 12.72{72} || karma tu siddhyate samyakkulavṛttiṃ ca cāriṇām | kulavṛttiṃ parityajya yo'nyavṛttau caretkudhīḥ || 12.73{73} || sa ihāpi paribhraṣṭaḥ paratra durgatiṃ vrajet | yenaivaṃ sadgatiprāptistadaiva karmma sādhayet || 12.74{74} || yato'pi durgatiṃ prāptistatkarma tarhitaṃ budhaiḥ | tadatra kiṃ kariṣye'haṃ kva yāsyāmyarthamarjitum | arthaṃ vinā kathaṃ dharmaṃ karttavyaṃ hi kuṭuṃvibhiḥ || 12.75{75} || vinā dharmaṃ hi saṃsāre janma jīvaṃ ca nisphalam | kiṃ te na pauruṣeṇāpi yena dharmaṃ na sādhyate || 12.76{76} || dhigdhigme janma saṃsāre jīvituṃ na tathotsahe | varaṃ prāṇaparityāgaṃ na tvevaṃ cirajīvitam || 12.77{77} || avaśyaṃ jantubhirmṛtyurgantavyamekadhā dhruvam | tato'tra martumichāmi na tvevamuṣituṃ gṛhe || 12.78{(78)} || evaṃjīvo na śobhe'haṃ dhigpravādāgnidagdhitaḥ | kathaṃ me śāmyate duḥkhaṃ yenāhaṃ parikheditaḥ || 12.79{(78)} || kiṃ karttavyaṃ kva gantavyaṃ yatnaṃ cātra na vidyate | sarvathāhaṃ vinaṣṭo'smi ko me'sti rakṣako janaḥ || 12.80{79} || yaśodharmaparibhraṣṭo vrajeyaṃ durgatiṃ khalu | tadāhaṃ kiṃ kariṣyāmi dharmayaśaḥsukhānvitaḥ || 12.81{80} || mānuṣye labhyamāne hi kuto dharmānusādhanam | vinā dharmmaṃ yaśodravyaḥ kiṃ saukhyaṃ gṛhavāsinām || 12.82{81} || vinā dharmayaśodravyairyo gṛhasthaḥ paśuḥ khalu | dharmeṇa sādhayeddravyaṃ yaśobhāgyasukhāptaye || 12.83{82} || dharmāddhi jāyate puṇyaṃ dānaśīlakṣamādibhiḥ | puṇyenaiva pralabhyante caturvargā api dhruvam || 12.84{83} || tadeteṣāṃ mamaiko'pi na vidyate kathaṃ cana | hā hato'smi svadaivena kiṃ karomi vikheditaḥ || 12.85{84} || sarvathāhaṃ vinaṣṭo'smi namo daivāya karmaṇe | evaṃ teṣāṃ svavaṃdhūnāṃ vilapītvā sa sārthapaḥ || 12.86{85} || tasthau cintākulībhūto dhanārjananirāśrayā | evaṃ vyavasthitaṃ dṛṣṭvā taṃ te sarve'pi vāṃdhavāḥ || 12.87{86} || datvāśvāsaṃ vinodāya bodhayante dhruvaṃ tathā | sādho sārthapate satyaṃ tatsarvaṃ yattvayocyate || 12.88{87} ||
