tadevaṃ dhairyyamālaṃvya prodyamasva gṛhe vasan | sādho kutrāpi mā dhāva nirmāṇasadṛśaṃ phalam || 12.89{88} || yāvadevāmbhasā kumbhaḥ siṃdhāvandhau'vapūryate | yadabhāvi na tadbhāvi bhāvi naiva tadanyathā || 12.90{89} || avaśyaṃ bhāvino bhāvā bhavaṃti sarvadehinām | avaśyaṃ bhāvino bhāvā na bhaveyustathā yadi || 12.91{90} || pitrā tyaktaḥ kathaṃ rāmo rājyabhraṣṭo vanaṃ yayau | tatrāpi vasatastasya bhāryā śītā pativratā || 12.92{91} || āhṛtya rakṣasā nītā kathaṃ laṃkāpure'vasat | tato rāmeṇa vīryeṇa hatvāsau rāvaṇastataḥ || 12.93{92} || pratyānīya punaḥ śītā tyaktā bharttrā svayaṃ katham | punarṛṣeḥ samānīya sabhāmadhye parikṣitā || 12.94{93} || tataḥ pṛthyā svayaṃ gṛhya sītānītā rasātalam | tatastadvirahārttāsau rāmaḥ saṃsāranispṛhaḥ || 12.95{94} || nadyāṃ prāṇasvayaṃ tyaktvā janaṃ sārddhaṃ divaṃ yayau | evamanye'pi rājāno yudhiṣṭhirā nṛpādayaḥ | rājyabhraṣṭā vane gatvā vibhramuste'pi daivataḥ || 12.96{95} || evamanye'pi lokāśca sarvatraidhātukabhavāḥ | uttamā adhamā madhyā saṃti te'pi svadaivataḥ || 12.97{96} || kecidgṛhe mṛtāḥ kecijjāyamānā mṛtā api | kecidvālye mṛtāḥ kecitkaumāratve mṛtāstathā || 12.98{97} || yauvane'pi mṛtāḥ kecinmṛtā vṛddhe vadanti me | sarve'pyevaṃ mṛtā lokāḥ svasvadaivapramāṇataḥ || 12.99{98} || evaṃ devādayo lokāḥ sukhaduḥkhānuyoginaḥ | svasvadaivānubhāvena ṣaḍgatiṣu caranti te || 12.100{99} || kecidvālye sukhaṃ bhuktvā yauvane duḥkhabhāginaḥ | kecicca yauvane saukhyaṃ bhuktvā vṛddhe suduḥkhitāḥ || 12.101{100} || kecicca duḥkhitā vālye yauvane saukhyabhāginaḥ | vṛddhatvasya sukhībhūtā bhavaṃti te'pi hi daivataḥ || 12.102{1} || sarve'pi sukhamichanti duḥkhaṃ nechati kaścana | tathā sukhāni saṃprāptuṃ yatnaṃ kurvantyanekaśaḥ || 12.103{2} || keṣāṃ citsiddhyate yatnaṃ keṣāṃ cidvā na siddhyati | keṣāṃ cidvighnatāṃ yāti tatsarvaṃ daivayogataḥ || 12.104{3} || tathā ca rogiṇāṃ rogā vaidyopacāraṇairapi | varddhyante naiva śāmyante tadapi daivayogataḥ || 12.105{4} || keṣāṃ cidrogiṇāṃ rogā vinā vaidyopacāraṇe | śāmyaṃte yatnato cāpi tadapi daivayogataḥ || 12.106{5} || tathā caldmaṃtriṇāṃ maṃtrāḥ siddhyante yatnato laghuḥ | keṣāṃ cidvighnatāṃ yānti tadapi daivakāraṇāt || 12.107{6} || tathaivaṃ vaṇijāṃ lābhoḥ siddhyante yatnato'pi ca | keṣāṃ cinnaiva yatnena tadapi daivayogataḥ || 12.108{7} || tathā vīrā raṇe śatruṃ vinā yatnaṃ jayaṃtyapi | kecittu ripunā yuddhe hanyamānā mṛtāḥ pare || 12.109{8} || kecitkṛtvā mahāyuddhaṃ hanyamānāḥ parasparam | tyaktvā dehaṃ gatāḥ svargaṃ tadapi daivayogataḥ || 12.110{9} || evaṃ sāṃyātrikā ratnaṃ prāptuṃ ratnākaraṃ gatāḥ | kecidratnāni saṃgṛhya svasti pratyāgatā gṛham || 12.111{10} || kecidratnamalabdhaṃ vai śūnyahastā gṛhāgatāḥ | kecicca nidhanaṃ yātāstatraiva makarālaye || 12.112{11} || kecidyatnātsamuttīrya jīvanto gṛhamāgatāḥ | kecicca jāṃgale caurairnihatā maraṇaṃ gatāḥ || 12.113{12} || kecicca jaṃtubhirmārge hiṃsyamāne mṛtā vane | keṣāṃ citsiddhyate yātrā mahallābhasamanvitāḥ || 12.114{13} || keṣāṃ cidvighnatāṃ yānti tathāpi daivayogataḥ | kaiścidgṛhe nidhiḥ prāptaḥ kaiściddeśāntare vane || 12.115{14} || kaiściddūre bhramadbhiśca naiva kiṃ citkva ciddhanam | keṣāṃ cidvarddhate saṃpadyatnāyāsaṃ vinā laghu || 12.116{15} || keṣāṃ ciddhīyate saṃpadrakṣitāpi prayatnataḥ | keṣāṃ citsusthirā saṃpatkeṣāṃ cidvala asthirā || 12.117{16} || keṣāṃ cijjāyate naiva nānopāyārjanairapi | evaṃ nānāprakāraiśca satvāstraidhātukodbhavāḥ || 12.118{17} || bhuṃjate sukhaduḥkhāni svasvadaivānusāriṇāḥ | sukhasyānte hi duḥkhāni duḥkhasyānte sukhāni ca || 12.119{18} || bhuṃjante jaṃtavaḥ sarve bhramante ṣaḍgatiṣvapi | tathā bhavanti mitrāṇi dviṣo'pi hitakāriṇaḥ || 12.120{19} || mitrāṇyapi dviṣo duṣṭā bhavaṃti daivayogataḥ | tathāmṛtaṃ viṣībhūtaṃ viṣaṃ cāpyamṛtī bhavet || 12.121{20} || tadapi daivayogena tasmāddaivaṃ mahadvaram || 12.122{21} || tathā ca brahmaṇaḥ śīrṣaṃ nikṛttaṃ śūlapāṇinā | tadapi daivayogena tasmāddaivaṃ mahāvalī || 12.123{22} || tathā cakrī suvīro'pi vyādheṣu nihato mṛtaḥ | tadapi daivayogena tasmāddaivaṃ mahadvalam || 12.124{23} || yaśca bhūtādhipaśceśaḥ so'pyumatto digaṃvaraḥ | tadapi daivayogena tasmāddaivaṃ maheśvaraḥ || 12.125{24} || caṃdro'pi ca kalaṃkāṅko māse māse'pi hīyate | tadapi daivayogena tasmāddaivaṃ mahadvalam || 12.126{25} || evaṃ candradineśau ca graheṇāpi nipīḍitau | tadapi daivayogena tasmāddaivaṃ mahāvalī || 12.127{26} || rāmo rakṣovijetāpi putreṇa nihato raṇe | tadapi daivayogena tasmāddaivaṃ mahāvalī || 12.128{27} || tathārjjunaḥ sudhīro'pi putreṇāpi hato raṇe | tadapi daivayogena tasmāddaivaṃ mahāvalam || 12.129{28} || tathā ca parśurāmeṇa mātāpi nihatā krudhā | tadapi daivayogena tasmāddaivaṃ mahāvalaḥ || 12.130{29} || biṃbisāro nṛpendro'pi putreṇājātaśatruṇā | vaṃdhane māritaṃ caivaṃ tadapi daivayogataḥ || 12.131{30} || tasmācca brahmadattena dharmapālo sa nandanaḥ | māritaḥ pramadātuṣṭyai tadapi daivayogataḥ || 12.132{31} || rājñī ca durpatī mātā svātmajasyāpi rohitam | pītvaiva nirdayā tuṣṭā tadapi daivayogataḥ || 12.133{32} || kṣāntivādī muniścāpi rājñā nirdayacetasā | asinā ghātito'raṇye tadapi daivayogataḥ || 12.134{33} || prasenajinnṛpeśo'pi putreṇāpi svarājyataḥ | nirvāsito vane bhrāntastadapi daivayogataḥ || 12.135{34} || evamanye'pi rājāno hatvā jñātī svavāṃdhavān | bhuṃjate prāpya rājyāni tadapi daivayogataḥ || 12.136{35} || evaṃ pitrā sutāstyaktvā mātrā ca svātmajā api | vaṃdhumitrādibhistyaktvā keciddaivānuyogataḥ || 12.137{36} || bhāryāpi svāminā tyaktvā bharttāpi bhāryyayā tathā | tadapi daivayogena tasmāddaivaṃ mahattaram || 12.138{37} || putreṇāpi pitā tyaktaṃ mātāpi jananī tathā | dhātrī cāpi parityaktāstathā pautrapitāmahaḥ || 12.139{38} || tathā pitāmahastyaktaḥ putraiścāpyatinirdayaiḥ | tadapi daivayogena tasmāddaivaṃ mahattaram || 12.140{39} || tathā rājñā svabhṛtyāśca sevakā api sajjanāḥ | aparādhaṃ vinā tyaktāstadapi daivayogataḥ || 12.141{40} || tathā sakhisahāyāṃ ca vaṃdhumitrasuhṛjjanān | parityaktvā nihaṃtyante tadapi daivayogataḥ || 12.142{40*} || tathā śiṣyān gururhanti śiṣyo hanti gurumapi | tadapi daivayogena tasmāddaivaṃ mahattaram || 12.143{41} || tathāpi ghnanti bharttāraṃ svāminaṃ sevakānnapi | tadapi daivayogena tasmāddaivaṃ mahattaram || 12.144{42} || tathā ca svayamātmānaṃ ghnanti kecidruṣānvitāḥ | tadapi daivayogena tasmāddaivaṃ mahattamaḥ || 12.145{43} || kecicchastraiḥ svayaṃ hatvā kecidbhuktvā viṣādikam | kecidagnau jale svabhre prapātātpatitā mṛtāḥ || 12.146{44} || kecitpāśaiḥ svayaṃ badhya mṛtāḥ kecicca vaṃdhane | kecitpānāśanādīṃśca tyaktvā yāṃti yamālayam || 12.147{45} || evaṃ kṛtvāpi yāntyeva kecidvāpi surālayam | kecicca narake yānti tatsarvaṃ daivayogataḥ || 12.148{46} || tathā mṛddārupāṣāṇe nānādhātupratiṣṭhitāḥ | devatāśca dadantyevaṃ phalaṃ daivaniyogataḥ || 12.149{47} || pare'pi svajanā iṣṭāḥ sahajā api ca dviṣaḥ | bhavanti tatkṣaṇādeva tadapi daivayogataḥ || 12.150{48} || evaṃ traidhātukotpannāḥ sarve satvāśca jaṃtavaḥ | ṣaḍgatiṣu bhramantaste caranti daivayogataḥ || 12.151{49} || kecidvīrā guṇāḍhyāśca suṃdarā bhāgyamāninaḥ | sarvasaṃpatsamṛddhāśca cakravarttinṛpādayaḥ || 12.152{50} || kecicca nirguṇāḥ prāḍhyāḥ kecinnirguṇinaḥ śaṭhāḥ | kecicca vikalāṃgāśca guṇasaṃpattibhāginaḥ || 12.153{51} || kecicca suṃdarā mūrkhā nirdhanā nirguṇāḥ śaṭhāḥ | kecicca guṇinaḥ prāḍhyā nīcakarmānucāriṇaḥ || 12.154{52} || kecinnīcakulotpannāḥ guṇāḍhyāḥ sādhuvṛttayaḥ | dātāro dhanino vīrāḥ sarvasatvānupālakāḥ || 12.155{53} || keciduccakulotpannā nirguṇā duṣṭavṛttayaḥ | kṛpaṇā vikalāṃgāśca nirdayāśca durāśayāḥ || 12.156{54} || kecidvīrā hyalābhijñāḥ kulīnāḥ sādhavo'pi ye | te'pi jātinihīne'pi bhajaṃti śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ || 12.157{55} || kecicca guṇavanto'pi kucelāḥ kṛśagātrikāḥ | pretavadbhujyamānāśca caraṃti bhikṣukā bhuvi || 12.158{56} || kecicca nirguṇā vāpi vaṃcakā duṣṭamānasāḥ | mānyante sādhuvalloke tadapi daivayogataḥ || 12.159{57} || evaṃ nānāvidhā lokāḥ ṣaḍgatiṣu samudbhavāḥ | sukhaduḥkhāni bhuṃjante bhramaṃti daivayogataḥ || 12.160{58} || tasmāddaivaṃ mahāvīraṃ sarvatraidhātukeṣvapi | kenāpi śakyate naiva vaśe netuṃ kathaṃ cana || 12.161{59} || tena daivaṃ mahānāthaḥ sarvakarmādhipaḥ prabhuḥ | sraṣṭā bharttā ca harttā ca traidhātuvāsināmapi || 12.162{60} || tasyāpyadhipatibrahmā sarvalokeśvaro vidhiḥ | tattasya śaraṇaṃ gatvā bhaktyā nityaṃ samarcaya || 12.163{61} || tasmiṃ tuṣṭe vidhau devaiḥ parituṣṭaṃ bhaveddhruvam | tato daivaprasādena sarvatra maṃgalaṃ bhavet || 12.164{62} || daive tuṣṭe susiddhyante sarvakarmāṇi yatnataḥ | viruddhe tu na siddhyante yatnaiḥ saṃsādhitānyapi || 12.165{63} || tasmāddaivādhipaṃ devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ caturānanam | bhaja daivaprasannāya sarvakāryaprasiddhaye || 12.166{64} || daivaṃ brahmaprasādena śubhadaṃ saṃmukhī bhavet | tataste maṃgalaṃ nityaṃ sarvakāryyeṣu saṃbhavet || 12.167{65} || evaṃ sārthapate natvā vidhānaṃ kāryyasādhanam | vidhinārādhya sadbhaktyā kuruṣva karmasādhanam || 12.168{66} || tathā cetsarvathā nityaṃ yātrāyaṃ maṃgalaṃ bhavet | anyadvā cintitaṃ kāryaṃ sarvāpyevaṃ prasatsyate || 12.169{67} || yadi vāṃchāsti te bhūyo gantuṃ ratnākaraṃ prati | tathābhyarcya vidhātāraṃ gachetsvasti bhavetkhalu || 12.170{68} || iti tenoditaṃ śrutvā sārthavāhastatheti saḥ | pratijñāya samabhyarcya brahmāṇaṃ prārthayattadā || 12.171{69} || namaste bhagavan brahmaṃ yātrāsiddhiṃ kuruṣva me | evaṃ vidhiṃ samārādhya sa sārthādhipatistataḥ || 12.172{70} || ratnaṃ prāptyai punaḥ sārthān samāhūyābravīttathā | bhavantaḥ śrūyatāṃ vākyaṃ yanmayā samudīritam || 12.173{71} || atrāsti yadi vo vāṃchā tathā kartuṃ samudyatām | ahaṃ ratnākaraṃ bhūyo gantumichāmi sāṃpratam || 12.174{72} || tadyadīchatha ratnāni tathā yāta mayā saha | kiṃ cāpyatra vayaṃ sarve sārthavāhakulodbhavāḥ || 12.175{73} || tadgṛhe paśuvadbhuktvā kathaṃ śobhī vrajemahi | saṃsāre sarvajaṃtūnāmekadhā maraṇaṃ dhruvam || 12.176{74} || tatkiṃ no maraṇe bhītyā mṛtyuṃ kena nivāryyate | yadi daivādvipattiḥ syādasmākaṃ karmmadoṣataḥ || 12.177{75} || sarvatīrthajalādhāre mṛtāḥ svargaṃ vrajemahi | yadi bhāgyācca no yātrā siddhā svastimatī bhavet | tadā jīvaṃ sukhaṃ dānaṃ kṛtvā svargaṃ vrajemahi | tadviṣādaṃ parityajya yaśodharmmasukhāptaye || 12.178{76} || vīryotsāhaṃ samādhāya samāyāta mayā saha | iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā sarve te vaṇijo mudā || 12.179{77} || tatheti ca samutsāhaṃ kṛtvā gaṃtuṃ samudyatāḥ | tataḥ sarve'pi te sārthā dhṛtvā svastyayanaṃ vidhim || 12.180{78} || paṇyamādāya tenaiva saha sārthabhṛtā yayuḥ | tataste prasthitāḥ sarve grāmāraṇyavanasthalīḥ || 12.181{79} || samuttīryya kramādyātāstīraṃ prāpurmahodadheḥ | tatra nāvi samārūḍhā karṇadhāraprayatnataḥ || 12.182{80} || marutāṃte'nukūlena jagāhire mahodadhim | tatasteṣāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ daivayogānuyogataḥ || 12.183{81} || sā naukā kālikāvātasaṃkṣubdhābhūdvibheditā | tadā sarve'pi te sārthā dṛṣṭvā naukāṃ vibheditām || 12.184{82} || trasitāḥ sahasā tasmātpratyāyayuḥ prayatnataḥ | tataste vaṇijaḥ sarve vipaṃnāśā viṣāditāḥ || 12.185{83} || rātrau svasvagṛhe gatvā vibhagnāsā viṣedire | tathāsau sārthavāho'pi lajjitaḥ khaṇḍitāśayaḥ || 12.186{84} || kheditātmā gṛhe tasthau mūkavaddhi natotsavaḥ | tato bhāryyā satī bhadrā patikhedavibheditam | dṛṣṭvā taṃ vikalībhūtaṃ samupetyābravītpunaḥ || 12.187{85} || mā viṣādaṃ kṛthāḥ svāminnatra dhairyyaṃ samāśrayaḥ | dharmiṣṭhe śaraṇaṃ gatvā kuruṣva dharmasādhanam || 12.188{86} || dharmmeṇa jīyate pāpaṃ niṣpāpo nirmalāśayaḥ | śuddhacitto viśuddhātmā puṇyātmā bhāgyamāpnuyāt || 12.189{87} || tato bhāgyavataḥ puṃso yadyatkarmaṇi sādhitam | tattatsarvaṃ prasiddhyeta tasmāddharmaṃ carottamam || 12.190{88} || dharmameva suhṛdmitramihāmutra sahānugaḥ | dharmmeṇa pālyate sarvaṃ tasmāddharmo jagatsuhṛt || 12.191{89} || dharmā nānāvidhā loke kulacaryyānusarataḥ | sarveṣāmapi dharmāṇāṃ dayā dharme viśiṣyate || 12.192{90} || dayāluḥ sugato buddho dharmarājastathāgataḥ | samantabhadra ātmajñaḥ sarvasatvahitaṃkaraḥ || 12.193{91} || sarvajño mārajicchāstā jagannāthaḥ śubhārthadaḥ | ṣaḍabhijño jagadbharttā sarvalokādhipeśvaraḥ || 12.194{92} || tasmāttasya munīndrasya sadbhaktyā śaraṇaṃ vrajan | saddharmaśaraṇaṃ kṛtvā bhaja nityamupāsakaḥ || 12.195{93} || tataste naśyate pāpaṃ maṃgalaṃ ca bhaveddhruvam | tadaiva sarvakāryāṇi sametsyaṃte na saṃśayaḥ || 12.196{94} || iti bhāryoditaṃ śrutvā sa sārthādhipatirmudā | tatheti saṃpratijñāya saṃbuddhaśaraṇaṃ yayau || 12.197{95} || namaste bhagavannātha pāpistho'haṃ sudurbhagaḥ | bhavatāṃ śaraṇaṃ gache tanmāṃ dṛṣṭvāśu rakṣatām || 12.198{96} || yanmayā prakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ kāritaṃ vānumoditaḥ | tatsarvaṃ deśayiṣyāmi tanme dehi śubhāṃ gatim || 12.199{97} || bhavatāṃ sarvadā nātha śaraṇaṃ yāmyupāsakaḥ | anyo me śaraṇaṃ nāsti tanmāṃ rakṣa sadā bhaje || 12.200{98} || tridhāpi me jagannātha yātrā bhagnā svadaivataḥ | gṛhasthaḥ sārthavāho'haṃ tanme dehi susaṃpadaḥ || 12.201{99} || yanvahaṃ sāṃprataṃ nātha bhavataṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajan | bhūyo ratnākaraṃ gantumichāmi ratnalabdhaye || 12.202{100} || yadi yātrā bhavetsiddhi yāvallābhaṃ ca lapsyate | tadupāyena saṃbuddhaṃ pūjayeyaṃ sasāṃghikam || 12.203{1} || ityevaṃ niścayaṃ kṛtvā saṃbuddhaṃ saṃsmaranmuhuḥ | tāṃ bhāryyāṃ bhadrikāṃ dṛṣṭvā punarevamabhāṣata || 12.204{2} || bhadre tvayā yadādiṣṭaṃ tathā kartuṃ samutsahe | adyāgreṇa jagannāthaṃ śaraṇaṃ yāsyāmyupāsakaḥ || 12.205{3} || bhadre nāmnā jinendrasya yāsye ratnākare punaḥ | yadi yātrā bhavetsiddhi yāvallābhaṃ ca lapsyate || 12.206{4} || tadupārddhena ratnena sasaṃghaṃ sugataṃ tadā | yathārhaṃ pūjayiṣye'hamiti saṃkalpitaṃ mayā || 12.207{5} || yadi daivādvipattiḥ syātsaṃbuddhanāma saṃsmaran | sarvatīrthajalādhāne mṛto yāyāṃ sukhāvatīm || 12.208{6} || tadatra yadi me kāryyaṃ śubhaṃ kartuṃ samichasi | tadviṣādaṃ parityajya dhairyyaṃ kṛtvā sukhaṃ vasa || 12.209{7} || iti bharttroditaṃ śrutvā sā bhāryyā bhadrikā satī | tatheti pratisaṃmodya svāminaṃ taṃ samabravīt || 12.210{8} || yadyevaṃ te samīhāsti kṛtvetaṃ niścayaṃ prabho | saṃbuddhasmaraṇaṃ dhṛtvā gacha svastiṃ samācara || 12.211{9} || yadi buddhakṛpādṛṣṭiḥ satveṣu vidyate kila | tathāvaśyaṃ sa saṃbuddhaḥ paśyan tvāṃ cāpyacetkhalu || 12.212{10} || tadā te maṅgalaṃ nityaṃ yātrā svastimatī bhavet | tataste janma saṃsāre sāphalyaṃ ca bhavetkhalu || 12.213{11} || tena svāmiṃ jineṃdrasya nāmasvastyayanaṃ dadhat | gacha yātrā susiddhāstu svasti pratyāgatāśu ca || 12.214{12} || iti bhāryoditaṃ śrutvā sa sārthādhipatirmudā | bhūyaḥ sārthagaṇān sarvān samāhūyābravīttathā || 12.215{13} || bhavanta śrūyatāṃ vākyaṃ yanmayātra samīhitam | ahaṃ ratnākaraṃ bhūyo gantumichāmi sāṃpratam || 12.216{14} || tadasti yadi vo vāṃchā yaśaḥsaṃpatsukhāptaye | samāyāta mayā sārddhaṃ ratnākaraṃ vrajemahi || 12.217{15} || yadi bhāgyāddhi no yātrā siddhā svastimatirbhavet | yāvajīvaṃ sukhaṃ dharmaṃ kṛtvā svargaṃ vrajemahi | atha vā syādvipattirnaḥ sarvatīrthajalāśraye | mṛtāḥ svargaṃ gamiṣyāmo hyavaśyaṃ maraṇe sati || 12.218{16} || paśuvatkiṃ gṛhe sthitvā sukhaṃ vā kiṃ yaśo vinā | yaśonvitā mṛtā ye hi tatpumāṃso narottamāḥ || 12.219{17} || yadarthameva jīvāmastadarthaṃ yanna vidyate | kiṃ tena jīvitenāpi kevalaṃ duḥkhabhāginaḥ || 12.220{18} || varamevādya me mṛtyurna vyarthaṃ cirajīvitam | yasmācciramapi sthitvā mṛtyurkena nivāryyate || 12.221{19} || iti mṛtyubhayaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvatrāpyanivāraṇam | tyaktvā viṣādakauśīdyaṃ prodyamahyaṃ yaśorjane || 12.222{20} || evaṃ nānāprakāreṇa tena sārthabhṛtāpi te | bodhyamānā vaṇiksaṃghāḥ kiṃ cinnaiva samūcire || 12.223{21} || abhadro'yaṃ pumāṃ cāpi yato yātrā na siddhyati | iti tena mahāṃbhodhau naiko'pi gantumaichata || 12.224{22} || atha sārthapatirdṛṣṭvā tān sarvān viratotsavān | eko'pi vā svayaṃ gantumaichadratnākaraṃ prati || 12.225{23} || tato bhāryāṃ samāmaṃtrya paribodhya prasannadhīḥ | svastyayanavidhiṃ kṛtvā pratasthe bhārakaiḥ saha || 12.226{24} || tataḥ paṇyaṃ samādāya bhāravāhajanaiḥ saha | purādvahi vinirgatya kramāddeśāṃtaraṃ yayau || 12.227{25} || kramāccaṃcūryyamāno'sau grāmāraṇyavanasthalīḥ | parikraman samullaṃghya prāpustīraṃ mahodadheḥ || 12.228{26} || tatrāsau sārthabhṛddṛṣṭvā taṃ samudraṃ mahāmbudhim | kṛtāṃjalipuṭo natvā prārthayaccharaṇaṃ gataḥ || 12.229{27} || namaste jīvamādhāra sarvasatvārthasaṃpade | tvadāsayā samāyāmi tadāśāṃ me prapūraya || 12.230{28} || tato'sau karṇadhāraṃ ca toṣayitvā prabodhayan | kṛtāṃjalipuṭo natvā saṃdhṛtvā samayācata || 12.231{29} || karṇadhāra mahāvāho tavāhaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraje | tatsvasti cārayannaukāṃ yātrāsiddhiṃ prasādhaya || 12.232{30} || tathāsau vahanaṃ kṛtvā dṛḍhītaṃ gāḍhavaṃdhitam | kṛtāṃjalipuṭo natvā saṃdhṛtvā samayācata || 12.233{31} || yathā mātā ca garbhasthaṃ vālakaṃ saṃprarakṣate | tathā māmeva garbhasthe nauke mātaḥ prarakṣatām || 12.234{32} || tataśca sugataṃ smṛtvā triratnaśaraṇaṃ gataḥ | kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā praṇamyaivamayācata || 12.235{33} || namaste bhagavannātha yathā trāsi jagattrayam | tathā māṃ kṛpayā dṛṣṭvā pāhi vraje ratnākare || 12.236{34} || ityevaṃ sārthavāho'sau praṇatvā sugataṃ smaran | bhāṇḍānyāropya naukāyaṃ samārohajjanaṃ saha || 12.237{35} || tato'sau naukrameṇaiva karṇadhāraprayatnataḥ | marutāṃ cānukūlena saṃjagāha mahāmbudhau || 12.238{36} || yattatra sārthavāho'sau saṃsmaran sugataṃ muhuḥ | tena puṇyabalenaiva sā naukā svastimācaran || 12.239{37} || tathā kramāccarantyevaṃ dvīpalokāntarāṇi ca | vyatikramya suśighreṇa ratnākaraṃ samāyayau || 12.240{38} || tatra ratnākare prāpya ratnāni samasādhayan | tato ratnāni saṃgṛhya pratasthe vahanāsthitaḥ || 12.241{39} || tataḥ kramādvyatikramya dvīpalokāntarāṇi ca | tīraṃ prāpuḥ suśīghreṇa buddhadṛṣṭiprasādataḥ || 12.242{40} || tataḥ sthalaṃ samāsādya śailāraṇyavanasthalīḥ | grāmāṃ deśāṃ parikramya śrāvastyāṃ puramāyayau || 12.243{41} || tato gṛhe praviṣṭo'sau bharyyayā saha moditaḥ | suhṛnmitrajanaiścāpi kṛtvālāpaṃ nyaṣīdata || 12.244{42} || tataḥ sadyargṛhastho'sau bhāryyayā saha naṃditaḥ | bhāṇḍamudghāṭya ratnāni pratyavekṣitumārabhat || 12.245{43} || tatra divyavicitrāṇi ratnāni vividhāni ca | dṛṣṭvā harṣaṃ samāsādya punarevaṃ vabhāṣate || 12.246{44} || mamaitāni suratnāni divyānyetādṛśāni hi | tatra divyavicitrāṇi nānāratnakulāni ca || 12.247{45} || labdhāni tajjinendrasya kṛpādṛṣṭiprasādataḥ | tasmādyathāpratijñātaṃ śraddhayā sāṃprataṃ mayā || 12.248{46} || yadupārddhaṃ pradātavyaiḥ śravaṇāyārhate'pi naḥ | tadupārddhaṃ kathaṃ cānudātavyaṃ munaye'rhate || 12.249{47} || yadi rājā vijānīyādetadarddhaṃ hare mama | ratnalubdho nareśo yaṃ daṇḍaṃ vā praṇayaṃ mayi || 12.250{48} || tadā me syādvipattiśca tatkathaṃ kriyate mayā | aho daivādvipattirmāmadyāpi ca na muṃcati | tatkathaṃ vā pratijñātaṃ pūrayituṃ na manyate | namaste bhagavannātha sarvajño'si munīśvaraḥ || 12.251{49} || rakṣa māṃ pāpinaṃ mūḍhanimagnaṃ duḥkhasāgare | ityasau sugataṃ smṛtvā taccintāvyathitāśayaḥ || 12.252{50} || kapolaṃ svakare dhṛtvā tasthau koṣṭhe nirutsavaḥ | tathaivaṃ sthitamālokya svāmi naṃ taṃ viṣāditam || 12.253{51} || sā bhāryā bhadrikopetya puraḥ sthitvābravīttathā | svāmiṃ bharttaḥ kimeva tvaṃ sthito'si duḥkhito yathā || 12.254{52} || kiṃ vā te jāyate duḥkhaṃ tadvaca cetpriyāsmi te || 12.255{53} || iti bhāryoditaṃ śrutvā sa sārthādhipatiḥ punaḥ | tāṃ bhāryyāṃ samupāmaṃtrya punaścaivamabhāṣata || 12.256{54} || bhadre yajjāyate duḥkhaṃ tatpravakṣye śṛṇu priye | yathā mayā pratijñātaṃ pūrayituṃ kathaṃ tathā || 12.257{55} || yadyupārddhaṃ pradāsyāmi śravaṇāyārhate'pi nu | etadarddhaṃ haredrājā lobhānme daṇḍayedapi || 12.258{56} || ityevaṃ tadviṣādena vyathito'haṃ nirutsavaḥ | tanme nātra pratīkāro kathaṃ kartuṃ na manyate || 12.259{57} || iti bharttroditaṃ śrutvā sā bhāryā punarabravīt | viṣādaṃ mā kṛthāḥ svāmiṃ śṛṇu yanme samīhitaiḥ || 12.260{58} || tāvadimāni saṃkalpaḥ paścāttatsamayāgate | pūjayā saha bhojaiśca sasaṃghāyārhate'rcayet || 12.261{59} || evaṃ kṛte tathā svāmin pratijñā tena setsyate | bhītiścāpi na vidyeta tasmādevaṃ kuru prabho || 12.262{60} || iti bhāryāvacaḥ śrutvā sa sārthādhipatirmudā | tatheti pratisaṃśrutya punarevamabhāṣata || 12.263{61} || tāvadimāni sarvāṇi ratnāni te samarppaye | paścātkāle sasaṃghaṃ taṃ pūjayiṣye munīśvaram || 12.264{62} || idānīṃ sugaṃdhadhūpena pūjayeyaṃ munīśvaram | ityuktvā sarvaratnāni bhāryāyāṃ sa nyadhāpayet || 12.265{63} || tato'sau cāguruṃ krītvā kārṣāpaṇadvayena vā | gatvā jetavane vihāre tatra dvāre sthito gurumadhūpayet || 12.266{64} || tatrāpatramāno'sau saṃbuddhaśaraṇaṃ gataḥ | kṛtāṃjalipuṭo natvā saṃsmaran prārthayattathā || 12.267{65} || bhagavacchāstāsi sarvajño vijānīyā mamāśayam | tadyathā me pratijñātaiḥ pūrayituṃ samarhasi || 12.268{66} || athāsau bhagavān tasya matvāśayaviśuddhatām | mahadṛdhyabhisaṃskāraṃ cakāra tatprasādataḥ || 12.269{67} || yena sa dhūpa ākāśe prābhyudgamya purīṃ ca tām | sphuritvā khe punarabhrakūṭībhūtvābhyaśobhayat || 12.270{68} || tatrāsau sārthabhṛddṛṣṭvā prātihāryaṃ tadadbhutam | mahānaṃdaprasaṃnātmā punarevaṃ vyaciṃtayat || 12.271{69} || naitanme pratirūpaṃ syādyadayaṃ sugato jinaḥ | mayā nābhyarcito ratnairdhigme cittabhayāddrutam || 12.272{70} || yanvahaṃ sāṃprataṃ nāthaṃ prārthayitvā sasāṃghikam | saratnaiḥ pūjayiṣyāmi bhojanaiśca svake gṛhe || 12.273{71} || ityasau niścayaṃ kṛtvā kṛtāṃjalipuṭo mudā | saṃbuddhasaṃmukhaṃ gatvā praṇatvaivaṃ vyajijñapat || 12.274{72} || bhagavannātha sarvajña kṣamasva me'parādhatām | bhavatāṃ pūjanāṃ kartumichāmi me prasīdatu || 12.275{73} || ityevaṃ prārthite tena sa saṃbuddho munīśvaraḥ | tatheti pratisaṃmodya tūṣṇībhūtvā vyavasthitaḥ || 12.276{74} || tato'sau sārthabhṛnmatvā sugatenādhivāsitam | praṇatvā ca muneḥ pādau sahasā svagṛhaṃ yayau || 12.277{75} || tatra sa bhāryyayā sārddhaṃ vaṃdhumitra janairapi | praṇītaṃ bhojyapūjāṃgaṃ sādhayāmāsa satvaram || 12.278{76} || tato bhojyārcanāṃgāni sajjīkṛtya pramoditaḥ | vihāre sahasā gatvā natvā taṃ prārthayanmunim || 12.279{77} || bhagavannātha saṃbuddha samayo'yaṃ pravarttate | tadbhavān sāṃghikaiḥ sārddhaṃ samāgantuṃ samarhati || 12.280{78} || ityevaṃ prārthite tena sa saṃbuddhaḥ sasāṃghikaḥ | pratasthe sūryyavanmārge prātihāryaṃ pradarśayan || 12.281{79} || tataḥ kramātpurīṃ prāpya tadgṛhaṃ samupāviśat | taddatte pādyamādāya śuddhāsane nyaṣīdata || 12.282{80} || tatastān sāṃghikān sarvān saṃbuddhapramukhān kramāt | svasvāsanasamāsīnān dṛṣṭvā samyaksamarcayat || 12.283{81} || yathārhaṃ bhojanairvāpi varṇagandharasānvitaiḥ | saṃbuddhapramukhān saṃghān saṃtarpya paryatoṣayat || 12.284{82} || tataśca bhojanānte sa śodhayitvā bhujādikam | apanīya ca pātrāṇi tāmbūlādīnaḍhaukayat || 12.285{83} || tato yāni suratnāni pūrvasaṃkalpatāni hi | etaiḥ sarvaṃ suratnaistaṃ saṃbuddhaiḥ samavākiran || 12.286{84} || tāni ratnāni sarvāṇi saṃbuddhasyānubhāvataḥ | munerupari khe gatvā chatrībhūtvā sthitā vabhau || 12.287{85} || tatastaṃ sa gṛhī dṛṣṭvā dviguṇasaṃpramoditaḥ | pādau tasya munernatvā praṇidhānaṃ vyadhāttathā || 12.288{86} || anena dānadharmeṇa puṇyena kuśalena ca | bhaveyaṃ sugato buddho loke'ndhe'pariṇāyake || 12.289{87} || amukto mocayiṣyāmi tārayiṣyāmyatāritān | bhītānāśvāsya saṃbodhau sthāpayiṣyāmi nirvṛtau || 12.290{88} || tathāsau bhagavān buddhastathāśayaviśodhitam | saṃbodhau nihitaṃ cittaṃ jñātvā smitaṃ vyadhāttathā || 12.291{89} || tadā tasya munīndrasya mukhapadmādvinirgatāḥ | paṃcavarṇā vibhāsanto viniśceruḥ subhānavaḥ || 12.292{90} || tataste bhāsvarāḥ sarve pravisṛtāḥ samaṃtataḥ | kecidūrddhaṃ gatāḥ kecinmadhyaṃ kecidrasātale || 12.293{91} || kecidadho gatā yāste sarve te narakeṣu ca | nipataṃto vibhāsanto pravisasruḥ samaṃtataḥ || 12.294{92} || ye uṣṇanarakāsteṣu śitībhūtā vicerire | ye śītanarakāsteṣu nyapataduṣṇikāśca te || 12.295{93} || ye ye taiḥ kiraṇaiḥ spṛṣṭāste te sarve sukhānvitāḥ | yadā te sukhasaṃprāptāstadā te vismayānvitāḥ || 12.296{94} || aho naḥ sukhamadyaivaṃ kathametadvyacintayan | kiṃ nu vayamitaścyutvā kutra yātāsma sāṃpratam || 12.297{95} || āhosvidupapannāḥ syuranyatra bhuvaneṣvapi | iti saṃdehināṃ teṣāṃ satvānāṃ paribodhane || 12.298{96} || bhagavānnirmite buddhaṃ preṣayannarakān prati | dṛṣṭvā taṃ nirmitaṃ muniṃ vismitā harṣitāśca vai || 12.299{97} || te sarve narakā lokāḥ saṃmīlya saṃvabhāṣire | na bhavanta itaścyutvā gatāsmānyatra bhūmiṣu || 12.300{98} || kiṃstvayaṃ nu mahāsatvaḥ hyapūrvadarśanaḥ pumān | nūnamasyānubhāvena duḥkhāni samitāni ca || 12.301{99} || tadvayamenamānamya vaṃde mayā pramuktaye | iti saṃbhāṣya te sarve natvā taccharaṇaṃ gatāḥ || 12.302{100} || namo buddhāya dharmāya saṃghāyeti vavandire | iti te nirmite tasmin prasādya cittamāratāḥ || 12.303{1} || sarvapāpavinirmuktā martyadevālayaṃ yayuḥ | evaṃ te bhānavaḥ sarve sarvatra narakeṣvapi || 12.304{2} || prodyante nārakān sarvān pratyāyayurmuneḥ puraḥ | tathā tadbhānavaścaivamupariṣṭāṃ gatā api || 12.305{3} || te'pi sarve caturlokapālānāṃ bhuvanāni ca | avabhāsya kramātsarvān devalokānabhāsayan || 12.306{4} || tathākaniṣṭhaparyantaṃ traidhātukānabhāsayan | evaṃ sarvāśca tān sarvānavabhāsya samaṃtataḥ || 12.307{5} || gāthāḥ prodghoṣayantaśca pralayaṃ saugate vṛṣe | anityaṃ khalu saṃsāraṃ duḥkhaśūnyaṃ hyanātmakam || 12.308{6} || tasmātmāraṃ parityajya gachadhvaṃ śaraṇaṃ muneḥ | niṣkrāmatārabhadhvaṃ kaṃ yujyadhvaṃ buddhaśāsane || 12.309{7} || mṛtyusainyaṃ dhunītāśu naḍāgāraṃ karī yathā | yo'pyasmin dharmavinaye hyapramattaścariṣyati || 12.310{8} || tyaktvā jātisasaṃsāre duḥkhasyāntaṃ kariṣyati || 12.311{9!} || atha te bhānavaḥ sarve traidhātubhuvaneṣvapi | sarvān satvān samuddhṛtya punaḥ pratyāyayurmuneḥ || 12.312{10} || atha te bhānavaḥ sarve bhagavantaṃ munīśvaram | pradakṣiṇatrayaṃ kṛtvā mūrddhni cāntardadhurmuneḥ || 12.313{11} || athaitatsabhāsīnā lokāḥ sarve sasāṃghikāḥ | tattadadbhutamālokya vabhūvurvismayoddhatāḥ || 12.314{12} || athānaṃdaḥ samutthāya kṛtāṃjalipuṭo mudā | bhagavantaṃ guruṃ natvā papracha smitakāraṇam || 12.315{12!} || bhagavan bhavato vaktrātpaṃcavarṇāḥ subhāṃsavaḥ | vinirgatā diśaḥ sarvānavabhāsya śatā punaḥ || 12.316{13} || bhavān hi sugato śāstā saṃbuddho bhagavañjinaḥ | nirmado nirahaṃkāraḥ mānamātsaryyavarjitaḥ || 12.317{14} || tadbhava bhagavaṃ kasmātsmitaiḥ karoti sāṃpratam | dṛṣṭvaivaṃ taṃ smitaṃ sarve ime lokāḥ pravismitāḥ || 12.318{15} || nāhetuḥ sugatā buddhā arhanto vigatoddhavāḥ | darśayanti smitaṃ kecittatkena bhavataḥ smṛtam || 12.319{16} || tadetaddhetumichanti śrotuṃ sarve ime janāḥ | tadetatkāraṇaṃ śāstaḥ samādeṣṭuṃ samarhati || 12.320{17} || ityevaṃ prārthite tena śiṣyeṇānaṃdayoginā | tatheti pratisaṃmodya tamānaṃdaṃ vabhāṣata || 12.321{18} || evametattathānaṃda yathaiva bhāṣasi tvayā | tatsmitaṃ yadarthaṃ me tadvakṣye śṛṇutādarāt || 12.322{19} || paśyānaṃda mamānena sārthavāhena sādhunā | ebhī ratnaiśca satkṛtya kṛtā pūjā svabhaktitaḥ || 12.323{20} || anena kuśalenaiva sārthavāho mahāsudhīḥ | kramādbodhicarīṃ prāpya pūryya pāramitā daśa || 12.324{21} || saṃbodhipākṣikān dharmān prāpya brahmavihārikaḥ | saṃbodhiṃ samavāpyaivaṃ jitvā māragaṇānapi || 12.325{22} || buddho ratnottamo nāma sarvajño'rhaṃ tathāgataḥ | dharmarājo jagaṃnātho loke śāstā bhaviṣyati || 12.326{23} || tadanumodanāṃ kṛtvā saddharmaṃ bhajatādarāt | dharmeṇaiva jagajjitvā māracaryāvinirgataḥ || 12.327{24} || bhadracarī samāsādya saṃbodhipadamāpnuyāt | dharnio hi jagatāṃ mitramihāmutra samantataḥ || 12.328{25} || hitakārī suhṛdiṣṭaḥ sarvadāpi sahānugaḥ | tasmāddharmaṃ samādhāya saṃcaradhvaṃ samāhitaḥ || 12.329{26} || tena vā maṃgalaṃ nityaṃ sarvabhāvī bhaveddhruvam || 12.330{27} || iti śāstrā samādiṣṭaṃ śrutvānaṃdaḥ sapārṣadaḥ | tatheti moditastaṃ ca guruṃ natvā sa naṃdataḥ || 12.331{28} || so'pi sārthapatiścaiva svakaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ kila | munīndreṇa samādiṣṭaṃ śrutvātīvābhyanaṃdatat || 12.332{29} || tataścābhiprasannātmā samutthāya kṛtāṃjaliḥ | bhagavaṃtaṃ sasaṃghaṃ taṃ praṇatvaivaṃ vyatijñapat || 12.333{30} || namaste bhagavannātha sarvadharmādhipeśvaraḥ | bhavatāṃ śaraṇaṃ kṛtvā bhavāmyahamupāsakaḥ || 12.334{31} || yanmayā prakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ kāritaṃ cānumoditam | tatsarvaṃ deśayiṣyāmi tanme dehi śubhāṃ carim || 12.335{32} || bodhau cittaṃ samādhāya triratnaṃ samupāśraye | kṣamasva me'parādhatvaṃ tanmāṃ rakṣa mudā tathā || 12.336{33} || evaṃ tenārthitaṃ śrutvā sa saṃbuddho'bhyadhātpunaḥ | yathā te'bhihitaṃ sādho tathā saṃsetsyate dhruvam || 12.337{34} || tasmāccittaṃ samādhāya triratnaśaraṇaṃ gataḥ | sarvasatvahitaṃ kṛtvā bodhicaryāṃ samācara || 12.338{35} || tatastvaṃ kramato hyevaṃ pūrya pāramitā drutam | bodhisatvo mahāsatvo bhavedbodhimavāpnuyāt || 12.339{36} || etatsatyaṃ parijñāya saddharmaṃ saṃprasādhaya | tena te maṃgalaṃ nityaṃ sarvatrāpi bhaveddhruvam || 12.340{37} || jayo'stu te sadā bodhau siddhyatu praṇihitaṃ drutam | ciraṃ jīvaṃ hitaṃ loke dharmaṃ dhṛtvā sukhaṃ vasa || 12.341{38} || ityasau bhagavān buddhastasmai datvāśiṣaṃ śubhām | saṃghaiḥ saha samutthāya svaṃ vihāraṃ yayau tataḥ || 12.342{39} || atha sārthapatiścāsau sadāraḥ saṃpramoditaḥ | triratnaśaraṇaṃ kṛtvā saddharmeṣu sadācarat || 12.343{40} || tathā sarve'pi satvāśca śrutvā tasya pravṛttitām | bodhicittaṃ samādhāya triratnaśaraṇaṃ yayuḥ || 12.344{41} || etatme guruṇākhyātaṃ saṃśrutaṃ yathā mayā | tathātraivaṃ tava prītyā kathyate saṃprabudhyatām || 12.345{42} || tathā rājan tvayāpyevaṃ svayaṃ dhṛtvā vṛṣaṃ śubhe | bodhayitvā prajāścāpi sthāpanīyāḥ sadā śubhe || 12.346{43} || evaṃ cette sadāpyevaṃ sarvatrāpi sumaṃgalam | bhavennūnaṃ mahārājan satyametanna saṃśayaḥ | dharmeṇa nirjitaṃ pāpaṃ dharmeṇa jīyate kudhīḥ | dharmeṇa nirjitā mārā dharmeṇa bodhimāpnuyāt | tasmādbodhipadaṃ prāptuṃ yadīcchatha narādhipaḥ | bodhicittaṃ samādhāya sadā ratnatrayaṃ bhaja | tathā taṃ kramaṇo rāja bodhicaryyāhitāya ca | sarvamāragaṇāṃ jitvā saṃbodhimāpnuyā dhruvam | etattenopaguptena guruṇādiṣṭaṃ samādarāt | śrutvā rājo tathetyevaṃ pratyanandan sapārṣadaḥ | ye śṛṇvantīdamevaṃ praṇihitamanasaḥ sārthavāhāvadānam | ye cāpi śrāvayanti pramuditamanasaḥ sarvalokahitārtham | te sarve bodhisatvā vijitakalimalo buddhadharmānuraktāḥ | saṃbhuktvā satsukhāni prathitaguṇayutā buddhakṣetre prayānti | iti śrīratnamālāvadānakathāyāṃ sārthavāho'vadānaṃ nāma dvādaśa vaḍikāvadāna oṃ namaḥ śrīsarvabuddhabodhisatvebhyaḥ | yaḥ śrīmāñchrīghano loke saddharmaiḥ samupādiśat | śāsanāni trilokeṣu jayantu tasya sarvadā || 13.1{1} || avadānatatvaṃ vakṣyāmi natvā taṃ śrīghanaṃ gurum | purābhūtpāṭalīputre nagare svargasannibhe || 13.2{2} || aśoko nṛparājendrastriratnasevakaḥ kṛtī | ekasmin samaye tatra sa rājā svajanaiḥ saha || 13.3{3} || paurikaiśca sabhāṃ kṛtvā saddharmaṃ śrotumaicchata | tadā sa saugato bhikṣurupagupto jināṃśajaḥ || 13.4{4} || lokān dharmotsukān dṛṣṭvā samādheḥ sahasotthitaḥ | tatsabhāyāṃ samākramya siṃhāsane śubhāsane || 13.5{5} || bhāsayaṃstatsabhālokāṃstasthau pūrṇasudhāṃśuvat | athāśoko mahīpālaḥ sa maṃtripaurikaiḥ saha || 13.6{6} || pūjāṅgaiḥ pūjayitvā tamupaguptamavandata | sthitvā bhūmau svajānubhyāmuttarāsaṅgamudvahan || 13.7{7} || kṛtāñjaliḥ puṭo natvā punarevamabhāṣata | bhadanta śrotumicchāmi saddharmaṃ sukhasaṃpradam || 13.8{8} || yathoktaṃ śrīmunīndreṇa tathā deṣṭuṃ ca me'rhati | evaṃ tena mahīndreṇa prārthite sa yatīśvaraḥ || 13.9{9} || upagupto narendraṃ taṃ samāmantryaivamabravīt | sādhu suṣṭhu mahārāja śṛṇu saddharmamādarāt || 13.10{10} || yathā me guruṇā khyātaṃ tathā vakṣyāmi te hite | purā sa bhagavān buddhaḥ śakyasiṃho śubhākaraḥ || 13.11{11} || dharmarājo jagacchāstā sarvajñaḥ sugato jinaḥ | sarvavidyākalāvijñaḥ ṣaḍabhijño munīśvaraḥ || 13.12{12} || mārajillokavinnātho vināyakastathāgataḥ | śrāvastyāṃ jetakāraṇye mahodyāne manorame || 13.13{13} || anāthapiṇḍadākhyasya gṛhasthasya mahātmanaḥ | nānāvṛkṣasamākīrṇe nānāpuṣpapraśobhitaiḥ || 13.14{14} || nānāphalabharānamraiḥ kalpavṛkṣasamānikaiḥ | aṣṭāṅgaguṇasaṃpannajalaiḥ padmotpālādibhiḥ || 13.15{15} || supuṣpaiḥ paripūrṇābhiḥ puṣkariṇībhirāśrite | nānājantuguṇaiścāpi mithaḥ snehānuvandhitaiḥ || 13.16{16} || nānāpakṣigaṇaiścāpi saṃharṣairupasevite | tasmiṃ divyamanoramye munisaṃghaniṣevite || 13.17{17} || puṇyakṣetre jināvāse vihāre maṇimaṇḍite | śrāvakairbhikṣubhiḥ sārddhaṃ bodhisatvairupāsakaiḥ || 13.18{18} || sarvasatvahitārthena tasthau dharmmaṃ prakāśitum | evaṃ tatra sabhāsīnaṃ saṃbuddhaṃ dharmabhāṣiṇam || 13.19{19} || dṛṣṭvā dharmāmṛtaṃ pātuṃ sarvalokāḥ samāyayuḥ || 13.20{19!} || daivā daityāśca siddhāśca yakṣagaṃdharvakinnarāḥ | grahā vidyādharāḥ sādhyā nāgeṃdrā garuḍā api || 13.21{20} || sarve'pi lokapālāśca munayaśca maharṣayaḥ | yatayo yoginaścāpi tīrthikāśca tapaśvinaḥ || 13.22{21} || brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyāścāpi vaiśyāḥ śūdrāśca maṃtriṇaḥ | amātyāḥ koṭṭavārāśca sārthavāhā mahājanāḥ || 13.23{22} || śilpino vaṇijaścāpi gṛhasthāḥ paurikā janāḥ | tathā jānapadāścāpi grāmyāḥ kārpaṭikā api || 13.24{23} || evamanye'pi satvāśca sarvajātisamudbhavāḥ | pūjāpaṃcopahārāṇi gṛhītvā bhaktimānasā || 13.25{24} || saddharmaṃ śraddhayā śrotumanumodya samāyayuḥ | tatra sarve praviṣṭāste dṛṣṭvā taṃ sugataṃ jinam || 13.26{25} || vanditvānanditāḥ sarve pūjāṃ cakruryathākramam || 13.27{26!} || tato natvā samāsīnāḥ parivṛtya pramoditāḥ | dharmmaṃ śrotuṃ puraskṛtya tasthuḥ sāñjalayo mudā || 13.28{27} || atha sa bhagavān dṛṣṭvā tāṃllokān dharmavāñchinaḥ | ādimadhyāntakalyāṇaṃ dideśa dharmamuttamam || 13.29{28} || evaṃ sa bhagavānnityaṃ sarvasatvahitārthikaḥ | dharmaṃ prakāśayaṃ loke tasthau dīptāṃśumāniva || 13.30{29} || tasminnavasare tatra śrāvastyāṃ purisaṃbhavaḥ | āḍhyaḥ śreṣṭhī mahābhogaḥ suvistīrṇaparigrahaḥ || 13.31{30} || śrāddho bhadrāśayo dhīraḥ sarvalokasuhṛtpriyaḥ | tīrthikasevako mānī vabhūva śrīmadānvitaḥ || 13.32{31} || tadā sa sundarībhāryāṃ kuladharmasamānikām | ādāya ratisaṃrakto reme nityaṃ yathāsukham || 13.33{32} || tasyaivaṃ ramamāṇasya bhāryā sābhūtsugarbhiṇī | tataḥ pravṛddhagarbhā sā pāṇḍuvarṇā vyarājata || 13.34{33} || tataḥ sā garbhasaṃjātaṃ putraṃ tasyāmupāśritam | putraṃ matvābhinaṃdaṃtī bharttāramevamabravīt || 13.35{34} || svāmin garbhe prajāto me yatkukṣau dakṣiṇāśritaḥ | dārako'yaṃ bhavetputraḥ nūnaṃ tasmātpramodaya || 13.36{35} || iti bhāryoditaṃ śrutvā sa gṛhasthaḥ praharṣitaḥ | garbhe sa vyāśritaṃ dṛṣṭvā mudaivaṃ samudānayat || 13.37{36} || vata me jāyate putrastadahaṃ bhāgyavān bhave | putramukhaṃ hi paśyeyaṃ vaṃśasthitirbhavedapi || 13.38{37} || yanmama vidyate puṇyaṃ dānaśīlādisaṃcitam | tenānayordvayorastu jananīputrayoḥ śivam || 13.39{38} || evaṃ proktvā gṛhasthaḥ sa śraddhayā saṃpramoditaḥ | bhikṣvarthibrāhmaṇebhyaśca dadau dānaṃ yathepsitam || 13.40{39} || kuleṣṭadevatāścāpi samabhyarcya yathāvidhi | tacchubhaṃ prārthayannityaṃ tasthau putrasamutsukaḥ || 13.41{40} || tataḥ sā bhadrikā nārī pathyopacārabhoginī | asūta samaye putraṃ suṃdaraṃ lakṣaṇānvitam || 13.42{41} || tataḥ sa janakaḥ śrutvā saṃprajātaṃ sutaṃ mudā | sahasā samupāsritya dadarśa taṃ sasuṃdaram || 13.43{42} || darśanīyaṃ subhadrāṅgaṃ prāsādikaṃ manoharam | dṛṣṭvāpi suciraṃ paśyanneva tasthāvatṛptitaḥ || 13.44{43} || tato jātimahaṃ kṛtvā tasya pitrā prasādinā | vaḍika iti nāmnā prakhyāpito'bhūtsa dārakaḥ || 13.45{45!} || tataḥ sa vālako'ṣṭābhyo dhātrībhyaḥ pratipālane | mānayitvānusaṃbhāṣya pitrā samarpito'bhavat || 13.46{46} || tathā sa vaḍiko vālo'ṣṭābhirdhātrībhirādarāt | pālyamānaḥ pravṛddho'bhūthradasthamiva paṃkajam || 13.47{47} || yadā sa dārakaḥ paṃcavarṣito'bhūnmadānvitaḥ | tadā vidyopalabdhārthī lipiśālāmupāviśat || 13.48{48} || tatra sa sadguruṃ natvā kramāllipīnmudāgrahīt | gurubhaktiprasādena lipipāraṃ yayau laghu || 13.49{49} || tataḥ sa gurubhiḥ samyacchiṣyamāṇaḥ subuddhimān | adhītya sarvaśāstrāṇi vidyāpāraṃ yayau laghu || 13.50{50} || tadā tadvaḍikasyāpi pūrvakarmavipākataḥ | dehe kasmātsamutpanno mahāvyādhiḥ parākramat || 13.51{51} || tadā sa vyādhinā tena pīḍyamāno'bhimūrchitaḥ | asahyavedanākrānto virurāva divāniśam || 13.52{52} || tathā taṃ vyādhināghrātamasahyavedanāturam | krandantaṃ sa pitā dṛṣṭvā kṛpayaivaṃ vyaciṃtayat || 13.53{53} || hā me daivaviruddhena putro'yaṃ vyādhimūrchitaḥ | asahyavedanākrānto bhoktumapi na vāñchati || 13.54{54} || avaśyaṃ maraṇaṃ yāyātkathaṃ jīvedabhuktavān | mṛte putre mariṣye'haṃ snehaduḥkhaṃ kathaṃ sahe || 13.55{55} || iti cintāvyathākrānto bhogye'pi viratotsavaḥ | tameva svātmajaṃ paśyaṃstasthau snehābhivandhitaḥ || 13.56{56} || mātāpi taṃ sutaṃ dṛṣṭvā snehaduḥkhāgnitāpitā | mṛtyuśaṃkā paritrastā rudantī samupācarat || 13.57{57} || tadā tasya suhṛnmitravāṃdhavāḥ samupāgatāḥ | sarve te rogiṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā snehārttā evamabruvan || 13.58{58} || kiṃ bho svasthaṃ na te dehe bhoktuṃ kiṃ vā na vāñchasi | bhuṃkṣva yathepsitaṃ pathyaṃ tiṣṭha dhairyaṃ samāśrayan || 13.59{59} || iti prokte'pi taiḥ sarvaiḥ sa vaḍiko jvarānvitaḥ | dṛṣṭvaiva tānmuhuḥ paśyannaiva kiñcidabhāṣata || 13.60{60} || tataḥ sarve'pi te dṛṣṭvā taṃ vaḍikaṃ rujāturam | mṛtyuśaṃkāviṣādigdhaṃ pitaraṃ taṃ tathāvadan || 13.61{61} || sādho'sya varddhate rogastadrogavyupāśāntaye | sahasā vaidyamāhūya darśayasva samāhitaḥ || 13.62{62} || upadiṣṭaṃ yathā tena vaidyena sudhiyā tathā | paricaryyāṃ samādhāya kurūpacāramādarāt || 13.63{63} || tathā pathyopacāreṇa siddhauṣadhyasahairapi | kramādasya śarīrastho rogaḥ śāntiṃ vrajeddhruvam || 13.64{64} || tataste'yaṃ suto bhadraḥ paripuṣṭatanuḥkṛtī | svakuladharmamādhāya sukhaṃ jīvecchubhe caran || 13.65{65} || iti matvā mahābhāga mā kṛthāstadviṣādanam | dhairyamālamvya devāṃśca smṛtvā bhuktvā sukhaṃ vasa || 13.66{66} || ityevaṃ samupādiśya tadgṛhasthātsamutthitāḥ | sarve te snehaduḥkhārttāḥ svasvagehamupācarat || 13.67{67} || tataḥ sa gṛhabhṛttasya putrasya rogaśāṃtaye | sadvaidyaṃ samupāhūya sādaraṃ samadarśayat || 13.68{68} || tasya roganimittaṃ sa vaidyo dṛṣṭvā samīkṣya ca | pathyauṣadhyupacāreṇa samāhita upācarat || 13.69{69} || tathāpi tasya tadrogaḥ parivṛddho dine dine | kenāpi hyupacāreṇa naiva śāntimupāyayau || 13.70{70} || tadrogaṃ varddhitaṃ dṛṣṭvā janakaḥ sa viṣāditaḥ | bhūtikaṃ sahasāhūya rogahetumapṛcchata || 13.71{71} || tataḥ sa bhūtiko dṛṣṭvā tasya rogapraśāntaye | sa bhūtadevatābhyaśca valiṃ prādādyathāvidhi || 13.72{72} || tathāpi vṛṃhito rogastasya karmavipākataḥ | kiñcidapi viśeṣeṇa naiva śāntimupāyayau || 13.73{73} || tataḥ sa janako dṛṣṭvā tadrogaṃ parivarddhitam | āyurvidamupāmaṃtrya rogahetumapṛcchata || 13.74{74} || sa ayurvidako dṛṣṭvā tasya grahadaśāphalam | kudaśāvyupaśāntyarthaṃ grahapūjāmupādiśat || 13.75{75} || tathā sa janakastasya rogiṇo grahaśāntaye | brāhmaṇaṃ samupāmantrya grahapūjāmakārayat || 13.76{76} || tathāpi tasya tadrogo varddhito na śamaṃ yayau | daivena samupāghrāte tadupāye na siddhyate || 13.77{77} || tathā sa janakastasya putrasya rogavṛddhitam | dṛṣṭvā nirāśayā bhinnacitto mūrcchāmupāyayau || 13.78{78} || tadā sā supriyā bhāryā bharttāraṃ taṃ vimohitam | dṛṣṭvaiva samupāgṛhya samāśvāsyaivamabravīt || 13.79{79} || svāmin dhairyyaṃ samālambya tyaja citte vimohatām | kimasmākaṃ prayatnena daivasyātra pramāṇike || 13.80{80} || sarvathā bhāvino bhāvāḥ phalaṃti sarvajīvinām | yadabhāvi na tadbhāvi bhāvi cenna tadanyathā || 13.81{81} || tasmāddaivaprasādāya svakuleśeṣṭadevatāḥ | anusmṛtya samārādhya yācasva putrajīvitam || 13.82{82} || iti bhāryoditaṃ śrutvā sa gṛhastho'numoditaḥ | kuladevaṃ samabhyarcya prārthayadevamādarāt || 13.83{83} || prasīda me kuleśa tvaṃ kṣamasva hyaparādhatām | tavaiva śaraṇastho'haṃ tanme putraṃ prarakṣatām || 13.84{84} || evaṃ tena gṛhasthena prārthite'pi divāniśam | tasya rogo vivṛddho'bhūnnaiva śāmyamupākramat || 13.85{85} || tathā brahmādidevāṃśca sarvān lokādhipānapi | vihāramaṇḍapārāmakṣetrāraṇyasamāśritān || 13.86{86} || nadīkūpataḍāgādijalāśrayapratisthitān | balibhoktṝn kalaṃkasthānmārgaśṛṅgāṭakāśritān || 13.87{87} || evamanyatra sarvatra pratisthitān samarcayan | putrasyārogyakauśalyaṃ jīvitaṃ sa samarthayan || 13.88{88} || tathāpi tasya rogo na śamito'bhūtpravarddhitaḥ | tatastaṃ janako dṛṣṭvā nirāśā mūrchito'patat || 13.89{89} || tadā sa vaḍiko rogī pitaraṃ taṃ vimūrchitam | pṛthivyāṃ patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā śanairnīcasvaro'vadat || 13.90{90} || hā hā me jāvate pāpaṃ yenāyaṃ patitaḥ pitā | snehaduḥkhāgnisaṃtaptaḥ putrato maraṇaṃ vrajet || 13.91{91} || hā tātottiṣṭha māṃ paśya mā tyajātmajamāturam | dhairyyamālamvya saṃdhāya rakṣa māṃ samupasthitaḥ || 13.92{92} || ityasau vilapan putraḥ pitaraṃ taṃ vimūrchitam | dṛṣṭvā bhojanaketyaśru muñcaṃstasthau nirāśritaḥ || 13.93{93} || tadā sā supriyā bhāryyā bharttāraṃ taṃ vimūrchitam | dṛṣṭvaiva sahasāliṃgya samutthāpyaivamabravīt || 13.94{94} || svāmin dhairyaṃ samālaṃbya paśya māṃ te priyaṃ satīm | tyaktvā dainyaṃ samādhāya paśyan rakṣātmakaṃ priyam || 13.95{95} || iti bhāryoditaṃ śrutvā sa gṛhastho samutthitaḥ | dṛṣṭvā tāṃ supriyāṃ bhāryāṃ putraṃ caivamabhāṣata || 13.96{96} || hā daiva kiṃ mayā pāpaṃ prakṛtaṃ dāruṇaṃ purā | yenāyaṃ sukṛtī putraḥ tyaktvā māṃ kva prayāsyati || 13.97{97} || hā hā me saṃpadaścaitāḥ samṛddhāḥ samupārjitāḥ | ko nu bhoktā bhavedāsāṃ vyarthaṃ nakṣyanti sarvaśaḥ || 13.98{98} || kimatrāhaṃ kariṣyāmi yāsyāmi śaraṇaṃ ca kam | ko nu māṃ sahasā rakṣeddatvā putrasya jīvitam || 13.99{99} || kimatrāsya rujaḥ śāntyai kariṣyāmi pratikriyām | na jāne parimūḍho'smi cetanā me na vidyate || 13.100{100} || iti cintāparītātmā putrasnehavimohitaḥ | kāruṇākulacitto'pi punarevaṃ vyacintayat || 13.101{101} || yadime tīrthikā vijñā bhagavanto vicakṣaṇāḥ | sarvajñāḥ sadguṇādhārāḥ śāstāro me hitaṃkarāḥ || 13.102{102} || tattān sarvān samāmaṃtrya gṛhe bhokṣyaiḥ samarcayan | imaṃ putraṃ puraḥ sthāpya darśayeyaṃ śubhāptaye || 13.103{103} || tatsudṛṣṭiprasādena nūnamasya bhavecchuvam | tato hi kramaśo rogāḥ śāmyeyuḥ sarvathā laghu || 13.104{104} || tadāyamātmajaḥ puṣṭo na rogī sutanuḥ sukhī | kṛtī śubharato bhogī kuladharme samācaret || 13.105{105} || iti niścitya sa śreṣṭhī tatra tīrthyāśrame gataḥ | tān sarvāṃstīrthikānnatvā prārthayedevamādarāt || 13.106{106} || namo vo brahmavijñebhyo bhavatāṃ śaraṇaṃ vraje | vijñapyate yadarthaṃ tadanugrahītumarhata || 13.107{107} || iti tenoditaṃ śrutvā tīrthikāste'bhimānikāḥ | sarve taṃ samupāmaṃtrya pramodayitumabruvan || 13.108{108} || sādhu vada mahāsādho yatte kāryaṃ samīhitam | tatsarvaṃ sarvathāsmābhiḥ kṛtamevaṃ kariṣyate || 13.109{109} || iti taistīrthikaiḥ prokte sa śreṣṭhī saṃprasāditaḥ | kṛtāñjalipuṭo natvā punarevamabhāṣata || 13.110{110} || bhagavanto mahāvijñā bhavanto guravo mama | tatsarvaṃ pratijānīta yadarthaṃ samupācare || 13.111{111} || tathāpi cārthayiṣye'tra yanme kaṣṭaṃ pravarttate | tadvo vijñāpanaṃ kartuṃ bhavataḥ śaraṇaṃ vraje || 13.112{112} || yanmayā prakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tena me svātmajādhunā | rogaiḥ saṃpīḍyate'tīvaniḥsvastho maraṇaṃ vrajet || 13.113{113} || nānāsvastividhānairhi tasya rogo na śāmyati | bhiṣajāṃ kṛtayatnāni na siddhyanti kathaṃ cana || 13.114{114} || anekā devatāścāpi prābhyarcya prārthito mayā | tathāpi śāmyate naiva tasya rogo vivarddhitaḥ || 13.115{115} || yathā yathā rujāśāntisvastyupāyakṛtāni hi | tathā tathā na tadrogaḥ praśāmyati pravarddhyate || 13.116{116} || kimupāyaṃ kariṣyāmi kena śāmyeta tadgadaḥ | tadupāyaṃ pradātavyaṃ yenāśu śāmyate kramāt || 13.117{117} || iti vijñāpanāṃ kartuṃ bhavatāṃ śaraṇaṃ vraje | tanme'nukampayāsu no rogaśāntirvidhīyatām || 13.118{118} || bhavanto me'nuśāstāraḥ sarvajñā brahmacāriṇaḥ | tanme sukṛpayā dṛṣṭyā paritrātuṃ samarhata || 13.119{119} || iti tenārthitaṃ śrutvā sarve te tīrthikā api | śreṣṭhinaṃ taṃ samāmaṃtrya punarevaṃ samabruvan || 13.120{120} || śṛṇu sādho yadasmābhirhitārthaṃ te pracakṣyatām | tatsatyaṃ naḥ parijñāya pramāṇīkriyatāṃ kila || 13.121{121} || vayaṃ hi sarvalokānāṃ śāstāro hitasādhakāḥ | tasmādatra viṣādatvaṃ mā kṛthā dhairyamāśraya || 13.122{122} || adyaiva sahasā gatvā vayaṃ dṛṣṭvā tavātmajam | niḥpāpaṃ nīrujaṃ svāsthyaṃ kariṣyāmaḥ sujīvitam || 13.123{123} || apyetadvacanaṃ satyaṃ śrutvā dṛṣṭvā pramāṇaya | anyathā na bhavetkvāpi hyasmākaṃ brahmacāriṇām || 13.124{124} || iti taistīrthikaiḥ proktaṃ śrutvā sa gṛhasattamaḥ | tatheti pratiharṣitvā natvā tān svagṛhaṃ yayau || 13.125{125} || tatra sa gṛha āsādya dāsidāsajanaiḥ saha | tadarhabhojyapūjāṅgasāmagrīṃ samasādhayat || 13.126{126} || tasminneva kṣaṇe tatra sarve te tīrthikā mudā | sahasā samupāgatya svasvāsane upāviśat || 13.127{127} || tathā tān samupāsīnān dṛṣṭvā śreṣṭhī sa moditaḥ | pūjāṅgaiḥ kramato'bhyarcya bhojanaiḥ samatoṣayat || 13.128{128} || tataśca bhojanānte sa vaḍikaṃ taṃ priyātmajam | rogiṇaṃ samupāhṛtya teṣāṃ puro'bhyadarśayat || 13.129{129} || te sarve tīrthikā dṛṣṭvā vaḍikaṃ taṃ rujānvitam | tadāmayanimittaṃ ca nirīkṣyaivamupādiśat || 13.130{130} || aho hyasya mahārogaṃ mahāpātakasaṃbhavam | tatpātakavimuktyai tu dātavyaṃ dānamādarāt || 13.131{131} || tadyathā navaratnāni hemalakṣapalāni ca | śraddhayā brahmacāribhyaḥ saṃpradadyātsamarcayan || 13.132{132} || yadyetaddīyate dānaṃ tvayā gṛhapate tathā | bhagnakuṣmāṇḍadarinamahiṣīśatadakṣiṇā || 13.133{133} || purā dattā naṃdarājñā asmākaṃ brahmacāriṇām | pādasphoṭāmayastasya śāṃto'bhūttatprabhāvataḥ || 13.134{134} || tathāsya sarvapāpāni vinakṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ | tataḥ sarve'pi rogāśca vinakṣyanti kramāddrutam || 13.135{135} || tato rogairvimukto'yaṃ kuśalī svāsthyamāpnuyāt | tataḥ puṣṭo viśuddhāṅgaḥ suśīlaḥ sukṛtī sudhīḥ | svakulācāradharmiṣṭho vaṃśāṃścāpi samuddharet || 13.136{136} || iti matvā tvayā sādho dātavyaṃ dānamādarāt | anyathā na bhavetsvasti tavāsya naṃdanasya ca || 13.137{167} || iti tairgaditaṃ śrutvā sa śreṣṭhī paribodhitaḥ | tasyātmajasya trāṇārthaṃ tathā dātumudācarat || 13.138{[138]} || tataḥ sa punarabhyarcya tān sarvānstīrthikān patīn | pradadau navaratnāni svarṇalakṣapalāni ca || 13.139{139} || tataste tīrthikāḥ sarve dṛṣṭvā tāni pramoditāḥ | sarvānyapi pratigṛhya tathāśīrvacanaṃ daduḥ || 13.140{140} || svastyastu te sadā sādho kalyāṇamastu sarvathā | nīrogī suciraṃ jīvyā jayo'stu te samantataḥ || 13.141{141} || etadeva samādiśya sarve te tīrthikāstataḥ | tāni sarvāṇi vastūni pratigṛhyāśramaṃ yayuḥ || 13.142{142} || tathāpi tasya rogā na śamitā varddhitāḥ kramāt | svadaivaphalabhogyāni bhoktavyāni hi sarvathā || 13.143{143} || tatastajjanako dṛṣṭvā svātmajaṃ taṃ rujāturam | nirāśāmūrchito bhūmau nipataṃ vyalapattathā || 13.144{144} || hā daiva kiṃ mayā pāpaṃ dāruṇaṃ prakṛtaṃ purā | yato'yaṃ svātmajaḥ putraḥ puro me maraṇaṃ vrajet || 13.145{145} || kṛtānyupāyayatnāni dānāni vividhāni ca | sarvāṇyetāni matpāpairnisphalāni bhavanti hi || 13.146{146} || kiṃ mayātrāpi karttavyaṃ ko'tra me hitamādiśet | sarvathāhaṃ vinaṣṭo'smi ko'pi trātā na vidyate || 13.147{147} || kasyātra śaraṇaṃ yāsye ko no rakṣeddayādṛśā | sarve vayaṃ vinaṣṭāsma hā daiva śaraṇaṃ vraje || 13.148{148} || ityevaṃ vilapaṃtaṃ taṃ janakaṃ vaḍiko'pi saḥ | dṛṣṭvā śanaiḥ samāhūya pura evamabhāṣata || 13.149{149} || bho tāta kiṃ tvayātrāpi karttavyaṃ hi mayāpi ca | sarveṣāmapi jantūnāṃ daivagatiḥ pramāṇikā || 13.150{150} || iti matvā viṣādatvaṃ hṛdaye mā kṛthāstyaja | saṃbuddhaśaraṇaṃ kṛtvā bhaja nityamanusmaran || 13.151{151} || buddha eva jagacchāstā trātā lokahitaṃkaraḥ | durgatitārako nātho bharttā sadgatināyakaḥ || 13.152{152} || tadevaṃ sugataṃ smṛtvā saddharmaṃ samupāśrayan | saṃghānāṃ bhajanaṃ kṛtvā cinu puṇyaṃ samāhitaḥ || 13.153{153} || triratne sādhitaṃ puṇyaṃ na kṣiṇuyātkadā cana | yadi daivādvipattiḥ syātpuṇyaṃ tu labhate varam || 13.154{154} || puṇyena rakṣyate lokaḥ puṇyena sadgatiṃ vrajet | tasmātpuṇyaṃ mahāratnaṃ cinu dhairyaṃ samāśrayan || 13.155{155} || avaśyamaraṇe loke kiṃ viṣādena siddhyate | iti matvāpi taṃ buddhaṃ smṛtvā bhaja samāhitaḥ || 13.156{156} || tathāhaṃ vā tamevātra saṃbuddhaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajan | saṃsmṛtvā bhajanaṃ kurvan vrajeya maraṇaṃ dhruvam || 13.157{157} || yadi tasya jinendrasya kṛpāsti mayi pāpini | tatkṛpādṛkprasādena jīveya nīrujaḥ punaḥ || 13.158{158} || yadi daivabalenāhaṃ mṛte tatsmṛtipuṇyataḥ | sarvathā durgatiṃ tyaktvā sadgatiṃ punarāpnuyām || 13.159{159} || evaṃ jñātvā tvayā tāta mā kriyatāṃ viṣādatā | saṃsāre'vaśyaṃ marttavyaṃ sarveṣāmapi janminām || 13.160{160} || ityuktvā sa rujārtto'pi vaḍiko dhairyyamāśrayan | saṃbuddhaṃ śaraṇaṃ kṛtvā smṛtvā tasthau samāhitaḥ || 13.161{161} || tathā sa gṛhabhṛcchreṣṭhī śrutvaitadātmajoditam | satyametatparijñāya buddhaṃ smṛtvā tathāvadat || 13.162{162} || namo buddhāya dharmāya saṃghāya ca sadā smare | adyārabhya sadā nityaṃ bhavatāṃ śaraṇaṃ vraje || 13.163{163} || yadi vo'sti kṛpā loke rakṣantu naḥ suduḥkhinaḥ | sarvathā kṛpayā dṛṣṭyā dṛṣṭvāśu trātumarhati || 13.164{164} || yathānye tribhave lokā bhavadbhiḥ pratipālitāḥ | tathāsmān kṛpayā dṛṣṭvā trātumarhati sarvathā || 13.165{165} || rakṣatu bhagavannātha jīvayeyaṃ mamātmajam | kṛpayānugrahaṃ kṛtvā putraratnaṃ prayaccha me || 13.166{166} || yadi jīvedayaṃ putro bhavaddṛṣṭiprasādataḥ | bhavatāṃ śaraṇe sthitvā caratu vratamādarāt || 13.167{167} || ityevaṃ smaraṇaṃ kṛtvā saṃbuddhaśaraṇaṃ vrajan | sa śreṣṭhī taṃ sutaṃ dṛṣṭvā tasthau mohavinoditaḥ || 13.168{168} || tasminneva kṣaṇe lokāṃ trātuṃ sa bhagavānmuniḥ | saṃpaśyan kṛpayā dṛṣṭyā prādrākṣīttān saduḥkhinaḥ || 13.169{169} || tathā tān duḥkhino dṛṣṭvā bhagavān sa jineśvaraḥ | sahasā tān paritrātuṃ buddharasmiṃ vyamuñcata || 13.170{170} || tābhiḥ kanakavarṇābhiḥ saṃbuddharaśmibhistadā | samantātsamatikramya tadgṛhamavabhāsitam || 13.171{171} || tato maitryaṃśavaścāpi tena bhagavatā punaḥ | samutṣṛṣṭāstanau tasya paryaspṛśan prasāditāḥ || 13.172{172} || tatastasya tanustaiḥ saṃspṛṣṭamātre samaṃtataḥ | prahlāditā sukhaprāptā svāsthyatāṃ samupāyayau || 13.173{173} || tataḥ sa vaḍikaḥ svāsthyaṃ prāpya nirmalamānasaḥ | vismitaḥ pitaraṃ paśyan samāmaṃtryaivamabravīt || 13.174{174} || aho buddhasya māhātmyamaho dharmānubhāvatā | aho saṃghaprabhāvatvaṃ paśya tāta muneḥ prabhām || 13.175{175} || yasyānusmṛtimātreṇa kṛpā loke prasāryate | dhanyo'yaṃ bhagavān buddho jayatvevaṃ sadā sthitaḥ || 13.176{176} || yasya dayānubhāvena jīvema nīrujaḥ sukhī | pāpaiścāpi vimukto'hamiti satyaṃ pramanyate || 13.177{177} || tasmāttameva śāstāraṃ saṃbuddhaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraje | yāvadbhavamanusmṛtvā bhajeya samupāśritaḥ || 13.178{178} || evaṃ buddhaguṇān smṛtvā vaḍikaḥ sa pramoditaḥ | kṛtāñjaliḥ smaran bhūyaḥ praṇatvaivamayācata || 13.179{179} || namaste bhagavannātha bhavatāṃ śaraṇaṃ vraje | yāvadbhavaṃ triratnānāṃ bhaveyaṃ sevakaḥ sadā || 13.180{180} || ityevaṃ sugataṃ smṛtvā vaḍikaḥ so'bhibodhitaḥ | bhūyo bhūyaḥ smarannatvā tasthau svāsthyatvamāgataḥ || 13.181{181} || tadā sa bhagavān buddho dṛṣṭvā taṃ śuddhamānasam | saddharmaṃ samupādeṣṭuṃ taddvāre samupāsarat || 13.182{182} || taddvārasamupāsīnaṃ taṃ munīndraṃ raviprabham | dṛṣṭvaiva vismito dvāsthaḥ sahasā gṛhamāviśat || 13.183{183} || tatra gṛhapatiṃ dṛṣṭvā vaḍikaṃ taṃ ca sādaram | purataḥ samupetyaiva vyajñāpayatsasatvaraḥ || 13.184{184} || gṛhapate munīndro'tra gṛhadvāra upasthitaḥ | tadatra sahasopetya samāmaṃtrya praveśaya || 13.185{185} || iti tenoditaṃ śrutvā vaḍikaḥ sa prasāditaḥ | utthitaḥ sahasopetya taṃ munīndraṃ mudānamat || 13.186{186} || natvā taṃ sugataṃ gehe prajñapya svāsanaṃ mudā | vijñapya samupāmaṃtrya praveśayaṃstathārthayan || 13.187{167!} || svāgataṃ bhagavan vāṃche bhavatāṃ śaraṇaṃ mune | praviśatu jagannātha vijayasvāsane śubhe || 13.188{168} || iti tenodite buddho bhagavān sa samāviśan | svāsane samupāsīno vaḍikaṃ taṃ tathāvadat || 13.189{1691} || kiṃ te vaḍika duḥkhatvaṃ vādhakaśca kathaṃ vada | iti bhagavatā pṛṣṭo vaḍikaḥ sa tathāvadat || 13.190{190} || kāyikaṃ jāyate duḥkhaṃ cetasikaṃ ca me mune | tadbhavān kṛpayā dṛṣṭyā śamayettatprabādhanam || 13.191{191} || iti tadvijñāpitaṃ śrutvā bhagavān sa munīśvaraḥ | taccittaduḥkhaśāntyarthaṃ maitrīdharmamupādiśat || 13.192{192} || vaḍikātra sadā loke maitracittaṃ samācara | anena te manodāhaṃ praśāmyeta sadāpi hi || 13.193{193} || ityādiśya munīndraḥ sa punarevaṃ vyaciṃtayat | vatendrakṣīrikāṃ nāma mahauṣadhāṃ samānayet || 13.194{194} || iti cittamataṃ śāstuḥ parijñāya surādhipaḥ | ādāya kṣīrikāṃ nāma mahauṣadhīmupānayat || 13.195{195} || tatra so surarājastaṃ bhagavantaṃ praṇamya tām | mahauṣadhīmupasthāpya pura evaṃ samabravīt || 13.196{196} || bhagavan pratigṛhṇātu divyauṣadhīmimāṃ bhavān | anayātra yathākāryaṃ sādhayatu sukhāptaye || 13.197{197} || ityukte tena śakreṇa dṛṣṭvā tāṃ bhagavānmuniḥ | gṛhītvā vaḍikāyaivaṃ pradatvā caivamādiśat || 13.198{198} || gṛhāṇa vaḍikemāṃ te kāyikaduḥkhaśāminīm | anayā te śarīre saṃskriyatāmupacāraṇaiḥ || 13.199{199} || ityādiṣṭe munīndreṇa vaḍikaḥ so'numoditaḥ | tatheti tāṃ samādāya yathādiṣṭamupācarat || 13.200{200} || tatastasya tanū rogairvimuktā paripuṣṭitā | krameṇa śāmyasaundaryaṃ prāpyābhiparyaśobhata || 13.201{201} || tataḥ śāstrā yathādiṣṭaṃ vaḍikena tathā hṛdi | maitrī prabhāvitā loke svātmaje supriye yathā || 13.202{202} || tadā tasya mahadduḥkhaṃ cetasikaṃ śaśāma tat | mahāmaitryā pariṣikte hṛdaye'gnirivāmbubhiḥ || 13.203{103!} || tataḥ sa vaḍikaḥ svasthaḥ pariśuddhendriyaḥ sudhīḥ | bhagavantaṃ tamānamya prārthayadevamādarāt || 13.204{104} || vande'haṃ bhavatāṃ pādau sarvadā śaraṇaṃ vraje | tathā ca sarvadā nātha kṛpayā trātumarhati || 13.205{105} || yadyevaṃ bhavatāṃ śāstaḥ kṛpādṛṣṭirna vidyate | mṛto'haṃ narake'dyāpi gato duḥkhānyavāpnuyām || 13.206{106} || yadevaṃ svasthito jīve tatte kṛpāmbubhāvataḥ | tathā me'nugrahaṃ kartuṃ nityamarhati sarvadā || 13.207{107} || ityevaṃ prārthanāṃ kṛtvā bhūyaḥ sa vaḍiko mudā | sāñjaliḥ praṇatiṃ kṛtvā paśyaṃstasthau munīśvaram || 13.208{108} || tathā tajjanakaḥ śreṣṭhī sadāraḥ saṃpramoditaḥ | triratne śaraṇaṃ kṛtvā saṃbuddhaṃ taṃ samarcayat || 13.209{109} || tataḥ sa gṛhabhṛcchreṣṭhī dṛṣṭvā taṃ sugataṃ mudā | kṛtāñjalipuṭo natvā prārthayadevamādarāt || 13.210{210} || vande te caraṇau śāstaḥ sarvadā śaraṇaṃ vraje | evaṃ no'nugrahaṃ kartuṃmarhati kṛpayā sadā || 13.211{211} || tataḥ sa bhagavān buddhastathāstviti samādiśat | ṛddhyākāśaṃ samutplutya svamāśramamupāyayau || 13.212{212} || tatra sa bhagavān prāptaḥ sabhāmadhye samāśritaḥ | etadvṛṣṭi samākhyāya tasthau dharmaṃ samādiśat || 13.213{213} || tadā sa vaḍiko bhūyo buddhaguṇānanusmaran | sa saṃghaṃ sugataṃ bhojyaiḥ pūjayituṃ samaichata || 13.214{214} || tadā sa nṛpate rājñaḥ prasenajita ānataḥ | etatsarvaṃ pravṛttāṃtaṃ nivedyaivamabhāṣata || 13.215{215} || rājannahaṃ mahārogī triratnaśaraṇaṃ vraje | tattriratnakṛpādṛṣṭerjīve rogairvimocitaḥ || 13.216{216} || tanmayā sa munīndro'pi sarvasaṃghaiḥ sahādhunā | samāmaṃtrya gṛhe bhojyaiḥ pūjayituṃ samicchyate || 13.217{217} || tanme'nugrahaṇaṃ kṛtvā lokānāṃ puṇyavṛddhaye | tadadhivāsanāṃ kṛtvā samanujñāpaya prabho || 13.218{218} || iti tenārthitaṃ śrutvā sa rājābhyanumoditaḥ | vaḍikaṃ taiḥ samālokya praśaṃsyaiva samādiśat || 13.219{219} || vaḍika tvaṃ mahāsādhustadbuddhaśaraṇaṃ gataḥ | tathānuśraddhayā nityaṃ bhaja ratnatrayaṃ sadā || 13.220{220} || iti rājñābhyanujñātaṃ śrutvā sa vaḍiko mudā | nṛpatiṃ taṃ praṇatvaivaṃ svagṛhaṃ samupāyayau || 13.221{221} || tatra gṛhe samāsādya kṛtvānumataṃ pituḥ | śāstu nimaṃtraṇāṃ kartuṃ vihāre samudācaran || 13.222{222} || tatra sa samupāviṣṭo dṛṣṭvā taṃ śrīghanaṃ mudā | kṛtāñjalipuṭo natvā prārthayadevamādarāt || 13.223{223} || bhagavaṃstadvijānīyādyadarthaṃ samupāvraje | tathāpyatra bhavadagre prārthaye'nugrahaṃ kuru || 13.224{224} || yadahaṃ roganirmuktaḥ puna janma ivāptavān | tadbhavatāṃ kṛpādṛṣṭeḥ prasādāditinmanyate || 13.225{225} || tadahaṃ bhavatāṃ sarvasaṃghānāṃ bhojanairgṛhe | pūjayituṃ samiche tadanugrahītumarhati || 13.226{226} || iti saṃprārthitaṃ tena śrutvā sa bhagavānmuniḥ | tathetyabhyanumoditvā tūṣṇībhūtvādhyuvāsa tat || 13.227{227} || tataḥ sa vaḍiko matvā bhagavatādhivāsitam | mudā tasya muneḥ pādau natvāśu svagṛhaṃ yayau || 13.228{228} || tatra sa sahasā gehe vandhumitrajanaiḥ saha | saṃghārhabhojyapūjāṅgaṃ sāmagrīṃ samasādhayat || 13.229{229} || tataḥ sa sarvasāmagrīṃ sādhayitvāsanāni ca | prajñapya śuddhite bhūmau maṃdayitvā samantataḥ || 13.230{230} || tatastaṃ śrīghanaṃ buddhaṃ sasaṃghaṃ svajanaiḥ saha | āmaṃtrituṃ vihāre sa sahasā samupācarat || 13.231{231} || tatra sa samupāviṣṭo dṛṣṭvā taṃ śrīghanaṃ mudā | sasaṃghaṃ sāṃjalirnatvā prārthayadevamādarāt || 13.232{232} || bhagavan sādhyate sādhyaṃ samayo varttate'dhunā | tadbhavāṃ sāṃghikaiḥ sārddhaṃ vijayituṃ samarhati || 13.233{233} || iti tenārthitaṃ śrutvā tatheti sa munīśvaraḥ | pātracīvaramādhāya sarvasaṃghaiḥ sahācarat || 13.234{234} || tatra mārgeṣu sarvatra nagare ca samantataḥ | prakāśayan prātihāryaṃ tadgṛhaṃ samupāviśat || 13.235{235} || tatra gṛhe samāsādya pādārghaṃ pratigṛhya saḥ | svāsane samupāviśya kramāttasthau sasāṃghikaḥ || 13.236{236} || tadā sa vaḍiko dṛṣṭvā taṃ buddhaṃ svāsane sthitam | sasaṃghaṃ sarvapūjāṅgaiḥ sarvapuṣpaiḥ samarcayat || 13.237{237} || tataśca surasairbhojyaiḥ supraṇītaiḥ suhādhitaiḥ | varṇagandharasopetaiḥ sarvaistāṃ samatoṣayat || 13.238{268!} || tataśca bhojanānte sa pātrādīnyapanīya ca | mukhādīṃ śodhayitvā ca pūgauṣadhīn praḍhaukayat || 13.239{269} || tataḥ sa prāñjalirnatvā sasaṃghaṃ sugataṃ mudā | purastho manasā hyevaṃ praṇidhānaṃ vyadhātsmaran || 13.240{270} || anena kuśalenāhaṃ loke'ndhe'pariṇāyake | yathāyaṃ bhagavān buddhastathā bhūyāsamātmavit || 13.241{271} || yathānena munīndreṇa jagalloko'bhipālitaḥ | tathāhaṃ sarvalokānāṃ pālayeyaṃ samantataḥ || 13.242{272} || atīrṇāṃstārayiṣyāmi mocayiṣyāmyamocitān | anāsvastān samāśvāsya sthāpayiṣyāmi nirvṛtau || 13.243{273} || ityevaṃ manasā tena praṇidhānaṃ kṛtaṃ mudā | matvā sa bhagavān buddho smitaṃ prāvirvyadhānmudā || 13.244{274} || tadā tasya munīndrasya mukhātpaṃca surasmayaḥ | nisṛtya triṣu lokeṣu bhāsayantaḥ samāsaran || 13.245{275} || yāpi kāścidadholoke prasṛtā narakeṣu tāḥ | uṣṇeṣu śītalībhūtā śītaleṣu tathoṣṇikāḥ || 13.246{276} || tadā tābhiḥ parispṛṣṭāḥ sarve nairayikā janāḥ | mahatsaukhyaṃ samāsādya vismitāścaivamālapat || 13.247{277} || aho saukhyaṃ kathaṃ hyevamanyatra kiṃ gatā vayam | kasya puṇyānubhāvena kvāsmākaṃ jāyate sukham || 13.248{278} || iti cintābhidagdhānāṃ teṣāṃ cittaprabodhane | bhagavānnirmitaṃ buddhaṃ saṃpreṣya samadarśayat || 13.249{279} || tatra taṃ nirmitaṃ buddhaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve'pi te mudā | vismitāḥ sahasaṃmīlya punarevaṃ vabhāṣire || 13.250{280} || aho samantabhadro'yaṃ puruṣo dṛśyate'dhunā | nūnamasyānubhāvena saukhyaṃ no jāyate khalu || 13.251{281} || iti saṃbhāṣya te sarve tasmin buddhe prasāditāḥ | namo buddhāya dharmāya saṃghāya ceti prāvadan || 13.252{282} || tataḥ sarve'pi te satvāstriratnasmṛtipuṇyataḥ | te durgativinirmuktāḥ sadgatiṃ samupāyayuḥ || 13.253{283} || evaṃ tā raśmayaḥ sarvā avabhāsya samaṃtataḥ | sarvasatvān samuddhṛtya muneḥ pratyāyayuḥ punaḥ || 13.254{284} || tathā yā raśmayaḥ kāścidupariṣṭātprasāritāḥ | tāḥ sarvān devalokānāmavabhāsya samantataḥ || 13.255{285} || yāvadbhavāgraparyaṃtaṃ bhāsayantaḥ prasāritāḥ | evaṃ cāpi mahāśabdamudghuṣya samudācaran || 13.256{286} || anityaṃ khalu saṃsāraṃ duḥkhaṃ śūnyamanātmakam | tadbhave sadgatiṃ hitvā saddharmaṃ bhajatādarāt || 13.257{287} || niṣkrāmatārabhadhvaṃ ca yujyadhvaṃ buddhaśāsane | dhunīta mṛtyusainyaṃ ca naḍāgāramiva dvipaḥ || 13.258{288} || yo'pyasmin dharmavaineye hyapramattaścaretsadā | sa hitvā jātisaṃsāraṃ duḥkhasyāntaṃ kariṣyati || 13.259{289} || ityevaṃ tanmahāśabdaṃ śrutvā sarve'pi te surāḥ | tathetyabhyanumodantastriratnaśaraṇaṃ yayuḥ || 13.260{290} || tathā tā arciṣaḥ sarvā avabhāsya samaṃtataḥ | punaḥ pratyāgatāstasya munerantikamāyayuḥ || 13.261{291} || tatastā arciṣaḥ sarvāḥ saṃmīlya samupāsthitāḥ | kṛtvā pradakṣiṇāṃ traidhamuṣṇīṣe'ntardadhau muneḥ || 13.262{292} || athānaṃdastamālokya vismitaḥ sahasotthitaḥ | kṛtāñjalipuṭo natvā paprachaivaṃ munīśvaram || 13.263{293} || bhagavan bhavato vaktrātpaṃcavarṇāḥ suraśmayaḥ | vinisṛtā diśaḥ sarvā bhāṣayanti samantataḥ || 13.264{294} || nākāraṇaṃ jinā buddhā darśayanti smitaṃ kvacit | bhavatsmitaṃ samālokya sarve bhavanti vismitāḥ || 13.265{295} || taddhetu śrotumichaṃti sarve'pīme sabhāśritāḥ | tadeṣāṃ saṃśayaṃ chetuṃ taddhetu samupādiśa || 13.266{296} || iti tenārthitaṃ śrutvā bhagavān sa munīśvaraḥ | tāṃ ca sarvāṃ sabhāṃ dṛṣṭvā tathānandamabhāṣata || 13.267{297} || paśyānaṃda mamānena vaḍikenānumodinā | saṃgheṣu śraddhayā bhaktyā satkṛtya bhajanaṃ kṛtam || 13.268{298} || etatpuṇyavipākena vaḍiko'yaṃ sudhīḥ kṛtī | kramādbodhicarīḥ pūrya daśabhūmīśvaro bhavan || 13.269{299} || sarvamāragaṇāṃ jitvā saṃbodhiṃ samavāptavān | ślakṣṇavāṇyabhidho buddhastathāgato bhaviṣyati || 13.270{300} || yadanena triratneṣu śaraṇaṃ saṃprasādinā | praṇidhānaṃ kṛtaṃ tena saṃbuddho'yaṃ bhaveddhruvam || 13.271{301} || evaṃ matvā tathānaṃda triratnaśaraṇaṃ gataḥ | satkṛtya samupāśritya bhaja nityaṃ samāhitaḥ || 13.272{302} || ye satvāḥ śraddhayā smṛtvā triratnaśaraṇaṃ gatāḥ | durgatiṃ te na gachanti bhavanti bodhibhāginaḥ || 13.273{303} || evaṃ matvā triratnānāṃ satkṛtya śraddhayā mudā | saṃsmṛtya śaraṇaṃ gatvā bhaktavyaṃ bodhivāṃchibhiḥ || 13.274{304} || ityādiṣṭaṃ munīndreṇa śrutvānaṃdaḥ sa moditaḥ | sāṃghikaṃ saha lokaiśca tatheti prābhyanaṃdata || 13.275{305} || tataḥ sa bhagavāṃstasmai vaḍikāya subhāgine | datvāśīrvacanaṃ bhūyaḥ samāmaṃtrya tamabravīt || 13.276{306} || vaḍika tvaṃ mahābhāga triratnaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ | bodhicaryyāṃ carannityaṃ saṃbodhiṃ samavāpnuyāḥ || 13.277{307} || iti satyaṃ parijñāya sarvasatvahitārthabhṛt | tathā ratnatrayaṃ smṛtvā bhaja nityaṃ samāhitaḥ || 13.278{308} || ityādiśya munīndraḥ sa saṃghaiḥ sārddhaṃ samutthitaḥ | vaḍikaṃ taṃ samāmaṃtrya svavihāraṃ yayau tathā || 13.279{309} || tathā sa vaḍiko nityaṃ triratnaśaraṇaṃ gataḥ | sadā lokahitaṃ kṛtvā bodhicaryāṃ samācarat || 13.280{310} || etanme guruṇādiṣṭaṃ śrutaṃ mayā narādhipa | tathā te kathyate rājaṃ śrutvā caivaṃ prakāśaya || 13.281{311} || tathā tvayāpi rājendra satvānāṃ hitasādhane | triratnaśaraṇaiḥ kṛtvā karttavyā bodhicārikāḥ || 13.282{312} || tathā te sarvadā nityaṃ sarvatra maṃgalaṃ bhavet | kramādbodhicarīṃ pūrya saṃbodhimapi cāpnuyāḥ || 13.283{313} || iti matvā mahārāja prajāścāpi prabodhayan | saddharme saṃpratisthāpya sarvathā trātumarhasi || 13.284{314} || iti tenopaguptena samādiṣṭaṃ niśamya saḥ | rājā tatheti vijñapya prābhyanandatsapārṣadaḥ || 13.285{315} || śrutvāvadānaṃ vaḍikasya sādhoridaṃ narā ye'bhyanumodayanti | sarve'pi te lokahitānuraktā bhavanti bodhiguṇalābhikā hi || 13.286{316} || iti ratnāvadānatatve vaḍikāvadānaṃ samāptam gāndharvikāvadāna athāśoko mahīpālaḥ śrotumanyatsubhāṣitam | upaguptaṃ yatiṃ natvā prārthayadevamādarāt || 14.1{1} || bhadanta śrotumicchāmi punaranyatsubhāṣitam | tadyathā guruṇākhyātaṃ tathādeṣṭuṃ ca me'rhati || 14.2{2} || iti tena narendreṇa prārthitaṃ sa jinātmajaḥ | śrutvā taṃ nṛpatiṃ dṛṣṭvā punarevaṃ samādiśat || 14.3{3} || śṛṇu rājanmayākhyātaṃ yathā me guruṇoditam | tathā śrūtvānumoditvā śubhe caritumarhasi || 14.4{4} || purā sa bhagavān buddhaḥ śrāvastyāṃ bahirāśrame | jetāraṇye mahodyāne vihāre maṇimaṇḍite || 14.5{5} || bhikṣubhiḥ śrāvakaiḥ sārddhaṃ cailakairvratibhistathā | bhikṣuṇībhistathānyaiścā mahāsātvairupāsakaiḥ || 14.6{6} || vihṛtya sarvasatvānāṃ samitisthitaḥ | saṃbodhisādhānaṃ dharmamupādeṣṭuṃ samārabhat || 14.7{7} || tadā tasya munīndrasya vaktrapadmādvinisṛtam | tatsaddharmāmṛtaṃ pātuṃ sarve satvā upagatāḥ || 14.8{8} || brahmaśakrādi devendrāḥ sarve lokādhipā api | daityendrāḥ sagaṇā yakṣāḥ siddhagaṃdharvarākṣasāḥ || 14.9{9} || vidyādharagaṇāścapi nāgeṃdrāśca mahoragāḥ | garuḍāḥ kinnarendrāśca tathānye'pi samāgatāḥ || 14.10{10} || brāhmaṇā ṛṣayaścāpi tāpasā brahmacāriṇaḥ | yatayo yogino vijñāstathānye tīrthikā api || 14.11{11} || rajānaḥ kṣatriyāścāpi vīrā rājakumārakāḥ | amātyā maṃtriṇaścāpi vaiśyāścāpi prajādhipāḥ || 14.12{12} || śreṣṭhino vaṇijaścāpi sārthavāhā mahājanāḥ | paurā jānapadā grāmyāstathā kārpaṭikā api || 14.13{13} || evamanye'pi satvāśca sarve lokāḥ samāgatāḥ | tatsaddharmāmṛtaṃ pātuṃ tadvihāre upāviśat || 14.14{14} || tatra taṃ śrīghanaṃ dṛṣṭvā samabhyarcya praṇamya ca | satkṛtya samupāśritya parivṛtya sāmāntataḥ || 14.15{15} || taṃ muṇīndraṃ samālokya śrotuṃ taddharmadeśanām | sāñjalayaḥ prasannāsyā upatasthuḥ samāhitāḥ || 14.16{16} || tathā tān samupāsīnān dṛṣṭvā sa bhagavāñjinaḥ | āryasatyaṃ samārabhya saddharmaṃ samupādiśat || 14.17{17} || tatsaddharmāmṛtaṃ pītvā sarve satvāḥ pramoditāḥ | triratnabhajanaṃ kṛtvā vabhūvurbodhicāriṇaḥ || 14.18{18} || tadāpi paṃcamātrāṇi gāṃdharvikaśatāni ca | śrāvastyāṃ puri jātāni samadāni pracerire || 14.19{19} || tadā tāṃ samadān dṛṣṭvā gaṃdharvādhipateḥ sutaḥ | supriyo nāma tanmādamīrṣyayā hantumudyayau || 14.20{20} || tataḥ sa supriyaḥ sarvagāndharvikasukauśalaḥ | divyavīṇāṃ samādāya tatraiva samupācarat || 14.21{21} || saptasvarānekataṃtryāmekaviṃśatimūrchanāḥ | samudghoṣayamānaḥ ca svamatiṃ darśayan yayau || 14.22{22} || ṣaṇmahānagareṣvevaṃ paṭṭaneṣu samantataḥ | samudghoṣayamānaśca śrāvastīṃ sa upāviśat || 14.23{23} || tatra taṃ samupāviṣṭaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve'pi paurikāḥ | śrutvā tadadbhutaṃ nādaṃ vismitāḥ samupācaran || 14.24{24} || tāni ca paṃcamātrāṇi gāṃdharvikaśatānyapi | śrutvā dṛṣṭvā ca sarvāṇi vismayaṃ samupāyayuḥ || 14.25{25} || tada tāni ca sarvāṇi dṛṣṭvā paṃcaśatānyapi | svasvamadābhimānatvāṃ pravihāya viṣedire || 14.26{26} || tataḥ sarve'pi te tena sahavāde bhayānvitāḥ | nṛpaterantikaṃ gatvā tatpravṛttiṃ nyavedayan || 14.27{27} || jaya prabho vijānīyādyadvayaṃ samupāgatāḥ | tadatra no bhayatrastāṃ trātumarhati sarvathā || 14.28{28} || atrāsau supriyo nāma gandharvādhipateḥ sutaḥ | nūnaṃ no madaghātāya vijetuṃ samupāgataḥ || 14.29{29} || tattasyāpyabhimānatvāṃ nihaṃtuṃ satpratikriyām | kriyatāṃ sahasāsmākamiti vijñāpanāṃ śṛṇu || 14.30{30} || iti vijñāpitaṃ sarvaistaiḥ śrutvā sa narādhipaḥ | sarvānstān samupāmaṃtrya pura evaṃ samādiśat || 14.31{31} || alpotsukā bhavanto'tra bhavate mā viṣīdata | bhaviṣyāmo'tra kālajñāścaratu sa yathechayā || 14.32{32} || iti rājñā samādiṣṭaṃ śrutvā te'bhyanumoditāḥ | tadvivādabhayātaṃkaṃ tyaktvā sarve prasedire || 14.33{33} || tadā sa supriyastatra dṛṣṭvā tānabhimānikān | teṣāṃ mānavighātārthaṃ manasaivaṃ vyacintayat || 14.34{34} || ayaṃ rājapi gāṃdharvavidyābhimāniko bhavet | tadanena sahātrāhaṃ vādaṃ kuryāṃ sabhāśraye || 14.35{35} || ityevaṃ niścayaṃ kṛtvā supriyaḥ so'bhimānikaḥ | nṛpatiṃ tamupālabdhuṃ tatsabhāṃ samupācarat || 14.36{36} || tatra sa nṛpatirdṛṣṭvā supriyaṃ tamupāgatam | prajñapyāsanamāmaṃtrya praṇatvaivamabhāṣata || 14.37{37} || svāgataṃ te bhavannatra tiṣṭhāsane prasīda me | kimarthe'tra samāyāsi tadādeṣṭuṃ hi me'rhasi || 14.38{38} || iti tenoditaṃ śrutvā supriyaḥ sa sabhāsthitaḥ | nṛpatiṃ taṃ samālokya pura evamabhāṣata || 14.39{39} || śṛṇu rājanmayākhyātaṃ śrutaṃ yatte yaśo mahat | tadguṇān bhavato draṣṭumihāhaṃ samupācare || 14.40{40} || tanme darśaya rājendra gāndharvaguṇāmātmanaḥ | kaste sāstā gururvāsti taṃ cāpi me pradarśaya || 14.41{41} || iti tenoditaṃ śrutvā sa rājā pratibhāṇavān | supriyaṃ taṃ samālokya tathetyevamabhāṣata || 14.42{42} || sādhu paśya mahābhāga darśayisyāmi taṃ gurum | yo me śāstā mahābhijñaḥ sarvavidyāguṇādhipaḥ || 14.43{43} || sa me śāstādhunehaiva sarvasatvahitārthataḥ | jetāraṇye mahodyāne nivaśati vṛṣaṃ diśan || 14.44{44} || sādhu paśya mahābhāga taṃ guruṃ me hitārthadam | tadehi saha yāsyāma śāstāraṃ darśayāmi tam || 14.45{45} || iti tena narendreṇa samākhyātaṃ sa supriyaḥ | śrutvā tatheti pramodya gantumabhāṣata || 14.46{46} || sādhu rājan samichāmi śāstāraṃ tatpradarśaya | tena saha vivādāni kuryāṃ tatra nayāśu mām || 14.47{47} || iti tenoditaṃ śrutvā nṛpatiḥ sa tatheti hi | supriyaṃ taṃ samādāya vihāre gantumaichata || 14.48{48} || tataḥ sa nṛpatistena supriyeṇābhimāninā | taiśca paṃcaśatairanyairgāndharvikaiḥ sahācarat || 14.49{49} || tasminnavasare buddho bhagavān sa munīśvaraḥ | loke satvān samuddhartuṃ kṛpayā samapaśyata || 14.50{50} || tadā tena nareśena sārddhamevamupāgatam | supriyaṃ taṃ sa ālokya manasaiva vyacintayat || 14.51{51} || aho vata sudhīryā sā gandharvādhipanandanaḥ | pañcaśikho'bhidho vīṇāmādāyehopasaṃkramet || 14.52{52} || iti tena munīndreṇa manasā paricintitam | matvā pañcaśikhaḥ so'pi tathāgantuṃ samaichata || 14.53{53} || tataḥ sa saptagaṃdharvasahasreṇa sahānvitaḥ | vaiḍūryadaṇḍavīṇāṃ saṃprādāya sahasācaran || 14.54{54} || tathā sa saṃkramaṃstatra vihāre samupāviśan | dṛṣṭvā taṃ śrīghanaṃ natvā tāṃ vīṇāṃ samupānayat || 14.55{55} || tataḥ sa sugataṃ bhaktyā samabhyarcya prasannadhīḥ | tatsaddharmāmṛtaṃ pātuṃ tatsabhāyāmupāśrayat || 14.56{56} || tadā sa supriyo'pyenaṃ dṛṣṭvā mānābhigarvitaḥ | tāṃ vīṇāṃ kvanayannagre'nuśrāvituṃ samārabhat || 14.57{57} || tatprakvāṇātsvarā sapta ekai viṃśati mūrchanāḥ | samutthitāḥ sarvalokacetānsi paryamohayan || 14.58{58} || tadā sarve'pi te lokāḥ śrutvā tatprakvaṇānmudā | nṛpatipramukhāścāpi paraṃ vismayamāyajuḥ || 14.59{59} || tataḥ sa bhagavāṃścāpi tasya mānābhighātane | vaiḍūryadaṇḍavīṇāṃ tāmanuśrāvitumārabhat || 14.60{60} || ekaikasyāṃ hi tattaṃtryā naikasvaraviśeṣitāḥ | mūrchanāśca tathā nānāvidhā niścāritāstathā || 14.61{61} || tataḥ śabdātsamuccerurgāthā evaṃ pracodināḥ | tadyatheha bhave sarvaṃ duḥkhaṃ śūnyaṃ hyanātmakam || 14.62{62} || idaṃ kāyaṃ ca vīṇāvadindriyāṇi svarānī ca | mūrchanā iva cittāni jñātvā bodhau samācara || 14.63{63} || etadgāthāmanuśrutvā sarve lokā nṛpādayaḥ | satyametaditi jñātvā bodhicittaṃ pralehire || 14.64{64} || tadā sa supriyo'pyevaṃ śrutvā matvānumoditaḥ | paritatyāja gāṃdharvavidyāmadābhimānatām || 14.65{65} || tato niryātya vīṇāṃ sa gandhakuṭyāṃ virāgitaḥ | bhagavacchāsane tatra pravrajituṃ samaichata || 14.66{66} || tadā taṃ śrīghanaṃ natvā supriyaḥ so'numoditaḥ | kṛtāñjaliḥ puraḥ sthitvā pravrajyāṃ samayācata || 14.67{67} || vaṃde te caraṇau śāsta bhavatāṃ śaraṇaṃ vraje | tanme'trānugrahaṃ kṛtvā pravrajyāṃ dātumarhati || 14.68{68} || iti tenārthitaṃ śrutvā bhagavān sa munīśvaraḥ | dṛṣṭvā tadāśayaṃ śuddhaṃ gaṃdharvaṃ taṃ tathāvadat || 14.69{69} || gaṃdharva saugate dharme pravrajituṃ yadīchasi | pitrorājñāṃ samāsādya prehi dāsyāmi te vratam || 14.70{70} || ityādiṣṭaṃ munīndreṇa śrutvā sa supriyo mudā | tatheti taṃ muniṃ natvā sahasarddhyā gṛhaṃ yayau || 14.71{71} || tatra sa sahasā prāpto natvā tau pitarau mudā | sāñjaliḥ purataḥ sthitvā prārthayadevamādarāt || 14.72{72} || śṛṇu me vāñchitaṃ tāta yadi te kṛpayā mayi | tanmamānugrahaṃ kṛtvā saddharme māṃ niyojaya || 14.73{73} || ahaṃ hi saugataṃ dharmaṃ dṛṣṭvā vāñchāmi tadvratam | tatpravrajyāṃ samāsādya prāptumichāmi nirvṛtim || 14.74{74} || anityaṃ khalu saṃsāraṃ tadatrāpi na me ratiḥ | avaśyaṃ hi bhavenmṛtyuḥ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināmapi || 14.75{75} || evaṃ dṛṣṭvātra saṃsāre bhogyaṃ nechāmi niḥspṛhaḥ | tatpravrajyāvrataṃ dhṛtvā prāptumiche sunirvṛtim || 14.76{76} || api cāsau munīndro hi sadātraiva na tiṣṭhati | buddhakāryaṃ samāpyaiva nirvṛtiṃ sarvathā vrajet || 14.77{77} || kiṃ cātra sarvadā naivamutpatsyate munīśvaraḥ | kadā cidevamutpanno loke bodhiṃ samādiśet || 14.78{78} || tathā ca durlabhaṃ janma sadgatau ca kṣaṇaṃ tathā | tatkṣaṇe'labhyamāne'tra kathaṃ dharmānulapsyate || 14.79{79} || dharmaṃ vinātra saṃsāre kiṃ sāraṃ sukhino'pi hi | kṣaṇadhvansi śarīraṃ hi jīvitaṃ ca tṛṇāmbuvat || 14.80{80} || dharmeṇa sadgatiṃ yāyātsaṃbodhimapi prāpnuyāt | tatpravrajyācariṃ dhṛtvā prāptumiche'tra nirvṛtim || 14.81{81} || tadātra yadi vāṃ tāta kṛpāsti svātmaje mayi | sarvathānugrahaṃ kṛtvā tadanujñāṃ pradehi me || 14.82{82} || iti tenārthitaṃ śrutvā sa gandharvādhipaḥ sudhīḥ | suciraṃ taṃ sutaṃ dṛṣṭvā snehādevamabhaṣata || 14.83{83} || satyamevaṃ sutākhyātaṃ tathāpi me vacaḥ śṛṇu | pravrajyā duṣkarīcaryyā tatkathaṃ tvaṃ samācareḥ || 14.84{84} || tvaṃ hi yuvā pramatto'si madanākrāṃtamānasaḥ | kāmabhogyasukhāraktastatkathaṃ tadvrataṃ careḥ || 14.85{85} || pravrajito viraktātmā saṃsārabhogyanispṛhaḥ | sarvān parigrahānstyaktvā sadaikāntī vane vase || 14.86{86} || sukule duḥkule cāpi yācitvā viraśāsanam | bhuṃjīthāstatkathaṃ bhuktvā samādhiṃ saṃpradhāsyasi || 14.87{87} || ityevaṃ duṣkaraṃ jñatvā pravrajyāvratasādhane | sahasā mā kṛthāścittaṃ nivāraya samāhitaḥ || 14.88{88} || yadyativāṃchase putra pravrajyāgrahaṇe tathā | vṛddhatve samupāśritya triratnaṃ tadvrataṃ cara || 14.89{89} || tattvaṃ yāvadyuvā gehe saukhyaṃ bhuktvā yathepsitam | vṛddhatve tadvrataṃ dhṛtvā triratnāni sadā bhaja || 14.90{90} || tathā cette bhavejjanma sāphalyaṃ bhavacāraṇe | sukhaṃ bhuktvā vrataṃ dhṛtvā nirvṛtiṃ vā samāpnuyāḥ || 14.91{91} || iti me vacanaṃ śrutvā matvaivaṃ tatprabodhitaḥ | tāvadgṛhe sukhaṃ bhuktvā smṛtvā ratnatrayaṃ vasa || 14.92{92} || iti pitroditaṃ śrutvā supriyaḥ so'bhiśaṃkitaḥ | punastaṃ pitaraṃ dṛṣṭvā bodhayannevamabravīt || 14.93{93} || satyamevaṃ bhave tāta tathāpi vakṣyate mayā | tacchrutvāpi tvayā parijñāya vibudhyatām || 14.94{94} || satkule durlabhaṃ janma tatrāpi durlabhaṃ kṣaṇam | durlabhaṃ sugatotpādaṃ durlabhaṃ tadvrataṃ bhave || 14.95{95} || iti matvātra saṃsāre kleśamānamadākule | avaśyaṃ maraṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā prāptumiche'tra nirvṛtim || 14.96{96} || tadatra kṛpayā mahyamanujñāṃ dātumarhasi | yūyaṃ cāpi hi taddharmabhāṇaiḥ sadgatimāpsyatha || 14.97{97} || iti hetoḥ pita tatra vilambaṃma kṛthā ciram | sahasānugrahaṃ kṛtvā tadanujñāṃ pradehi me || 14.98{98} || iti tenārthitaṃ śrutvā sa gaṃdharvādhipaścirāt | snehaduḥkhāgnisaṃtapto galadaśrumukho'vadat || 14.99{99} || ayi supriya putra tvaṃ snehānmayā nivāryasa | yadyativāṃchase prāptuṃ nirvṛtiṃ tan samācara || 14.100{100} || saṃbuddhaśaraṇaṃ kṛtvā pravrajya saṃvaraṃ dadhat | triratnabhajanaṃ kṛtvā cara nityaṃ samāhitaḥ || 14.101{1} || iti pitroditaṃ śrutvā supriyaḥ so'bhimoditaḥ | pitroḥ pādān praṇatvaiva sahasā niryayau gṛhāt || 14.102{2} || tataḥ sa sahasā gatvā vihāraṃ samupācarat | tatra prāpto munīndraṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvaiva samupāviśat || 14.103{3} || tatra taṃ śrīghanaṃ nātvā prāñjaliḥ pura āśrayan | suprasannamukhāṃbhojaḥ prārthayadevamādarāt || 14.104{4} || sarvajña bhagavāñchāstarādiṣṭaṃ bhavatāyathā | tathānujñāṃ pituḥ prāpya prāgatāhamihādhunā || 14.105{5} || tadatra bhavatāṃ śāstaḥ śaraṇaṃ samupāgataḥ | brahmacaryaṃ cariṣyāmi tatpravrajyāṃ pradehi me || 14.106{6} || iti tenārthitaṃ śrutvā bhagavān sa jagadguruḥ | dṛṣṭvā tasyāśayaṃ śuddhaṃ punareva samādiśat || 14.107{7} || ehi supriya bhikṣo'tra cara brahmacariṃ śivām | triratnaṃ śaraṇaṃ kṛtvā samādhiṃ samupāśrayat || 14.108{8} || tato dṛṣṭvā ca saṃsāraṃ kleśasaṃghasamākulam | paṃcagaṃḍamayaṃ dehaṃ jīvitaṃ ca trināmvuvat || 14.109{9} || samādhisaṃvaraṃ dhṛtvā saṃbodhisādhanodyataḥ | sarvakleśaripuñjitvā sākṣādarhatpadaṃ yayau || 14.110{10} || tataḥ supriyo bhikṣuḥ prāptābhijñaḥ kṛtī sudhīḥ | bhindan sarvamavidyāṅgaṃ nirvikalpo'bhavadyatiḥ || 14.111{11} || samaloṣṭasuvarṇaśca pariśuddhatrimaṃḍalaḥ | vāsīcaṃdanakalpo'bhūdākāśasamamānasaḥ || 14.112{12} || saṃsārabhogyasatkāramānyalābhaparāṅmukhaḥ | niḥkleśaḥ pariṣuddhātmā brahmacārī niraṃjanaḥ || 14.113{13} || sadevāsuralokānāṃ sarvabhuvanavāsinām | vaṃdyaḥ pūjyo'bhinaṃdyaśca mānanīyo bhavan babhau || 14.114{14} || tadaivaṃbhūtamarhantaṃ supriyaṃ taṃ śubhendriyam | prālokya vismitāḥ sarve tatsabhāsthāḥ prasedire || 14.115{15} || tadā sarve'pi te lokā devā daityāśca kinnarāḥ | yakṣāḥ siddhāśca gaṃdharvā nāgāśca rākṣasā api || 14.116{16} || garuḍāśca tathānye'pi vidyādharāśca sāpsarāḥ | sarve lokādhipāścāpi triratnaśaraṇaṃ gatāḥ || 14.117{17} || saṃbuddhaśāsane tatra sāṃghikānāṃ samantataḥ | rakṣāvaraṇasaṃguptiṃ kṛtvābhajan samudyatāḥ || 14.118{18} || taddṛṣṭvā tāni pañcāpi gāṃdharvikaśatāni ca | anumodya prasannāni saṃmīlyaivaṃ vabhāṣire || 14.119{19} || ete sarve vayaṃ nīce karmaṇi parivarttikāḥ | sukhānabhijñaduḥkhārttāḥ kleśinaḥ kṛchravṛttayaḥ || 14.120{20} || yadasmābhiḥ purā puṇyaṃ kiṃ cidvāpi na sādhitam | tenāsyātra vayaṃ sarve duḥkhino nīcavṛttayaḥ || 14.121{21} || tadasmābhirayaṃ śāstā munīśvaraḥ sasāṃghikaḥ | satkṛtya bhojanairvāpi pūjanīyo yathāvidhiḥ || 14.122{22} || nūnametadvipākena bhavemahi subhāginaḥ | tataḥ puṇyānusāreṇa bodhimārge caremahi || 14.123{23} || tataḥ krameṇa saṃprāpya bodhicaryyāṃ śubhāṃ carīm | carantastadvipākaiśca nirvṛtiṃ saṃlabhemahi || 14.124{24} || iti matvā vayaṃ sarve vijñapya nṛpatiṃ tathā | sasaṃghaṃ sugataṃ bhojyairarhāmahe samarcitum || 14.125{25} || tatheti saṃmataṃ kṛtvā sarve te'bhyanumoditāḥ | nṛpatervijñāpanāṃ kartuṃ sahasā samupācaran || 14.126{26} || tatra te samupāsṛtya dṛṣṭvā taṃ nṛpatiṃ mudā | kṛtāñjalipuṭo natvā prārthayannevamādarāt || 14.127{27} || jaya deva mahārāja lokān dharmeṇa pālaya | kiñcidvijñāpanāṃ karttuṃ vayamupāgatāḥ || 14.128{28} || vijānīyādbhavān hyetattathāpi prārthayāmahe | śrutvā no'nugrahaṃ kṛtvā kṛpayā tatprasīdatu || 14.129{29} || yadvayaṃ deva sarve'tra nīcakarmānucāriṇaḥ | tatsasaṃghaṃ muniṃ bhojyaiḥ samichāmaḥ samarcitum || 14.130{30} || tadanujñāṃ pradatvā naḥ kṛpayoddhartumarhasi | etadvijñāpanāṃ kurmastatprasīda nṛpādhipa || 14.131{31} || iti taiḥ prārthitaṃ śrutvā nṛpatiḥ so'numoditaḥ | tān sarvān samupāmaṃtrya punarevaṃ samādiśat || 14.132{32} || sādhu bhavatu sarveṣāṃ yuṣmākaṃ satsamīhitam | tattathā kriyatāṃ buddhe satkāraṃ śraddhayādarāt || 14.133{33} || saṃbuddhe yatkṛtaṃ karma tatphalaṃ kṣiṇuyānna hi | kramādbodhicariṃ pūrya nirvṛtiṃ samavāpnuyāt || 14.134{34} || tadatra sarvathā yūyaṃ sasaṃghaṃ śrīghanaṃ munim | yathārhabhojanaṃ bhaktyā pūjayadhvaṃ samādarāt || 14.135{35} || ityādiṣṭam …ndreṇa śrutvā sarve'pi te mudā | tatheti pratinaṃditvā nṛpaṃ natvā tato'caran || 14.136{36} || tataste saṃmataṃ kṛtvā vihāre sahasā gatāḥ | dṛṣṭvā taṃ śrīghanaṃ natvā prārthayannevamādarāt || 14.137{37} || bhagavaṃstadvijānīyādyadarthaṃ samupāgatāḥ | tathāpi prārthayeyaivamanugrahītumarhati || 14.138{38} || yadvayaṃ bhavatāṃ sarvasāṃghikānāṃ yathāvidhim | pūjayituṃ samichāmo satkartuṃ bhojanairapi || 14.139{39} || tadbhavāṃ kṛpayā dṛṣṭvā kṛtvāsmākamanugraham | pure śvaḥ sāṃghikaiḥ sārddhaṃ vijayituṃ samarhasi || 14.140{40} || iti taiḥ prārthite sarvairbhagavān sa munīśvaraḥ | teṣāṃ dharmapravṛddhyarthaṃ tūṣṇībhūtvādhyuvāsa tat || 14.141{41} || tatassarve'pi te matvā bhagavatādhivāsitam | bhūyastaṃ śrīghanaṃ natvā svaṃ puraṃ sahasā yayuḥ || 14.142{42} || tatra sarve'pi te bhūmiṃ śodhayitvā samantataḥ | prajñapya svāsanānyevaṃ sāmagriṃ samasādhayan || 14.143{43} || tataḥ pūjopahārāṇi bhojyāṅgāni rasāni ca | peyāni supraṇītāni sādhayitvā pramoditāḥ || 14.144{44} || tatra taṃ sugataṃ sarvaṃ saṃghaṃ cāmaṃtrituṃ yayuḥ | vihāre samupasṛtya śrīghanaṃ saṃpraṇemire || 14.145{45} || kṛtāñjalipuṭo natvā sarve te samupasthitāḥ | saṃbuddhapramukhaṃ saṃghaṃ prārthayannevamādarāt || 14.146{46} || sarvajña bhagavaṃ chāstaḥ samayo varttate'dhunā | tadbhavān saṃghikaiḥ sārddhaṃ vijayituṃ samarhati || 14.147{47} || iti taiḥ prārthite dṛṣṭvā bhagavān sa sasāṃghikaḥ | pātracīvaramādaya pratasthe saṃprabhāsayan || 14.148{48} || tatra mārgeṣu sarvatra prātihāryaṃ pradarśayan | sarveṣāṃ śubhatāṃ kṛtvā tatpure samupāviśat || 14.149{49} || pradakṣiṇakrameṇaivaṃ caraṃstatra samaṃtataḥ | bhāsayaṃ bhadratāṃ kurvan tatpradeśe samācaran || 14.150{50} || tatra pādyārghamādāya krameṇa saha sāṃghikam | svāsane samupāviśya tasthau bhānurivojvalan || 14.151{51} || tadā taṃ śrīghanaṃ sarvasaṃghaṃ ca svāsane sthitam | dṛṣṭvā sarve'pi te harṣātpūjayituṃ samārabhan || 14.152{52} || tathā krameṇa saṃpūjya taṃ buddhapramukhaṃ gaṇam | yathārhabhojanaiḥ sarvaṃ saṃtṛptaṃ samatoṣayan || 14.153{53} || tataste bhojanāṃte tatpātrāṇi vyapanīya ca | karādīñchodhayitvā tadbhūmiṃ ca paryaśodhayan || 14.154{54} || tataḥ pūgādikaṃ datvā punaḥ sarve'pi te mudā | kṛtāñjalipuṭā natvā samupatasthire punaḥ || 14.155{55} || te ca gāṃdharvikāḥ sarve triratnaśaraṇaṃ gatāḥ | bodhipraṇidhimādhāya prabhejire samāhitāḥ || 14.156{56} || veṇuvīṇāmṛdaṃgādi tūryasaṃgītivādanaiḥ | upasthitya sasaṃghaṃ taṃ śrīghanaṃ samatoṣayat || 14.157{57} || tada sa bhagavāṃ dṛṣṭvā teṣāṃ bhaktiprasādinīm | sarveṣāṃ śuddhacittāni vyamuñcatsmitamuddhavāt || 14.158{58} || tatsaṃsmitasahotpannāḥ paṃcavarṇāḥ śubhāṃśavaḥ | sarvatra bhuvane gatvā praceruramṛtāṃśuvat || 14.159{59} || teṣāṃ ke cidadhogatvā narakeṣu samantataḥ | avabhāsya parispṛṣṭvā sarvatrāpi sukhaṃ daduḥ || 14.160{60} || tadā te nārakīyāstatprabhāspṛṣṭāḥ sukhānvitāḥ | kimetaditi saṃdigdhāḥ saṃmīlyaivaṃ vabhāṣire || 14.161{61} || aho nu jāyate saukhyamasmākaṃ sāṃprataṃ katham | vatānyatra gatāḥ smo'dya kasya puṇyānubhāvataḥ || 14.162{62} || iti saṃdigdhacittānāṃ teṣāṃ manaḥ prabodhane | bhagavānnirmitaṃ buddhaṃ saṃpreṣayan samaṃtataḥ || 14.163{63} || tatrā taṃ saugataṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve te narakasthitāḥ | vismitāḥ samupāsṛtya vavandire prasāditāḥ || 14.164{64} || namo buddhāya dharmāya saṃghāya ca namassadā | iti proktvā praṇatvā taccharaṇaṃ samupāyayuḥ || 14.165{65} || etatpuṇyānubhāvena sarve te narakotthitāḥ | sahasā svargatiṃ yātāḥ saddharme samudācaran || 14.166{66} || evaṃ tān sarvasatvāṃśca samuddhṛtya samantataḥ | sarve te'pyaṃśavo bhūyassaṃbuddhāntikamupācaran || 14.167{67} || ke cidūrddhvagatā yāvadakaniṣṭhaṃ samantataḥ | avabhāsya samudghuṣya tatraivaṃ samacodayan || 14.168{68} || anityaṃ khalu saṃsāraṃ śūnyaṃ hyanātmakam | iti satyaṃ parijñāya triratnaṃ bhajatādarāt || 14.169{69} || niṣkrāmatārabhadhvaṃ ca yūjyadhvaṃ buddhaśāsane | dhunīta mārasainyāśca naḍāgāraṃ yathā karī || 14.170{70} || yo'pyasmin saugate dharme hyapramattaścaretsadā | sa tyaktvā janma saṃsāre duḥkhasyāntaṃ kariṣyati || 14.171{71} || iti saṃcodayantastāṃ sārvān devāṃśca sarvataḥ | te sarve'pyaṃśavo bhāyaḥ sugatāntikamāyayuḥ || 14.172{72} || tataste'pyaṃśavaḥ sarve saṃmīlya saṃgatā muneḥ | pradakṣiṇatrayaṃ kṛtvā tasyorṇāyāṃ samāviśan || 14.173{73} || taddṛṣṭvā te sabhālokā vismayoddhatamānasāḥ | kimetaditi saṃcintya sarve tasthuḥ śakautukāḥ || 14.174{74} || athānaṃdaḥ samālokya tān sarvān vismayoddhavān | utthāya sāñjalirnatvā śāstāraṃ taṃ samabravīt || 14.175{75} || bhagavanste mukhādbhāsiḥ paṃcavarṇā vinirgatā | avabhāsya diśaḥ sarvā ūrṇāyāṃ ca viśanti tāḥ || 14.176{76} ||
