etaddṛṣṭvā sabhālokāḥ sarve'pīme savismayāḥ | taddhetuṃ śrotumichanti tadupādeṣṭumarhati || 14.177{77} || nāhetu hi smitaṃ buddhā darśayanti kadā cana | yaddhetau bhavatā śāsturhasitaṃ tatsamādiśa || 14.178{78} || iti saṃprārthitaṃ śiṣyena sa munīśvaraḥ | tamānaṃdaiḥ sabhāṃ cāpi samālokyaivamādiśat || 14.179{79} || paśyānaṃda yadetairhi sarvai gāndharvikairapi | mama sasāṃghikasyaivaṃ satkāraṃ prakṛtaṃ mudā || 14.180{80} || etatpuṇyavipākena sarve'pīme bhavāntare | kramādbodhicarīṃ prāptā niḥkleśā vimalāśayāḥ || 14.181{81} || māracaryāvinirmuktāḥ pariśuddhāstrimaṇḍalāḥ | varṇasvarābhidhāḥ sarve pratyekasugatā jināḥ || 14.182{82} || prāntāśayyāsānāsīnā hīnadīnānukampakāḥ | dakṣiṇīyā mahāsatvā bhaviṣyanti śubhaṃkarāḥ || 14.183{83} || evametātsamālokya yūyaṃ yadi samichatha | tathātra śraddhayā nityaṃ triratnaṃ bhajatādarāt || 14.184{84} || ye triratnaṃ sadā bhaktyā satkṛtyaivaṃ bhajanti te | vihāya durgatiṃ nityaṃ sadgatiṃ samavāpnuyuḥ || 14.185{85} || iti matvātra saṃsāre yeṣāṃ vāṃchā sukhe śive | te satkṛtya triratneṣu śraddhayā bhajatāniśam || 14.186{86} || ityādiṣṭaṃ munīndreṇa śrutvā sarve ca te janāḥ | satyamevaṃ pratijñāya triratnaṃ sarvadābhajan || 14.187{87} || taddṛṣṭvā bhikṣavaḥ sarve vismayoddhatamānasāḥ | kṛtāñjalipuṭā natvā paprachustaṃ munīśvaram || 14.188{88} || yadevaṃ bhagavannebhiḥ satkāraṃ prakṛtaṃ mahat | tatte kena supuṇyena samyagādeṣṭumarhati || 14.189{89} || evaṃ tairbhikṣubhiḥ sarvaiḥ prārthite sa jineśvaraḥ | sarvānstāñchrāvakān bhikṣūn samālokyaivamādiśat || 14.190{90} || śṛṇudhvaṃ bhikṣavaḥ puṇyaṃ yanmayā prakṛtaṃ purā | tadatra kathitaṃ śrutvā śraddhayābhyanumodata || 14.191{91} || purāsīdbhagavān buddhaḥ prabodhanābhidho jinaḥ | sarvajñaḥ sugataḥ śāstā dharmarājo munīśvaraḥ || 14.192{92} || sarvavidyādhipo nāthastathāgato vināyakaḥ | mārajillokavidbharttā subhadro'rhan hitaṃkaraḥ || 14.193{93} || tadā sa bhagavān buddho janapadeṣu cārikām | carannanyāṃ rājadhānīmanuprāptaḥ sasāṃghikaḥ || 14.194{94} || tatra tasya narendrasya krīḍodyāne taroradhaḥ | praviśya svāsanāsīnastasthau vahnirivojvalan || 14.195{95} || tadaikasmin dine tatra rājā kāntāpravādinaiḥ | saṃgītaiḥ saha saṃrakto ramituṃ samupāviśat || 14.196{96} || tatrasthaṃ taṃ samāsīnaṃ sugataṃ suprabhojvalam | dṛṣṭvaiva sahasopetya natvā kṛtvā pradakṣiṇām || 14.197{97} || samādhisthaṃ tamālokya taṣṭhau ciramupāśrayan | tatastanmukhapadmotthasaddharmāmṛtalipsayā || 14.198{98} || vādyamānaiḥ satairvādyairmuniṃ prābodhayannṛpaḥ | tataḥ sa sugato buddho samādheḥ śīghramutthitaḥ || 14.199{99} || sāntaḥpuraṃ nareṃdraṃ taṃ prādrākṣītsamupasthitam | tadā taṃ nṛpatiṃ dṛṣṭvā sa saṃbuddhaḥ prabodhanaḥ || 14.200{100} || saddharmmaṃ samupādeṣṭuṃ samāmaṃtryaivamabravīt | ehi rājanmahāvāho svāgataṃ te mahīpate || 14.201{1} || saddharmaṃ samupāśritya bodhicaryāṃ samācara | sadā dānaṃ pradatvātra śīlaṃ dhṛtvā samāhitaḥ || 14.202{2} || kṣāntyā prasādayallokān dharmavīryaṃ prasādhaya | bodhau cittaṃ samādhāya prajñāratnamupārjaya || 14.203{3} || tadratnānubhāvena saṃbodhimārgamāpnuyāḥ | tataste maṅgalaṃ nityamihāmutre sadā bhavet || 14.204{4} || sarvasatvahitaṃ kurvan sadgatimeva prāpnuyāḥ | iti matvā mahārāja saddharmaṃ samupāśrayan || 14.205{5} || triratnaṃ śaraṇaṃ kṛtvā satkṛtya bhaja sarvadā | triratneṣu kṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ na kṣiṇoti kadā cana || 14.206{6} || sarvadā satphalānyeva sūte bodhiṃ samarpayet | iti matvā mahārāja triratnaśaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 14.207{7} || bodhicaryāvrataṃ dhṛtvā cara nityaṃ samāhitaḥ | tathā te maṃgalaṃ nityaṃ sarvatrāpi bhaveddhruvam || 14.208{8} || kramādbodhiṃ samāsādya saṃbuddhapadamāpnuyāḥ | iti tenārhatādiṣṭaṃ munīndreṇa sa bhūpatiḥ || 14.209{9} || śrutvā tatheti vijñapya prābhyanandatprabodhitaḥ | tataḥ sa mudito rājā taṃ munīndraṃ sasāṃghikam || 14.210{10} || yathāvidhi samabhyarcya bhojanaiḥ samatoṣayat | tataśca bhojanānte sa nṛpatiḥ sāñjalirmudā | taṃ munīndraṃ praṇatvaivaṃ praṇidhānaṃ hṛdo vyadhāt || 14.211{11} || anena kuśalenāhaṃ loke'ndhe'pariṇāyake | samyagbodhiṃ samāgamya bhaveyaṃ sugato jinaḥ || 14.212{12} || etattena narendreṇa praṇidhānaṃ kṛtaṃ mudā | matvā sa sugatastasya tathāśīrvacanaṃ dadau || 14.213{13} || jayo'stu te sadā rājaṃ dharmeṇa pālaya prajāḥ | praṇidhānaṃ yathā bodhau tathā te siddhyatu dhruvam || 14.214{14} || ityādiṣṭaṃ munīndreṇa tena śrutvā sa bhūpatiḥ | muditaḥ sāñjalirnatvā taṃ munīndraṃ samabravīt || 14.215{15} || adyārabhya sadā śāstastriratnaśaraṇaṃ gataḥ | saṃbodhisaṃvaraṃ dhṛtvā cariṣyāmi samāhitaḥ || 14.216{16} || tadbhavān kṛpayā dṛṣṭyā sadā māṃ draṣṭumarhati | sarvadā bhavatāmeva śaraṇe'smi samāsthitaḥ || 14.217{17} || iti saṃprārthanāṃ kṛtvā rājā sa sajano mudā | bhagavaṃtaṃ tamānamya sānaṃdaḥ svapuraṃ yayau || 14.218{18} || tataḥ sa bhagavāñchāstā samutthāya sasāṃghikaḥ | sarvatra bhadratāṃ kṛtvā svāśrame samupāyayau || 14.219{19} || manyatāṃ bhikṣavo yo'sau rājā saṃbuddhasevakaḥ | ahameva tadābhūvannānyo draṣṭavya eva saḥ || 14.220{20} || yanmayā śraddhayā tasya prabodhanasya tāyinaḥ | pūjākāri mahotsāhaistūryasaṃgītivādanaiḥ || 14.221{21} || tena puṇyavipākena mamātraiva mahotsavaiḥ | etairgāndharvikairevaṃ satkāraḥ prakṛtādhunā || 14.222{22} || evaṃ matvā mahatpuṇyaṃ saṃbuddhabhajanodbhavam | triratnaṃ śaraṇaṃ kṛtvā bhajanīyaṃ śubhārthibhiḥ || 14.223{23} || yūyaṃ cāpi sadā nityaṃ śāstāraṃ sadguruṃ jinam | saṃbuddhaṃ samupāśritya viharadhvaṃ samāhitāḥ || 14.224{24} || ityādiṣṭaṃ munīndreṇa śrutvā te bhikṣavo mudā | sarve tatheti vijñapya triratnāni sadābhajan || 14.225{25} || iti me guruṇādiṣṭaṃ śrutaṃ mayā narādhipa | tathādhunā samākhyātaṃ tava puṇyapravṛddhaye || 14.226{26} || evaṃ rājaṃstvayāpyevaṃ triratnaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ | saṃbuddhaśāsanaṃ dhṛtvā cara dharmaṃ samāhitaḥ || 14.227{27} || prajāścāpi tathā rājaṃ bodhayitvā prayatnataḥ | saṃbodhisādhane dharme yojanīyāstvayādarāt || 14.228{28} || tathā cette sadā bhadraṃ bhavennūnaṃ samantataḥ | kramādbodhiṃ samāsādya saṃbuddhapadamāpnuyāḥ || 14.229{29} || iti śāstrā samādeṣṭaṃ śrutvāśokaḥ sa bhūpatiḥ | tatheti pratimoditvā prābhyanandatsapārṣadaḥ || 14.230{30} || gāṃdharvikānāmavadānametacchrutvānumodanti narā mudā ye | te sarva enaḥparimuktacittā bhuktvā sukhānyeva labhanti bodhim | iti ratnāvadānatatve gāṃdharvikāvādanaṃ samāptam sūkṣmatvacovadāna athāśoko mahīpālaḥ kṛtāṃjalipuṭo mudā | upaguptaṃ guruṃ natvā punarevamabhāṣata || 15.1{1} || bhadanta śrotumichāmi punaranyatsubhāṣitam | tadyathā guruṇākhyātaṃ tathādeṣṭuṃ ca me'rhasi || 15.2{2} || iti saṃprārthite rājñā sa yatiḥ sugatātmajaḥ | aśokaṃ taṃ nṛpaṃ dṛṣṭvā punarevamupādiśat || 15.3{3} || śṛṇu rājanmahābhāga yathā me guruṇoditam | tathāhaṃ te pravakṣyāmi śrutvāpyevaṃ pramodaya || 15.4{4} || purā sa bhagavān buddhaḥ śākyasiṃho jagadguruḥ | vihāre jetakāraṇye vijahāra sasāṃghikaḥ || 15.5{5} || tasmiṃśca samaye tatra sarve bhikṣugaṇā api | śrāvakāścailakāścaiva sarva upāsakā api || 15.6{6} || sarve'pi bhikṣuṇīsaṃghā upāsikāgaṇā api | bodhisatvagaṇāścāpi saddharmasādhanodyatāḥ || 15.7{7} || sabhāmadhyāsanāsīnaṃ śrīghanaṃ taṃ jagadgurum | upatasthuḥ puraskṛtya parivṛtya samaṃtataḥ || 15.8{8} || tadā tasya munīndrasya mukhāmbhojavinirgatam | bhadradharmāmṛtaṃ pātuṃ sarve lokāḥ samāgatāḥ || 15.9{9} || śakrādayaḥ surendrāśca brahmādayo maharddhikāḥ | lokapālā mahāvīrāḥ sasainyaparivārakāḥ || 15.10{10} || yogino yatayaścāpi maharṣayastapaśvinaḥ | brāhmaṇāśca mahāvijñāḥ saddharmaguṇavāṃchinaḥ || 15.11{11} || rājāno rājaputrāśca vaiśyā maṃtrijanā api | amātyāḥ śreṣṭhino bhaṭṭāḥ paurikāśca gṛhādhipāḥ || 15.12{12} || sainyādhipāśca yodhāraḥ sārthavahā mahājanāḥ | vaṇijaḥ śilpinaścāpi grāmyāḥ kārpaṭikā api || 15.13{13} || evamanye'pi lokāśca saddharmaguṇavāñchinaḥ | sarve dharmāmṛtaṃ pātuṃ vihāre samupāgatāḥ || 15.14{14} || tatra prāptāḥ sabhāmadhye samāsīnaṃ munīśvaram | śrīghanaṃ taṃ samālokya praṇatvā samupācaran || 15.15{15} || tatra te samupāsṛtya sarve taṃ śrīghanaṃ munim | tridhā pradakṣiṇīkṛtvā samabhyarcya praṇemire || 15.16{16} || tataḥ sarve'pi te lokāḥ parivṛtya samantataḥ | sāñjalayaḥ prasannāsyā upatasthuḥ samāhitāḥ || 15.17{17} || tadā sa bhagavān dṛṣṭvā sarvāṃstān samupasthitān | ādimadhyāntakalyāṇamāryadharmamupādiśat || 15.18{18} || tatsaddharmāmṛtaṃ pītvā sarve te tridaśādayaḥ | lokā dharmaviśeṣatvaṃ vijñāya prāṇanandire || 15.19{19} || tasminnavasare tatra śrāvastyāṃ pauriko gṛhī | śreṣṭhī mahājanaḥ śrimāñchrāddho bhadrāśayābhavat || 15.20{20} || sa ekasmiṃ dine svasmin bhāṇḍālakoṣṭhake viśan | svasaṃpannicayaṃ dṛṣṭvā manasaivaṃ vyacintayat || 15.21{21} || aho me jāyate saṃpaddīyatī saṃpravarddhitā | tathāpi varddhyate tṛṣṇā yataḥ saukhyaṃ na kiṃ cana || 15.22{22} || yadime caṃcalā bhogā jalacaṃdranibhā mama | anityā asthirāḥ padmapatrasthitajalopamā || 15.23{23} || tadatra kiṃ mano'dyāpi tṛṣṇayākṛṣyate mama | yena carāmyahaṃ loke duḥkhī bhavikalāśayaḥ || 15.24{24} || tatkiṃ me saṃpadā sāraṃ yataḥ saukhyaṃ na vidyate | dharmārthe gocaraṃ naiva kevalaṃ madavṛddhaye || 15.25{25} || madena varddhate mānaṃ mānālloke pramādatā | pramādāddīpyate cerṣyā kopāgnirdīpyate tataḥ || 15.26{26} || kopātkrūrāśayaścaṇḍo nirdayo duritāśayaḥ | pāpātmā hiṃsako duṣṭo daśākuśalasādhakaḥ || 15.27{27} || svayaṃ naṣṭaḥ parāṃścāpi nāśayati durāśayaḥ | tato'tipāpasaṃrakto durācaro'tidurmanāḥ || 15.28{28} || tato'tidurmatirdrohī saṃvṛttidharmaniṃdakaḥ | triratnāni pratikṣipya mahāpātakamācaret || 15.29{29} || tato'tipāpasaṃkliṣṭāḥ pramūḍho narakaṃ vrajet | narakeṣu bhramannityaṃ duḥkhānyeva sadāśnuyāt || 15.30{30} || yadvātrāpi ca saṃsāre jīvitamadhruvaṃ khalu | kṣaṇadhvaṃsi śarīraṃ ca sārveṣāṃ maraṇaṃ dhruvam || 15.31{31} || tadatrāhamasārebhyo bhogebhyaḥ sāramuttamam | saddharmaṃ samupādātuṃ yatnaṃ kuryāṃ samādarāt || 15.32{32} || saddharmaṃ saugataṃ dharmamityākhyātaṃ purāvidaiḥ | tadatra saugate kṣetre dānaṃ kurvīya sāṃpratam || 15.33{33} || bauddhakṣetre kṛtaṃ dānaṃ bodhivījaṃ bhaveddhruvam | etadevātra saṃsāre sādhanīyaṃ śubhāptaye || 15.34{34} || dānena śuddhyate cittaṃ sucittaḥ sumatiṃ labhet | subuddhiḥ sadguṇāraktaḥ saṃvṛttiśīlabhṛtkṛtī || 15.35{35} || suśīlaḥ kṣāntimān dhīraḥ parātmasamabhāvikaḥ | sudhīro vīryavān sarvasatvārthasādhanodyataḥ || 15.36{36} || apradhṛṣyo mahāsatvaḥ kleśāridamako bhavet | tataḥ supariśuddhātmā samādhisusthito bhavet || 15.37{37} || tatsamādhivalādhānaiḥ prajñābdhipāramāgataḥ | bodhiratnaṃ samāsādya bodhisatvo'dhipo bhavet || 15.38{38} || etadratnānubhāvena bhadraṃkalā samantataḥ | sarvamārān vinirjitya saṃbuddhapadamāpnuyāt || 15.39{39} || ityarhadbhirmahābhijñaiḥ samākhyātaṃ mayā śrutam | tatsaṃbuddhapadāṃ praptuṃ buddhaṃ bhajeya sāṃpratam || 15.40{40} || nūnaṃ buddhānubhāvena bhāvitaṃ setsyate dhruvam | tadbuddhapramukhaṃ sarvasaṃghaṃ pūjeya sādaram || 15.41{41} || iti niścitya sa śrīmān gṛhasthaḥ saṃpramoditaḥ | bhagavaṃtaṃ sasaṃghan taṃ pūjayituṃ samaichata || 15.42{42} || tataḥ sa sajanaḥ śreṣṭhī triratnabhajanotsukaḥ | vihāre jetakāraṇye prayayau saṃpraharṣitaḥ || 15.43{43} || tatra taṃ śrīghanaṃ dṛṣṭvā sa gṛhasthaḥ pramoditaḥ | natvā pradakṣiṇīkṛtya samarcayadyathāvidhiḥ || 15.44{44} || tataḥ sa sajano natvā sāñjaliḥ saṃpramoditaḥ | munīndraṃ taṃ samālokya puraḥ sthitvaivamabravīt || 15.45{45} || sarvajña bhagavaṃ chāstarbhavatāṃ śaraṇaṃ vraje | tato'bhilaṣite kārye prasīdatu jagadguro || 15.46{46} || bhagavaṃ bhavataḥ śāstuḥ sasaṃghasya jagadguroḥ | pūjayituṃ samichāmi tadanujñāṃ dadātu me || 15.47{47} || iti saṃprārthite tena bhagavān sa munīśvaraḥ | tathāstviti pratijñāya tūṣṇībhūtvādhyuvāsa tat || 15.48{48} || tataḥ sa gṛhabhṛnmatvā bhagavatādhyuvāsa tam | sāñjalistaṃ muniṃ natvā muditaḥ svagṛhaṃ yayau || 15.49{49} || tatra sa svajanaiḥ svasmiṃ gṛhe margeṣu sarvataḥ | pariśodhya sugaṃdhaiśca pariṣiṃcyābhyaśobhayat || 15.50{50} || tatrāsanāni prajñapya vitānāni vitatya ca | muktapuṣpaiḥ samākīrya surabhiṃ samadhūpayat || 15.51{51} || tataḥ sa bhojyasāmagrīṃ sādhayitvā svavaṃdhubhiḥ | tathopahārasāmagrīṃ pariśuddhāmasādhayat || 15.52{52} || tato'nye dyurgṛhasthaḥ sa snātvā śuddhāṃvarāvṛtaḥ | saṃbuddhāmaṃtraṇaṃ kartuṃ vihāre sajano yayau || 15.53{53} || tatra taṃ śrīghanaṃ dṛṣṭvā sasaṃghaṃ sa purogataḥ | kṛtāñjalipuṭo natvā prārthayadevamādarāt || 15.54{54} || bhagavannātha sarvajña samayo vartate'dhunā | tatsasaṃgho mamāvāse bhāvānāgantumarhati || 15.55{55} || iti saṃprārthite tena bhagavān sa sasāṃghikaḥ | pātracīvaramādāya saṃpratasthe prabhāsayan || 15.56{56} || tatra sa bhagavānmārge kṛtvā bhadraṃ prabhāsayan | bhikṣusaṃghagaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ śrāvastīṃ samupāviśan || 15.57{57} || tadābhūnnagare tatra sarvatrāpi sumaṅgalam | upadravāṇi sarvāṇi sahasā vilayaṃ yayuḥ || 15.58{58} || andhā rūpāṇi paśyantaḥ śṛṇvanto vadhirā ravān | hīnendriyāśca ye te'pi pratilabdhendriyā vavuḥ || 15.59{59} || ksutpipāsāhatā ye ca te'bhavan parituṣṭitāḥ | rogiṇo nīrujā āsan kuvelā rucirāmvarāḥ || 15.60{60} || mūkā āsan pravaktāro jaḍāścāpi suvāgminaḥ | ciravairābhisaṃnaddhāste'pyāsanmaitrabhāvitāḥ || 15.61{61} || ye ca caṇḍāśāyāḥ krūrāste'pyabhūvan dayālavaḥ | ye ca duṣṭā durācārāste santassamyamodyatāḥ || 15.62{62} || daridrā dhaninaḥ proḍhyā dūrvalā valino'bhavan | ye śaṭhā vaṃcakāścauraste āryāḥ satyavādinaḥ || 15.63{63} || evaṃ ye duḥkhinaḥ satvāste sarve sukhino'bhavan | evaṃ sa bhagavāṃstatra kṛtvā bhadraṃ samantataḥ || 15.64{64} || pradakṣiṇakrameṇaivaṃ sasaṃghaṃ tadgṛhe viśan | tatra tasya munīndrasya sa gṛhastho yathākramam | pādyaṃ dadau sasaṃghasya sadārāḥ śucināmbunā || 15.65{65} || tataḥ sa suprāsannātmā sasaṃghaṃ taṃ munīśvaram | prajñapte svāsane tatra yathākramaṃ nyaveśayat || 15.66{66} || tatra te sāṃghikāḥ sarve saṃbuddhapramukhāḥ kramāt | svasvāsane samāviśya samātasthuḥ samāhitāḥ || 15.67{67} || tataḥ svasvāsanāsīnān saṃbuddhapramukhān yatīn | tān sarvān sa gṛhī dṛṣṭvā yathāvidhi samarcayat || 15.68{68} || tataḥ sa sajanaḥ śreṣṭhī svahastena sasāṃghikam | taṃ munīndraṃ sudhākalpairbhojanaiḥ samatarpayet || 15.69{69} || tataḥ saṃtṛptitaṃ dṛṣṭvā sasaṃghaṃ taṃ munīśvaram | apanīya sa pātrāṇi taddhastādīn vyaśodhayat || 15.70{70} || tataḥ sa sāñjalirnatvā tān buddhapramukhān yatīn | puro nīcāsanāsīno dharmaṃ śrotumupāśrayat || 15.71{71} || tataḥ sa bhagavān dṛṣṭvā taṃ gṛhaṣṭhaṃ subhāvinam | ādimadhyāntakalyāṇaṃ dharmāmādeṣṭumabravīt || 15.72{72} || ārogyamastu te nityaṃ gṛhapate sadā śivam | bodhau cittaṃ samādhāya cara dharmaṃ samāhitaḥ || 15.73{73} || dharmeṇa jīyate pāpaṃ niṣpāpaḥ sadgatiṃ vrajet | sadgatau satsukhānyeva bhuktvā saṃcarate sadā || 15.74{74} || dharmeṇa puruṣo vidvān sarvavidyākalādhipaḥ | sudhiro guṇavān vijño bhavecchrīmānmaharddhikaḥ || 15.75{75} || dharmeṇa suciraṃ jīvedārogyaṃ ca sadā tanau | sarvatrāpi bhavennityaṃ maṃgalaṃ nirupadravam || 15.76{76} || dharmo na naśyate kvapi hriyate nāpi kena cit | kenāpi naśyate naiva cālayituṃ kadā cana || 15.77{77} || nāgnibhirdahyate dharmaḥ klidyate nāpi codakaiḥ | vāyubhiḥ śuṣyate naiva kṣīyate nāpi bhūmiṣu || 15.78{78} || dharmeṇa bhūḥ sthirībhūtā dharmeṇa dīpyate'nalaḥ | dharmeṇa calate vāyurdharmeṇa vahate jalaḥ || 15.79{79} || dharmeṇa dīpyate bhānurdharmeṇaivaṃ sudhākaraḥ | meghā dharmeṇa varṣāṇā bhūmiḥ śaṣyauṣadhībharāḥ || 15.80{80} || dharmeṇaivaṃ tathā sarve lokapālā maharddhikāḥ | sarvaduṣṭān vinirjitya pālayanti jagattraye || 15.81{81} || dharmo na śīyate kvāpi dharmo na paribhūyate | sarvatra jayate dharmo dharmo hi śobhate sadā || 15.82{82} || dharmahīnā na śobhante śrimanto guṇino'pi ca | dharmmiṣṭhā eva śobhante daridrā nirguṇā api || 15.83{83} || dharmeṇa rakṣitā vīrāḥ saṃgrāme vijitārayaḥ | yaśomānyamahatsaṃpatsukhāni te labhanti ca || 15.84{84} || tathā vīrā vaṇiksārthā dharmeṇaivābhirakṣitāḥ | mahāmbudhiṃ samuttīrya ratnānyapi labhanti ca || 15.85{85} || dharmavanto narā dhīrā buddhimanto vicakṣaṇāḥ | sarvavidyākalāvijñā jayante paravādinaḥ || 15.86{86} || tathā dharmānubhāvena śilpavidyākalāvidaḥ | yaśomānyaprasādaśrīsatsukhāni labhanti ca || 15.87{87} || tathā ca maṃtriṇo'mātyā dharmavanto vicakṣaṇāḥ | rājyakāryāṇi sarvāṇi sādhayanto jayantyarīn || 15.88{88} || rājānaḥ kṣatriyāścaivaṃ dharmanītivicakṣaṇāḥ | sarvaduṣṭān vinirjitya virājante nārādhipāḥ || 15.89{89} || tathā dharmeṇa rājendraścakravarttī mahīśvaraḥ | saptaratnasamāyuktaḥ sarvaśāstā virājate || 15.90{90} || tathā dharmadharā eva yatayo yogino'pi ca | sarvakleśagaṇāñjitvā labhanti paramaṃ padam || 15.91{91} || tatharṣayo mahābhijñā dharmabhṛto maharddhikāḥ | yathābhilaṣitāṃ siddhiṃ prāpya mokṣaṃ vrajanti ca || 15.92{92} || tathā dharmānusāreṇa maṃtravidyārthasādhakāḥ | siddhisamṛddhisaṃprāptāḥ sādhayanti yathehitam || 15.93{93} || tathā ca mānavāḥ sarve lokā dharmānusārataḥ | nihīnamadhyamotkṛṣṭāḥ prabhavanti mahītale || 15.94{94} || tathā dharmānusāreṇa lokā daityādayo'pi ca | nihīnamadhyamotkṛṣṭā pracaranti rasātale || 15.95{95} || tathā svargeṣu devāśca svasvadharmānubhāvataḥ | sukhāni suciraṃ bhuktvā pravasanti pramoditāḥ || 15.96{96} || evaṃ sarvatra lokeṣu svasvadharmānubhāvataḥ | sarve satvāḥ sukhaprāptāḥ pracaranti yathechayā || 15.97{97} || evaṃ traidhātukotpannāḥ satvāḥ sarve surādayaḥ | svasvadharmānusāreṇa bhramanti ṣaḍgatiṣvapi || 15.98{98} || kimatra vahunoktena dharma eva jagatprabhuḥ | dharmeṇaiva sadā nityaṃ rakṣitaḥ pracarecchubhe || 15.99{99} || ṣubhena siddhyate cittaṃ śuddhacittaḥ sudhīrbhavet | subuddhiḥ sadguṇādhāraṃ sadguruṃ samupāśrayet || 15.100{100} || tadgurorupadeśena carannityaṃ samāhitaḥ | bodhicittaṃ samādhāya triratnāni sadā bhajet || 15.101{1} || etatpuṇyānubhāvena saddharmasādhanodyataḥ | bodhisatvo mahāsatvo bodhicaryāṃ vrataṃ caret || 15.102{2} || tato māragaṇāñjitvā pūrya pāramitāḥ kramāt | trividhāṃ bodhimāsādya saṃbuddhapadamāpnuyāt || 15.103{3} || evaṃ dharmavaraṃ matvā triratnaśaraṇaṃ gataḥ | saddharmaṃ samupaśritya cara bodhipadāptaye || 15.104{4} || mṛtyukāle vipattau ca dharmma evānugassuhṛt | tadā sarve tyajantyāśu ko'pi naiva sahānugaḥ || 15.105{5} || dharma eva tadā trātā sarvatrāpyanugaḥ suhṛt | tasmāddharmo mahāratnaṃ sādhanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ || 15.106{6} || evaṃ sa bhagavāñchāstā dharmasyābhyanubhāvatām | samādiśya kṣaṇaṃ tasthau tūṣṇībhūtvā samāhitaḥ || 15.107{7} || tatastasya munīndrasya pādau sa mudito gṛhī | praṇatvā manasā caivaṃ praṇidhānaṃ sāmadadhe || 15.108{8} || anena kuśalenāhaṃ sarvakleśavivarjitaḥ | pratyekāṃ bodhimāsādya nirvṛtiṃ samavāpnuyāt || 15.109{9} || tataḥ sa suprasannāsyo gṛhasthaḥ sajano mudā | bhagavataṃ tamālokya purastasthau samāhitaḥ || 15.110{10} || tadā sa bhagavāṃstasya śrīmato hṛdaye sthitam | praṇidhānaṃ parijñāya susaṃsmitaṃ vyamuñcata || 15.111{11} || tatastasya munīndrasya mukhapadmātsurasmayaḥ | paṃcavarṇā vinirgatya sarvatra samudācaran || 15.112{12} || tāsāṃ yā raśmayo yātā adholoke samantataḥ | tāḥ sarvanarakeṣvevamavabhyāsya samāsarat || 15.113{13} || tadā tābhiḥ parispṛṣṭāḥ sarve te narakasthitāḥ | mahatsaukhyaṃ samāsādya vismayaṃ samupāyayuḥ || 15.114{14} || tatra sarve'pi te satvāḥ parasparasamāgatāḥ | sarvaduḥkhavinirmuktāḥ saṃmīlyaivaṃ samabruvan || 15.115{15} || aho citraṃ kimadyaivaṃ mahatsaukhyaṃ prajāyate | kiṃ nu vayaṃ bhavanto'smāccyutā anyatra cāgatāḥ || 15.116{16} || yadasmākaṃ mahadduḥkhaṃ tatsarvaṃ śāmyate'dhunā | saṃjāyate mahāsaukhyaṃ tadadbhutaṃ na manyate || 15.117{17} || nūnamatrādhunā ko'pi bodhisatvaḥ samāgataḥ | yasmādiyaṃ mahāraśmiravabhāsya prasaryati || 15.118{18} || iti ciṃtābhidagdhānaṃ teṣāṃ cittaprabodhane | bhagavānnirmitaṃ buddhaṃ sarvatra tatra preṣayet || 15.119{19} || tadā taṃ saugatiṃ mūrttiṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve'pi te mudā | aho citramiti proktvā vismitāścaivamabruvan || 15.120{20} || nehaivetaścyutāḥ sarve nāpyanyatra gatā vayam | ihaiva saṃsthitāḥ sarve narake pravasāmahe || 15.121{21} || api tvayaṃ mahān satvo'pūrvadarśana āgataḥ | nūnamasyānubhāvena saṃjāyante sukhāni naḥ || 15.122{22} || tadasmiṃ sugatākare vayaṃ sarve prasāditāḥ | upetya praṇatiṃ kṛtvā sarvathā saṃbhajemahi || 15.123{23} || iti saṃbhāṣya sarve te nārakīyāḥ pramoditāḥ | upetya taṃ mahāsatvaṃ sāñjalayo'bhinemire || 15.124{24} || namo buddhāya dharmāya saṃghāye ca namaḥ sadā | ityuktvā ca triratnānāṃ saṃsmṛtvā śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ || 15.125{25} || iti te nirmite tasmiṃ cittaṃ prasādya nirmalāḥ | sarvanirmuktakarmāṇaḥ sahasā sadgatiṃ yayuḥ || 15.126{26} || tathā corddhagatā yāstāḥ kramāccāturmahādhipān | samārabhya trayastriṃśān sarvāṃścāpi surālayāt || 15.127{27} || yāvadbhavāgraparyantamavabhāsya prasāritāḥ || 15.128{27} || tathā cāpi samodghuṣya sarvān devānanodayan | anityaṃ khalu saṃsāraṃ duḥkhaṃ śūnyamanātmakam | iti matvā śubhe nityaṃ caritavyaṃ sadāpi ca || 15.129{28} || niṣkrāmatārabhadhvaṃ tadyujyadhvaṃ buddhaśāsane | dhunīta mṛtyusainyāni naḍāgāraṃ karī yathā || 15.130{29} || yo hyasmiṃ dharmavinaye hyapramattaścariṣyati | tyaktvā janmātra saṃsāre duḥkhasyāntaṃ kariṣyati || 15.131{30} || iti matvātra saṃbodhipadaṃ yadi samichatha | tacchraddhayā triratnāni bhajadhvaṃ sarvadādarāt || 15.132{31} || etacchabdaṃ samākarṇya sarve devāḥ prabodhitāḥ | triratnaṃ śaraṇaṃ kṛtvā prabhejire sadādṛtāḥ || 15.133{32} || evaṃ tā raśmayaḥ sarvāḥ sarvāṃllokāṃcchubhe vṛṣe | bodhayitvā pratisthāpya pratyāyayurmuneḥ puraḥ || 15.134{33} || tatra tā raśmayaḥ sarvāḥ piṇḍitāstasya tāyinaḥ | tridhā pradakṣiṇīkṛtvā sūrṇāyāṃ nyaviśatpunaḥ || 15.135{34} || taddṛṣṭvā vismitāḥ sarve lokāste samitisthitāḥ | kiṃ dharmamādiśedbuddha iti saṃciṃtya tasthire || 15.136{35} || athānando mahābhijñaḥ samutthāya kṛtāñjaliḥ | puraḥ sthito munīndraṃ taṃ praṇatvā prārthayattathā || 15.137{36} || bhagavānnānāvidhā raśmirbhavanmukhābjanirgatāḥ | avabhāsya jagallokaṃ bhavadūrṇāṃ niveśitā || 15.138{37} || mārajinnirmalasvānto nirvikalpo niraṃjanaḥ | nāhetvapratyayaṃ buddhā nirdainyā nirmadoddhavāḥ | smitaṃ caṃdrakarāhāsaṃ darśayanti kadācana || 15.139{38} || tadyadarthaṃ bhavān smitaṃ darśayati munīśvara | tadarthaṃ śrotumicchaṃti sarve lokā ime'dhunā || 15.140{39} || tadbhavāṃ yatsamādeṣṭumichati sāṃprataṃ mune | taddharmaṃ samupādiśya prasādayatvimāṃ sabhām || 15.141{40} || iti tena vaśiṣyeṇa prārthite sa munīśvaraḥ | tamāyuṣmantamānandaṃ samāmaṃtryaivamabravīt || 15.142{41} || evametatsadānaṃda nāhetvapratyayaṃ smitam | saṃbuddhā api te sarve darśayanti kadā cana || 15.143{42} || yadarthe smitamānaṃda darśitaṃ sāṃprataṃ mayā | tadarthaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi tacchṛṇudhvaṃ samāhitāḥ || 15.144{43} || paśyasi tvaṃ tadānaṃda śreṣṭhinānena yanmama | evaṃvidhaṃ sasaṃghasya satkāraṃ śraddhayā kṛtam || 15.145{44} || etatpuṇyavipākena mayi cittaprasādataḥ | ayaṃ śrīmānmahāsatvo bodhisatvo bhavetsudhīḥ || 15.146{45} || tataḥ kleśavimuktātmā pariśuddhatrimaṃḍalaḥ | sūkṣmatvagiti vikhyātaḥ pratyekabuddha ātmavit || 15.147{46} || bhaviṣyati mahābhijñaḥ saṃvṛtiparamārthavit || 15.148{47!} || evametatmahatpuṇyavījamārādhitaṃ mama | sāsane śrīmatānena śraddhayā bodhicetasā || 15.149{48} || buddhakṣetre kṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ na kṣiṇoti kadā cana | saṃbodhisatphalaṃ dadyānnānyaddharmaphalaṃ khalu || 15.150{49} || evaṃ mahattaraṃ puṇyaṃ buddhakṣetreṣu satkṛtam | matvā taccharaṇaṃ kṛtvā triratnaṃ bhajatādarāt || 15.151{50} || ye buddaśaraṇaṃ gatvā bhajanti sarvadādarāt | te sadā sadgatiṃ yātāścaraṃti bodhisaṃvaram || 15.152{51} || ye dharmaṃ śaraṇaṃ kṛtvā śrutvā bhajanti sādaram | sarve te'kleśino bhadrāḥ saṃprayānti jinālayam || 15.153{52} || ye saṃghe śaraṇaṃ gatvā bhajanti śraddhayā sadā | na te gacchanti duḥkhatvaṃ sadā yānti sukhāvatīm || 15.154{53} || iti matvā tathā yūyaṃ sadā nityaṃ samāhitāḥ | triratnaśaraṇaṃ kṛtvā bhajadhvaṃ śraddhayādarāt || 15.155{54} || tena puṇyavipākena yūyaṃ sarve'pi sarvathā | trividhāṃ bodhimāsādya saṃbuddhapadamāpsyatha || 15.156{55} || iti śāstrā munīndreṇa samādiṣṭaṃ niśamyate | sarve'pi sāṃghikāḥ sarve lokāśca saṃpramoditāḥ || 15.157{56} || tatheti pratisaṃśrutya triratnaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ | satkṛtya śraddhayā nityaṃ prabhejire samāhitāḥ || 15.158{57} || so'pi śreṣṭhī tathā śāstrā samādiṣṭaṃ tadātmanam | vyākaraṇaṃ samākarṇya prābhyanandatprabodhitaḥ || 15.159{58} || tataḥ prabhṛti sa śrīmāṃstriratnaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ | satkṛtya śraddhayā nityaṃ sadā bheje pramoditaḥ || 15.160{59} || tataḥ sa bhagavāñchāstā sasāṃghikaḥ samutthitaḥ | tathā sarvatra bhadrāṇi prakurvan svāśramaṃ yayau || 15.161{60} || ityevaṃ guruṇākhyātaṃ tathā mayātra kathyate | tvamapyevaṃ mahārāja śrutvā dharmaṃ śubhe cara || 15.162{61} || prajāścāpi tathā dharmaṃ śrāvayitvā prabodhayan | bodhimārge pratiṣṭhāpya śubhe'bhyava sadādarāt || 15.163{62} || tathā te sarvadā nityaṃ maṃgalaṃ nirupadravam | bhavennūnaṃ mahārāja satyametatprabudhyatām || 15.164{63} || etatpuṇyavipākena daśapāramitā api | paripūryya krameṇaivaṃ saṃbodhimapi cāpsyai || 15.165{64} || evaṃ satyaṃ parijñāya triratnaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ | satkṛtya śraddhayā nityaṃ bhaja bodhiṃ yadīchasi || 15.166{65} || iti tenārhatā śāstrā samādiṣṭaṃ niśamya saḥ | nṛpastatheti saṃśrutya prābhyanandatsapārṣadaḥ || 15.167{66} || sūkṣmatvaco'vadānaṃ yattadidaṃ ye narā mudā | satkṛtya śraddhayā bhaktyā śṛṇvanti śrāvayanti ca || 15.168{67} || te sarve sadgatiṃ yātā bhuktvā saukhyāni sarvadā | saddharmaṃ samupāśritya saṃprayānti jinālayam || 15.169{68} || iti ratnāvadānatatve sūkṣmatvaco'vadānaṃ samāptaḥ pretikāvadāna athāśoko mahārājaḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭo mudā | upaguptaṃ yatiṃ natvā punareva samabravīt || 16.1{1} || bhadanta śrotumichāmi punaranyatsubhāṣitam | tadyathā guruṇādiṣṭaṃ tathādeṣṭuṃ ca me'rhasi || 16.2{2} || iti saṃprārthitaṃ tena rājñā sa yatirātmavit | tamaśokaṃ mahīpālaṃ samālokyaivamādiśat || 16.3{3} || śṛṇu rājanmahābhāga yathā me guruṇoditam | tathāhaṃ te pravakṣyāmi śrutvānumodanāṃ kuru || 16.4{4} || purā sa bhagavān buddhaḥ śākyasiṃho jagadguruḥ | sarvajñaḥ sugataḥ śāstā dharmarājastathāgataḥ || 16.5{5} || bhikṣubiḥ śrāvakaiḥ sārddhaṃ cailakairbhikṣuṇīgaṇaiḥ | upāsakairmahāśrāddhaistathā copāsikāgaṇaiḥ || 16.6{6} || bodhisatvagaṇaiścāpi saddharmasādhanodyataiḥ | kṛtakṛtyairmahābhijñaiścaturbrahmavihārakaiḥ || 16.7{7} || rājagṛhe puropānte veṇuvane śubhāṅkite | karaṇḍakanivāpākhye mahodyāne jināśrame || 16.8{8} || vihṛtya sarvasatvānāṃ hitārthena sabhāśritaḥ | ādimadhyāntākalyāṇaṃ dharmamādeṣṭumārabhat || 16.9{9} || tadā sarve'pi devendrāḥ sadevāḥ kamalāsanaḥ | sarve lokādhipāścāpi yakṣagaṃdharvakinnarāḥ || 16.10{10} || siddhā vidyādharāḥ sādhyā rākṣasā dānavādhipāḥ | nāgeṃdrā garuḍāścāpi sajanaparivārakāḥ || 16.11{11} || ṛṣayo brahmaṇāścāpi yatayo yogino'pi ca | rājāno rājaputrāśca maṃtriṇo'pi ca || 16.12{12} || amātyāḥ sainyalokāśca sārthavāhā mahājanāḥ | vaṇijaḥ śilpinaścāpi gṛhasthāḥ paurikā janāḥ || 16.13{13} || grāmyā jānapadāścāpi kārpaṭikāśca nairgamāḥ | tathānye'pi samāyātāḥ saddharmaguṇavāṃchinaḥ || 16.14{14} || tatra sarve'pi te lokā vihāre samupāgatāḥ | taṃ munīndraṃ samāsīnaṃ dṛṣṭvā natvā pramoditāḥ || 16.15{15} || tridhā pradakṣiṇīkṛtvā samabhyarcya yathākramam | natvā sāñjalayaḥ sarve parivṛtya samaṃtataḥ || 16.16{16} || tatsaddharmāmṛtaṃ pātuṃ suprasannamukhāmbujam | śrīghanaṃ taṃ samālokya samātasthuḥ samāhitāḥ || 16.17{17} || tadā sa bhagavān dṛṣṭvā tān sarvān samupasthitān | āryasatyaṃ samārabhya saddharmaṃ samupādiśat || 16.18{18} || tatsaddharmāmṛtaṃ pītvā lokāḥ sarve'pi te mudā | saṃbodhisādhanotsāhāḥ pracerire pramoditāḥ || 16.19{19} || tasminnavasare tatra rājagṛhāntike vane | veṇuvanāntike paṃcapretaśatāni cerire || 16.20{20} || nagnānyatikṛtāṅgāni dagdhasthūṇākṛtīni vai | romavastrāṇi rukṣāṇi śailopamodarāṇi ca || 16.21{21} || sūcīchidramukhānyasthiyaṃtravaducchṛtānyapi | kṣutpipāsābhidagdhāni hīnadīnasvarāṇyapi || 16.22{22} || tīvraduḥkhāni taptāni pralapanti vihāyasi | vibhramanti sadā kvāpi kiñci sthitiṃ na lebhire || 16.23{23} || tadaikasmin dine tatra maudgalyāyana ātmavit | āyuṣmān saugato bhikṣurmahābhijño dayānvitaḥ || 16.24{24} || pūrvāhne pātramādāya kāṣāyacīvarāvṛtaḥ | rājagṛhe pure piṇḍaṃ yācituṃ samupācaran || 16.25{25} || tatra yatiḥ sa tāṃ pretāṃ sarvān vibhramato'mvare | dṛṣṭvene ka iti dhyātvā paśyañjanairupācaran || 16.26{26} || te sarve pretakāścāpi dṛṣṭvā taṃ bhikṣumāgatam | sahasopetya natvāgre rudanta etadabruvan || 16.27{27} || bhadanta bhavatāṃ pādau vandāmahe samānatāḥ | tadasmākaṃ hitaṃ kṛtvā kṛpayā trātumarhati || 16.28{28} || vayaṃ rājagṛhe jātāḥ paurāḥ paṃcaśatānyapi | svakarmaparibhuṃjānaḥ pretībhūtāścarāmahe || 16.29{29} || tadā vayamime sarve gṛhasthāḥ śreṣṭhino narāḥ | mahādhanā mahābhogāstīrthikā dharmasevakāḥ || 16.30{30} || yadvayaṃ matsārākrāntamānasāḥ kuṭukuñcakāḥ | āgṛhītapariṣkārāḥ kevalārjanasādhakāḥ || 16.31{31} || naiva kiñcittadā dānamadadmahi kadā cana | arthinamāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā prākuṣyāmahi roṣitāḥ || 16.32{32} || paradattānyapi śrutvā dṛṣṭvā cāpi praroṣitāḥ | dīyamāneṣu vighnāni prākurmahi prayatnataḥ || 16.33{33} || saugatā api cārhantaḥ pretā iveyamāgatāḥ | ityasmābhiḥ pramohāndhaiḥ paribhāṣyābhininditāḥ || 16.34{34} || tata ete vayaṃ sarve kālaṃ kṛtvā ca sāṃpratam | evaṃ pretālayotpannā duḥkhārditāścarāmahe || 16.35{35} || iti bhadanta vijñāya gatvā rājagṛhe bhavān | kṛpayāsmatpravṛttāṃtaṃ jñātīnāṃ purato vadan || 16.36{36} || chandakabhikṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā buddhādiṃ sarvasāṃghikam | asmannāmnā samabhyarcya bhojayituṃ samarhati || 16.37{37} || saṃbuddhapramukhebhyaśca saṃghebhyo bhavatādarāt | asmannāmnā prakarttavyaṃ praṇāmamapi sadguro || 16.38{38} || dakṣiṇādeśanāpyasmannāmnā buddhādisāṃghikaiḥ | bhavatā kārayitavyā ityasmāsu kṛpāṃ kuru || 16.39{39} || yathāsmākamitaḥ pretalokā muktirbhaveddhruvam | tathāsmāsu bhavāmcchāstā kṛpayā kartumarhāti || 16.40{40} || iti taiḥ prārthitaṃ sarvaiḥ sa maudgalyāyanaḥ sudhīḥ | śrutvā tatheti saṃśrutya tūṣṇībhūtvādhyuvāsa tat || 16.41{41} || tatastān pretikān sarvān sa maudgalyāyano yatiḥ | samālokya samāśvāsya punaretatsamabravīt || 16.42{42} || tatra yūyaṃ ca sarva śvaḥ pravṛtte saṃghabhojane | sasaṃghaṃ śrīghanaṃ draṣṭuṃ samāyāta samādarāt || 16.43{43} || iti tenārhātādiṣṭaṃ śrutvā te pretakā api | tatheti hi pratijñāya praṇatvā taṃ vane yayuḥ || 16.44{44} || tataḥ sa saugato bhikṣurmaudgalyo yatirātmavit | gatvā rājagṛhe teṣāṃ jñātīnāṃ samupācaran || 16.45{45} || tatra sarvatra teṣāṃ tatjñātīnāṃ bhavaneṣu sa | gatvā teṣāṃ pravṛttāṃtaṃ sarvamevaṃ nyavedayat || 16.46{46} || tataḥ sa tatra sarvāṃstāṃ jñātīnāhūya sādaram | teṣāṃ pretagatermuktihetorevaṃ samabravīt || 16.47{'47} || śṛṇuta bho mahābhāgya yūyaṃ sarve samāhitāḥ | yuṣmākaṃ jñātivargāṇāṃ muktihetuṃ pravakṣyate || 16.48{48} || yato yuṣmatsagotrāste matsariṇo durāśayāḥ | āgṛhītapariṣkārā daśākuśalasaṃcarāḥ || 16.49{49} || nāpi dānaṃ pradattaṃ taiḥ kasmai ci kvāpi kiṃ cana | paradattānyapi śrutvā dṛṣṭvā vā paryabhāṣyata || 16.50{50} || arhanto bhikṣavo vā tairyācakāśca gṛhāgatāḥ | paribhāṣyābhisaṃtarjya niṣkāsitā gṛhādvalāt || 16.51{51} || pretā iva sadā bhikṣāṃ yācitveme'bhibhuṃjate | ityarhato yatī cāpi dṛṣṭvaiva te'bhyanindayan || 16.52{52} || etatkarmavipākaiste pretībhūtā vane'dhunā | kṣutpipāsāhatā nityaṃ vibhramyante'bhiduḥkhitāḥ || 16.53{53} || tattesāṃ tanmahatpāpamuktihetorihādhunā | saṃbuddhaśāsane dānaṃ kartumichāmyahaṃ khalu || 16.54{54} || mayaitaddakṣiṇādeśāstannāmnā kārayiṣyate | tadā tatpāpamuktāste sarve yāyurdivaṃ dhruvam || 16.55{55} || tadatra śraddhayā yūyaṃ yathāśakti mayārthitāḥ | saṃghabhojanasāmagriṃ sarve pradātumarhaya || 16.56{56} || saṃghabhojye pravṛtte'tra sarve te pretikā api | draṣṭuṃ samāgamiṣyanti yūyaṃ cāgaṃtumarhatha || 16.57{57} || ityuktvā prārthite tena maudgalyena dayālunā | śrutvā tajjātayaḥ sarve vismayāṃ samupāyayuḥ || 16.58{58} || tataste vismitāḥ sarve tatpretagatimuktaye | tatbhojyasāmagrīṃ śraddhayā dātumicchire || 16.59{59} || ke cittasmai suvarṇāni ke cidratnāni saṃdaduḥ | ke cidropyādi dhātūṃśca dravyāni vividhāni cā || 16.60{60} || taṇḍulāni daduḥ ke ciddadurdhānyāni ke cana | ke ciddaduḥ kalāyāṃśca godhūmāṃśca yavānapi || 16.61{61} || kulmāṣānmasurāṃścāpi māṣacanakasarṣapān | mudgāṃścāpi tathānyāṃśca sarvān vrīhin daduḥ pare || 16.62{62} || tilapriyaṃgusiddhārthān bhaṃgāśca rājikā api | mūlaśākakadamvāṃśca patrapuṣpāṃkurāṇi ca || 16.63{63} || śṛṅgaverātipakvāni phalāni vividhāni ca | surasāni supathyāni pradaduścāpare mudā || 16.64{64} || tiktāmlalavaṇādīni rasāni vividhāni ca | śunṭhīśca pippirīścāpi maricāni dadurmudā || 16.65{65} || hiṅguṃ ca jīrakāṃścānye viḍarkasaiṃdhavādi ca | anye ghṛtāni tailāni pradaduḥ śraddhayā mudā || 16.66{66} || śaktūṃśca piṣṭakāṃścānyamodakāṃśca dadurmudā | tathā dadhīni dugdhāni madhuni ca guḍāni ca || 16.67{67} || tathānye sarkarāścāpi pradaduḥ śraddhayā mudā | tathauṣadhāni pathyāni pācakāni daduḥ pare || 16.68{68} || lāṅgalīpūgatāmbūlaravaṃgādīni saṃdaduḥ | sarvapeyāni bhojyāni vividhānyapi | sarve te jñātayasteṣāṃ saṃghabhokṣyāya saṃdaduḥ || 16.69{69} || evaṃ te sarvavastūni datvā sarve pramoditāḥ | sāṃjalayaḥ praṇatvā taṃ maudgalyaṃ yatimūcire || 16.70{70} || bhadanto'nugrahaṃ kṛtvā saṃbuddhapramukhaṃ bhavān | sarvasaṃghaṃ samabhyarcya bhojayatu pratoṣayan || 16.71{71} || vayamapyāgamiṣyāmaḥ pravṛtte saṃghabhojane | tān pretān samupāyātān sarvān draṣṭuṃ sabāndhavāḥ || 16.72{72} || iti taiḥ prārthitaṃ śrutvā tatheti sa prabodhayan | tāni dravyāni sarvāṇi gṛhītvā svāśrame yayau || 16.73{73} || tataḥ sa bhikṣurāyuṣmān vihāre samupācaran | dṛṣṭvā taṃ śrīghanaṃ natvā sāñjaliḥ samupāśrayan || 16.74{73} || tatra sa bhagavān dṛṣṭvā taṃ maudgalyamupasthitam | prahasan suprasannāsyaḥ samāmaṃtryaitadabravīt || 16.75{74} || kaṃ citte kuśalaṃ vatsa kuto'trāsi samāgataḥ | lokeṣu kiṃ pravṛttāṃtaṃ tan pracakṣva mahāmate || 16.76{75} || ityādiṣṭe munīndreṇa sa maudgalyāyanaḥ sudhīḥ | bhagavantaṃ tamānatvā sāñjaliretadabravīt || 16.77{76} || bhagavan kṛpayā śāstaḥ sarvatra kauśalaṃ mama | rājagṛhe pure piṃḍaṃ yācituṃ samupācaran || 16.78{77} || tatra mārge vanopānte paṃca pretaśatānyapi | dṛṣṭvā māṃ samupasṛtya praṇatvaitadvadanti vai || 16.79{78} || bhadanta tadvijānīyā yadvayaṃ pretikā ime | sarve rājagṛhe jātā gṛhasthāḥ paurikāḥ khalu || 16.80{79} || tadā vayaṃ svayaṃ naṣṭā daśākuśalacāriṇaḥ | ete svadaivayogena pretībhūtāścarāmahe || 16.81{80} || tadbhavān kṛpayāsmākaṃ pretagativimuktaye | jñātīnāmapi sarveṣāṃ karmaplotiṃ nivedya hi || 16.82{81} || chandakabhikṣaṇaṃ kṛtvāpyasmannāmnā sasāṃghikam | bhagavantaṃ samabhyarcya bhojayituṃ samarhati || 16.83{82} || asmannāmnāya saṃbuddhaṃ sasaṃghaṃ namatāṃ bhavān | dakṣiṇādeśanāścāsmannāmnā deśayatumarhasi || 16.84{83} || tato nūnaṃ vayaṃ sarve pretagativimocitāḥ | nirmuktapāpakāḥ śuddhāḥ prāpnuyāma surālayam || 16.85{84} || ityasmatprārthanāṃ kṛtvā kṛpayāsmān samuddharan | bodhimārge pratisthāpya pātumarhati sarvadā || 16.86{85} || iti teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā tathā rājagṛhe gataḥ | tadjñātīnāṃ purasteṣāṃ pravṛttāṃtaṃ nivedya ca || 16.87{86} || chandakabhikṣaṇaṃ tebhyo yācitvāhamihācare | tathārcayitumichāmi bhagavantaṃ sasāṃghikam || 16.88{87} || iti me prārthanāṃ kṛtvā bhavāṃ chāstā jagadguruḥ | tadadhivāsanāṃ kṛtvā kṛpayā tān samuddhara || 16.89{88} || iti saṃprārthitaṃ tena bhagavān sa munīśvaraḥ | tatheti saṃpratiśrutya tūṣṇībhūtvādhyuvāsa tat || 16.90{89} || tato matvā sa maudgalyo bhagavato'dhivāsitam | sahasā bhojyasāmagrīṃ sapauraiḥ samasādhayat || 16.91{90} || tato'nye dyuḥ prabhātāyāṃ sarvasādhitasiddhite | sāñjalistaṃ munīndraṃ ca praṇatvaitatsamabravīt || 16.92{91} || bhagavan sarvasāmagrīṃ saṃsādhitaṃ susiddhyate | tatsarvasāṃghikaiḥ sārddhaṃ sahasāgaṃtumarhati || 16.93{92} || iti saṃprārthite tena bhagavāṃ sa munīśvaraḥ | bhikṣuṃ prāha samāhūya gaṇḍīmākoṭyatāmiti || 16.94{93} || tadādiṣṭaṃ munīndreṇa śrutvā bhikṣustatheti saḥ | āśrutya sahasādāya gaṇḍīmākoṭayattadā || 16.95{94} || tadgaṇḍīśabdamākarṇya sarve te sāṃghikā api | vihāre sahasāgatya bhagavantaṃ praṇemire || 16.96{95} || tataḥ sa bhagavāṃstatra svāsane samupāviśat | sarve te sāṃghikāścāpi kramātsvasvāsane'viśan || 16.97{96} || tatastadjñātayaḥ sarve tatrānye paurikā api | tān pretān draṣṭumāyātā upatasthuḥ sakautukāḥ || 16.98{97} || tadā te pretikāḥ sarve prakṣiptāḥ karmavāyubhiḥ | bahulokāntare dure yātāstasthurvimohitāḥ || 16.99{98} || tadā sa yatirālokya sarvasaṃghān samāsthitān | tadjñātibandhuvargāṃśca pretān draṣṭuṃ samācarat || 16.100{99} || tatra pretānadṛṣṭvā sa maudgalyo vismitāśayaḥ | kiṃ te'tra nāgatā veti samantato vyalokayat || 16.101{100} || vilokayan sa sarvatra nādrakṣīttāṃ samaṃtataḥ | sa saṃdigdhaḥ punastatra samyagdṛṣṭyā vyalokayat || 16.102{1} || sarvatrāpi sa tāṃ pretānadṛṣṭvā vismayānvitaḥ | sarvatra magadhe'paśyatsamyagdṛśā samāhitaḥ || 16.103{2} || tatrāpi ca sa sarvatra naiva kaṃ cidapaśyate | tato'tivismito'nyatra divyadṛśābhyalokayat || 16.104{3} || aṃgavaṃgakaliṃgeṣu saurāṣṭramagadheṣu ca | tatrāpi tānadṛṣṭvā sa narakeṣu samantataḥ | divyena cakṣuṣā paśyanna ca tatrāpyapaśyata || 16.105{4} || tataścaturmahārājabhuvaneṣu samantataḥ | sa divyacakṣuṣā paśyaṃstatrāpi nābhyapaśyata || 16.106{5} || tatrāpi tānadṛṣṭvā sa maudgalyo vismayānvitaḥ | devālayeṣu sarvatra krameṇa samalokayat || 16.107{6} || tatrāpi tāṃ samanteṣu sa maudgalyo'tivismitaḥ | tānadṛṣṭvātisaṃdigdho bhagavatāntike'carat || 16.108{7} || tatra sa purato gatvā śāstāraṃ taṃ munīśvaram | kṛtāñjalipuṭo natvā paprachaitatpravṛttitām || 16.109{8} || bhagavan sarvalokeṣu paśyatā divyacakṣusā | mayā na dṛśyate kaścitte pretāḥ kvādhunā gatāḥ || 16.110{9} || teṣāṃ nāmnā bhavatpūjāṃ karttumetatprasādhitam | yadatra nāgatāḥ kecittatte pretā gatāḥ kuha || 16.111{10} || dṛśyante na mayā kvāpi sarvatrāpi samīkṣyate | eko'pi nāgato hyatra kva gatāste'dhunā khalu || 16.112{11} || tanme cittaṃ prasaṃdigdhaṃ dṛṣṭvā śāstā bhavān sudṛk | teṣāṃ gatiṃ samākhyāya saṃbodhayitumarhati || 16.113{12} || iti saṃprārthite tena maudgalyena sa sarvavit | bhagavāṃstaṃ samālokya maudgalyametadabravīt || 16.114{13} || maudgalya mā kṛthā yatnaṃ khedamevābhipatsyase | gatāste pretikāḥ sarve sudūrabhuvane'dhunā || 16.115{14} || sarve te yatidevarṣipratyekasugatairapi | adṛśye viṣaye yātāḥ preritāḥ karmavāyubhiḥ || 16.116{15} || yadi sarvāṃ ca tāṃ draṣṭuṃ vāṃchasi tvamihāśritaḥ | sarvāṃstāṃ darśayiṣyāmi paśya buddhānubhāvatām || 16.117{16} || tadatra tvaṃ samādāya gaṇḍīmākoṭaya drutam | oṃ namo bhagavate aparimitāyurjñānasuviniścitatejorājāya tathāgatāyārhate samyakambuddhāya || tadyathā || oṃ puṇye puṇye mahāpuṇye aparimitapuṇye aparimitapuṇyajñānasaṃbhāropacite | oṃ sarvasaṃskārapariśuddhe dharmate gagaṇasamudgate svabhāvaviśuddhe mahānayaparivāre svāhā | aṣṭottaraśatākṣaryyānayāsaṃlabdhacetanāḥ || 16.118{17} || sarve te'trāgamiṣyanti gaṇḍīśabdābhināditāḥ | iti śāstrā samādiṣṭaṃ śrutvā sa pratibodhitaḥ || 16.119{18} || sahasā tatsabhāmadhye gaṇḍīmākoṭayattathā | tadgaṇḍīśabdamākarṇya sarve te pretikā api | pariśuddhāśayā draṣṭuṃ vihāre samupācaran || 16.120{19} || tatra sarve'pi te pretā dṛṣṭvā taṃ śrīghanaṃ mudā | tridhā pradakṣiṇīkṛtya sāñjalayaḥ praṇemire || 16.121{20} || kramāttāṃ sarvasaṃghāṃśca praṇatvā te pramoditāḥ | sarve'pyekāntamāśritya paśyanta upatasthire || 16.122{21} || tatra tadjñātayaḥ sarve paurikāścāpare'pi ca | tān pretān samupāsīnān dṛṣṭvā tasthuḥ sakautukāḥ || 16.123{22} || evaṃ sarve'pi te pretāḥ svasvajñātīnupasthitān | bhātrādīn bandhuvargāṃśca dṛṣṭvaivamupatasthire || 16.124{23} || tataḥ so'rhanmahābhijño maudgalyastānupasthitān | pretān sarvān samālokya natvāhaivaṃ munīśvaram || 16.125{24} || bhagavannātha sarvajña te pretāḥ sarva āgatāḥ | tadeṣāṃ bhagavāṃ cchāstānugrahaṃ karttumarhati || 16.126{25} || nivedyeti sa maudgalyaḥ saṃbuddhapramukhaṃ kramāt | sarvaṃ saṃghaṃ samabhyarcya bhojayan samatoṣayat || 16.127{26} || tataḥ sa sarvasaṃghaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃtṛptikaṃ mudā | apanīyāśu pātrāṇi hastādīn samaśodhayat || 16.128{27} || tataḥ khapurasūkṣmailātāmbūlādi rasāyanam | datvā kṣamārthanāṃ kṛtvā prārthayatsa munīśvaram || 16.129{28} || bhagavannātha sarvajña bhavāṃ chāstā sasāṃghikaḥ | dakṣiṇādeśanāmebhyaḥ pretebhyaḥ kartumarhati || 16.130{29} || iti saṃprārthitaṃ śrutvā sarve te pretikā mudā | sasaṃghaṃ taṃ muniṃ natvā sādaramupatasthire || 16.131{30} || tataḥ sa bhagavān dṛṣṭvā sasaṃghastānupasthitān | dakṣiṇādeśanāṃ tebhyaḥ sarvebhyo vidadhe śubhām || 16.132{31} || ito dānāddhi yatpuṇyaṃ tatpretānanugachatu | uttiṣṭhantaḥ prayāntyete sarve pretāḥ surālayam || 16.133{21} || ityādiśya punastatra bhagavāṃ sa munīśvaraḥ | āryyasatyaṃ samārabhyāparimitāyuṣastadā || 16.134{22} || dhāraṇyā guṇamāhātmyaṃ saddharmaṃ samupādiśat || 16.135{23} || saṃsāre mānuṣe janma durlabhaṃ bhavacāriṇām | mānuṣye labhyamāne'pi kṣaṇasaṃpatsudurlabhā || 16.136{24} || mānuṣye'labhyamāne hi jantūnāṃ sukhatā kutaḥ | duḥkhānyeva bhave nityaṃ puṇye matiḥ kathaṃ caret || 16.137{25} || vinā puṇyamatiṃ jantuḥ saddharme kathamācaret | vinā saddharmabhāvena sadgatiṃ kathamāpnuyāt || 16.138{26} || preteṣu sarvadā nityaṃ kṣutpipāsāvidāhitaḥ | tiryakṣu narakeṣveva bhraman duḥkhānyavāpnuyāt || 16.139{27} || tadatra mānuṣe janmaprāptairyatnena mānavaiḥ | satkṛtya śraddhayā nityaṃ śrotavyaṃ sadvṛṣaṃ mudā || 16.140{28} || saddharmaśrutamātreṇa mahatpuṇyamavāpnuyāt | etatpuṇyavipākena sadgurau sarvadā bhajet || 16.141{29} || sadgurorupadeśena saddharmeṣveva sadācaret | etatpuṇyavipākena sadgatiṃ sarvadā vrajet || 16.142{30} || tatra sukhāni saṃbhuktvā saṃcareta śubhe sadā || 16.143{31} || etaddharmānubhāvena mahatsamṛddhimāpnuyāt | mahatsamṛddhisaṃpatsu karttavyaṃ dānamarthiṣu || 16.144{32} || dānena varddhyate lakṣmīrlakṣmīmāṃ cchobhate pumān | sadbuddhiḥ sadguṇādhāro yaśobhāgyasukhānvitaḥ || 16.145{33} || tataḥ saugatadharmāṇi śrutvā nityaṃ prabodhitaḥ | triratnaśaraṇaṃ kṛtvā bhajedbhaktyā sadādarāt || 16.146{34} || etatpuṇyānubhāvena bodhicittaṃ samāpnuyāt | bodhicitte hi labdhe hi bodhisatvo bhavetkṛtī || 16.147{35} || tataḥ sa bodhicittena daśapāramitāḥ kramāt | paripūrya mahāsatvastrividhāṃ bodhimāpnuyāt || 16.148{36} || tato māragaṇāṃ jitvā pariśuddhastrimaṇḍalaḥ | ṝsākṣādarhatpadaṃ prāpya nirvṛtipadamāpnuyāt || 16.149{37} || evaṃ vijñāya martyena karttavyaṃ dānamarthine | dānena sadgatiṃ yāyādadātā durgatiṃ vrajet || 16.150{38} || durgatiṣu sadā bhuktvā duḥkhāni vividhāṃ sa | sarvadā duḥkhasaṃkliṣṭaḥ pāpeṣvevārataścaret || 16.151{39} || etatpāpavipākena daśasvakuśaleṣvapi | nirato hyaviśaṃkena saṃcareta pramādataḥ || 16.152{40} || tataḥ so hyatipāpiṣṭhaḥ saddharmanindakaḥ kudhīḥ | svayaṃ naṣṭaḥ parāṃścāpi nāśayennāstikaḥ śaṭhaḥ || 16.153{41} || tato'tipāpasaṃkliṣṭaḥ pratikṣipya jinānapi | ghoreṣu narakeṣveva gatvā bhraman sadā vaset || 16.154{42} || sadāpi narakeṣvevaṃ bhramatastasya duḥkhinaḥ | kaścinnaiva samuddhartuṃ śaknuyātsaugatādṛte || 16.155{43} || yāvanna smarate buddhaṃ tāvatsa narake vaset | yadeva smarate buddhaṃ tadā syācchuddhitāśayaḥ || 16.156{44} || tadā taṃ kṛpayā buddho dṛṣṭvā bauddhena cakṣuṣā | puṇyakareṇa saṃspṛṣṭvā samuddharedaraṃ tataḥ || 16.157{45} || tatastaṃ pāpinaṃ bauddhā dharmāmbubhirviśodhya ca | krameṇa bodhimārgeṣu niyojayetprabodhayan || 16.158{46} || tataḥ sa pariśuddhātmā saṃbuddhaśāsane rataḥ | triratnaśaraṇaṃ kṛtvā saddharma eva prācaret || 16.159{47} || tataḥ satvahitārthe sa bodhicaryāsamudyataḥ | kramātpāramitāḥ sarvā pūrayituṃ samudyamet || 16.160{48} || tataḥ pāramitāḥ sarvāḥ pūrayitvā samāhitaḥ | bodhisatvo mahāsatvo buddhātmajo bhavedapi || 16.161{49} || tataḥ kleśagaṇāñjitvā pariśuddhatrimaṃḍalaḥ | trividhāṃ bodhimāsādya nirvṛtipadamāpnuyāt || 16.162{50} || evaṃ matvā sadā nityaṃ triratnaśaraṇaṃ gatāḥ | saddharmaṃ samupāśritya caradhvaṃ mānavā mudā || 16.163{51} || ityādiṣṭaṃ munīndreṇa śrutvā te brāhmaṇādayaḥ | sarve lokā parijñāya dṛṣṭasatyāstathācaran || 16.164{52} || tathā sarve'pi te pretāḥ śrutvā taddharmadeśanām | mudā taṃ śrīghanaṃ natvā śuddhātmānastato'caran || 16.165{53} || tatastadjñātayaḥ sarve dṛṣṭvā śrutvā sakautukāḥ | sasaṃghaṃ taṃ muniṃ natvā svasvālayaṃ yayurmudā || 16.166{54} || tataḥ sa bhagavān buddhaḥ samutthāya saṣāṃghikaḥ | dhyānālayaṃ samāśritya tasthau dhyānasamāhitaḥ || 16.167{55} || sa maudgalyāyanaścāpi kṛtakṛtyaḥ pramoditaḥ | śāstāraṃ taṃ praṇatvaivaṃ svamāśramaṃ samāśrayat || 16.168{56} || tadā sarve'pi te pretāḥ saṃbuddhe'bhiprasāditāḥ | triratnasmaraṇaṃ kṛtvā tataścyutā divaṃ yayuḥ || 16.169{57} || tatrotpannā hi te sarve mahatsaukhyasamanvitāḥ | pariśuddhasubhadrāṅgā vismitā etadabruvan || 16.170{58} || aho'smākaṃ mahatsaukhyaṃ kimevaṃ jāyate'dhunā | kutaścyutāḥ kuhāyāmaḥ karmaṇā kena vā vayam || 16.171{59} || atha buddhānubhāvena sarve te pretapūrvakāḥ | devaputrā anusmṛtvā prabodhitāḥ samabruvan || 16.172{60} || bhavanto yadvayaṃ sarve pretā buddhānubhāvataḥ | maudgalyasyārhato bhikṣoḥ kṛpādṛṣṭiprayatnataḥ || 16.173{61} || saṃbuddhadarśanaprāptāstriratnaśaraṇaṃ gatāḥ | etatpuṇyaparispṛṣṭāḥ pariśuddhatrikāyikāḥ || 16.174{62} || tataḥ pretagateścyutvā svargaloke samāgatāḥ | mahaddivyasukhānyevamatra labhāmahe'dhunā || 16.175{63} || etatsatyaṃ parijñāya tasya śāsturjagadguroḥ | punaḥ sarve vayaṃ gatvā satkṛtya prabhajemahi || 16.176{64} || iti saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā sarve te pretapūrvakāḥ | devaputrāḥ śubhāmbhobhiḥ snātvā divyāmvarāvṛtāḥ || 16.177{65} || divyasugaṃdhaliptāṅgā divyālaṃkārabhūṣitāḥ | divyapūjopacārāṇi gṛhītvā mahadutsavaiḥ | sarvaṃ veṇuvanaṃ bhābhiravabhāsya samantataḥ || 16.178{66} || vihāre samupāsṛtya dṛṣṭvā taṃ śrīghanaṃ mudā | natvā pradakṣiṇīkṛtvā praharṣitā upācaran || 16.179{67} || tatra divyopacāraistaiḥ pūjāṃgaistaṃ munīśvaram | sarve'pi te samabhyarcya satkṛtya śraddhayābhajan || 16.180{68} || tatra caikāntamāśritya saddharmmaśravaṇotsukāḥ | kṛtāñjalipuṭāḥ sarve upatasthuḥ samāhitāḥ || 16.181{69} || atha sa bhagavān dṛṣṭvā tān sarvān samupasthitān | āryasatyaṃ samārabhaḥ saddharmaṃ samupādiśat || 16.182{70} || tatsaddharmāmṛtaṃ pītvā sarve te pretapūrvakāḥ | devaputrāśca dharmāṇāṃ viśeṣatvaṃ pralebhire || 16.183{71} || tataste muditāḥ sarve saṃbodhipadavāṃchinaḥ | śāstāraṃ taṃ punarnatvā samālokyaitadabruvan || 16.184{72} || bhagavan yadvayaṃ sarve vimuktakarmabaṃdhanāḥ | pretalokātparicyutvā svarge yātāḥ sma sāṃpratam || 16.185{73} || divyasukhāni sāmbhuktvā devaiḥ saha pramoditāḥ | saddharmaguṇamākarṇya carāmahe sadādhunā || 16.186{74} || tatkṛpālo yatastasya maudgalyasya mahāmateḥ | kṛpadṛṣṭiprasādena nūnaṃ manyāmahe vayam || 16.187{75} || tadbhavaddarśanaṃ prāpya pītvā dharmāmṛtānyapi | muditāḥ śraddhayā bhaktyā triratnaṃ saṃbhajāmahe || 16.188{76} || etatpuṇyaiḥ parītāṅgāḥ pariśuddhāśayā mudā | bhavatāṃ darśanaṃ kartuṃ bhūyaḥ prāyāmahe vayam || 16.189{77} || tathā ca bhavatāṃ śāstaḥ kṛpādṛṣṭiprasādataḥ | āryadharmāmṛtaṃ pītvā saṃtuṣṭiṃ na labhāmahe || 16.190{78} || tadvayaṃ bhavatāmevaṃ sarvadā śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ | satkṛtya samupāsṛtya bhaktumichāmahe punaḥ || 16.191{79} || tadbhavān kṛpayāsmā kaṃ kṛtvānugrahamābhavam | saddharmaṃ samupādiśya sarvadā trātumarhati || 16.192{80} || bhavatāṃ kṛpayāsmābhi duḥkhābdhiḥ parilaṃghitaḥ | satkāyadṛṣṭiśailaṃ ca jñānavajreṇa bhidyate || 16.193{81} || jñānacakṣuśca saṃprāptaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ māyāmayaṃ bhavam | āryamārgaśca saṃprāptaḥ prāptā ca nirvṛtiśrutiḥ || 16.194{82} || dhanyā ime vayaṃ sarve yadbhavaccharaṇaṃ gatāḥ | āryadharmāmṛtaṃ pītvā mahānandaṃ labhāmahe || 16.195{83} || dhanyāste puruṣāḥ sarve ye buddhaśaraṇaṃ gatāḥ | sadā dharmāmṛtaṃ pītvā kārāṃ kurvanti śāsane || 16.196{84} || evaṃ bhavāṃ jagacchāstā sarvasatvānukampayā | saddharmaṃ samupādiśya tiṣṭhatu sarvadā sukham || 16.197{85} || iti prabhākhya sarve te devaputrāḥ pramoditāḥ | taṃ munīndraṃ praṇatvā ca suprasannā divaṃ yayuḥ || 16.198{86} || tatra sarve'pi te devāstriratnaśaraṇaṃ gatāḥ | prabhejire sadā smṛtvā saṃbodhipadavāṃchinaḥ || 16.199{87} || tataḥ prātaḥ samutthāya bhagavān so'numoditaḥ | taṃ maudgalyāyanaṃ śiṣyaṃ samāmaṃtryaivamabravīt || 16.200{88} || sādhu maudgalya saṃvṛttaṃ saphalaṃ te kṛpāmate | yattvayā prakṛtaṃ kāyaṃ vaiyāvṛttaṃ suśobhitam || 16.201{89} || yannāmnā bhikṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā buddhapūjā kṛtā tvayā | te sarve devalokeṣu samutpannāḥ pratisthitāḥ || 16.202{90} || te sarve'dya niśāyāṃ matsakāśaṃ samupagatāḥ | teṣāṃ bhadrāśayaṃ dṛṣṭvā saddharmo deśito mayā || 16.203{91} || tatsaddharmāmṛtaṃ pītvā te sarve'pi pramoditāḥ | dṛṣṭasatyāḥ prakrāntāśca gachanti tridaśālaye || 16.204{92} || tatra svarge'pi te sarve triratnaśaraṇaṃ gatāḥ | prabhajanti sadā nityaṃ saṃbodhiguṇavāṃchinaḥ || 16.205{93} || yannāmnā yatkṛtaṃ karma tatphalaṃ te prabhuṃjate | evaṃ lokahitaṃ kartuṃ karttavyaṃ puṇyasādhanam || 16.206{94} || evaṃ lokahitaṃ kṛtvā prakurvanti śubhāni ye | te pumāṃso mahāsatvā bodhisatvā jinātmajāḥ || 16.207{95} || evaṃ vijñāya lokānāṃ hitaṃ kartuṃ samudyataḥ | saddharmasādhaneṣveva caritavyaṃ samāhitaḥ || 16.208{96} || iti śāstrā samādiṣṭaṃ śrutvā so'rhaṃ mahāmatiḥ | satyamiti pratijñāya prābhyanandatprabodhitaḥ || 16.209{97} || tataḥ so'rhanmahābhijñastacchāstrādiṣṭamādarāt | tadjñātīnāṃ purogatvā sarvamevaṃ nyavedayat || 16.210{98} || te'pi ca jñātayaḥ sarve tenārhatā niveditam | śrutvā satyamiti jñātvā prāmodyaṃ pratilebhire || 16.211{99} || tataste jñātayaḥ sarve triratnaśaraṇaṃ gatāḥ | satkṛtya śraddhayā nityaṃ prabhejire samādarāt || 16.212{100} || iti me guruṇādiṣṭaṃ śrutaṃ mayā narādhipa | lokaprabodhanārthena tava prītyā prakathyate || 16.213{1} || evaṃ vijñāya rājendra pretānāṃ śubhasādhanam | triratnabhajanaṃ lokaiḥ kārayituṃ tvamarhasi || 16.214{2} || tathā te maṃgalaṃ nityaṃ bhavennūnaṃ samaṃtataḥ | sarvasatvahitodbhutaṃ mahatpuṇyaṃ hi satphalam || 16.215{3} || iti matvā mahārāja lokān sarvān prabodhayan | pratiṣṭhāpya śubhe dharme pālayasva samāhitaḥ || 16.216{4} || iti śāstrā samādiṣṭaṃ śrutvāśokaḥ sa bhūpatiḥ | tatheti pratimoditvā prābhyanandatsapārṣadaḥ || 16.217{5} || pretāvadānaṃ manujā idaṃ ye śṛṇvanti ye cāpi niśāmayanti | te sarva evaṃ pratilabdhapuṇyā bhuktvā sukhāni pracaranti loke || 16.218{6} || iti ratnāva dānatatve pretikāvadānaṃ samāptam kacaṃgalāvadāna athāśoko mahārājaḥ pramoditaḥ | upaguptaṃ yatiṃ natvā punarevamabhāṣata || 17.1{1} || bhadanta śrotumicchāmi punaranyatsubhāṣitam | tadyathā guruṇādiṣṭaṃ tathādeṣṭuṃ ca me'rhati || 17.2{2} || iti saṃprārthitaṃ rājñā śrutvā so'rhan yatiḥ sudhīḥ | upagupto nareṃdrāṃ taṃ samalokyaivamādiśat || 17.3{3} || sādhu śṛṇu mahārāja yathā me guruṇoditam | tathāhaṃ te pravakṣyāmi śrutvā cāpyanumodaya || 17.4{4} || puraikasamaye buddhaḥ sākyasiṃho munīśvaraḥ | sarvajñaḥ sugataḥ sāstā dharmarājo vināyakaḥ || 17.5{5} || śrāvastyā nikaṭe'raṇye jetāśrame śubhālaye | vihāre śrāvakaiḥ sārddhaṃ bhikṣubhiścailakairapi || 17.6{6} || bhikṣuṇībhiḥ suśilābhirupāsikāgaṇairapi | upāsakaistathānyaiśca triratnaśaraṇāgataiḥ || 17.7{7} || bodhisatvagaṇaiścāpi satvoddharaṇatatparaiḥ | vijahāra jagallokaṃ dharmāṃśubhiḥ prabhāsayan || 17.8{8} || tatsaddharmāmṛtaṃ pātuṃ sarve lokāḥ samāgatāḥ | śakrādayaḥ suparvāṇabrahmādi lokapālakāḥ || 17.9{9} || daityā nāgāśca gaṃdharvā yakṣakinnararākṣasāḥ | garuḍā vidyādharāścāpi sarve te saṃpracerire || 17.10{10} || tataḥ sarve'pi te tatra puraskṛtya samantataḥ | parivṛtya sasaṃghaṃ tamupatasthuḥ samāhitāḥ || 17.11{11} || tadā sa bhagavān dṛṣṭvā tān sarvān samupasthitān | ādimadhyāntakalyāṇaṃ dideśa dharmamuttamam || 17.12{12} || tatsaddharmāmṛtaṃ pītvā sarve te saṃpramoditāḥ | dharmaviśeṣamājñāya prābhyanandañchūbhāśayāḥ || 17.13{13} || tasminnavasare tatra vṛddhārāmodakārthinī | kacaṅgalābhidhā kumbhaṃ dhṛtvā kūpāntike'carat || 17.14{14} || tatra tāṃ bhagavān dṛṣṭvā matvā janmāntaraprasūm | ānaṃdaṃ samupāmaṃtrya pura evamabhāṣata || 17.15{15} || gachānaṃda tvametasyāṃ vṛddhāyāṃ prārthayāmṛtam | bhagavāṃstṛṣito mātastadambu dīyatāmiti || 17.16{16} || etadbhagavatādiṣṭaṃ śrutvānaṃdastatheti saḥ | sahasā samupāśritya tāṃ vṛddhāmevamabravīt || 17.17{17} || mātarme bhagavāñchāstā tṛṣito'yamihādhunā | tatpānīyaṃ pradatvā me mahaddharmamavāpnuhi || 17.18{18} || iti saṃprārthitaṃ tena śrutvā sā sthavirā satī | tamānandaṃ samālokya muditaivamabhāṣata || 17.19{19} || bhadanta sādhu tatrāhamamṛtapūritaṃ ghaṭam | svayameva samānīya dāsyāmi vrajatāṃ bhavān || 17.20{20} || iti tayoditaṃ śrutvā sa ānaṃdaḥ prabodhitaḥ | upetyaivaṃ samākhyāya śāstuḥ pura upāśrayat || 17.21{21} || tadā sā sahasā kṛtvā ghaṭaṃ śuddhāmbupūritam | svayameva samādāya tatrābhisaṃmukhācarat || 17.22{22} || tatra sā samupāśritya prādrākṣīttaṃ munīśvaram | dvātriṃśallakṣaṇāśītivyaṃjanapratimaṇḍitam || 17.23{23} || vyāmaprabhābhibhāsvaṃtaṃ śatasūryādhikaprabham | jaṃgamamiva ratnābhaṃ saumyaṃ samantabhadrakam || 17.24{24} || saha taddarśaṇāttatra putrasnehasamudbhavāḥ | stanābhyāṃ praśrutāstasyāḥ kṣīradhārā niraṃtaram || 17.25{25} || tato dharmānubhāvena smṛtvā pūrvabhavātmajam | putra putreti soktvā taṃ pariṣvektumupācarat || 17.26{26} || tadā te bhikṣavaḥ sarve evaṃ tāṃ samupadrutām | dṛṣṭvaiva sahasotthāya pradhārayitumārabhan || 17.27{27} || taddṛṣṭvā bhagavāṃ chastā sarvāṃstāṃ sāṃghikānapi | sahasā samupāmaṃtrya punarevaṃ samādiśat || 17.28{28} || mā bhikṣava imāṃ vṛddhāṃ dhārāyatātra muñcata | paṃcajanmaśatānyeṣā mātā me bhūyataḥ purā || 17.29{29} || tatpūrvajanmamāteyaṃ putrasnehānubhāvinī | samāliṃgatumīchantī mama gātre pradhāvati || 17.30{30} || yadyatraiṣā nivāryyete gātra me śleṣmaṇādapi | idānīṃ rudhiraṃ hyuṣṇaṃ kamṭhādasyāḥ kṣaretkṣaṇāt || 17.31{31} || kṛtajñatāmanusmṛtvā dṛṣṭvemāṃ putralālasām | kāruṇyādgātrasaṃśleṣaṃ dadāmyatrānukaṃpayā || 17.32{32} || iti śāstrā samādiṣṭaṃ śrutvā te sarvasāṃghikāḥ | tāṃ śāstuḥ pūrvaprasūṃ matvā vyavatasthuḥ savismayāḥ || 17.33{33} || tatkṣaṇādurddhavāhuḥ sā samīkṣya taṃ munīśvaram | sahasā saṃpradhāvitvā samāliṃgya namacciram || 17.34{34} || tataścirātsamutthāya sā vṛddhā sāñjalirmudā | śrīghanaṃ taṃ samālokya purastasthau samāhitā || 17.35{35} || tadā sa bhagavān dṛṣṭvā tāṃ puraḥ samupāsthitām | āryyasatyaṃ samārabhya saddharmaṃ samupādiśat || 17.36{36} || tatsaddharmāmṛtaṃ pītvā sa vṛddhāpi kacaṃgalā | pariśuddhāśayā bhadrā bodhicaryā prabodhitā || 17.37{37} || satkāyadṛṣṭibhūmīdhraṃ viṃśatiśikharodgatam | nirbhidya jñānavajreṇa dṛṣṭasatyaprabodhitā || 17.38{38} || saṃprāpya śrotaāpattiphalaṃ sākṣatkṛtodyamā | sāṃjalistaṃ muniṃ natvā gāthā imā abhāṣata || 17.39{39} || yatkarttavyaṃ svaputreṇa māturduṣkarakāriṇā | tatkṛtaṃ bhavatā me'tra cittaṃ mokṣaparāyaṇam || 17.40{40} || durgatibhyaḥ samuddhṛtya svarge mokṣaṃ ca sāṃpratam | sthāpito'haṃ prayatnena viśeṣasaṃprabodhane || 17.41{41} || tathā me'nugrahaṃ kṛtvā saṃbodhipadasādhanam | pravrajyāsaṃvaraṃ dātumarhati sāṃprataṃ bhavān || 17.42{42} || bhavatāṃ śaraṇaṃ kṛtvā triratnabhajanodyatā | pravrajyāsaṃvaraṃ dhṛtvā cariṣye brahmacārikām || 17.43{43} || ityarthitaṃ tayā śrutvā bhagavān sa munīśvaraḥ | tasyāścittaviśuddhatvaṃ matvaivaṃ samupādiśat || 17.44{43!} || yadi śraddhāsti te mātaḥ pravrajyāsadhane khalu | bhartturanujñāṃ samāsādya prāgacha cara saṃvaram || 17.45{44} || ityādiṣṭaṃ munīndreṇa śrutvā sā saṃpramoditā | tathā hīti pratijñāya muniṃ natvā tato'carat || 17.46{45} || tatra sā sahasā gehe gatvā taṃ svāminaṃ mudā | kṛtāṃjalipuṭo natvā puraḥ sthitvaivamabravīt || 17.47{46} || svāmi cchṛṇvadbhutaṃ vakṣye yadadyāhaṃ jalārthinī | ghaṭaṃ dhṛtvā vahirdeśe kūpāntikamupācare || 17.48{47} || tatra māṃ samupāyātāṃ dṛṣṭvānando mahāyatiḥ | sahasā samupāśritya bhagavate'mbu yācate || 17.49{48} || tato'haṃ sahasā śuddhaiḥ pūrayitvā jalairghaṭam | dhṛtvā svayaṃ pradātuṃ tatsabhāyāmupasaṃcare || 17.50{49} || tatra taṃ śrīghanaṃ dṛṣṭvā cittaṃ me snehamohitam | kṣāradhārā stanābhyāṃ ca saṃpraśrutā niraṃtaram || 17.51{50} || tatrāhaṃ sneharāgāṃdhā svātmajamiva taṃ munim | ūrddhavāhuḥ pariṣvaktuṃ pradhāvāmi bhavāntare || 17.52{51} || evaṃ māmabhidhāvantīṃ dṛṣṭvā te sāṃghikā api | sarve pradhātumichantaḥ pradhāvanti samutthitāḥ || 17.53{52} || tadā sa bhagavān dṛṣṭvā tān sarvānevamutthitān | sahasā samupāmaṃtrya pura evaṃ samādiśat || 17.54{53} || mā imāṃ sarvathā yūyaṃ nivārayitumarhatha | yanmameyaṃ puṇyaṃ ca śatajanmaprasū kila || 17.55{54} || tadatra māṃ samālokya svātmajasneharāgiṇī | pariṣvaktuṃ samīchantī pradhāvatīyamunmukhī || 17.56{55} || yadyatreṣātra dhāryyeta purato me vimūrchitā | uṣṇaṃ rudhiramutsṛjya mṛtyuṃ yāyānna saṃśayaḥ || 17.57{56} || etacchāstrā samādiṣṭaṃ śrutvā te sāṃghikāstathā | prabodhitāḥ praṇatvā māṃ svasvāsane samāśritāḥ || 17.58{57} || evaṃ tena munīndreṇa samākhyātaṃ niśamya tat | sarvaṃ prabudhyamānāhaṃ purāvṛttaṃ smarāmi hi || 17.59{58} || tato'haṃ vismayākrāṃtahṛdayātyabhinaṃditā | tatsaddharmāmṛtaṃ pātumupatiṣṭhāmi sādaram || 17.60{59} || tatra sa bhagavān dṛṣṭvā māmevaṃ samupasthitām | āryasatyaṃ samārabhya samādiśati sadvṛṣam || 17.61{60} || tatsaddharmāmṛtaṃ pītvā mano me'tipramodite | bhūyo'pi tadrasāsvādatṛṣitaṃ pātumichate || 17.62{61} || sarve te sāṃghikāstatra saddharmāmṛtatṛptitāḥ | śuddhātmānaḥ subhadrāṃgāḥ pariśuddhāstrimaṃḍalāḥ || 17.63{62} || śuddhaśīlāḥ śubhācārā dayākāruṇyabhāvinaḥ | sarvasattvahitādhānāḥ saṃsāralābhanispṛhāḥ || 17.64{63} || samādhidhāraṇīvidyā ghaṭamānāḥ samāhitāḥ | sākṣādarhatpadaprāptā nirvikalpā niraṃjanāḥ || 17.65{64} || saṃbuddhaśaraṇaṃ kṛtvā saṃbodhisādhanodyatāḥ | vihāre samupāsīnāḥ pradṛśyante mayā prabho || 17.66{65} || tatsabhāgaṃ cariṃ prāptuṃ pravrajyāvratamichyate | tadatra kṛpayā bharttastadanujñāṃ pradehi me || 17.67{66} || iti bhāryāsamākhyātaṃ śrutvā so'tidaridritaḥ | sāścaryastambhitastasthau paśyaṃstāmeva niścalaḥ || 17.68{67} || tataḥ sa suciraṃ bhāryāṃ tāmevamabhilokayan | viyogaśaṃkayā trastaḥ śanairevamabhāṣata || 17.69{68} || are nāri pramūdhāsi kimevaṃ tvaṃ prabhāṣase | kathamevaṃ tvayākhyātaṃ ko'tra satyaṃ pratīṣyati || 17.70{69} || yadasau bhagavān buddhaścakravarttinṛpātmajaḥ | sarvatraidhātukādhīśo dharmarājo vināyakaḥ || 17.71{70} || jagacchāstā jagannāthaḥ sarvajñaḥ sugato jinaḥ | munīndro mārajidarhan ṣaḍabhijñastathāgataḥ || 17.72{71} || bodhisatvo mahāsatvaḥ samaṃtabhadrarūpakaḥ | daśabalo maheśākhyo brahmacārī jitendriyaḥ || 17.73{72} || subrahmāmaradaityādilokānāṃ sarvadehinām | śaraṇyo mānanīyo hi vandyaḥ pūjyo bhavatyapi || 17.74{73} || tvamevaṃ durbhagā nārī daridratātiduḥkhinī | dāsī paravatī preṣyā kṛpaṇā duḥkṛtākṛtiḥ || 17.75{74} || kathamevaṃvidhāyāste garbhe jāto'pyasau mahān | bodhicittaṃ samāsādya prācaradbodhicārikām || 17.76{75} || yataḥ puṇyavipākena pūrya pāramitāḥ kramāt | adhunā bodhimāsādya saṃbuddho'yaṃ bhavatyapi || 17.77{76} || etatpuṇyavibhāgena kathaṃ te īdṛśī gatiḥ | adyāpīdṛgavasthā hi kiṃ citsaukhyaṃ na vidyate || 17.78{77} || tadatra mā vadaivaṃ ca tathoktvā naiva śobhase | kastavaitadvacaḥ śrutvā supratītaḥ pramāṇayet || 17.79{78} || dhikpravādāgnidagdhāṅgā mahatkaṣṭābhikhedītā | vamitvā rudhiraṃ hyuṣṇaṃ tvaṃ nūnaṃ maraṇaṃ vrajeḥ || 17.80{79} || mithyāvādābhisaṃkalpādapi hi narake vrajet | tvamapi ca tathā nūnaṃ narake na vrajeḥ katham || 17.81{80} || narakeṣu sadā nityaṃ duḥkhāni vividhāni vai | bhuktvātivedanākrāntā suciraṃ sthāsyase dhruvam || 17.82{81} || iti bharttroditaṃ śrutvā sā vṛddhā strī kacaṃgalā | vibhinnahṛdayā tasthau tannirāśābhimohitā || 17.83{82} || tadā sā sucireṇaiva saṃprāpya cetanāṃ tataḥ | bharttāraṃ taṃ punardṛṣṭvā bodhayitumabhāṣata || 17.84{83} || svāminnatra prasīda tvaṃ māmevaṃ vada sarvathā | satyametanmayā proktaṃ na mithyeti prakalpaya || 17.85{84} || yadi mithyāvacaḥ syānme tenāhaṃ narake vraje | atha me vacanaṃ satyamatrāhaṃ sadgatiṃ vraje || 17.86{85} || tenātrobhayathāpyeva viyogaṃ nau bhavetkhalu | sarveṣāmapi jaṃtūnāmavaśyaṃ maraṇaṃ bhave || 17.87{86} || kimevaṃ jīvitenāpi kevalaṃ duḥkhabhāginā | yatra na vidyate dharmmaṃ tatra kiṃ sukhatāpi ca || 17.88{87} || dharmārthameva saṃsāre janmadehārthasādhanam | dharmaṃ vinā kimetairnaḥ kevalaṃ duḥkhatāptaye || 17.89{88} || iti matvā mahānto'pi śrīmanto'pi vicakṣaṇāḥ | sarvān parigrahān tyaktvā pravrajanti jināśrame || 17.90{89} || tathātrāhaṃ parijñāya saṃbuddhaśaraṇaṃ gatā | saddharmasādhanaṃ karttumichāmi sāṃprataṃ prabho || 17.91{90} || tatpravrajyāvratānujñāṃ pradātuṃ me samarhasi | etatpuṇyavibhāgena tvaṃ cāpi sadgatiṃ vrajeḥ || 17.92{91} || yadi na dīyate'nujñā pravrajyāvratasādhane | akasmātmṛtyunāghrāte tadā kathaṃ nivāraye || 17.93{92} || kiyatkālaṃ ca jīveyaṃ vṛddhāhaṃ jirṇitendriyā | iti matvātra māṃ naivaṃ nivārayitumarhasi || 17.94{93} || kiṃ cāhaṃ jaratī vṛddhā tatte kiṃ snehatā mayi | vṛddhayā durbalāṅgātra kārye kiṃ nu prayojanam || 17.95{94} || tvaṃ cāpi jarayākrānto vṛddho'si durbalendriyaḥ | tatkiṃ te sneharāgeṇa vṛddhāyā mayi sāṃpratam || 17.96{95} || adyāpi kiṃ sukhāśā nau jarākrāntaśarīrayoḥ | avaśyaṃ mṛtyuratrāvāṃ samākramya grasiṣyati || 17.97{96} || tadāhaṃ kiṃ kariṣyāmi tvaṃ cāpi kiṃ kariṣyasi | śocitveva niṣatsyāmi tvamapyevaṃ niṣatsyasi || 17.98{97} || avaśyamatra saṃsāre bhāvi bhāvā phalantyapi | kasyāpi bhūyate nātra bhāvi bhāvānyathā kvacit || 17.99{98} || svakṛtakarma evātra gṛhītvā sarvajaṃtavaḥ | yātā yānti ca yāsyaṃti dehaṃ tyaktvā yamālayam || 17.100{99} || tatra yamājñayā sarve svakṛtakarmabhāginaḥ | dharmiṇaḥ sadgatiṃ yātāḥ pāpino durgatiṃ gatāḥ || 17.101{100} || evaṃ sarve ime satvāḥ svadaivaphalabhoginaḥ | sasukhāni ca duḥkhāni bhuktvā bhramanti sarvadā || 17.102{1} || evaṃ svāmin parijñāya sarvadā sukhavāṃchibhiḥ | dharmamevātra saṃsāre karttavyaṃ yatnataḥ sadā || 17.103{2} || dharman tu pravaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ saugatasaṃvarodbhavam | iti buddhaiḥ samākhyātaṃ tvayāpyetacchrutaṃ na kim || 17.104{3} || tasmādahaṃ munīndrasya śāsane śaraṇaṃ gataḥ | pravrajyāsaṃvaraṃ dharttumichāmi sāṃprataṃ prabho || 17.105{4} || etatpuṇyavipākena pariśuddhāstrimaṇḍalāḥ | sākṣādarhatpadaṃ prāpya nirvṛtipadamāpnuyām || 17.106{5} || etaddharmavibhāgena tvaṃ cāpi sadgatiṃ vrajeḥ | iti matvā tathā svāmiṃstadanujñāṃ dadātu me || 17.107{6} || tvamatra svagṛhe sthitvā triratnaśaraṇaṃ gataḥ | yāvajjīvaṃ sukhaṃ bhuktvā śubhe cara sadādarāt || 17.108{7} || etatpuṇyavipākena tvaṃ cāpyevaṃ sudhīrbhaveḥ | tataste saugate dharme vāṃchā jāyeta cetasi || 17.109{8} || tatastvaṃ śraddhayā gatvā saṃbuddhaśāsane svayam | pravrajyāsaṃvaraṃ prāpya sākṣādarhatvamāpnuyāḥ || 17.110{9} || iti matvā bhavān svāmin saddharmaṃ yadi vāñchati | tatpravrajyāvratānujñāṃ mahyaṃ pradātumarhati || 17.111{10} || iti tayoditaṃ śrutvā sa daridraḥ prabodhitaḥ | tāṃ bhāryāṃ suciraṃ dṛṣṭvā śanairevamabhāṣata || 17.112{11} || hā priye kathameva tvaṃ māṃ vihātuṃ samichasi | kimatrāhaṃ vadiṣyāmi tvayaivaṃ pratibhāṣate || 17.113{12} || yadi te'sti mano dhairyyaṃ kṛtvā śraddhānvitāśrayā | pravraja saṃvaraṃ dhṛtvā cara satyasamāhitā || 17.114{13} || iti bhartroditaṃ śrutvā sā vṛddhāpi kacaṃgalā | bharttāraṃ taṃ praṇatvaivaṃ tato'caratpramoditā || 17.115{14} || tataḥ sā sahasā gatvā tatrāśrame upāgatā | śrīghanaṃ taṃ samālokya purataḥ samupācarat || 17.116{15} || tatra tatpurato gatvā sāñjaliḥ sā pramoditā | munīndraṃ taṃ praṇatvaivaṃ pravrajyāṃ samayācata || 17.117{16} || bhagavannātha sarvajña bhavatāṃ śaraṇaṃ vraje | tadbhavāṃ kṛtvā kṛpayā mahyaṃ pravrajyāṃ dātumarhati || 17.118{17} || tayeti prārthitaṃ śrutvā bhagavān sa munīśvaraḥ | savyena pāṇinā tasyā vṛddhāyāḥ śirasi spṛśan || 17.119{18} || ehi mataścara brahmacārikāṃ tvaṃ samāhitā | ityuktvā tāṃ samāgṛhya sāṃghike punarabravīt || 17.120{19} || gacha māta prajāpatyā gautamyāḥ śaraṇaṃ vraja | sārhantī bhikṣuṇīmātā pravrajyāṃ te pradāsyati || 17.121{20} || ityādiṣṭaṃ munīndreṇa śrutvā sā pratinaṃditā | tathetyāśrutya śāstāraṃ taṃ praṇatvā tato'carat || 17.122{21} || tatra sā samupāsṛtya dṛṣṭvā tāṃ gautamīṃ mudā | upetya sāṃjalirnatvā pravrajyāṃ samayācata || 17.123{22} || mātaratra samāyāmi bhavatyāḥ śaraṇaṃ mudā | tadbhavantī jaganmātā pravrajyāṃ pradadātu me || 17.124{23} || tayeti prārthitaṃ śrutvā gautamī sānumoditā | hastena śirasi spṛṣṭvā sāṃghikatāṃ samagrahīt || 17.125{24} || tatra sāśu prajāpatyāṃ pravrajitā yathāvidhiḥ | muṇḍitā khikkhirīpātrahastā kākhāyacīvarā || 17.126{25} || saumyendriyā subhadraṃgā vṛddhāpi sā kacaṃgalā | bhikṣuṇīgaṇamadhyasthā śāntarūpātyaśobhata || 17.127{26} || tataḥ sā bhikṣuṇī śāstu gautamyāśca prasādataḥ | samādhidhāraṇīvidyādhyayanābhisamudyatā || 17.128{27} || hitvāvidyāgaṇaṃ prāptavidyābhijñāviśāradā | pratisaṃvidguṇādyāgu pariśuddhākṛtirvabhau || 17.129{30!} || atha sā parivijñāya bhavacakraṃ calācalam | viditvā saṃskāragatīścābhivighātinīstataḥ || 17.130{31} || sarvakleśagaṇāṃ jitvā pariśuddhastrimaṇḍalā | sākṣādarhatpadaṃ prāpya vabhūva brahmacāriṇī || 17.131{32} || tadā sā nirjitakleśā nirvikalpā niraṃjanā | caṃdanakalpasaurabhyā samaloṣṭhasuvarṇikā || 17.132{33} || saṃsārabhogasatkāraniṣpṛhākāśasannibhā | sarvasatvahitādhānā sarvasūtrāṃtapāragā || 17.133{34} || sadevāsuralokānāṃ tridhātukanivāsinām | vaṃdyā pūjyābhimānyā ca vabhūva sā subhāṣiṇī || 17.134{35} || yadā sa bhagavañchāstā bhikṣuṇīnāṃ subhāṣitam | saṃkṣepeṇa samuddiśya dhyānāgāre samāśrayat || 17.135{36} || tadā sā bhikṣuṇī tatra kacaṃgalā subhāṣiṇī | bhikṣuṇīnāṃ sabhāmadhye sutrāntaṃ samupādiśat || 17.136{37} || tacchrutvā bhagavāṃstatra tayā sūtrāṃtadeśite | sarvānstān sāṃghikān bhikṣūn samāmaṃtryaivamādiśat || 17.137{38} || eṣo'grā bhikṣavo mātā bhikṣuṇīnāṃ mamāśrame | sūtrāntabhāgakartṝṇāṃ yaduteyaṃ kacaṃgalā || 17.138{39} || ityādiṣṭaṃ munīndreṇa śrutvā sarve'pi sāṃghikāḥ | savismayā munīndraṃ taṃ paprachustatpurākṛtam || 17.139{40} || bhagavannanayā karmaṃ kiṃ prakṛtaṃ purākṛtam | imān sarvān sabhāsīnān prabodhayitumarhati || 17.140{41} || yeneyaṃ śāsane bauddhe vṛddhā pravrajitādhunā | sākṣādarhatvamāsādya bhavati brahmacāriṇī || 17.141{42} || kiṃ vānayā purākarma kṛtaṃ kutra kadā katham | sūtrāntabhāgakartṝṇāṃ yenāgreyaṃ bhavatyapi || 17.142{43} || kiṃcāpi prakṛtaṃ karmaṃ purānayā kadā katham | yenātra paścime garbhāvāse na dhārito bhavān || 17.143{44} || etatsarvaiḥ parijñāya bhagavānnasyāḥ purākṛtam | imān sarvān sabhāsīnān prabodhayitumarhati || 17.144{45} || iti tairbhikṣubhiḥ sarvaiḥ prārthite sa munīśvaraḥ | sarvāṃstān sāṃghikān dṛṣṭvā samāmaṃtryaivamādiśat || 17.145{46} || śṛṇuta bhikṣavaḥ sarve yadyatkṛtaṃ purānayā | tattatsarvaṃ pravakṣyāmi yuṣmākaṃ cittabodhane || 17.146{47} || purā me bodhisatvasya bodhicaryānucāriṇaḥ | paṃcajanmaśatānyeṣā jananyāsīnniraṃtaram || 17.147{48} || tadā me dadato dānamantarāyaḥ kṛto'nayā | tenādyāpi daridreyaṃ durbhagā ca bhavatyapi || 17.148{49} || pravrajyāyai tadai caiṣā vahudhā prārthitā mayā | naivānujñāṃ dadau mahyaṃ vighnameva vyadhāddhaṭhāt || 17.149{50} || etatkarmavipākena vṛddhaiṣā duḥkhinī satī | pravrajyāsaṃvaraṃ prāptā carati mama śāsane || 17.150{51} || yadi naiṣā tadā dānaṃ vighnā mamākariṣyati | naiṣādhunā daridrātra bhavati hi kadā cana || 17.151{52} || pravrajyāyāṃ ca me vighnaṃ yadi naiṣākariṣyata | acariṣyadvrataṃ vālye na tu vṛddhātra sāṃpratam || 17.152{53} || yanmamaivaṃ kṛtaṃ vighnaṃ dāne vrate tadānayā | tenādhunā daridraiṣā vṛddhā vrataṃ caratyapi || 17.153{54} || yattadā sukṛtaṃ kiṃ citprakṛtaṃ nānayā purā | tenāhaṃ paścime garbhāvāse'dhunā na dhāritaḥ || 17.154{55} || yatsā māyā mahādevī mahāpuṇyārthasādhinī | tenāhaṃ paścime garbhāvāse tayātra dhāritaḥ || 17.155{56} || bhūyo'pyeṣā purā tatra vāraṇasyāṃ dvijātmajāḥ | kleśāgniparidagdhāṃgā daridrā kṛpaṇābhavat || 17.156{57} || tadā tatra munīndrasya kāśyapasya jagadguroḥ | śāsane śaraṇaṃ gatvā pravrajitācaradvratam || 17.157{58} || tatra sa sarvaśāstrārthakovidātivicakṣaṇā | sarvasūtrāntasaddharmaṃ bhikṣuṇīnāmupādiśat || 17.158{59} || tadā sā bhikṣuṇī tatra kiñcitkāryārtharoṣitāḥ | sarvāstā bhikṣuṇīrdāsīvādena paryabhāṣata || 17.159{60} || etatkarmavipākena saiṣādhunātiduḥkhitā | parasevākarā dāsī bhavati durbhagākṛtiḥ || 17.160{61} || yaccānayā tadā tatra vidyābhyāsīkṛtaṃ mudā | tenaiṣā sahasārhantī bhavati brahmacāriṇī || 17.161{62} || yaccāpyesā tadā tatra sūtrāntaṃ samupādiśat | tena sūtrāntavaktānāmagrā bhavati sāṃpratam || 17.162{63} || evaṃ hi bhikṣavaḥ sarve manyadhvaṃ karmasaṃbhavam | sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ ca saṃsāre bhramatāṃ sarvadehinām || 17.163{64} || yenaiva yatkṛtaṃ karmaṃ tenaivaṃ bhujyate phalam | abhuktaṃ kṣīyate naiva karmaṃ kvāpi kadā cana || 17.164{65} || nāgnibhirdahyate karmaṃ klidyate nodakairapi | vāyubhiḥ śuṣyate naiva kṣīyate na ca bhūmiṣu || 17.165{66} || ahyathāpi bhavennaiva vipāke karmaṇaḥ phalam | yaduptaṃ bhūtale bījaṃ tadeva sūyate phalam || 17.166{67} || anyathā na bhavetkvāpi kṛtaṃ karmaṃ phalaṃ bhave | śubhasya karmaṇaḥ pāke śubhataiva sadā bhave || 17.167{68} || kṛṣṇasya kṛṣṇataiva syā miśritasyāpi miśritam | evaṃ vijñāya kṛṣṇāni vihāya miśritāni ca || 17.168{69} || śubha eva sadāpyatra caritavyaṃ śubhārthibhiḥ | śubhena sadgatiṃ yāyātkṛṣṇena durgatiṃ sadā || 17.169{70} || miśritena tathohe ca gatīryāyādbhaveddhruvam | iti matvātra saṃsāre sarvadā śubhavāñchibhiḥ | triratnabhajanaṃ kṛtvā caritavyaṃ śubhe sadā || 17.170{71} || ye bhajanti sadā buddhaṃ na te gacchanti durgatim | sarvadā sadgatau bhadraṃ kṛtvā yānti jinālayam || 17.171{72} || ye śṛṇvanti sadā dharmmaṃ na yānti te'pi durgatim | sarvadā bhadrasaukhyāni bhuktvā yānti sukhāvatīm || 17.172{73} || dānaṃ dadanti ye saṃghe te'pi na yānti durgatim | sarvadā śubhasaukhyāni bhuktvā yānti jināśrayam || 17.173{74} || evaṃ matvātra saṃsāre triratnaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ | satkṛtya śraddhayā nityaṃ bhajadhvaṃ samupāsthitāḥ || 17.174{75} || triratneṣu kṛtaṃ karmaṃ tadvipāke mahatphalam | aprameyamasaṃkhyeyaṃ saṃbodhipadasādhanam || 17.175{76} || etatpuṇyānubhāvena bodhisatvāḥ sadā bhave | sarvasatvahitaṃ kṛtvā pracaranti yathechayā || 17.176{77} || nānārūpadharāḥ sarve satvārthasādhanodyatāḥ | saddharmaṃ samupādiśya pālayanti jagattrayam || 17.177{78} || kramātpāramitāḥ sarvāḥ paripūrya śubhānvitāḥ | sarvakleśagaṇāñjitvā pariśuddhāstrimaṇḍalāḥ || 17.178{79} || jitvā māragaṇāñcāpi prāpya saṃbodhimuttamām | sarvatra dharmasotkṛtvā tato nirvṛtimāyayuḥ || 17.179{80} || ye'tītā jināste'pi triratnabhajanodyamāt | kramādbodhiṃ samāsādya nirvṛtipadamāgatāḥ || 17.180{81} || varttamānā jināste'pi triratnabhajanodbhavaiḥ | puṇyairbodhiṃ samāsādya gacheyurnirvṛtiṃ tathā || 17.181{82} || anāgatā jināste'pi triratnabhajanodbhavaiḥ | puṇyairevaṃ kramādbodhiṃ prāpya yāsyanti nirvṛtim || 17.182{83} || ahaṃ cāpi tathā nūnaṃ triratnabhajanodyamī | etatpuṇyānubhāvena bodhiṃ prāpnomi sāṃpratam || 17.183{84} || tathāhamapi sarvatra kṛtvā dharmamayaṃ jagat | sarvān bodhau niyojyaivaṃ yāsyāmi nirvṛtiṃ dhruvam || 17.184{85} || evaṃ ye ye bhajantyatra triratnaśaraṇaṃ gatāḥ | te te sarve'pi saṃbodhiṃ prāpya nirvṛtimāyayuḥ || 17.185{86} || iti matvātra saṃsāre nirvṛtipadavāṃchinaḥ | triratnabhajanaṃ kṛtvā pracaradhvaṃ śubhe sadā || 17.186{87} || tathā kṛtvātra saddharmaṃbhuktvaiva satsukhānyapi | kramādbodhiṃ samāsādya nirvṛtiṃ samavāpsyatha || 17.187{88} || ityādiṣṭaṃ munīndreṇa śrutvā sarve'pi te janāḥ | sāṃghikāśca tathetyuktvā prābhyanaṃdatprabodhitāḥ || 17.188{89} || tadā tatra janāḥ sarve triratnaśaraṇaṃ gatāḥ | satkṛtya śraddhayā nityaṃ prabhejire'numoditāḥ || 17.189{90} || etatpuṇyānubhāvaistu tadā samaṃtataḥ | sarvadā maṃgalotsāhaṃ babhuva nirupadravam || 17.190{91} || iti me guruṇākhyātaṃ śrutaṃ mayā tathocyate | śrutvā rājanstvamapyevaṃ triratnaṃ bhaja sarvadā || 17.191{92} || prajāścāpi tathā dharmaṃ śrāvayitvā prabodhayan | triratnabhajanaṃ nityaṃ kārayituṃ sadārhasi || 17.192{93} || tathā te maṃgalaṃ nityaṃ sarvatrāpi bhaveddhruvam | kramātpāramitā pūrya bodhiṃ cāpi samāpsyasi || 17.193{94} || iti tenārhatādiṣṭaṃ śrutvāśokaḥ sa bhūpatiḥ | tathā hīti pratijñāya prābhyanandan sapārṣadaḥ || 17.194{95} || kacaṃgalāyā avadānametacchṛṇvanti ye śrāvayatīha yaśca | vihāya pāpaṃ khalu te'pi sarve bhuktvā sukhānyeva sugatiṃ vrajanti || 17.195{96} || iti ratnamālāyāmavadānatatve kacaṃgalāvadānaṃ samāptam dhanikāvadāna athāśoko mahīpālaḥ kṛtāṃjalipuṭo mudā | upaguptaṃ guruṃ natvā punarevaṃ samabravīt || 18.1{1} || bhadanta śrotumicchāmi punaranyatsubhāṣitam | tadyathā guruṇādiṣṭaṃ tathādeṣṭuṃ ca me'rhati || 18.2{2} || iti saṃprārthitaṃ rājñā śrutvā so'rhan sudhīryatiḥ | upagupto narendraṃ taṃ samālokyaivamabravīt || 18.3{3} || śṛṇu rājan samādhāya yathā me guruṇoditam | tathāhaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi tava puṇyapravṛddhaye || 18.4{4} || puraikasamaye sa śrīśākyasiṃho munīśvaraḥ | sarvajñaḥ sugataḥ śāstā dharmarājo vināyakaḥ || 18.5{5} || bhikṣubhiḥ śrāvakaiḥ sārddhaṃ bhikṣuṇībhiśca cailakaiḥ | upāsakai mahāśrāddhairupāsikāgaṇairapi || 18.6{6} || bodhisatvagaṇaiścāpi mahāsatvaiḥ śubhārthibhiḥ | sarvasatvahitārthāya bodhicaryāṃ prakāśibhiḥ || 18.7{7} || vṛjiṣu puri vaiśālyāṃ markaṭākhyahradāntike | kūṭāgāraguhāvāse vijahāra prabhāsayan || 18.8{8} || tatsaddharmāmṛtaṃ pātuṃ tatra sarve samāgatāḥ | brahmaśakrādidevendrā lokapālā digāsthitāḥ || 18.9{9} || grahāḥ siddhagaṇāḥ sādhyā yakṣagaṃdharvakinnarāḥ | garuḍā nāgarājāśca vidyādharāśca dānavāḥ || 18.10{10} || rākṣasāḥ sagaṇāścaiva ṛṣayo brahmacāriṇaḥ | brahmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā bhūpā rājāno'pi narādhipāḥ || 18.11{11} || tathā rājakumārāśca vaiśyā maṃtrijanā api | gṛhasthāḥ śreṣṭhinaḥ paurāḥ sārthavāhā mahājanāḥ || 18.12{12} || vaṇijaḥ śilpinaścāpi tathānye'pi śubhārthinaḥ | grāmyā jānapadāścāpi tathā kārpaṭikā api || 18.13{13} || evamanye'pi lokāśca saddharmāmṛtavāṃchinaḥ | sarve te samupāyātāstatrādrākṣustamīśvaram || 18.14{14} || sabhāmadhyāsanāsīnaṃ sarvasaṃghapuraskṛtam | śrīghanaṃ taṃ samālokya sarve te samupāśritāḥ || 18.15{15} || natvā pradakṣiṇīkṛtya samabhyarcya yathākramam | punaḥ sāñjalayo natvā parivṛtya samaṃtataḥ | tatsaddharmāmṛtaṃ pātumupatasthuḥ samāhitāḥ || 18.16{16} || tadā sa bhagavān dṛṣṭvā tān sarvān samupasthitān | ādimadhyāntakalyāṇīṃ bodhicaryāṃ samādiśat || 18.17{17} || tadāryadharmamākarṇya sarve lokāḥ pramoditāḥ | tadā te dharmavaiśeṣyaṃ matvā pratinanaṃdire || 18.18{18} || tadā tatra mahāpūryyāṃ vaiśālyāṃ pauriko mahān | gṛhastho dhaniko nāma śrīmān sarvaguṇī sudhīḥ || 18.19{19} || śrāddho bhadrāśayo dātā śuddhaśīlo vicakṣaṇaḥ | sarvasatvahitādhānādāsītsatpuruṣottamaḥ || 18.20{20} || patnī dharmasakhī tasya śīlavatyabhidhābhavat | tanayaśca vaṃdānyākhyaḥ satyavatyabhidhā snuṣā || 18.21{21} || tadā tatra dvijā sarve bhaktimanto jagadguroḥ | pūjānimaṃtraṇe cakruḥ samayaṃ saṃmatāstathā || 18.22{22} || bhavanto yanmunīndro'yamatrāsmākaṃ hitechayā | saddharmaṃ samupādeṣṭuṃ sasaṃghaḥ samupāgataḥ || 18.23{23} || tadasmābhirmunīndro'yaṃ pūjanīyaṃ samādarāt | ato nimaṃtraṇīyo'tra sarvaiḥ saṃbhūya nānyathā || 18.24{24} || ekaścetkurute dravyamadādasya nimaṃtraṇam | sarvairnirvāsanīyo'sau yato'nyadharmavighnakṛt || 18.25{25} || tadā sa dhaniko'jñātvā samayaṃ taistathā kṛtam | svayameva munīndraṃ taṃ pūjayituṃ samichata || 18.26{26} || tataḥ sa dhanikaḥ śrīmān divyasaṃpatsamṛddhimān | svayaṃ nimaṃtraṇaṃ karttuṃ sasaṃghasya muneryayau || 18.27{27} || tatra sa samupāsṛtya natvā taṃ śrīghanaṃ mudā | sasaṃghaṃ tatpuraḥ sthitvā prārthayadeva sāṃjaliḥ || 18.28{28} || bhagavannātha sarvajña bhagavaṃtaṃ sasāṃghikam | pūjayituṃ samichāmi paśyanme'nugrahaṃ kuru || 18.29{29} || iti saṃprārthitaṃ tena bhagavān sa munīśvaraḥ | tathā hīti pratiśrutvā tūṣṇībhūtvādhyuvāsa tat || 18.30{30} || tadā te brāhmaṇāḥ sarve saṃbhūya samupāgatāḥ | bhagavataścaraṇau natvā cakrurbhojyanimaṃtraṇam || 18.31{31} || tacchrutvā bhagavān prāha tān dṛṣṭvā bhaktimānasān | pūrvameva sasaṃghāhamanenodya nimaṃtritaḥ || 18.32{32} || etadākarṇya sarve te brāhmaṇā bheditāśayāḥ | paraṃ pratīkṣyamānāśca śanaiḥ svasvagṛhaṃ yayuḥ || 18.33{33} || tataḥ sa dhaniko matvā munīndreṇādhyuvāsitam | muditastaṃ muniṃ natvā sahasā svagṛhaṃ yayau || 18.34{34} || tatra sa svagṛhe gatvā vāṃdhaveṣṭajanaissaha | tadarhabhojyasāmagrīṃ sahasā samasādhyayat || 18.35{35} || tato bhojyasthalaṃ tatra śodhayitvā samantataḥ | ratnadhvajairvitānaiśca sa patākairamaṇḍayat || 18.36{36} || tato yathākramaṃ tatra divyaratnamayāni ca | svāsanāni samāstīryya sugaṃdhīḥ samadhūpayat || 18.37{37} || tataḥ sa prātarutthāya snātvā śuddhāmvarāvṛtaḥ | pūjāpādyārghasāmagrīṃ pratiṣṭhāpya pramoditaḥ || 18.38{38} || savāṃdhaveṣṭajanastatra kūṭāgāre samācarat | sāñjalistaṃ muniṃ natvā prārthayadevamādarāt || 18.39{39} || bhagavannātha sarvajña samayo varttate'dhunā | tatsasaṃgho mamāvāse vijayituṃ samarhasi || 18.40{40} || iti saṃprārthite tena bhagavān sa sasāṃghikaḥ | khikkhirīpātramādāya pratasthe cīvarāvṛtaḥ || 18.41{41} || tatra sa bhagavānmārge kṛtvā bhadraṃ samantataḥ | prabhāsayan krameṇaivaṃ vaiśālyāṃ samupaviśat || 18.42{42} || tathāyātaṃ munīndraṃ taṃ śrīghanaṃ sāṃghikānvitam | dṛṣṭvā vaiśālikāḥ lokāḥ sarve'pi samapūjayan || 18.43{43} || evamabhyarcyamāno'bhivaṃdyamāno'bhinaṃditaḥ | bhāsayan bhadratāṃ kṛtvā saṃghaiḥ saha samācarat || 18.44{44} || tatra tasya gṛhe gatvā sasaṃghaḥ sa munīśvaraḥ | taddattaṃ pādyamādāya svāsane samupāśrayat || 18.45{45} || tataste sāṃghikāścāpi sarve tatra yathākramam | taddattaṃ pādyamādāya svasvāsane samāśrayan || 18.46{46} || tataḥ sa dhaniko dṛṣṭvā sasaṃghaṃ taṃ munīśvaram | svasvāsane samāsīnaṃ pūjāṅgaiḥ samapūjayat || 18.47{47} || tato divyopacāraistaṃ bhagavantaṃ sasāṃghikam | supraṇītai rasopetairbhojanaiḥ samatoṣayat || 18.48{48} || tadbhojyaṃ surasaṃ bhuktvā bhagavān sa sasāṃghikaḥ | amṛtairiva saṃtuṣṭastṛptiṃ yayau pramoditaḥ || 18.49{49} || asaṃghaiḥ taṃ muniṃ tṛptaṃ dṛṣṭvā sa dhaniko mudā | tato'panīya pātrāṇi taddhastādīnyaśodhayat || 18.50{50} || tataḥ śuddhauṣadhīpūgatāmvūlādi rasāyanam | buddhapramukhasaṃghebhyo muditaḥ sa svayaṃ dadau || 18.51{51} || tataḥ sa harṣito natvā taṃ munīndraṃ sasāṃghikam | purataḥ sāñjaliḥ sthitvā prārthayadevamādarāt || 18.52{52} || bhagavannātha sarvajña bhavatāṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ | bhaktyaiva bhajanaṃ kurve tatkṣamasvāparādhatām || 18.53{53} || sadaivaṃ kṛpayā dṛṣṭya paśyan bhavān sasāṃghikaḥ | mamānugrahamādhāya trātumarhati sarvathā || 18.54{54} || tataḥ sa bhagavāñchāstā sasāṃghiko'numoditaḥ | dhanikaṃ taṃ samālokya naṃdayannevamādiśat || 18.55{55} || gṛhapate sadā nityamārogyamastu vo dhruvam | bodhipraṇidhisiddhiśca bhūyādbhadraṃ ca sarvadā || 18.56{56} || tatastasya priyā bhāryā śīlavatyanumoditā | sāñjaliḥ praṇatiṃ kṛtvā prārthayattaṃ munīśvaram || 18.57{57} || bhagavannātha sarvajña śvaścātra bhavatāmaham | pūjāṃ kartuṃ samicche tadanugrahītumarhati || 18.58{58} || tayeti prārthite dṛṣṭvā bhagavān sa tadāśayam | śraddhānvitaṃ pratijñāya tuṣṇībhūtvādhyuvāsa tat || 18.59{59} || tataḥ sa bhagavāñchāstā samutthāya sasāṃghikaḥ | bhāsayaṃ bhadratāṃ kṛtvā svāśrame ca samāśrayat || 18.60{60} || tataḥ paradine prātaḥ snātvā śuddhāṃvarāvṛtā | sādhitvā sarvasāmagrīṃ sā dūtaṃ preṣayanmunau || 18.61{61} || sa dūtaḥ sahasā gatvā vihare taṃ munīśvaram | sasaṃghaṃ sāṃjalirnatvā punarevaṃ nyavedayat || 18.62{62} || bhagavannātha sarvajña samayo varttate'dhunā | tatsasaṃgho bhavāṃstatra sahasāgantumarhati || 18.63{63} || tataḥ sa bhagavānnevaṃ bhadraṃ kṛtvā sasāṃghikaḥ | dhanikasya gṛhe gatvā pādyaṃ gṛhyāsane'viśat || 18.64{64} || tatrāsane samāsīnaṃ sasaṃghaṃ taṃ munīśvaram | dṛṣṭvā śīlavatī sātha yathāvidhi samarcayat || 18.65{65} || tataśca sā muditā sarvaṃ saṃghaṃ buddhādikaṃ tathā | divyopacārasaṃyuktairbhojanaiḥ samatoṣayat || 18.66{66} || tataḥ saṃtarppitaṃ dṛṣṭvā śodhayitvā karādikam | datvā tāmvurapūgādiṃ natvā sā samupāśrayat || 18.67{67} || tataḥ sa bhagavān tasmai datvāśiṣaṃ sasāṃghikaḥ | samutthāya tataścaivaṃ svavihāre samāśrayat || 18.68{68} || tathā sarve tadānyo'pi dhanikasyātmajaḥ sudhīḥ | tatparedyu vihāraṃ taṃ gatvā natvā nyamaṃtrayat || 18.69{69} || bhagavānnapi tasyaivaṃ dṛṣṭvā śraddhānvitaṃ manaḥ | tatheti pratimoditvā tūṣṇībhūtvādhyuvāsa ca || 18.70{70} || tataḥ sastaṃ muniṃ natvā svagṛhaṃ sahasāgataḥ | bāṃdhavaiḥ sarvasāmagrīṃ muditaḥ samasādhayat || 18.71{71} || tataḥ prātaḥ samutthāya snātvā śuddhāmvārāvṛtaḥ | vihāre samupāsṛtya natvaivaṃ munimabravīt || 18.72{72} || bhagavannātha sarvajña samayo varttate'dhunā | tatsaṃgho bhavān gehe mamāgantuṃ samarhati || 18.73{73} || tataḥ sasaṃgha utthāya bhagavān sa tathācarat | tadgṛhe pādyamādāya tatrāsane samāśrayat || 18.74{74} || tataḥ sa mudito buddhapramukbaṃ sarvasāṃghikam | samabhyarcya tathā divyabhojanaiḥ samatoṣayat || 18.75{75} || tato'panīya pātrāṇi śodhayitvā karādikam | datvā pūgādikaṃ natvā purataḥ samupāśrayat || 18.76{76} || punaḥ sa sāṃjalirnatvā prakṛtvā ca kṣamārthanām | sasaṃghaṃ taṃ munīndraṃ taṃ saṃdṛṣṭvaivaṃ samupāśrayat || 18.77{77} || tadā tasya snuṣā cāpi satyavatī pramoditā | bhagavaṃtaṃ sasaṃghaṃ taṃ praṇatvaivaṃ nyamaṃtrayat || 18.78{78} || bhagavānnapi tasyāśca dṛṣṭva śraddhānvitaṃ manaḥ | tatheti pratimoditvā tuṣṇībhūtvā radhāṃ vyadhāt || 18.79{79} || tataḥ sa bhagavāṃstasmai datvāśiṣaṃ sasāṃghikaḥ | tathā kṛtvā śubhaṃ loke gatvāśrame samāśrayat || 18.80{80} || tataḥ sāpi tathā prātaḥ snātvā śuddhāmvarāvṛtā | dūtenāpi munīndraṃ taṃ sasaṃghaṃ samacodayat || 18.81{81} || tathā sa bhagavāṃścāpi sasāṃghikaḥ samutthitaḥ | pracaran bhadratāṃ kṛtvā tasyā gehe samāviśat || 18.82{82} || tatra pādyārghamādāya bhagavān sa sasāṃghikaḥ | śubhāsane samāsīnastasthau tatra prabhāsayan || 18.83{83} || tathāsthitaṃ munīndraṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃpramoditā | yathāvidhi samabhyarcya tathā bhojyairatoṣayat || 18.84{84} || tātastaṃ sugataṃ tṛptaṃ sasāṃghikaṃ samīkṣya sā | tatrāpanīya pātrāṇi hastādīṃ paryaśodhayat || 18.85{85} || tataḥ pūgādikaṃ datvā prārthayitvā kṣamāṃ tathā | sasaṃghaṃ taṃ muniṃ natvā sā sāñjalirupāśrayat || 18.86{86} || tathā sa bhagavāṃstasyai datvāśīṣaṃ sasāṃghikaḥ | tato vihāyasā gatvā svāśrame ca samāśrayat || 18.87{87} || tathā sa dhaniko bhaktyā bhagavantaṃ sasāṃghikam | divyādbhutarddhisaṃbhāraiḥ punarevaṃ nyamaṃtrayat || 18.88{89!} || tatputreṇa tṛtīye'hni caturthe snuṣayā tathā | sasaṃgho bhagavānnevaṃ divyabhogairnimaṃtritaḥ || 18.89{90} || tacchrutvā taddvijāḥ sarve vaiśālikāḥ prajā api | alabdhāvasarāḥ śāstuḥ pūjāyāṃ praticukruśuḥ || 18.90{91} || tataste saṃmataṃ kṛtvā sarve viprāḥ sapaurikāḥ | dhanikāya puraṃ kruddhāścakrurnikāsanodyamam || 18.91{92} || evaṃ tatsamataṃ jñātvā
