bhagavān sa munīśvaraḥ | dhanikaṃ taṃ samāhūya pura evamupādiśat || 18.92{93} || sādho gṛhapate sarve ime vaiśālikā dvijāḥ | kruddhāste saṃghabhojye'tra hyalabdhāvasarā mama || 18.93{94} || tadatra tvaṃ kṣamāṃ kṛtvā dvijān sarvān prabodhaya | kṛtvātra vinayaṃ dharme prasādayitumarhasi || 18.94{95} || ityādiṣṭaṃ munīndreṇa śrutvā sa dhanikastathā | ityāśrutya dvijān sarvān samupetyaivamabravīt || 18.95{96} || bhavanto na mayā jñātaṃ bhavatāṃ kopakāraṇam | tadatra me samākhyāta yadarthe kupyate'dhunā || 18.96{97} || iti tenoditaṃ śrutvā sarve te brāhmaṇā | kopāgniparidagdhāsyā dhanikaṃ taṃ ninindire || 18.97{98} || tatraiko brāhmaṇaḥ sādhurdayāluḥ sukṛtārthavit | dhanikaṃ taṃ samāmaṃtrya bodhayituṃ samabravīt || 18.98{99} || sādho gṛhapate'smābhiryathātra samataṃ kṛtam | tathā tatte pravakṣyāmi śrutvā tatpratibudhyatām || 18.99{100} || bhavanto yanmunīndro'yamatrāsmākaṃ hitechayā | saddharmaṃ samupādeṣṭuṃ sasāṃghikaḥ samāgataḥ || 18.100{1} || tadasmābhirmunīndro'yaṃ pūjanīyaḥ samādaraiḥ | ato nimaṃtraṇīyo'tra sarvaiḥ saṃbhūya nānyathā || 18.101{2} || ekaścetkurute vittamadādasya nimaṃtraṇam | sarvairnirvāsanīyo'sau yato'nyadharmavighnakṛt || 18.102{3} || ityasmābhiḥ kṛtaṃ sādho samayaṃ sarvasaṃmatam | tadvilaṃghya tvayaikena śāstuḥ pūjā kṛtā sadā || 18.103{4} || etaddheto ime sārve brāhmaṇā ruṣitāstathā | niṣkāsayitumichanti tvāmanyadharmavādhakam || 18.104{5} || kiṃ cāpi bhagavānatra sarvadā sthāsyate na hi | tatsarve bhagavatpūjāṃ kartuṃ vāṃchanti sāṃpratam || 18.105{6} || yaccāyaṃ bhagavāñchāstā dharmarājo munīśvaraḥ | sarvasatvahitārthāya samutpanna ihā'dhunā || 18.106{7} || tathātra sarvasatvānaṃ hitaṃ kartumupācaran | saddharmaṃ samupādiśya caratyayaṃ samaṃtataḥ || 18.107{8} || tathātrāpi hitaṃ kartumasmākaṃ samupāgataḥ | saddharmaṃ samupādiśya vijayate sasāṃghikaḥ || 18.108{9} || tadatra sarvalokānāṃ triratnabhajanotsavam | dātumarhasi sarveṣāmapi puṇyapravṛddhaye || 18.109{10} || eka eva tvamevaṃ tu mā kṛthā bhajanaṃ sadā | sarvaiḥ saṃbhūya te sāstuḥ karttavyaṃ bhajanaṃ sadā || 18.110{11} || iti tenoditaṃ śrutvā dhanikaḥ sa vivodhitaḥ | brāhmaṇaṃ taṃ samālokya praṇatvaivamabhāṣata || 18.111{12} || mayā na jñāyate hyevaṃ bhavadbhiḥ samayaṃ kṛtam | tadatra me'parādhatvaṃ kṣantumarhanti sarvathā || 18.112{13} || yadi vo vidyate śraddhā triratnabhajane sadā | kurudhvaṃ sarvadāpyatra saṃbuddhabhajanaṃ khalu || 18.113{14} || yadā na vidyate pūjā saṃbuddhe'smin sasāṃghike | tadaivāhaṃ kariṣyāmi saṃbuddhabhajanaṃ khalu || 18.114{15} || iti tena samākhyātaṃ śrutvā sarve'pi te dvijāḥ | satyamiti parijñāya vabhūvustatprasāditāḥ || 18.115{16} || tataste brāhmaṇāḥ sarve saṃbhūya saha paurikaiḥ | bhagavataḥ sasaṃghasya nimaṃtritumupāsaran || 18.116{17} || tatra te brāhmaṇāḥ sarve sametya saha paurikaiḥ | sāñjalayo munīndraṃ taṃ natvaivaṃ prārthayanmudā || 18.117{18} || bhagavannātha sarvajña trimāsyaṃ bhavatāṃ sadā | satkāraṃ kartumichāma tvadanujñāṃ dadātu naḥ || 18.118{19} || iti taiḥ prārthite sarvairdṛṣṭvā sa bhagavānmuniḥ | teṣāmāśayaśuddhatvaṃ tūṣṇībhūtvādhyuvāsa tat || 18.119{20} || tataste brāhmaṇāḥ sarve bhagavatādhivāsitam | matvā sapaurikā natvā taṃ muṇiṃ svapure'caran || 18.120{21} || tatra te paurikā viprāḥ śodhayitvā samamṭataḥ | bhojyakṣatre dhvajairuccairvitānaiḥ paryaśobhayan || 18.121{22} || tatrāsanāni prajñapya sarvasāmagrasādhanam | kṛtvā sarve'pi te lokā mahotsāhaṃ pracakrire || 18.122{23} || tataste brāhmaṇāḥ prātaḥ snātvā śuddhāmvarāvṛtāḥ | tatrāśrame sametyaivaṃ natvā taṃ prārthayanmunim || 18.123{24} || bhagavannātha sarvajña samayo varttate'dhunā | tatsasaṃgho bhavāṃstatra pure āgantumarhati || 18.124{25} || tataḥ sa bhagavān buddhaḥ sasaṃghaścīvarāvṛtaḥ | khikkhiripātramādāya saṃpratasthe prabhāsayan || 18.125{26} || tatra mārgeṣu sarvatra bhagavān sa sasāṃghikaḥ | bhāsayaṃ bhadratāṃ kṛtvā pracaraṃstatpure'viśat || 18.126{27} || tatra sa bhagavān kṣetre suśodhite sasāṃghikaḥ | taddattaṃ pādyamādāya svāsane samupāśrayat || 18.127{28} || saṃbuddhapramukhaṃ sarvaṃ saṃghaṃ te samatoṣayat | tatastaṃ sugataṃ tṛptaṃ saṃghaṃ cāpi vilokyate || 18.128{29} || tatpātrāṇyupanītvā taddhastādīkaṃ vyaśodhayat | tataḥ sa pūgatāmbūramahauṣadhyarasāya nam || 18.129{30} || datvā kṣamārthanaṃ kṛtvā taṃ sasaṃghaṃ praṇemire | tataste brāhmaṇāḥ sarve paurāścāpi pramoditāḥ | tatsaddharmāmṛtaṃ pātimupātasthuḥ samāhitāḥ || 18.130{31} || tatra sa bhagavān dṛṣṭvā sarvāṃstān samupasthitān | āryyasatyaṃ samārabhya saddharmaṃ samupādiśat || 18.131{32} || tato bhadrāśiṣaṃ datvā bhagavān saha saṃghikaiḥ | bhāsayaṃ bhadratāṃ kurvan gatvā svāśramamāśrayat || 18.132{33} || evaṃ vaiśālikā lokāste traimāsyaṃ niraṃtaram | yathārhabhojanaiḥ śāstuḥ sasaṃghasya prabhejire || 18.133{34} || tato'nte dhanikaścāpi patnī putraḥ snuṣāpi ca | saṃbuddhapramukhaṃ saṃghaṃ divyabhogyaiḥ samārcayat || 18.134{35} || bhagavānnapi tathā tebhyo datvā śubhāśiṣaṃ tataḥ | samutthāya sasaṃghaśca gatvāśrame samāśrayat || 18.135{36} || tataḥ sa dhanikaḥ patnīputrasnuṣāsamanvitaḥ | dṛṣṭasatyaḥ sadā ratnatrayasevārato'bhavat || 18.136{37} || etatpuṇyānubhāvena bhūyo'tiśrīsamṛddhimān | sarvalokahitaṃ kṛtvā pracacāra śubhe sadā || 18.137{38} || taddṛṣṭvā vismitāḥ sarve bhikṣavaḥ samupāśritāḥ | bhagavantaṃ praṇatvaivaṃ paprachustatpurākṛtam || 18.138{39} || bhagavan kiṃ purānena dhanikena vṛṣaṃ kṛtam | kutra kathaṃ kadaitannaḥ sarvamākhyātumarhati || 18.139{40} || iti tairbhikṣubhiḥ pṛṣṭe bhagavān sa munīśvaraḥ | sarvānstāṃ saṃghikān dṛṣṭvā tadaivaṃ samupādiśat || 18.140{41} || śṛṇuta bhikṣavaḥ sarve yadanena vṛṣaṃ kṛtam | tatpatnyā ca putreṇa snuṣayā ca taducyate || 18.141{42} || varāṇasyāmabhūtpūrvaṃ mālikaḥ kamalābhidhaḥ | durbhikṣakṣapite kāle parāṃ durgatimāgataḥ || 18.142{43} || patnī patnavikā nāma putraḥ kuvaliyābhidhaḥ | pāṭalokhyā snuṣā ceti vabhūvustasya saṃmatāḥ || 18.143{44} || tadaikasmin dine tasya gṛhāntike prapuṣpite | udyāne sāyamāgatya pratyekabuddha āśrayet || 18.144{45} || te sarve ekavastrā hi paryyāyena nṛpālaye | datvā puṣpāṇi prāyātāḥ svabhavane niṣīdire || 18.145{46} || tadā sa ca gṛhasthāste tatrodāne jvalatprabhām | dṛṣṭvā kiṃ mahojvālamudyāne iti vismitāḥ || 18.146{47} || sahasā te samutthāya tatrodyāne nirīkṣitum | sarvagatāḥ samīkṣantaḥ dadṛśustaṃ prabhāsayam || 18.147{48} || tatra te samupāśritya dṛṣṭvā taṃ dhyānasaṃsthitam | sāñjalayaḥ praṇatvaiva muditā svagṛhaṃ yayuḥ || 18.148{49} || tatra te svagṛhāsīnāḥ prātastatpūjanotsukāḥ | nirddhanāstadvyathāṃ prāpu lūnapakṣāḥ khagā iva || 18.149{50} || tadā sa mālikastasmai pūjāṃ kartuṃ samutsukaḥ | taddravyaṃ svagṛhe samyaganviṣya samalokayat || 18.150{51} || tatra gṛhe sa sarvatra samanviṣya samaṃtataḥ | kañci mātramapi dravyamalabdhaivaṃ vyaciṃtayat || 18.151{52} || aho mayā purā pāpaṃ prakṛtaṃ kiṃ yato'dhunā | akiṃcanyo daridro'smi kimatra jīvitena me || 18.152{53} || yato na vidyate dravyaṃ kiṃ cidapi gṛhe mama | tatkena kariṣyāmi pūjāmasya mahātmanaḥ || 18.153{54} || atrāyaṃ svayamāgatya mamodyāne samāśritaḥ | pratyekabuddha ātmajo dhyātvā tiṣṭhati bhāsayan || 18.154{55} || tadasya sugatasyātra karttavyā satkṛtirmayā | kadāyaṃ puri ramyatra samāgachetsvayaṃ punaḥ || 18.155{56} || tatprātaḥ śūnyapātreṇa gachedito mamātmavit | tanmamātra bhave śūnyamiva janmāpi nisphalam || 18.156{57} || yato mānyo'bhipūjyo yaṃ pūjyate na kathaṃ cana | tatra kiṃ jāyate bhadraṃ puṇyaṃ vāsya kathaṃ kutaḥ || 18.157{58} || puṇyaṃ vinātra saṃsāre kiṃ sāraṃ janma nisphalam | bhuktvāpi kiṃ sukhānyatra suciraṃ jīvite nanu || 18.158{59} || puṇyārthe jīvitaṃ janma tadatra yadi naśyati | kimeva jīvitenāpi janmanā pāpasādhinā || 18.159{60} || tanmṛtyurme varaṃ hyatra na mithyācirajīvitam | avaśyameva saṃsāre sarvatra maraṇaṃ dhruvam || 18.160{61} || kimevaṃ dehapuṣṭena bhuktvā duḥkhāṃ sarvadā | tatkenāpi pradānena pūjayeyamimaṃ jinam || 18.161{62} || puṇyena sadgatiṃ yāyāṃ pāpena durgatiṃ sadā | tatpāpaṃ parityaktuṃ puṇyaṃ prāptu yateya hi || 18.162{63} || yadyatra pūjyate nāyaṃ drakṣyate ca kadā kuha | buddhapūjāṃ vinā bhadre puṇyaṃ ca lapsyate kutaḥ || 18.163{64} || yāvanna prāpyate puṇyaṃ tāvaddurgaticāraṇam | tasmātpuṇyaṃ prayatnena karttavyaṃ sukhatāptaye || 18.164{65} || tadatra śraddhayā kiṃcinmātreṇāpi svavastunā | satkṛtyainaṃ mahābhijñaṃ bhajeyaṃ samupasthitaḥ || 18.165{66} || iti dhyātvā viniścitya mālikaḥ saṃpramoditaḥ | bhāryāṃ putraṃ snuṣāṃ cāpi samāmaṃtryaivamabravīt || 18.166{67} || aye priye snuṣe putra yūyaṃ śṛṇuta madvacaḥ | yadatra kartumichāmi tatra yūyaṃ prasādataḥ || 18.167{68} || yadatrāyaṃ mahābhijñaḥ svayameva samāgataḥ | asmākaṃ gṛhe dravyaṃ kiñcitmātraṃ na vidyate || 18.168{69} || tatkenātra kariṣyāmaḥ pūjāmasya mahātmanaḥ || 18.169{69!} || yadi na pūjyate'smābhiḥ sugato'yaṃ muniryatiḥ | tadā puṇyaṃ vayaṃ kutra lapsyāmahe kadā katham || 18.170{70} || puṇyaṃ vinātra saṃsāre nisphalaṃ janma jīvitam | tadvayaṃ puṇyato prāptuṃ yatema sarvathā vayam || 18.171{71} || puṇyena sadgatiṃ prāpya pāpena durgatiṃ sadā | tatsadgatisukhaprāptyai puṇyaṃ kurvīmahi dhruvam || 18.172{72} || caturṇāṃ vidyate'smākamekaṃ sarvasvamamvaram | anenāpyenamāchādya prabhajamahi sāṃpratam || 18.173{73} || nādyarājakule nagnā gachāmaḥ kiṃ bhaviṣyati | etatme vacanaṃ śrutvābhyanumoditumarhatha || 18.174{74} || iti tenoditaṃ śrutvā patnī putraḥ snuṣāpi te | sarve'pyabhyanumoditvā tathā kurviti procire || 18.175{76!} || ityetatsamayaṃ kṛtvā sarve te śraddhayānvitāḥ | gatvā tenaikavastreṇa taṃ prāchādya samārcayan || 18.176{77} || tataste muditāḥ sarve kṛtāñjalipuṭā muneḥ | tasya pādau praṇatvaivaṃ praṇidhānaṃ pracakrire || 18.177{78} || anena vastradānena vayaṃ sarve śubhāśayāḥ | bhaveyaṃ sadgatiṃ yātā divyasaṃpattihāninaḥ || 18.178{79} || śāstāraṃ sugataṃ buddhaṃ samārādhya sadā bhave | triratnabhajanaṃ kṛtvā bhavema bodhicāriṇaḥ || 18.179{80} || iti tairmuditaiḥ sarvaiḥ praṇidhānaṃ kṛtaṃ tathā | viditvā sa mahāvijñastathāstviti samādiśat || 18.180{81} || tatastesāṃ manoharṣaṃ kṛtvā sa sugato muniḥ | tata uḍḍīya pakṣīva bhāsayan svāśrame yayau || 18.181{82} || taddṛṣṭvā te nanditāḥ sarve buddhadharmānuśaṃsinaḥ | triratnasmaraṇaṃ kṛtvā pracerire sukhaṃ sadā || 18.182{83} || tatpuṇyapraṇidhānena dhaniko'yaṃ sa mālikaḥ | jāto divyaprabhāvarddhiḥ patnīputrasnuṣānvitaḥ || 18.183{84} || manaḥśuddhividhānena dānenātiglaghīyasā | bhavantyalaghvyāḥ saṃkalpaiḥ saṃpadaḥ satvaśālinām || 18.184{85} || buddhakṣetreṣu yatkarma sukṛtaṃ duḥkṛtaṃ tathā | mahattaratvamāsādya phalatyeva sadā bhave || 18.185{86} || iti matvātra saṃsāre karttavyaṃ sukṛtaṃ sadā | bauddhe satkṛtapuṇyena labhanti bodhisaṃpadaḥ || 18.186{87} || iti śāstrā samādiṣṭaṃ śrutvā sarve'pi sāṃghikāḥ | menire cittavaimalyamūlaṃ dānaphalaśriyam || 18.187{88} || tacchrutvā brāhmaṇāste'pi tatpuṇyavismitā mudā | bhagavaṃtaṃ sadā smṛtvā prabhejire'numoditāḥ || 18.188{89} || tathā te brāhmaṇāścāpi sarve'pi paurikāstathā | tatpuṇyapariśuddhāṃśā vabhuvuḥ kuśalodyatāḥ || 18.189{90} || helārpitaṃ ratnadhanaṃ tṛṇāgraṃ śraddhāvatīrṇaṃ tṛṇamapyanargham | anekaśobhānubhavaṃ hi cittaṃ cittaṃ nimittaṃ śubhasaṃbhavānām || 18.190{91} || iti me guruṇādiṣṭaṃ śrutaṃ mayā tathocyate | śrutvāpyevaṃ mahārāja karttavyaṃ sukṛtaṃ sadā || 18.191{92} || prajāścāpi mahārāja bodhayitvā prayatnataḥ | kramādbodhiṃ samāsādya saṃbuddhapadamāpnuyāḥ || 18.192{94} || iti tenārhatākhyātaṃ śrutvāśokaḥ sa bhūpatiḥ | tathā hīti pratijñāya prābhyanandatsapārṣadaḥ || 18.193{95} || idaṃ narā ye dhanikāvadānaṃ śṛṇvanti ye cāpi niśāmayanti | sukhāni bhuktvā sa śubhe sadā te sarve'pi śamyānti jinālayan te | iti ratnāvadānatatve dhanikāvadānaṃ samāptam raivatāvadāna athāśoko narendraḥ sa kṛtāṃjalipuṭo mudā | upaguptaṃ guruṃ natvā punarevamabhāṣata || 19.1{1} || bhadanta śrotumichāmi punaranyatsubhāṣitam | tadyathā guruṇākhyātaṃ tathādeṣṭuṃ ca me'rhati || 19.2{2} || iti sāṃprārthitaṃ rājñā śrutvā so'rhaṃ mahāmatiḥ | upagupto narendraṃ taṃ samālokyaivamādiśat || 19.3{3} || sādhu śṛṇu mahārāja yathā me guruṇoditam | tathāhaṃ te pravakṣyāmi śrutvaivaṃ paribudhyatām || 19.4{4} || krauryeṇa dvirasanāḥ śuciveṣṭitānāṃ mithyāpavādaviṣamaṃ viṣamutsṛjanti | te pāpaśāpaparitāpaparaṃparārttāstīvravyalīkatimiravivaraṃ viśanti || 19.5{5} || tadyathābhūtpurā bhikṣuḥ kāsmīre patitāśrame | raivatakābhidho bauddhaḥ sarvabhūtadayāśrayaḥ || 19.6{6} || sa kadāciddhanoddeśe vivikte sughaṭāntare | tarutvacaḥ kaṣāyena cakre cīvararaṃjanam || 19.7{7} || tasminnavasare tatra piśunākhyadvijanmanaḥ | dhenuvatsā vane naṣṭā vabhūvuryūthanirgatāḥ || 19.8{8} || tadā sa brāhmaṇo dṛṣṭvā taṃ duṣṭāśitaśaṃkitaḥ | sarvatrāpi samanviṣṭā tatrāpyanveṣituṃ yayau || 19.9{9} || tatra taccīvarakvāthavāke vahnisamudgatam | dhūmaṃ sa dvija ālokya vatsapākamamanyata || 19.10{10} || tataḥ sa brāhmaṇaḥ sārddhaṃ svajanaiḥ śastrapāṇibhiḥ | taddraṣṭuṃ śailamāruhya sahasāgāttadantike || 19.11{11} || tatra taṃ raivataṃ bhikṣuṃ dṛṣṭvā sa dvija ādarāt | upetya cūḍikeḍyāhataṃ kumbhamapaśyat || 19.12{12} || taddṛṣṭvā śaṃkitaścāsau vinayān samupāsaran | kimetatkriyate bhikṣoriti taṃ paryapṛchata || 19.13{13} || iti pṛṣṭe dvijenāsau raivato bhikṣurādarāt | tatra cīvararāgo'yamiti taṃ dvijamabravīt || 19.14{14} || asminnavasare tasyā pūrvakarmavipākataḥ | gomāṃsaraktapāṇīyaḥ sapākaḥ samapadyata || 19.15{15} || sukhaṃ duḥkhatvamānāti śuklamapyeti kālatām | vidhau vidhuratāṃ yāte dharmo'pyāyātyadharmatām || 19.16{16} || mithyāpāpaprakaṭatā janakopaḥ padacyutiḥ | apuṇyaparipākānāmetatpratyakṣalakṣaṇam || 19.17{17} || doṣaḥ samunmiṣati yātyaguṇaḥ prakāśaṃ kāryaṃ viparyayamupeti viśīryate dhīḥ || 19.18{18} || puṃsāṃ purāvihitaḥ duḥkṛtapākakāle ke ke na nāma nipatanti mahābhighātāḥ || 19.19{19} || tataḥ sa brāhmaṇo'pyatra kumbhe kimiti śaṃkitaḥ | paśyāmīti viniścitya nirīkṣitumupācarat || 19.20{20} || viruddhāmiṣagaṃdhena rudhireṇa ca śaṃkitaḥ | apaśyan sa dvijaḥ kumbhe māṃsapiṇḍaṃ supakvitaiḥ || 19.21{21} || pratyakṣadoṣamālokya dvijaḥ krodhito ruṣā | tamabhāṣata nirbhatsya tīvravaiśaśakaṃpitaḥ || 19.22{22} || aho vata sadācāraḥ sthito'yaṃ vijane vane | yasyedṛśāni karmāṇi na kasyacidiha paśyati || 19.23{23} || pravrajyāraṃjitaḥ kāyaḥ kriyā mlechajanocitā | jānāti channapāpānāṃ kaḥ kūṭavrataśāntitām || 19.24{24} || ityukte tena sākṣepaṃ sa raivato'pyaciṃtayat | doṣe pratyakṣalakṣyasmin kiṃ bravīmi niruttaraḥ || 19.25{25} || mama daivāya ghāto'yamityukte ko'numanyate | hāsyāyatanatāmeti pratyakṣyāpahnavī janaḥ || 19.26{26} || upasthitaṃ sahe sarvaṃ maunamālambya kevalam | ayaṃ me niḥpratīkāraḥ salilādagnidutthitaḥ || 19.27{27} || doṣe guṇātiśayamāśu guṇe'pi doṣaṃ paiyūṣadhāmni viṣamapyamṛtaṃ viṣe ca || saṃdarśayatyaniśamadbhutarūpameva kālendrajālikāvadhūrbhavitavyeyam || 19.28{28} || ityevaṃ manasā dhyātvā raivataḥ sa mahāmatiḥ | svadaivasmaraṇaṃ kṛtvā tasthau yogasamāhitaḥ || 19.29{29} || iti dhyānaṃ samālambya sthitaṃ taṃ raivataṃ munim | dṛṣṭvātiruṣitaścāsau saṃtaryya paryabhāṣata || 19.30{30} || are re durmate bhikṣo kimatra durjane vane | sthitvevaṃ dāruṇaṃ pāpaṃ sādhayitvā niṣīdasi || 19.31{31} || are pāpiṣṭha bhāṣasva yadarthe vālakāṃ vṛṣam | hatvātra pacyate māṃsa tvayātmano pareṇa vā || 19.32{32} || pareṇāpi hataṃ dṛṣṭvā tatpāpaiḥ parilipyase | tattvayā vṛṣabhī hatvā kathaṃ pāpairna dahyase || 19.33{33} || dhigdhiktvāmatra rebhikṣo saṃbuddhaśāsane yataḥ | pravrajyāsaṃvaraṃ dhṛtvā nirjane vana āśrayan || 19.34{34} || mahadduḥkarakarmāṇi kṛtvaivaṃ tapase'dhunā | are re śrūyate kiṃ na tvayā saṃbuddhabhāṣitam || 19.35{35} || atha śrutvāpi te tatra śraddhā na vidyate khalu | kimevaṃ pātakaṃ kṛtvā pravrajyāsaṃvaraṃ caran || 19.36{36} || kevalaṃ pāpakānyeva sādhayitvātra tiṣṭhase | pravrajito viraktātmā pariśuddhatrimaṃḍalaḥ || 19.37{37} || sarvasatvadayādṛṣṭiścarennityaṃ samāhitaḥ || 19.38{37!} || adattaṃ kasya ciddravyaṃ gṛhīyānna kathaṃ cana | dayākaruṇyayuktātmā na kuryātprāṇipīḍinam || 19.39{38} || kāmabhogamadharmeṇa naiva bhuṃjyātkadā cana | mṛṣāvādaṃ kadāpyatra naiva brūyātkathaṃ cana || 19.40{39} || pāruṣyavacanaṃ cāpi naiva brūyātkathaṃ cana | paiśunyavacanaṃ vāpi vadenna kasya citpuraḥ || 19.41{40} || saṃbhinnapralāpaṃ ca na pravadetkasya cidapi | vyāpādaṃ kasya ciccāpi bhāvayenna kathaṃ cana || 19.42{41} || abhidhyāṃ ca tathā naiva ciṃtayetkasya cidapi || 19.43{42} || mithyādṛṣṭiṃ sadā kvāpi bhāvayenna kadā cana | etāni daśapāpānāṃ mūlāni sarvathā tyajet || 19.44{43} || etāni ye samālabhya pracaranti pramādataḥ | te sarve kleśasaṃtaptā bhramanti duḥkhino bhave || 19.45{44} || tataḥ kleśāgnisaṃtaptāḥ pāpeṣveva samāhitāḥ | duḥkhānyeva sadā bhuktvā narakeṣu bhramanti te || 19.46{45} || iti matvātra saṃsāre tyaktvaitāni daśāpi hi | santo nityaṃ śubheṣveva pracaranti samāhitāḥ || 19.47{46} || śubhena sadgatiṃ yānti papina durgatiṃ sadā | ityākhyātaṃ jinaiḥ sarvaiḥ kiṃ naitacchrūyate tvayā || 19.48{47} || kathametadavajñāya pravrajitastvamācareḥ | dhikte cittaṃ yadevaṃ me govatsaṃ bhoktumichati || 19.49{48} || pravrajito hi śuddhātmā pariśuddhastrimaṇḍalaḥ | sarvasatvadayācittaścarennityaṃ samāhitaḥ || 19.50{49} || sarvasatvahitaṃ kṛtvā brahmacaryaṃ samāhitaḥ | bhikṣānnamātrasaṃkṛṣṭaḥ suniḥspṛhaścarecchubhe || 19.51{50} || samādhinirato yogī dhāraṇīparamārthabhṛt | sarvakleśān vinirjitvā sarvamāragāṇānapi || 19.52{51} || sarvān parigrahān tyaktvā nirvikalpo niraṃjanaḥ | sākṣādarhatvamāsādya brahmacaryaṃ samācaret || 19.53{52} || evaṃ pravrajito bhikṣuścarannityaṃ suśīlabhṛt | śivāṃ bodhiṃ samāsādya nirvṛtipadamāpnuyāt || 19.54{53} || tvaṃ tu pravrajito'pyevaṃ mahaddāruṇapātakam | kṛtvātra nirjane bhuktvā carase mlechacārikām || 19.55{54} || hā vatātra vinaṣṭo'si yadetatpātakānvitaḥ | sahasā narake gatvā ciraṃ duḥkhāni bhokṣyasi || 19.56{55} || kiṃ tvayā prakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ purā janmāntare katham | yadatra saugate dharmaṃ prāpto'pyevaṃ durāśayaḥ || 19.57{56} || taccarasva samādhāya prāyaścittavrataṃ punaḥ | etatpāpābhisaṃśuddhyai punarvratasamāptaye || 19.58{57} || tathā te śuddhite kāye maṃgalaṃ ca bhavetkramāt | pariśuddhastrikāyaśca pravrajyāsaṃvaraṃ cara || 19.59{58} || tadā tvaṃ sarvathā jitvā kleśānmāragaṇānnapi | sākṣādarhatvamāsādya brahmacārī bhaviṣyati || 19.60{59} || tadā tvaṃ pariśuddhātmā nirvikalpo niraṃjanaḥ | śivāṃ bodhiṃ samāsādya nirvṛtipadamāpnuyāḥ || 19.61{60} || iti tenoditaṃ śrutvā raivataḥ sa prabodhitaḥ | tathāpi maunamādhāya tathau daivābhyanusmaran || 19.62{61} || evaṃ sthitaṃ tamālokya brāhmaṇaḥ sa ruṣānvitaḥ | evaṃ dvidhā tridhāpyenaṃ paribhāṣyābhyanindayat || 19.63{62} || evaṃ dvidhā tridhāpyukte brāhmaṇena sa raivataḥ | svadaivamabhyanusmṛtvā maunenaiva nyaṣīdata || 19.64{63} || svadaivacintayastasya maunātsa brāhmaṇo ruṣā | raivataṃ tāṃ katākṣeṇa dṛṣṭvainaṃ paryabhāṣata || 19.65{64} || are re durmate bhikṣo kimevaṃ tiṣṭhase'dhunā | uttiṣṭhātra pravaṃdhitva nayāmi tvāṃ nṛpāntike || 19.66{65} || evaṃ tenodite'pyeva sthitaḥ sa raivato yatiḥ | kiṃ cinnaivāvadenmaunamevālambya nyaṣīdata || 19.67{66} || tataḥ sa brāhmaṇastasya maunādatiprakopitaḥ | murddhni pāpamiva sthūlaṃ laguḍaṃ marpayātayat || 19.68{67} || tathābhighātyamāno'pi raivataḥ sa samāhitaḥ | daivamevābhyanusmṛtvā tasthau niḥkaṃpitāśayaḥ || 19.69{68} || tathāsthitaṃ taṃ munimātmavidyaṃ daivaṃ smaraṃtaṃ hyakṛtāparādham | nināya paścātkṛtavāhudaṃḍaṃ sadastadā naṃdanabhūmibhartuḥ || 19.70{69} || tathāsthitaṃ tamālokya sa dvijaḥ pratiroṣitaḥ | raktākṣaṃ raivataṃ vaddhvā sahasānayannṛpāntike || 19.71{70} || tatra sa brāhmaṇo nītvā taṃ rājñaḥ sthitaḥ | tadvatsapiśitaṃ pakvamupasthāpya'bhyadarśayat || 19.72{71} || tataḥ sa brāhmaṇaḥ krūrastasya bhikṣo savistaram | sarvavṛttāṃtamākhyāya taṃ nṛpaṃ paryakopayat || 19.73{72} || tadvatsamāṃsamālokya nṛpatiḥ sa prakopitaḥ | raivataṃ taṃ yatiṃ vaddhvā cakre kārāgṛhātithim || 19.74{73} || nirdoṣaḥ kleśamāśnāti tambhate guptapātakaḥ | jānāti kasya kaḥ śuddhiṃ citrākāreṣvasākṣiṣu || 19.75{74} || tatra sa vaṃdhanāgāre vaṃdhito'pi sa sanmatiḥ | triratnasmaraṇaṃ kṛtvā tasthau daivānucintayan || 19.76{75} || tatraivaṃ vaṃdhanāgāre tasmin bhikṣau nivandhite | kāle na visnito rājā tadvicāre'pi nāsmarat || 19.77{76} || tadānyasmin dine tatra te vatsāḥ sarva āgatāḥ | mātṛbhiḥ saha saṃsaktāstṛṇaṃ bhuktvā niṣedire || 19.78{77!} || tān vatsānmātṛsaṃsaktān sarvānālokya sa dvijaḥ | vismitaḥ punarālokya paśyannevaṃ vyaciṃtayat || 19.79{78} || aho vatsā ime sarve kutra gatvādhunāgatāḥ | sarvatrānviṣyamānā hi kutrāpi nābhyadṛśyate || 19.80{79} || hā mamātra mahatpāpo jāyate sāṃprataṃ katham | yanmayā sahasā bhikṣorasamīkṣyāparādhyate || 19.81{80} || yathā bhikṣorghaṭe mānsaṃ dṛṣṭvaiṣāmiti cintayat | caurāyamiti taṃ bhikṣuṃ paryabhāṣaṃ ruṣābhṛtam || 19.82{81} || aparādhaṃ vinārhaṃtamapi bhikṣuṃ pratāḍayat | vaddhvā taṃ sahasā rājñaḥ puro'tra samupānayam || 19.83{82} || rājāpi mama vākyena sahasaiva nimaṃtrayan | vaddhvāśu vaṃdhanāgāre prasthāpayati sāṃpratam || 19.84{83} || tadatra kiṃ kariṣyāmi vatsāḥ sarve ihāgatāḥ | aparādhā yaterneti vadeya sāṃprataṃ katham || 19.85{84} || yadyavakṣyaṃ tathā rājā tadā me kupito nṛpaḥ | sarvasvamapahṛtvāpi prāhariṣyate māmiha || 19.86{85} || atha yadi bhayādrājño nāvadiṣyaṃstathā kvacit | nūnaṃ taṃ yatimarhantamapi rājā haniṣyate || 19.87{86} || tadāhaṃ kiṃ kariṣyāmi tadghorapātakānalaiḥ | pacyamānassadāvīcau tiṣṭheyamatiduḥkhitaḥ || 19.88{87} || tadatra kiṃ kariṣyāmi yatropāyaṃ na vidyate | sarvathāhaṃ vinaṣṭo'smi vrajeya śaraṇaṃ kuha || 19.89{88} || yadimaṃ saugataṃ bhikṣumarhantaṃ brahmacāriṇam | anaparādhinaṃ hatvā kathaṃ pāpairna lepsyate || 19.90{89} || etairhi pātakairghorairahaṃ rājā janā ime | sarve vatsyāmahe'vīcau bhuktvā duḥkhāni sarvadā || 19.91{90} || hā me daivādyateścāpi nirjane vasato'pi yat | ghaṭe'bhidṛśyate vatsamānsībhūtaṃ hi cīvaram || 19.92{91} || avaśyaṃ bhāvino bhāvā bhavantyeva na cānyathā | tadatra kiṃ kariṣyāmi bhikṣurvā kiṃ kariṣyati || 19.93{92} || tasyaiva karmadoṣeṇa māṃsībhūtaṃ hi cīvaram | atha mamaiva daivena taditi manyate na hi || 19.94{93} || tadatra kiṃ vadeyāhaṃ daivaṃ hi sarvakarmakṛti | iti mamārho'pyasya dūṣaṇaṃ nātra vidyate || 19.95{94} || tathapyetatpravṛttirna vaktavyaṃ kasya cidapi | na gaṃtavyaṃ vahiḥ kvāpi sthātavyaṃ svagṛhe sadā || 19.96{95} || kadā citskhalitā buddhirvāṇī ca vismṛtasya me | etaddhi pātakaṃ ghoraṃ samācakṣata kutra cit || 19.97{96} || tadāhaṃ niṃdyamāno'tra sarvalokairitastataḥ | bhratsyamānaḥ kathaṃ loke cariṣye duṣṭajaṃtuvat || 19.98{97} || iti dhyātvā viniścitya brāhmaṇaḥ sa viṣāditaḥ | kasyāpyetatpravṛttāṃtaṃ noce daurjanyalajjayā || 19.99{98} || tatpātakāgnisaṃtaptaḥ smṛtvārhantaṃ tameva saḥ | prāyaścittavrataṃ kurvanniva tasthau gṛhāśritaḥ || 19.100{99} || evaṃ dvādaśavarṣāṇi nṛpeṇāpi sa vismṛtaḥ | raivato vaṃdhanāgāre tasthau dhyānasamāhitaḥ || 19.101{100} || atha dvādaśavarṣānte tacchiṣyāḥ sarva āgatāḥ | tatpravṛttiṃ samākarṇya vismitāste'bhavaṃstadā || 19.102{1} || tataḥ sarve'pi te śiṣyāḥ saṃmīlya nṛpateḥ puraḥ | upetyaitatpravṛttāṃtaṃ samākhyāya nyavedayan || 19.103{2} || ārogyamastu te rājan lokān dharmeṇa pālaya | yadarthe vayamāyāmastatra bhavān prasīdatu || 19.104{3} || yadasmākaṃ gururbhikṣuraparādhaṃ vinā katham | bhavatā vaṃdhanāgāre sthāpitastadvicāraya || 19.105{4} || iti tairbhikṣubhiḥ sarvaistacchiṣyaiḥ prārthite tadā | vyomavāṇī tathākhyāya narendraṃ taṃ vyabodhayat || 19.106{5} || tatkhavāṇiṃ samākarṇya nṛpaḥ sa paribodhitaḥ | tacchiṣyaiḥ sārito bhikṣuṃ taṃ mumocāśu vaṃdhanāt || 19.107{6} || aho grāvāgralikhitā niścalā karmasaṃtatiḥ | prāptabhijño'pi yatprāpa krūrakleśadaśāṃ tathā || 19.108{7} || taṃ yatiṃ nirgataṃ dṛṣṭvā sa rājābhyānutāpitaḥ | ninindā mandapuṇyatvaṃ pramādāddhatamātmanaḥ || 19.109{8} || tadā sa nṛpati rājā sahasā tasya pādayoḥ | sāṃjaliḥ praṇatiṃ kṛtvā samutthāyaivamabravīt || 19.110{9} || bhadanto vicāryaiva pramadā yadbhavānmayā | sthāpito vaṃdhane tanme'parādhaṃ kṣaṃtumarhati || 19.111{10} || vismṛtā me sahāyāṃ ca parijñātā na kena cit | daṇḍaḥ patati śuddheṣu prāptaḥ pāpe mahīpatau || 19.112{11} || ityuktaḥ kṣitipālena kṣāntiprakṣālitāśayaḥ | raivataḥ sa nareṃdraṃ taṃ samālokyaivamabravīt || 19.113{12} || rājanna te'parādhatvaṃ mamaitatkarmajaṃ phalam | tadatra mā kṛthāḥ kheṭaṃ saugata ātmavidyutam || 19.114{13} || tatastaṃ yatimarhantaṃ sa rājā sahasādarāt | cīvareṇa samāchādya piṃḍakena samārcayat || 19.115{14} || tadaitadvṛttimākarṇya brāhmaṇaḥ sa tvarānvitaḥ | āgatya tatsabhāmadhye dattāśīḥ samupācarat || 19.116{15} || tatra sa samupāsṛtya rājñe datvā jayāśiṣām | taṃ yatiṃ sāñjalirnatvā prārthayan vinayātkṣamām || 19.117{16} || bhadanta bhavatāmevamaparādhamakārayan | tanme'parādhatāṃ kṣaṃtumarhati sarvathā bhavān || 19.118{17} || ityukte tena vipreṇa raivataḥ sa viśuddhadhīḥ | brāhmaṇaṃ taṃ viṣaṇṇāsyaṃ samālokyaivamabravīt || 19.119{18} || na manyurvidyate vipra na tvayāpakṛtaṃ mayi | mamaiva daivayā kena māṃsībhūtaṃ hi cīvaram || 19.120{19} || tatrāhaṃ maunamālambya sthito daivābhyanusmaran | tenātra kiṃ vadiṣyāmi daivā hi valavān bhave || 19.121{20} || na tvayāpākṛtaṃ kiñcidvipulakleśapātitaḥ | tanmamopanataṃ pāke svakarmasadṛśaṃ phalam || 19.122{21} || yatsautkaṇṭhatayaiva sarvavipadaḥ kurvanti kaṇṭhagrahaṃ sarvāṅgaprasabhopabhogasubhagāḥ kliśyanti yatsaṃpadaḥ | yatsvāchaṃdyasukhāspadaṃ viharaṇaṃ dīrghaṃ ca yadvaṃdhanaṃ tatpuṃsāṃ nijakarmapākaśavalaṃ saṃsāravallīphalam || 19.123{22} || iti tenārhatākhyātaṃ śrutvā naṃdaḥ sa bhūpatiḥ | vismitaḥ kautukāccaivaṃ dṛṣṭvā taṃ yatimabravīt || 19.124{23} || tavāpi sumate kasya phalametatkukarmaṇaḥ | kiṃ purā prakṛtaṃ karman tatsamākhyātumarhati || 19.125{24} || iti pṛṣṭe narendreṇa raivataḥ sa sudhiryatiḥ | taṃ nareṃdraṃ samālokya bodhayituṃ tathāvadat || 19.126{25} || sādhu śṛṇu mahārāja yanmayā prakṛtaṃ purā | tadatrāhaṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvalokaprabodhane || 19.127{26} || vārāṇasyāṃ purā krūracarito'bhūtkuthābhidhaḥ | gocauraḥ kutsikācāro gomāṃsavihitāśanaḥ || 19.128{27} || kadā citsa vane gatvā hatvā govatsamātmanā | tadvatsamāṃsamādāya sahasā tato viniryayau || 19.129{28} || tatra gorakṣiṇo vatsanaṣṭamanviṣya sarvataḥ | dṛṣṭvā taṃ māṃsabhārārttaṃ kopātsamabhidudruvuḥ || 19.130{29} || tatra sa kutha ālokya tān sarvān samupadrutān | sahasopadruto'raṇye pradudrāva vanāṃtare || 19.131{30} || tatra pratyekabuddhasya dhyānalīnasya so'grataḥ | upanikṣipya tanmāṃsaṃ tatraikānte nyalīyata || 19.132{31} || te'pi gorakṣiṇaḥ sarve sānucarāmabhidrutāḥ | tatra pratyekabuddhaṃ tamālokya samupācaran || 19.133{32} || tatra sa kutha āgatya teṣāṃ gorakṣiṇāṃ puraḥ | gomāṃsaṃ darśayitvā taṃ caurāyamityadarśayat || 19.134{33} || tatra te gobhṛtaḥ sarve gomāṃsaṃ tanmuneḥ puraḥ | dṛṣṭvaiva sahasā kopāttaṃ munimabhyaghātayat || 19.135{34} || vadhyo'yamiti taṃ vadhvā gopālāste prakopitāḥ | ākruśya sahasānītvā kārāgāre nyavaṃdhayat || 19.136{35} || tataḥ sa kutha ākarṇya taṃ yatiṃ vaṃdhane dhṛtam | paścāttāpāgnisaṃtaptastahītyevaṃ vyaciṃtayat || 19.137{36} || hā mayā pāpināpyevaṃ sādhyate pātakāni ca | avaśyaṃ vahnināvīcau kuṃhbhyāṃ pakṣye rataṃściram || 19.138{37} || yadayaṃ nirjane dhyāto pratyekabuddha ātmavit | caurāyamiti saṃdarśya vaṃdhane sthāpitomayā || 19.139{38} || etatpāpavipāke hi sarvadā narake sthitaḥ | tīvraduḥkhāgnisaṃtapta ante māṃ svakṛte phalam || 19.140{39} || hā mayaivaṃ mahāghoraṃ pātakaṃ durdhiyā kṛtam | kadā tatpātakānmukto vrajeyaṃ sadgatiṃ katham || 19.141{40} || hā sarvajña namastubhyaṃ paśya māmatipāpinam | bhavānneva jagattrātā tanme'pi trātumarhati || 19.142{41} || mayā mūḍhena duṣṭena mahāpātakamācitam | tadvimuktyāmupāyaṃ me kṛpayā dātumarhati || 19.143{42} || iti kuthaḥ sa cāṇḍālaḥ smṛtvā saṃbuddhamādarāt | paścāttāpābhisaṃtaptastasthau gehe pramohitaḥ || 19.144{43} || tataḥ sa cetanaṃ prāpya saṃbuddhasyānubhāvataḥ | sahasā tata utthāya tadantike upācarat || 19.145{44} || tatra sa samupāsṛtya tesāṃ gorakṣiṇaṃ puraḥ | kṛtāṃjalipuṭo natvā yācitvābhayamabravīt || 19.146{45} || bhavanto'tra mayā pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ tatpratidekṣyate | tadbhavaṃtaḥ samākarṇya kṣaṃtumarhaṃti sarvathā || 19.147{46} || asya pratyekabuddhasya hyaparādho na vidyate | tatra mayātiduṣṭena cauro'yamiti darśitaḥ || 19.148{47} || tadatra mucyatāmeṣa pratyekasugato muniḥ | satkṛtyābhyarcya piṃḍena mānanīyo hi sarvadā || 19.149{48} || atraitatpātakaṃ nāsya mamaiva mastake pacet | tadahameva vadhyo'tra tadayaṃ mucyatāṃ yatiḥ || 19.150{49} || iti tenoditaṃ śrutvā sarve gorakṣiṇo'pi te | ruṣṭāstaṃ sahasā vaddhvā paryyākhyāyātyatāḍayat || 19.151{50} || tattāḍanaravaṃ śrutvā sa pratyekajinaḥ sudhīḥ | gopālāṃstān samāmaṃtrya punarevaṃ samādiśat || 19.152{51} || bhavanto mucyatāmeṣa māparādhe'pi hanyatām | kṣamā hi paramaṃ dharmaṃ tatkurvantu kṣamāmiha || 19.153{52} || tantāsādyāgano yogaṃ kartumarhanti sarvathā | kiṃ daivaṃ nihataṃ hatvā yuṣmākaṃ setsyate phalam || 19.154{53} || mayaitadvaṃdhanaṃ prāptaṃ mamaiva daivayogataḥ | tadasyāpyaparādho'tra nāstītyeṣa vimucyatām || 19.155{54} || iti pratyekabuddhena tenādiṣṭaṃ niśamyate | tatheti pratibuddhitvā tatkopaṃ mumucustadā || 19.156{55} || atha te gobhṛtaḥ sarve śrutvā tasya munervacaḥ | sahasā vinatiṃ kṛtvā vaṃdhanāttaṃ vyamuṃcayat || 19.157{56} || tataste gobhṛtaḥ sarve taṃ pratyekamuniṃ mudā | cīvareṇa samāchādya samabhyarcyātyatoṣayan || 19.158{57} || tatra taṃ samupāśritya kṛtāṃjalipuṭo natāḥ | tadaparādhasaṃtaptāḥ prārthayannevamādarāt || 19.159{58} || bhagavañjñāyate'smābhirbhavato nāparādhatā | tenāsmākaṃ kṣamāṃ kartumarhatyatra bhavānapi || 19.160{59} || iti taiḥ prārthitaṃ śrutvā sa pratyekajinaḥ | tān sarvān gobhṛto dṛṣṭvā samāśvāsyaivamabravīt || 19.161{60} || bhavanto mā viṣīdantu dūṣaṇaṃ vā na vidyate | etadvṛttiṃ vijānāmi saugatā hi bhavārthavit || 19.162{61} || ityādiśya sa sarvajñaḥ pratyekabuddha utthitaḥ | tata ākāśa utplutya svāśramaṃ gate āśrayan || 19.163{62} || taddṛṣṭvā te janāḥ sarve gopālāḥ prativismitāḥ | tameva sugataṃ smṛtvā saddharme sarvadācaran || 19.164{63} || yo'sau kuthābhidho goghnaḥ praduṣṭo'haṃ tadābhavat | tatpāpairnarakeṣvevaṃ ciraṃ duḥkhāni bhuktavān || 19.165{64} || asmiñjanmanyapi prāptakleśadvādaśavārṣikam | tadasyātrāparādhaṃ na mamaitaddaivayogataḥ || 19.166{65} || iti mahārāja śubhāśubhaṃ svadaivataḥ | saṃsāre'tra sadā puṇyaṃ karttavyaṃ satsukhārthibhiḥ || 19.167{66} || puṇyamevātra saṃsāre sārasarvārthasiddhidam | puṇyaṃ vinā na siddhyante kṛtakarmāṇi sarvathā || 19.168{67} || puṇyena jāyate svarge puṇyena yānti sadgatim | puṇyena sarvadā bhadraṃ kṛtvā yāṃti jinālayam || 19.169{68} || daṃḍena mucyate vadhyaḥ puṇyasyaivānubhāvataḥ | daṃḍārho'pi prahāreṇa prahārārho'pi roṣataḥ || 19.170{69} || roṣārhā romaharṣanena mucyate puṇyato nṛpa | yāvantaḥ sūkhinaḥ sarvasaṃpatsamanvitāḥ || 19.171{70} || sarve te puṇyakarttāra iti jñeyā narādhipa | puṇyena śuddhyate cittaṃ śuddhāśayo bhavetsudhīḥ || 19.172{71} || subuddhiḥ sarvadā nityaṃ śubheṣveva samācaret | śubhācāro viśuddhāṃgaḥ satyavādī jitendriyaḥ || 19.173{72} || pariśuddhāśayo dhīro bhavetsatvahitārthabhṛt | tathaitatpuṇyayuktātmā sarvavidyākalārthavit || 19.174{73} || bhaveddharmārthavijñaśca suguṇaśrīsamanvitaḥ | tato māheśvarīsaṃpatprāpto lokahitodyataḥ || 19.175{74} || dānaṃ kṛtvā sadā saukhyaṃ bhuktyā nityaṃ śubhe caret | etatpuṇyavipākena pariśuddhastrimaṇḍalaḥ || 19.176{75} || śubhraśīlo viśuddhātmā sadāryavratamācaret | etatpuṇyānubhāvena kṣantidharmārthasādhakaḥ || 19.177{76} || svaparātmasamābhāvī caretmaitrīsukhānvitaḥ | etatpuṇyavipākena dharmotsāhaguṇānvitaḥ || 19.178{77} || sarvaduṣṭagaṇāñjitvā caretsatvahite kṛtī | etatpuṇyaprabhāvaiśca sarvakleśān vinirjayan | samādhidhāraṇīvijñaścareddhyānaṃ samāhitaḥ || 19.179{78} || etatpuṇyavipākaiśca sarvaśāstrābdhipāragaḥ | prajñāratnaṃ samāsādya mahābhijñapadaṃ labhet || 19.180{79} || etatpuṇyānubhāvaiścia sarvopāyavidhānavit | sarvasatvahitaṃ kṛtvā śubhe nityaṃ samācaret || 19.181{80} || etatpuṇyānubhāvaiśca bodhipraṇidhimānasaḥ | sarveṣāṃ maṃgalaṃ kṛtvā bhadracaryāṃ samācaret || 19.182{81} || etatpuṇyaprabhāvaiśca daśabalasamanvitaḥ | sarvamārān vinirjitya caredbodhivrataṃ sadā || 19.183{82} || etatpuṇyabalenaiva saṃbodhijñānamuttamam | mahāratnaṃ samāsādya bhavetsarvavināyakaḥ || 19.184{83} || tataḥ sarvatra lokeṣu kṛtvā bhadrāṇi sarvadā | bodhisatvo mahāsatvaḥ saṃbuddhapadamāpnuyāt || 19.185{84} || etatpuṇyānubhāvaiśca sarvāṃstraidhātukāsthitān | satvān bodhau pratisthāpya kṛtvā dharmamayaṃ jagat || 19.186{85} || etatpuṇyavipākena dharmarājastathāgataḥ | nirvṛta ālayalīno mahābuddho bhaveddhruvam || 19.187{86} || evaṃ matvā mahārāja nirvṛtipadalabdhaye | yadīchasi tathā puṇyameva karttavyamābhavaiḥ || 19.188{87} || puṇyameva mahāratnaṃ sarvatrāpi mahānugam | sarvārthasiddhidaṃ bhadraṃ saṃbuddhapadasādhanam || 19.189{88} || iti vijñāya rājendra hitvā pāpānurāgatām | puṇyānyevātra saṃsāre karttavyāni hi sarvadā || 19.190{89} || pāpena sarvadāpyevaṃ durgatīṣveva saṃgatāḥ | mūḍhā kleśāgnisaṃtaptā bhramanti bhavacārake || 19.191{90} || yāvaṃto duḥkhito duṣṭā saṃsāre kleśatāpitāḥ | sarve te pāpakarttāra iti buddhaiḥ prakathyate || 19.192{91} || iti matvā mahārāja sadā bhadraṃ yadīchasi | hitvā pāpānurāgatvaṃ saddharmaṃ cinu sādaram || 19.193{92} || saddharmaṃ saugataṃ dharmaṃ yallokaṃ hitasādhanam | tenātra sarvadharmāṇāṃ pravaramagramucyate || 19.194{93} || tadetaddharmasaṃprāptyai triratnaśaraṇaṃ gataḥ | satkṛtya śraddhayā nityaṃ bhajasva samupasthitaḥ || 19.195{94} || triratne yatkṛtaṃ karmaṃ śubhaṃ vāpyaśubhaṃ tathā | tatphalamaprameyamasaṃkhyeya mahattaram || 19.196{95} || etatpuṇyānubhāvena sarve buddhā munīśvarāḥ | jagaddharmamayaṃ kṛtvā niḥkleśā parinirvṛtāḥ || 19.197{96} || evaṃ vijñāya bhūmīndra hitvā pāparatiṃ sadā | triratnabhajanaṃ kṛtvā cara nityaṃ sadā śubhe || 19.198{97} || abhuktaṃ kṣīyate naiva kvāpi karma śubhāśubham | yenaiva yatkṛtaṃ karmaṃ tenaiva bhujyate phalam || 19.199{98} || nāgnibhirdahyate karmaṃ dahyate deha eva hi | nodakaiḥ klidyate karmaṃ klidyate tanureva ca || 19.200{99} || nānilaiḥ śuṣyate karmaṃ kāya evābhiśuṣyate | na kṣītau kṣīyate karmaṃ kṣīyate tanureva hi || 19.201{100} || anyathāpi bhavennaiva vipāke karmaṇaḥ phalam | yathaiva yatkṛtaṃ yena tenaiva bhujyate tathā || 19.202{1} || kṛṣṇasya karmaṇaḥ pāke duḥkhataiva sadā bhave | śubhasya sukhatā nityaṃ miśritasyobhayaṃ tathā || 19.203{2} || evaṃ karmavipākotthaṃ śubhāśubhaphalaṃ sadā | bhuktvā sarvatra saṃsāre bhramanti sarvajaṃtavaḥ || 19.204{3} || evaṃ matvā mahārāja kṛṣṇāni miśritāni ca | vihāyātra śobheṣveva caritavyaṃ sadā bhave || 19.205{4} || iti tenārhatādiṣṭaṃ śrutvānaṃdaḥ sa bhūpatiḥ | tatheti prativijñapya sajanaḥ prābhya naṃdataḥ || 19.206{5} || tataḥ sa nṛpatirbhūyo raivataṃ taṃ mahāmatim | sucīvaraiḥ samāchādya sāṃjaliḥ praṇatiṃ vyadhāt || 19.207{6} || punarutthāya bhūpālastamarhantaṃ kṛtāṃjaliḥ | praṇatvā vinayaṃ kurvan kramācca prārthayattathā || 19.208{7} || bhadantātra prasīdasva kṣamasva me'parādhatām | sarvadā darśanaṃ datvānugrahaṃ kartumarhasi || 19.209{8} || ityukte'nena bhūpena raivataḥ sa prasāditaḥ | haṃsarāja ivāplutya bhāsayan khe samāyayau || 19.210{9} || tatrākāśe samāsīnaḥ prātihāryaṃ pradarśayan | lokaiḥ saṃdṛśyamāno'sau dhyātvā tasthau samujvalan || 19.211{10} || tatastairbhikṣubhiḥ śiṣyaiḥ samanvitaḥ prabhāsayan | tathākāśāścaraṃ gatvā svāśrame samupāśrayan || 19.212{11} || taddṛṣṭvā sa nṛpo lokaiḥ sahātivismayānvitaḥ | triratnabhajanaṃ kurvan pracacāra sadā mudā || 19.213{12} || evaṃ hyadoṣena viśeṣayuktyā pratyakṣaṇakṣyīkṛtalakṣaṇena | alaṃkṛtaḥ sādhujanaḥ khalena nighnīkṛto'pi na vikārameti || 19.214{13} || evaṃ svadaivayogena jāyate hyaparādhatā | tannānyasyāparādhatvaṃ vaktavyaṃ kena citkva cit || 19.215{14} || iti me guruṇākhyātaṃ tathātra kathyate mayā | iti matvā mahārāja sadā dharme samācara || 19.216{15} || prajāścāpi tathā rājan bodhayitvā prayatnataḥ | bodhimārge pratiṣṭhāpya pālayasva sadādarāt || 19.217{16} || tathā te maṃgalaṃ nityaṃ sarvaṃ cāpi bhavetsadā | kramādbodhiṃ samāsādya saṃbuddhapadamāpnuyāḥ || 19.218{17} || iti satyaṃ parijñāya triratnaśaraṇaṃ gataḥ | satkṛtya śraddhayā nityaṃ bhajasvātra samāhitaḥ || 19.219{18} || iti tenārhatādiṣṭaṃ śrutvāśokaḥ sa bhūpatiḥ | tathā hīti pratijñapya prābhyanandatsapārṣadaḥ || 19.220{19} || satkṛtyedaṃ narā ye kalimatidaraṇaṃ raivatasyāvadanaṃ śṛṇvanti śrāvayanti pramuditamanaso bhaktiśraddhāprasannāḥ | te sarve'pyevamatra vimalasumanasaḥ sarvadā satsukhāni bhuktvā kṛtvā subhadraṃ jinavaranilaye saṃprayānti pramodām || 19.221{20} || iti ratnāvadānatatve raivatāvadānaṃ samāptam
